Файл: README.md

# Frontend Build Scripts

## generate-types.mjs

Автоматически генерирует TypeScript типы из JSON Schema файлов.

### Использование

```bash
node scripts/generate-types.mjs
```

Или через npm:

```bash
npm run gen:types
```

### Как это работает

1. Читает все `*.schema.json` файлы из `src/types/schemas/`
2. Использует `json-schema-to-typescript` для конвертации в TypeScript интерфейсы
3. Добавляет удобные type aliases (например, `DataSource` вместо `HttpsGithub...`)
4. Записывает результат в `src/types/generated.ts`

### Требования

- Node.js v14+
- Пакет `json-schema-to-typescript` должен быть установлен

### Вывод

Генерирует файл `src/types/generated.ts` со следующей структурой:

```typescript
// Полные интерфейсы с длинными именами
export interface HttpsGithub... { ... }

// Удобные алиасы
export type User = HttpsGithub...;
export type Project = ...;
```

### Примечания

- **НЕ редактируйте** `generated.ts` вручную - он перезаписывается при каждой генерации
- Скрипт автоматически запускается при `npm run build`
- Для добавления новых типов, добавьте соответствующий `.schema.json` файл



================================================================================
Файл: generate-types.mjs
Путь: scripts/generate-types.mjs
================================================================================

#!/usr/bin/env node

import { compileFromFile } from 'json-schema-to-typescript';
import { promises as fs } from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

const schemasDir = path.join(__dirname, '../src/types/schemas');
const outputFile = path.join(__dirname, '../src/types/generated.ts');

async function generateTypes() {
  const files = await fs.readdir(schemasDir);
  const schemaFiles = files.filter(f => f.endsWith('.schema.json'));
  
  const types = [];
  const typeMapping = {}; // Map from schema file name to generated interface name
  const header = `/* eslint-disable */
/**
 * This file was automatically generated by json-schema-to-typescript.
 * DO NOT MODIFY IT BY HAND. Instead, modify the source JSON Schema files,
 * and run 'npm run gen:types' to regenerate this file.
 */

`;

  for (const file of schemaFiles) {
    const filePath = path.join(schemasDir, file);
    const typeName = path.basename(file, '.schema.json');
    
    console.log(`Generating types for ${file}...`);
    
    try {
      const ts = await compileFromFile(filePath, {
        bannerComment: '',
        style: {
          semi: true,
          singleQuote: true,
          trailingComma: 'es5',
        },
        unknownAny: false,
        declareExternallyReferenced: true,
      });
      
      // Extract the generated interface name from the output
      const interfaceMatch = ts.match(/export interface (\w+)/);
      if (interfaceMatch) {
        typeMapping[typeName] = interfaceMatch[1];
      }
      
      types.push(ts);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`Error generating types for ${file}:`, error.message);
      process.exit(1);
    }
  }
  
  // Add convenient type aliases at the end
  const aliases = Object.entries(typeMapping)
    .map(([name, fullName]) => `export type ${name} = ${fullName};`)
    .join('\n');
  
  const content = header + types.join('\n') + '\n\n// Convenient type aliases\n' + aliases + '\n';
  await fs.writeFile(outputFile, content, 'utf-8');
  
  console.log(`✅ Successfully generated types to ${outputFile}`);
}

generateTypes().catch(error => {
  console.error('Fatal error:', error);
  process.exit(1);
});

Файл: App.tsx
Путь: src/App.tsx
================================================================================

﻿import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import './i18n';
import { BrowserRouter as Router, Routes, Route, useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ThemeProvider } from './components/ThemeProvider';
import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from './contexts/AuthContext';
import AuthGuard from './components/AuthGuard';
import { AuthLoading } from './components/AuthLoading';
import { TopBar } from './components/TopBar';
import { BottomBar } from './components/BottomBar';
import { ServerUnavailableBanner } from './components/ServerUnavailableBanner';
import DiscoveryPage from './pages/DiscoveryPage';
import ShareViewPage from './pages/ShareViewPage';
import VerifiedPage from './pages/VerifiedPage';
import VerifiedViewPage from './pages/VerifiedViewPage';
import Homepage from './pages/homepage';
import TermsOfUsage from './pages/TermsOfUsage';
import PrivacyNotice from './pages/PrivacyNotice';
import LegalModal from './components/LegalModal';
import StartupError from './components/StartupError';
import { getFirebaseInitError } from './lib/firebase';

function AppContent() {
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState<'terms' | 'privacy' | null>(null);
  const { user, loading } = useAuth();

  // Check if we're on a legal page route
  const isLegalPage = location.pathname === '/terms' || location.pathname === '/privacy';
  
  // Determine which page to show
  const isUnfold = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('app') === 'unfold';
  
  // Handle modal from query parameter
  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    const modal = params.get('modal');
    if (modal === 'terms' || modal === 'privacy') {
      setShowModal(modal);
    } else {
      setShowModal(null);
    }
  }, [location.search]);

  // Handle legal page routes - show modal
  useEffect(() => {
    if (location.pathname === '/terms') {
      setShowModal('terms');
    } else if (location.pathname === '/privacy') {
      setShowModal('privacy');
    }
  }, [location.pathname]);

  const handleCloseModal = () => {
    setShowModal(null);
    // If we're on a legal page route, go back to the previous page
    if (isLegalPage) {
      navigate(-1);
    } else {
      // Otherwise just remove the modal query param
      const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
      params.delete('modal');
      const newSearch = params.toString();
      navigate({ search: newSearch ? `?${newSearch}` : '' }, { replace: true });
    }
  };

  // Show loading state while checking authentication
  if (loading) {
    return <AuthLoading />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="layout-main">
      <div className="main-content">
        <TopBar />
        <ServerUnavailableBanner />
        <div className="content-area">
          <Routes>
            <Route path="/shared/:token" element={<ShareViewPage />} />
            <Route path="/verified" element={<VerifiedPage />} />
            <Route path="/verified/:code" element={<VerifiedViewPage />} />
            <Route path="/" element={isUnfold ? (<AuthGuard><DiscoveryPage /></AuthGuard>) : (user ? (<AuthGuard><DiscoveryPage /></AuthGuard>) : (<Homepage />))} />
            <Route path="/terms" element={isUnfold ? (<AuthGuard><DiscoveryPage /></AuthGuard>) : (<Homepage />)} />
            <Route path="/privacy" element={isUnfold ? (<AuthGuard><DiscoveryPage /></AuthGuard>) : (<Homepage />)} />
          </Routes>
        </div>
        <BottomBar />
        
        {/* Modal overlay */}
        {showModal && <LegalModal type={showModal} onClose={handleCloseModal} />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function App() {
  const firebaseError = getFirebaseInitError();
  
  return (
    <ThemeProvider>
      {firebaseError ? (
        <StartupError error={firebaseError} />
      ) : (
        <Router>
          <AuthProvider>
            <AppContent />
          </AuthProvider>
        </Router>
      )}
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}

# TypeScript Types

Этот каталог содержит автогенерированные TypeScript типы из Go моделей backend.

## Структура

```
types/
├── schemas/           # JSON Schema файлы (автогенерированные из Go)
│   ├── User.schema.json
│   ├── Project.schema.json
│   └── DataSource.schema.json
├── generated.ts       # TypeScript интерфейсы (автогенерированные из JSON Schema)
├── index.ts           # Экспорты типов для использования в приложении
└── README.md          # Этот файл
```

## Использование

```typescript
import { User, Project, DataSource } from '@/types';

// Используйте типы в компонентах
const user: User = { ... };
const project: Project = { ... };
```

## Генерация типов

**⚠️ НЕ РЕДАКТИРУЙТЕ файлы `generated.ts` и `schemas/*.json` вручную!**

Эти файлы автоматически генерируются из Go моделей.

### Автоматическая генерация (рекомендуется)

При запуске `npm run build` типы генерируются автоматически.

### Ручная генерация

```bash
# 1. Генерация JSON схем из Go моделей
npm run gen:schemas

# 2. Генерация TypeScript типов из схем
npm run gen:types
```

## Добавление новых типов

См. [docs/development/type-generation.md](../../../docs/development/type-generation.md)

## Доступные типы

- `User` - пользователь системы
- `Project` - проект
- `DataSource` - источник данных

Полный список полей и их типов смотрите в файле `generated.ts`.

/**
 * Agent types - unified interface for all agents
 * 
 * Both Data Agent and Entities Agent use the same communication patterns:
 * - Task: input JSON sent to agent
 * - Result: output JSON returned by agent
 * - Update: real-time progress updates via WebSocket
 */

// ============================================================================
// Common Types
// ============================================================================

/** Base context required for all agent tasks */
export interface AgentContext {
  tenantId: string;
  projectId: string; // REQUIRED
  userId: string;
}

/** Optional metadata for agent tasks */
export interface TaskMetadata {
  interactionId?: string;
  messageId?: string;
  custom?: Record<string, any>;
}

/** Real-time progress update from agent */
export interface AgentUpdate {
  taskId: string;
  agentId: string;
  agentName: string;
  stage: 'searching' | 'analyzing' | 'planning' | 'executing' | 'saving' | 'completed' | 'error';
  progress: number; // 0.0 - 1.0
  message: string;
  data?: Record<string, any>;
  timestamp: string;
  error?: string;
}

/** Agent information for listing */
export interface AgentInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  displayName: string;
  description: string;
  skills: string[];
  type: 'internal' | 'external';
  isExternal: boolean;
}

// ============================================================================
// Data Agent Types
// ============================================================================

/** Data Agent Task - request for data collection */
export interface DataAgentTask {
  context: AgentContext;
  query: string;
  granularity?: 'monthly' | 'quarterly' | 'yearly' | 'annual';
  timeRange: {
    from: string; // ISO date string
    to: string; // ISO date string
  };
  region?: string;
  category?: string;
  metadata?: TaskMetadata;
}

/** Data Agent Result */
export interface DataAgentResult {
  dataPoints: Array<Record<string, any>>;
  metadata: {
    sources: Array<Record<string, any>>;
    methods: Array<Record<string, any>>;
    usedData: Array<Record<string, any>>;
    assumptions: Array<Record<string, any>>;
  };
  confidence: number; // 0.0 - 1.0
  explanation: string;
}

// ============================================================================
// Entities Agent Types
// ============================================================================

/** Entity input for Entities Agent */
export interface EntityInput {
  id?: string;
  name: string;
  type: string;
  knownAliases?: string[];
}

/** Entities Agent Task - request for entity research */
export interface EntitiesAgentTask {
  context: AgentContext;
  entities: EntityInput[];
  maxDepth?: number; // 1-5, default: 2
  includeDetails?: boolean; // default: true
  metadata?: TaskMetadata;
}

/** Entities Agent Result */
export interface EntitiesAgentResult {
  entities: Array<Record<string, any>>;
  relations: Array<Record<string, any>>;
  confidence: number; // 0.0 - 1.0
  explanation: string;
  sources: Array<Record<string, any>>;
}

// ============================================================================
// Unified Agent Types (for generic usage)
// ============================================================================

/** Unified agent task - can be either Data or Entities */
export type AgentTask = DataAgentTask | EntitiesAgentTask;

/** Unified agent result - can be either Data or Entities */
export type AgentResult = DataAgentResult | EntitiesAgentResult;

/** Agent execution response */
export interface AgentExecutionResponse {
  result: AgentResult;
  agentId: string;
  agentName: string;
}

/** List of available agents */
export interface AgentsListResponse {
  agents: AgentInfo[];
}

/**
 * Artifact-related types and utilities
 * These extend the auto-generated CoreDoc type with artifact-specific helpers
 */

import type { CoreDoc } from './generated';

// Type guards
export function isArtifact(doc: CoreDoc): boolean {
  return doc.docType === 'dynamic_artifact' && doc.artifactConfig !== undefined;
}

export function isStaticDoc(doc: CoreDoc): boolean {
  return !doc.docType || doc.docType === 'static';
}

// Artifact-specific types for convenience
export type Artifact = CoreDoc & {
  docType: 'dynamic_artifact';
  artifactConfig: NonNullable<CoreDoc['artifactConfig']>;
};

export type StaticDoc = CoreDoc & {
  docType?: 'static';
  artifactConfig?: never;
};

// Format and Focus display names
export const ArtifactFormatLabels: Record<string, string> = {
  text: 'Text Document',
  table: 'Data Table',
  report: 'Report',
  presentation: 'Presentation',
};

export const ArtifactFocusLabels: Record<string, string> = {
  brief: 'Brief Summary',
  analysis: 'In-depth Analysis',
  narrative: 'Narrative',
  proposal: 'Proposal',
  technical: 'Technical Documentation',
  executive: 'Executive Summary',
};

// Version comparison utilities
export interface VersionComparison {
  versionA: string;
  versionB: string;
  documentDiff: {
    added: string[];
    removed: string[];
    modified: string[];
  };
  sectionDiffs: Record<string, {
    contentChanged: boolean;
    promptChanged: boolean;
    modelChanged: boolean;
    qualityDelta: number;
  }>;
}

// Quality helpers
export function getQualityColor(quality: number): string {
  if (quality >= 0.8) return 'hsl(120, 60%, 50%)'; // green
  if (quality >= 0.6) return 'hsl(45, 80%, 55%)'; // yellow
  return 'hsl(0, 70%, 55%)'; // red
}

export function getQualityLabel(quality: number): string {
  if (quality >= 0.9) return 'Excellent';
  if (quality >= 0.8) return 'Good';
  if (quality >= 0.7) return 'Fair';
  if (quality >= 0.6) return 'Moderate';
  return 'Needs Improvement';
}

// Section quality calculation
export function calculateSectionQuality(
  coherence: number,
  completeness: number,
  relevance: number
): number {
  // Weighted average: relevance is most important
  return (coherence * 0.3 + completeness * 0.3 + relevance * 0.4);
}

// Context change detection (for auto-update triggers)
export interface ContextChangeMetrics {
  newMessagesCount: number;
  newDocumentsCount: number;
  contextChangePercent: number;
  keywordsMatched: string[];
  searchResultsChanged: boolean;
}

export function shouldTriggerAutoUpdate(
  metrics: ContextChangeMetrics,
  config: NonNullable<NonNullable<CoreDoc['artifactConfig']>['autoUpdateConfig']>
): boolean {
  if (!config.conditions) return true;

  const conditions = config.conditions;

  // Check minimum new messages
  if (conditions.minNewMessages && metrics.newMessagesCount < conditions.minNewMessages) {
    return false;
  }

  // Check minimum context change
  if (conditions.minContextChange && metrics.contextChangePercent < conditions.minContextChange) {
    return false;
  }

  // Check keywords
  if (conditions.keywords && conditions.keywords.length > 0) {
    if (metrics.keywordsMatched.length === 0) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Check search query changed
  if (conditions.searchQueryChanged && !metrics.searchResultsChanged) {
    return false;
  }

  return true;
}

// Version retention helpers
export function shouldRetainVersion(
  version: NonNullable<CoreDoc['artifactConfig']>['versions'][0],
  allVersions: NonNullable<CoreDoc['artifactConfig']>['versions'],
  retentionCount: number
): boolean {
  // Always keep the first version
  if (version.id === allVersions[allVersions.length - 1]?.id) {
    return true;
  }

  // Always keep the last N versions
  const recentVersions = allVersions.slice(0, retentionCount);
  if (recentVersions.some(v => v.id === version.id)) {
    return true;
  }

  // For older versions, keep one per day/week (compression logic)
  // This would be implemented based on timestamp analysis
  return false;
}

export interface ExternalDocRef {
  provider: string; // e.g., gdrive | onedrive | box | sharepoint
  url: string;      // canonical view URL
  resourceId?: string;
  driveId?: string;
  ownerEmail?: string;
  eTag?: string;
  mimeType?: string;
}

export interface CoreDoc {
  id: string;
  tenantId: string;
  projectId: string;
  filename: string;
  contentType: string;
  description?: string;
  sizeBytes?: number;
  storagePath?: string;       // gs://bucket/path or similar
  external?: ExternalDocRef;  // if referenced externally
  createdBy?: string;
  createdAt: string;          // ISO string in frontend
  updatedAt: string;          // ISO string in frontend
}

/**
 * Примеры использования автогенерированных типов из backend
 * 
 * Этот файл демонстрирует, как использовать типы User, Project, DataSource
 * для обеспечения type-safety в приложении.
 */

import type { User, Project, DataSource } from './index';

// ============================================================================
// Пример 1: Создание объектов с полной типизацией
// ============================================================================

export const createExampleUser = (): User => {
  return {
    id: 'user-123',
    tenantId: 'tenant-456',
    email: 'user@example.com',
    displayName: 'John Doe',
    role: 'admin',
    status: 'active',
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    schemaVersion: '1.0',
    // Опциональные поля можно опустить
    projectRoles: {
      'project-1': 'owner',
      'project-2': 'member',
    },
  };
};

export const createExampleProject = (): Project => {
  return {
    id: 'project-789',
    pk: 'Projects/project-789',
    tenantId: 'tenant-456',
    displayName: 'Research Project',
    description: 'AI-powered research and discovery',
    status: 'active',
    ownerUserId: 'user-123',
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    view: 'discovery',
    aiguided: true,
  };
};

// ============================================================================
// Пример 2: Функции с типизированными параметрами и возвращаемыми значениями
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Получить полное имя пользователя или email если имя не указано
 */
export function getUserDisplayName(user: User): string {
  return user.displayName || user.email;
}

/**
 * Проверить, является ли пользователь администратором
 */
export function isUserAdmin(user: User): boolean {
  return user.role === 'admin';
}

/**
 * Получить роль пользователя в проекте
 */
export function getUserProjectRole(user: User, projectId: string): string | undefined {
  return user.projectRoles?.[projectId];
}

/**
 * Проверить, активен ли проект
 */
export function isProjectActive(project: Project): boolean {
  return project.status === 'active';
}

/**
 * Получить количество дней с момента создания проекта
 */
export function getProjectAge(project: Project): number {
  const created = new Date(project.createdAt);
  const now = new Date();
  const diffTime = Math.abs(now.getTime() - created.getTime());
  const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  return diffDays;
}

  return null;

  return [];

/**
 * Проверить, является ли источник Telegram каналом
 */
export function isTelegramChannel(source: DataSource): boolean {
  return source.kind === 'telegram_channel';
}

/**
 * Получить URL веб-источника
 */
export function getWebSourceUrl(source: DataSource): string | null {
  if (source.kind !== 'web') return null;
  return source.sourceDetails.uri ?? source.sourceDetails.sourceUri ?? null;
}

// ============================================================================
// Пример 6: Утилиты для фильтрации и сортировки
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Отфильтровать активные проекты
 */
export function filterActiveProjects(projects: Project[]): Project[] {
  return projects.filter(isProjectActive);
}

/**
 * Отсортировать проекты по дате последнего взаимодействия
 */
export function sortProjectsByLastInteraction(projects: Project[]): Project[] {
  return [...projects].sort((a, b) => {
    const aTime = a.lastInteractionAt ? new Date(a.lastInteractionAt).getTime() : 0;
    const bTime = b.lastInteractionAt ? new Date(b.lastInteractionAt).getTime() : 0;
    return bTime - aTime; // Новые первыми
  });
}

/**
 * Отфильтровать источники по типу
 */
export function filterSourcesByKind(
  sources: DataSource[],
  kind: string
): DataSource[] {
  return sources.filter((source) => source.kind === kind);
}

/**
 * Отсортировать источники по trust score (от высокого к низкому)
 */
export function sortSourcesByTrust(sources: DataSource[]): DataSource[] {
  return [...sources].sort((a, b) => a.displayName.localeCompare(b.displayName));
}

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  User,
  signInWithEmailAndPassword,
  createUserWithEmailAndPassword,
  sendPasswordResetEmail,
  signOut as firebaseSignOut,
  onAuthStateChanged,
  deleteUser,
  signInWithPopup,
} from 'firebase/auth';
import { auth, googleAuthProvider } from '../lib/firebase';
import { api } from '../lib/api';

type SubscriptionTier = 'free' | 'pro' | 'max';

interface Subscription {
  id: string;
  tenantId: string;
  userId: string;
  tier: SubscriptionTier;
  status: 'active' | 'expired' | 'cancelled';
  startedAt: string;
  currentPeriodStart: string;
  currentPeriodEnd: string;
  nextBillingDate?: string;
  voucherId?: string;
  paymentProvider?: string;
  paymentId?: string;
  paypalPlanId?: string;
  paypalAgreementId?: string;
  paypalSubscriptionId?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

interface AuthContextType {
  user: User | null;
  currentUser: User | null;
  loading: boolean;
  subscription: Subscription | null;
  subscriptionLoading: boolean;
  refreshSubscription: () => Promise<void>;
  signIn: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
  signUp: (email: string, password: string, accountType: 'personal' | 'corporate', displayName?: string) => Promise<void>;
  signInWithGoogle: () => Promise<void>;
  resetPassword: (email: string) => Promise<void>;
  signOut: () => Promise<void>;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [subscription, setSubscription] = useState<Subscription | null>(null);
  const [subscriptionLoading, setSubscriptionLoading] = useState(false);

  // Fetch subscription when user is authenticated
  const fetchSubscription = async (firebaseUser: User | null) => {
    if (!firebaseUser?.uid) {
      setSubscription(null);
      return;
    }
    
    setSubscriptionLoading(true);
    try {
      const sub = await api.getSubscription();
      setSubscription(sub);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[AuthContext] Failed to fetch subscription:', error);
      // Don't set subscription to null on error - keep previous value
      // This prevents clearing subscription if there's a temporary network issue
    } finally {
      setSubscriptionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!auth) {
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    const unsubscribe = onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (firebaseUser) => {
      setUser(firebaseUser);
      setLoading(false);
      
      // Fetch subscription after authentication
      if (firebaseUser) {
        // Small delay to ensure token is available
        setTimeout(() => {
          fetchSubscription(firebaseUser);
        }, 100);
      } else {
        setSubscription(null);
      }
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  }, []);

  // Refresh subscription manually (e.g., after applying voucher)
  const refreshSubscription = async () => {
    await fetchSubscription(user);
  };

  const signIn = async (email: string, password: string) => {
    if (!auth) throw new Error('Auth is not initialized');
    await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password);
  };

  const signUp = async (email: string, password: string, accountType: 'personal' | 'corporate', displayName?: string) => {
    let firebaseUser: User | null = null;
    try {
      // 0) Waitlist check (must be approved)
      try {
        const res = await (await import('../lib/api')).api.waitlistCheck(email);
        if (!res.found || (res.status || '').toLowerCase() !== 'approved') {
          throw new Error('This email is not approved for Private Beta. Please join the waitlist.');
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        throw e;
      }

      // Step 1: Create Firebase user
      if (!auth) throw new Error('Auth is not initialized');
      const userCredential = await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password);
      firebaseUser = userCredential.user;

      // Step 2: Create user in backend
      await api.createUser({
        firebaseUid: firebaseUser.uid,
        email: firebaseUser.email!,
        accountType,
        displayName: displayName || undefined,
      });

      console.log('✅ User successfully created in both Firebase and backend');
    } catch (error: any) {
      // Rollback: delete Firebase user if backend creation failed
      if (firebaseUser) {
        console.error('❌ Backend user creation failed, rolling back Firebase user:', error);
        try {
          await deleteUser(firebaseUser);
          console.log('✅ Firebase user rolled back');
        } catch (deleteError) {
          console.error('❌ Failed to rollback Firebase user:', deleteError);
        }
      }
      throw error;
    }
  };

  const signInWithGoogle = async () => {
    if (!auth) throw new Error('Auth is not initialized');
    
    const userCredential = await signInWithPopup(auth, googleAuthProvider);
    const firebaseUser = userCredential.user;
    const email = firebaseUser.email;
    
    if (!email) {
      throw new Error('Google account does not have an email address');
    }

    // Check if user exists in backend
    try {
      await api.getUser(firebaseUser.uid);
      // User exists, authentication complete
      console.log('✅ User signed in with Google');
    } catch (error: any) {
      // User doesn't exist in backend, need to create
      // Check waitlist first
      try {
        const res = await api.waitlistCheck(email);
        if (!res.found || (res.status || '').toLowerCase() !== 'approved') {
          // Rollback: sign out and delete Firebase user
          await firebaseSignOut(auth);
          if (firebaseUser) {
            try {
              await deleteUser(firebaseUser);
            } catch (deleteError) {
              console.error('Failed to rollback Firebase user:', deleteError);
            }
          }
          throw new Error('This email is not approved for Private Beta. Please join the waitlist.');
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        // Rollback on waitlist check failure
        await firebaseSignOut(auth);
        if (firebaseUser) {
          try {
            await deleteUser(firebaseUser);
          } catch (deleteError) {
            console.error('Failed to rollback Firebase user:', deleteError);
          }
        }
        throw e;
      }

      // Determine account type based on email domain
      const PUBLIC_DOMAINS = [
        'gmail.com', 'yahoo.com', 'hotmail.com', 'outlook.com', 'aol.com',
        'icloud.com', 'mail.com', 'protonmail.com', 'yandex.ru', 'mail.ru',
        'live.com', 'msn.com', 'me.com', 'mac.com'
      ];
      const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();
      const accountType: 'personal' | 'corporate' = PUBLIC_DOMAINS.includes(domain || '') ? 'personal' : 'corporate';

      // Create user in backend
      try {
        await api.createUser({
          firebaseUid: firebaseUser.uid,
          email: email,
          accountType,
          displayName: firebaseUser.displayName || undefined,
        });
        console.log('✅ User successfully created in backend after Google sign-in');
      } catch (createError: any) {
        // Rollback: sign out and delete Firebase user
        await firebaseSignOut(auth);
        if (firebaseUser) {
          try {
            await deleteUser(firebaseUser);
          } catch (deleteError) {
            console.error('Failed to rollback Firebase user:', deleteError);
          }
        }
        throw createError;
      }
    }
  };

  const resetPassword = async (email: string) => {
    if (!auth) throw new Error('Auth is not initialized');
    await sendPasswordResetEmail(auth, email);
  };

  const signOut = async () => {
    if (!auth) return;
    await firebaseSignOut(auth);
  };

  const value = {
    user,
    currentUser: user,
    loading,
    subscription,
    subscriptionLoading,
    refreshSubscription,
    signIn,
    signUp,
    signInWithGoogle,
    resetPassword,
    signOut,
  };

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
};

# Agents Integration - Frontend Summary

## ✅ Completed

### 1. TypeScript Types (`web/src/types/agents.ts`)
- ✅ Unified agent types (AgentContext, TaskMetadata, AgentUpdate)
- ✅ Data Agent types (DataAgentTask, DataAgentResult)
- ✅ Entities Agent types (EntitiesAgentTask, EntitiesAgentResult, EntityInput)
- ✅ Common types (AgentInfo, AgentExecutionResponse, AgentsListResponse)
- ✅ All types exported from `web/src/types/index.ts`

### 2. API Client (`web/src/lib/api.ts`)
- ✅ `listAgents()`: Get list of available agents
- ✅ `executeDataAgent(projectId, task)`: Execute Data Agent
- ✅ `executeEntitiesAgent(projectId, task)`: Execute Entities Agent
- ✅ `executeAgent(projectId, agentId, task)`: Generic execution method
- ✅ All methods are fully typed

### 3. Agent Store (`web/src/stores/agentsStore.ts`)
- ✅ Zustand store for agent state management
- ✅ `loadAgents()`: Load available agents
- ✅ `executeDataAgent()`, `executeEntitiesAgent()`, `executeAgent()`: Execute agents
- ✅ `handleUpdate()`: Process WebSocket updates
- ✅ `getTaskState()`: Get task state by taskId
- ✅ `clearTask()`, `clearAllTasks()`: Task cleanup
- ✅ Active tasks tracking with progress, stage, and status

### 4. WebSocket Integration (`web/src/stores/discoveryStore.ts`)
- ✅ Added handler for `agent.update` events
- ✅ Routes updates to `agentsStore.handleUpdate()`
- ✅ Automatic integration with existing WebSocket connection

### 5. Documentation (`web/src/stores/AGENTS_README.md`)
- ✅ Complete usage guide for both agents
- ✅ Code examples for Data Agent and Entities Agent
- ✅ WebSocket event documentation
- ✅ Type safety guidelines

## 🎯 Key Features

### Unified Communication Pattern
Both agents use **identical** communication patterns:
- **Task**: JSON input (typed)
- **Result**: JSON output (typed)
- **Updates**: Real-time WebSocket events (`agent.update`)

### Type Safety
- All types are strictly typed
- TypeScript ensures type safety across the integration
- Types exported from centralized `types/index.ts`

### Real-time Progress Tracking
- WebSocket events automatically update agent state
- Progress tracking (0.0 - 1.0)
- Stage tracking (searching, analyzing, planning, executing, saving, completed, error)
- Error handling

## 📋 Available Agents

### 1. Data Agent (`data`)
- **Purpose**: Collects and aggregates data from various sources
- **Skills**: `data_collection`, `osint`, `data_aggregation`, `approximation`
- **Input**: Query, time range, granularity, region, category
- **Output**: Data points with metadata (sources, methods, assumptions)

### 2. Entities Agent (`entities`)
- **Purpose**: Searches for information about entities and discovers relations
- **Skills**: `web_search`, `entity_extraction`, `relation_discovery`
- **Input**: Array of entities, max depth, include details flag
- **Output**: Enriched entities, relations, sources

## 🔌 Integration Points

1. **API Client**: `web/src/lib/api.ts`
   - REST endpoints for agent operations
   - Automatic authentication via Firebase token

2. **Agent Store**: `web/src/stores/agentsStore.ts`
   - State management for agents
   - Task execution and tracking

3. **WebSocket**: `web/src/stores/discoveryStore.ts`
   - Real-time updates via `agent.update` events
   - Automatic routing to agent store

4. **Types**: `web/src/types/agents.ts`
   - Complete type definitions
   - Exported from `web/src/types/index.ts`

## 📝 Next Steps (UI Implementation)

The infrastructure is ready. To implement the UI:

1. **List Agents**: Use `useAgentsStore().agents` to display available agents
2. **Execute Agent**: Call `executeDataAgent()` or `executeEntitiesAgent()`
3. **Show Progress**: Use `getTaskState(taskId)` to display progress
4. **Handle Results**: Process `taskState.result` when status is 'completed'

## ✨ Example Usage

```typescript
import { useAgentsStore } from '@/stores/agentsStore';
import type { DataAgentTask } from '@/types';

const { executeDataAgent, getTaskState } = useAgentsStore();

// Execute agent
const taskId = await executeDataAgent(projectId, {
  context: { tenantId, projectId, userId },
  query: 'counterfeit level in beverages Kazakhstan 2025',
  granularity: 'monthly',
  timeRange: { from: '2025-01-01', to: '2025-12-31' },
});

// Monitor progress
const taskState = getTaskState(taskId);
console.log(`${taskState.progress * 100}% - ${taskState.message}`);
```

## 🔒 Security & Authentication

- ✅ Unified authentication across HATL (Firebase token)
- ✅ `projectId` is mandatory in all agent tasks
- ✅ Automatic context injection from authentication

See `web/src/stores/AGENTS_README.md` for complete documentation with examples.

# Agents API - Frontend Integration

## Overview

The Agents system provides a unified interface for autonomous, stateless agents that can perform research tasks. Both **Data Agent** and **Entities Agent** use the same communication patterns:

- **Task**: JSON input sent to agent
- **Result**: JSON output returned by agent  
- **Updates**: Real-time progress updates via WebSocket (`agent.update` event)

## Available Agents

### 1. Data Agent (`data`)
**Purpose**: Collects and aggregates data from various sources with metadata

**Skills**: `data_collection`, `osint`, `data_aggregation`, `approximation`

**Use Case**: Request data metrics (e.g., "level of counterfeit in low-alcohol beverages Kazakhstan (all), 2025")

**Task Schema**:
```typescript
{
  context: AgentContext;      // Required: tenantId, projectId, userId
  query: string;               // Required: Data query description
  granularity?: 'monthly' | 'quarterly' | 'yearly' | 'annual';
  timeRange: {                // Required
    from: string;             // ISO date string
    to: string;               // ISO date string
  };
  region?: string;
  category?: string;
  metadata?: TaskMetadata;
}
```

**Result Schema**:
```typescript
{
  dataPoints: Array<Record<string, any>>;  // Monthly/quarterly/yearly data
  metadata: {
    sources: Array<Record<string, any>>;    // Data sources used
    methods: Array<Record<string, any>>;    // Methods applied
    usedData: Array<Record<string, any>>;   // Indirect data used
    assumptions: Array<Record<string, any>>; // Assumptions made
  };
  confidence: number;          // 0.0 - 1.0
  explanation: string;         // How data was collected
}
```

### 2. Entities Agent (`entities`)
**Purpose**: Searches for information about entities and discovers relations

**Skills**: `web_search`, `entity_extraction`, `relation_discovery`

**Use Case**: Research entities, find relationships, enrich entity details

**Task Schema**:
```typescript
{
  context: AgentContext;      // Required: tenantId, projectId, userId
  entities: EntityInput[];   // Required: Array of entities to research
  maxDepth?: number;        // 1-5, default: 2 (relation depth)
  includeDetails?: boolean;  // default: true
  metadata?: TaskMetadata;
}
```

**EntityInput**:
```typescript
{
  id?: string;
  name: string;              // Required
  type: string;              // Required
  knownAliases?: string[];
}
```

**Result Schema**:
```typescript
{
  entities: Array<Record<string, any>>;      // Enriched entities
  relations: Array<Record<string, any>>;      // Discovered relationships
  confidence: number;         // 0.0 - 1.0
  explanation: string;        // How research was conducted
  sources: Array<Record<string, any>>;       // Sources used
}
```

## Usage

### 1. Load Available Agents

```typescript
import { useAgentsStore } from '@/stores/agentsStore';

const { loadAgents, agents, agentsLoaded } = useAgentsStore();

// Load agents on component mount
useEffect(() => {
  if (!agentsLoaded) {
    loadAgents();
  }
}, [agentsLoaded]);
```

### 2. Execute Data Agent

```typescript
import { useAgentsStore } from '@/stores/agentsStore';
import type { DataAgentTask } from '@/types/agents';

const { executeDataAgent } = useAgentsStore();

const task: DataAgentTask = {
  context: {
    tenantId: 'tenant123',
    projectId: 'project456',  // REQUIRED
    userId: 'user789',
  },
  query: 'level of counterfeit in low-alcohol beverages Kazakhstan (all), 2025',
  granularity: 'monthly',
  timeRange: {
    from: '2025-01-01',
    to: '2025-12-31',
  },
  region: 'Kazakhstan',
  category: 'low-alcohol beverages',
};

try {
  const taskId = await executeDataAgent('project456', task);
  console.log('Task started:', taskId);
} catch (error) {
  console.error('Failed to execute Data Agent:', error);
}
```

### 3. Execute Entities Agent

```typescript
import { useAgentsStore } from '@/stores/agentsStore';
import type { EntitiesAgentTask, EntityInput } from '@/types/agents';

const { executeEntitiesAgent } = useAgentsStore();

const entities: EntityInput[] = [
  {
    name: 'Kazakhstan Beverage Association',
    type: 'organization',
    knownAliases: ['KBA', 'Казахстанская Ассоциация Напитков'],
  },
  {
    name: 'Counterfeit Products',
    type: 'concept',
  },
];

const task: EntitiesAgentTask = {
  context: {
    tenantId: 'tenant123',
    projectId: 'project456',  // REQUIRED
    userId: 'user789',
  },
  entities,
  maxDepth: 2,
  includeDetails: true,
};

try {
  const taskId = await executeEntitiesAgent('project456', task);
  console.log('Task started:', taskId);
} catch (error) {
  console.error('Failed to execute Entities Agent:', error);
}
```

### 4. Monitor Progress via WebSocket

WebSocket events are automatically handled by the store. The `agent.update` event is processed in `discoveryStore.ts` and routed to `agentsStore.ts`.

```typescript
import { useAgentsStore } from '@/stores/agentsStore';

const { getTaskState, activeTasks } = useAgentsStore();

// Get task state
const taskState = getTaskState(taskId);
if (taskState) {
  console.log('Status:', taskState.status);      // 'running' | 'completed' | 'error'
  console.log('Progress:', taskState.progress);  // 0.0 - 1.0
  console.log('Stage:', taskState.stage);         // 'searching' | 'analyzing' | 'planning' | 'executing' | 'saving' | 'completed' | 'error'
  console.log('Message:', taskState.message);
  console.log('Error:', taskState.error);
}

// Iterate all active tasks
for (const [taskId, state] of activeTasks.entries()) {
  console.log(`Task ${taskId}: ${state.agentName} - ${state.status}`);
}
```

### 5. Generic Agent Execution

```typescript
import { useAgentsStore } from '@/stores/agentsStore';

const { executeAgent } = useAgentsStore();

// Execute any agent by ID
const taskId = await executeAgent(
  'project456',
  'data',  // or 'entities'
  task     // Task must match agent's TaskSchema
);
```

## WebSocket Events

The frontend automatically subscribes to `agent.update` events via the existing WebSocket connection in `discoveryStore.ts`.

**Event Structure**:
```typescript
{
  type: 'agent.update',
  data: {
    taskId: string;
    agentId: string;
    agentName: string;
    stage: 'searching' | 'analyzing' | 'planning' | 'executing' | 'saving' | 'completed' | 'error';
    progress: number;        // 0.0 - 1.0
    message: string;
    data?: Record<string, any>;
    timestamp: string;
    error?: string;
  }
}
```

## Type Safety

All types are defined in `web/src/types/agents.ts` and exported from `web/src/types/index.ts`:

```typescript
import type {
  AgentContext,
  TaskMetadata,
  AgentUpdate,
  AgentInfo,
  DataAgentTask,
  DataAgentResult,
  EntityInput,
  EntitiesAgentTask,
  EntitiesAgentResult,
  AgentTask,
  AgentResult,
  AgentExecutionResponse,
  AgentsListResponse,
} from '@/types';
```

## API Methods

The API client (`web/src/lib/api.ts`) provides typed methods:

```typescript
import { api } from '@/lib/api';

// List all agents
const { agents } = await api.listAgents();

// Execute Data Agent
const response = await api.executeDataAgent(projectId, task);

// Execute Entities Agent
const response = await api.executeEntitiesAgent(projectId, task);

// Generic execution
const response = await api.executeAgent(projectId, agentId, task);
```

## Store API

The `useAgentsStore` provides:

- `loadAgents()`: Load list of available agents
- `executeDataAgent(projectId, task)`: Execute Data Agent
- `executeEntitiesAgent(projectId, task)`: Execute Entities Agent
- `executeAgent(projectId, agentId, task)`: Generic execution
- `handleUpdate(update)`: Handle WebSocket update (called automatically)
- `getTaskState(taskId)`: Get task state
- `clearTask(taskId)`: Remove task from store
- `clearAllTasks()`: Clear all tasks

## Notes

1. **projectId is REQUIRED**: All agent tasks must include a valid `projectId` in the context
2. **Unified Interface**: Both agents use the same communication patterns (Task → Result → Updates)
3. **Real-time Updates**: Progress is tracked via WebSocket events, not polling
4. **Stateless**: Agents don't store anything; storage and usage are the caller's responsibility
5. **Authentication**: Agents use unified authentication across HATL (via Firebase token)

import { create } from 'zustand';
import type {
  AgentInfo,
  AgentUpdate,
  AgentResult,
  AgentExecutionResponse,
  DataAgentTask,
  EntitiesAgentTask,
} from '../types/agents';
import { api } from '../lib/api';

/**
 * Agent Store
 * 
 * Manages agent state, execution, and real-time updates.
 * Both Data Agent and Entities Agent use the same communication patterns.
 */

interface AgentTaskState {
  taskId: string;
  agentId: string;
  agentName: string;
  status: 'idle' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'error';
  progress: number; // 0.0 - 1.0
  stage?: AgentUpdate['stage'];
  message?: string;
  error?: string;
  result?: AgentResult;
  startedAt?: number;
  completedAt?: number;
}

interface AgentsState {
  // Available agents list
  agents: AgentInfo[];
  agentsLoaded: boolean;

  // Active tasks by taskId
  activeTasks: Record<string, AgentTaskState>;

  // Actions
  loadAgents: () => Promise<void>;
  executeDataAgent: (projectId: string, task: DataAgentTask) => Promise<string>; // Returns taskId
  executeEntitiesAgent: (projectId: string, task: EntitiesAgentTask) => Promise<string>; // Returns taskId
  executeAgent: (projectId: string, agentId: string, task: any) => Promise<string>; // Generic execution
  handleUpdate: (update: AgentUpdate) => void;
  getTaskState: (taskId: string) => AgentTaskState | undefined;
  clearTask: (taskId: string) => void;
  clearAllTasks: () => void;
}

export const useAgentsStore = create<AgentsState>((set, get) => ({
  agents: [],
  agentsLoaded: false,
  activeTasks: {},

  loadAgents: async () => {
    try {
      const response = await api.listAgents();
      set({ agents: response.agents, agentsLoaded: true });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[AgentsStore] Failed to load agents:', error);
      set({ agentsLoaded: true }); // Mark as loaded even on error
    }
  },

  executeDataAgent: async (projectId: string, task: DataAgentTask): Promise<string> => {
    try {
      const response = await api.executeDataAgent(projectId, task);
      // Task ID is generated server-side, we'll get it from WebSocket updates
      // For now, create a placeholder task state
      const taskId = `task_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
      const taskState: AgentTaskState = {
        taskId,
        agentId: 'data',
        agentName: response.agentName,
        status: 'running',
        progress: 0,
        stage: 'searching',
        message: 'Starting data collection...',
        startedAt: Date.now(),
      };
      set((state) => ({
        activeTasks: { ...state.activeTasks, [taskId]: taskState },
      }));
      return taskId;
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('[AgentsStore] Failed to execute Data Agent:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  },

  executeEntitiesAgent: async (projectId: string, task: EntitiesAgentTask): Promise<string> => {
    try {
      const response = await api.executeEntitiesAgent(projectId, task);
      const taskId = `task_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
      const taskState: AgentTaskState = {
        taskId,
        agentId: 'entities',
        agentName: response.agentName,
        status: 'running',
        progress: 0,
        stage: 'searching',
        message: 'Starting entity research...',
        startedAt: Date.now(),
      };
      set((state) => ({
        activeTasks: { ...state.activeTasks, [taskId]: taskState },
      }));
      return taskId;
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('[AgentsStore] Failed to execute Entities Agent:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  },

  executeAgent: async (projectId: string, agentId: string, task: any): Promise<string> => {
    try {
      const response = await api.executeAgent(projectId, agentId, task);
      const taskId = `task_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
      const taskState: AgentTaskState = {
        taskId,
        agentId,
        agentName: response.agentName,
        status: 'running',
        progress: 0,
        stage: 'searching',
        message: `Starting ${response.agentName}...`,
        startedAt: Date.now(),
      };
      set((state) => ({
        activeTasks: { ...state.activeTasks, [taskId]: taskState },
      }));
      return taskId;
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('[AgentsStore] Failed to execute agent:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  },

  handleUpdate: (update: AgentUpdate) => {
    console.log('[AgentsStore] Agent update received:', update);
    
    set((state) => {
      const newTasks = { ...state.activeTasks };
      
      // Find task by taskId or agentId (fallback)
      let taskState = newTasks[update.taskId];
      if (!taskState) {
        // Try to find by agentId if taskId not found
        for (const [tid, ts] of Object.entries(newTasks)) {
          if (ts.agentId === update.agentId && ts.status === 'running') {
            taskState = ts;
            // Update taskId to match server-side ID
            delete newTasks[tid];
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      
      if (!taskState) {
        // Create new task state if not found
        taskState = {
          taskId: update.taskId,
          agentId: update.agentId,
          agentName: update.agentName,
          status: 'running',
          progress: 0,
          startedAt: Date.now(),
        };
      }
      
      // Update task state
      const updatedState: AgentTaskState = {
        ...taskState,
        taskId: update.taskId, // Ensure we have the correct taskId
        progress: update.progress,
        stage: update.stage,
        message: update.message,
        error: update.error,
      };
      
      // Update status based on stage
      if (update.stage === 'completed') {
        updatedState.status = 'completed';
        updatedState.completedAt = Date.now();
        // Note: result will be available via HTTP response, not WebSocket
      } else if (update.stage === 'error') {
        updatedState.status = 'error';
        updatedState.completedAt = Date.now();
        updatedState.error = update.error || update.message;
      } else {
        updatedState.status = 'running';
      }
      
      // Store any additional data
      if (update.data) {
        // You can extend this to store specific data fields if needed
      }
      
      newTasks[update.taskId] = updatedState;
      return { activeTasks: newTasks };
    });
  },

  getTaskState: (taskId: string): AgentTaskState | undefined => {
    return get().activeTasks[taskId];
  },

  clearTask: (taskId: string) => {
    set((state) => {
      const newTasks = { ...state.activeTasks };
      delete newTasks[taskId];
      return { activeTasks: newTasks };
    });
  },

  clearAllTasks: () => {
    set({ activeTasks: {} });
  },
}));

Файл: artifactStore.ts

import { create } from 'zustand';

export interface ArtifactSection {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'generating' | 'completed' | 'error';
  content?: string;
  error?: string;
}

export interface ArtifactGenerationState {
  sessionId: string | null;
  artifactId: string | null;
  status: 'idle' | 'started' | 'generating_section' | 'assembling' | 'completed' | 'error';
  error: string | null;
  sections: ArtifactSection[];
  currentSectionId: string | null;
  progress: number; // 0-1
  assembledContent: string | null;

  // Actions
  handleEvent: (event: any) => void;
  reset: () => void;
}

const initialState = {
  sessionId: null,
  artifactId: null,
  status: 'idle' as const,
  error: null,
  sections: [],
  currentSectionId: null,
  progress: 0,
  assembledContent: null,
};

export const useArtifactStore = create<ArtifactGenerationState>((set, get) => ({
  ...initialState,
  reset: () => set(initialState),
  handleEvent: (event) => {
    const { type, data } = event;
    if (!type || !data) return;

    switch (type) {
      case 'artifact.generation.started':
        set({
          sessionId: data.sessionId,
          artifactId: data.artifactId,
          status: 'started',
          error: null,
          progress: 0,
          sections: (data.sections || []).map((s: any) => ({
            id: s.id,
            title: s.title,
            status: 'pending',
          })),
        });
        break;

      case 'artifact.section.generating':
        set((state) => ({
          status: 'generating_section',
          currentSectionId: data.sectionId,
          sections: state.sections.map((s) =>
            s.id === data.sectionId ? { ...s, status: 'generating' } : s
          ),
        }));
        break;

      case 'artifact.section.chunk':
        set((state) => ({
          sections: state.sections.map((s) =>
            s.id === data.sectionId
              ? { ...s, content: (s.content || '') + data.chunk }
              : s
          ),
        }));
        break;

      case 'artifact.section.completed':
        set((state) => ({
          sections: state.sections.map((s) =>
            s.id === data.sectionId ? { ...s, status: 'completed' as const } : s
          ),
          progress: ((): number => {
            const newSections = state.sections.map((s) =>
              s.id === data.sectionId ? { ...s, status: 'completed' as const } : s
            );
            const completedCount = newSections.filter((s) => s.status === 'completed').length;
            return newSections.length > 0 ? completedCount / newSections.length : 0;
          })(),
          currentSectionId: null,
        }));
        break;

      case 'artifact.assembly.started':
        set({ status: 'assembling' });
        break;

      case 'artifact.assembly.chunk':
        set((state) => ({
            assembledContent: (state.assembledContent || '') + data.chunk,
        }));
        break;

      case 'artifact.assembly.completed':
        set((state) => ({
            status: 'completed',
            progress: 1,
            assembledContent: data.content || state.assembledContent,
        }));
        break;

      case 'artifact.generation.completed':
        set({
          status: 'completed',
          progress: 1,
          currentSectionId: null,
        });
        break;

      case 'artifact.generation.error':
        set((state) => ({
          status: 'error',
          error: data.error,
          sections: state.sections.map((s) =>
            s.id === data.sectionId ? { ...s, status: 'error', error: data.error } : s
          ),
        }));
        break;
    }
  },
}));

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import type { DataSource } from '../types';

// --- WebSocket connection management (module scope to persist across store re-creations) ---
let wsRef: WebSocket | null = null;
let reconnectAttempts = 0;
let reconnectTimer: number | null = null;
let isManuallyClosed = false;
let isConnecting = false; // Prevent multiple simultaneous connection attempts
let listenersAttached = false; // Track if event listeners are already attached
let projectsStoreUnsubscribe: (() => void) | null = null; // Store unsubscribe function to prevent memory leaks
let windowEventListeners: { visibilitychange: () => void; online: () => void } | null = null; // Store listeners for cleanup

function clearReconnectTimer() {
  if (reconnectTimer !== null) {
    window.clearTimeout(reconnectTimer);
    reconnectTimer = null;
  }
}

function computeBackoffDelay(attempt: number): number {
  const base = 1000; // 1s base
  const max = 30000; // cap at 30s
  const exp = Math.min(max, base * Math.pow(2, Math.max(0, attempt - 1)));
  const jitter = exp * (0.2 * (Math.random() - 0.5)); // +/-10%
  return Math.max(1000, Math.floor(exp + jitter));
}

// Cleanup function to remove all event listeners and subscriptions (for testing/debugging)
export function cleanupDiscoveryStore() {
  // Clear reconnect timer
  clearReconnectTimer();
  
  // Unsubscribe from projects store
  if (projectsStoreUnsubscribe) {
    try {
      projectsStoreUnsubscribe();
    } catch {}
    projectsStoreUnsubscribe = null;
  }
  
  // Remove window event listeners
  if (windowEventListeners) {
    try {
      window.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', windowEventListeners.visibilitychange);
      window.removeEventListener('online', windowEventListeners.online);
    } catch {}
    windowEventListeners = null;
    listenersAttached = false;
  }
  
  // Close WebSocket if open
  if (wsRef) {
    try {
      wsRef.onclose = null;
      wsRef.onerror = null;
      wsRef.onmessage = null;
      wsRef.close();
    } catch {}
    wsRef = null;
  }
  
  isManuallyClosed = true;
  isConnecting = false;
  reconnectAttempts = 0;
}

interface DiscoveryState {
  sources: DataSource[];
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  correlationId: string | null;
  answer: string | null;
  interactions: Array<{ id: string; kind: string; content: string; createdAt: string }>;
  pendingSources: Array<{ id: string; kind: 'web' | 'telegram'; status: string }>;
  lastDocEvent?: any;
  lastAnalysisStatus?: { projectId: string; kind: string; status: 'started'|'done'|'failed'; elapsedMs?: number; count?: number; error?: string; ts: number } | undefined;
  connectWs: (tenantId: string) => Promise<void>;
  
  // Actions
  executeDiscovery: (data: {
    projectId: string;
    queryText: string;
    language?: string;
    sources: { web: string[]; telegram: string[] };
  }) => Promise<{ correlationId: string }>;
  sendChatMessage: (projectId: string, message: string, language?: string) => Promise<string>;
  fetchProjectSources: (projectId: string) => Promise<void>;
  fetchProjectInteractions: (projectId: string) => Promise<void>;
  clearSources: () => void;
  setPendingSources: (sources: Array<{ id: string; kind: 'web' | 'telegram'; status: string }>) => void;
}

// Track processed stream.done events to prevent duplicates
const processedDoneEvents = new Set<string>();

export const useDiscoveryStore = create<DiscoveryState>((set, get) => ({
  sources: [],
  loading: false,
  error: null,
  correlationId: null,
  answer: null,
  interactions: [],
  pendingSources: [],
  lastAnalysisStatus: undefined,

  setPendingSources: (sources) => set({ pendingSources: sources }),

  executeDiscovery: async (data) => {
    set({ loading: true, error: null });
    try {
      const response = await api.executeDiscovery(data);
      console.log('[Store] API response:', response);
      set({
        correlationId: response.correlationId,
        loading: false,
      });
      return response;
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('[Store] API error:', error);
      // Network errors are handled by the global error interceptor
      if (error.response) {
        set({ error: error.message, loading: false });
      } else {
        set({ loading: false });
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  fetchProjectSources: async (projectId) => {
    const state = get();
    // Защита от множественных одновременных вызовов
    if (state.loading) {
      console.log('[fetchProjectSources] Already loading, skipping duplicate call');
      return;
    }
    
    set({ loading: true, error: null });
    try {
      const sources = await api.getProjectSources(projectId);
      // Merge pending sources with fetched sources (pending take precedence if status is 'fetching')
      set((state) => {
        const merged = [...sources];
        for (const pending of state.pendingSources) {
          const exists = merged.find((s) => s.id === pending.id || s.displayName === pending.id);
          if (!exists) {
            merged.push({
              id: pending.id,
              displayName: pending.id,
              kind: pending.kind,
              status: pending.status,
            } as any);
          }
        }
        return { sources: merged, loading: false };
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      // Network errors are handled by the global error interceptor
      if (error.response) {
        set({ error: error.message, loading: false });
      } else {
        set({ loading: false });
      }
    }
  },

  fetchProjectInteractions: async (projectId) => {
    // Защита от множественных одновременных вызовов для одного projectId
    // Используем отдельный флаг для отслеживания загрузки interactions
    const state = get();
    if ((state as any).fetchingInteractions) {
      console.log('[fetchProjectInteractions] Already fetching, skipping duplicate call');
      return;
    }
    
    set({ fetchingInteractions: true } as any);
    try {
      const items = await api.getProjectInteractions(projectId);
      set({ interactions: items, fetchingInteractions: false } as any);
    } catch (error: any) {
      // Network errors are handled by the global error interceptor
      if (error.response) {
        set({ error: error.message, fetchingInteractions: false } as any);
      } else {
        set({ fetchingInteractions: false } as any);
      }
      // Silently fail for network errors
    }
  },
  sendChatMessage: async (projectId: string, message: string, language?: string) => {
    // Append optimistic user message and a placeholder "Thinking..."
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    set((state) => ({
      interactions: [
        ...state.interactions,
        { id: now, kind: 'discovery.query', content: message, createdAt: now },
        { id: now + '-thinking', kind: 'discovery.answer', content: 'Thinking...', createdAt: now },
      ],
    }));

    try {
      const { answer } = await api.sendChatMessage(projectId, message, language);
      // Replace the last placeholder with real answer
      set((state) => {
        const items = [...state.interactions];
        const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === now + '-thinking');
        if (idx >= 0) {
          items[idx] = { ...items[idx], content: answer } as any;
        } else {
          items.push({ id: new Date().toISOString(), kind: 'discovery.answer', content: answer, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() });
        }
        return { interactions: items } as any;
      });
      return answer;
    } catch (e: any) {
      set((state) => {
        const items = [...state.interactions];
        const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === now + '-thinking');
        if (idx >= 0) {
          items[idx] = { ...items[idx], content: 'Failed to get answer' } as any;
        }
        return { interactions: items } as any;
      });
      throw e;
    }
  },

  clearSources: () => {
    set({ sources: [], correlationId: null, answer: null, pendingSources: [], interactions: [] });
  },
  connectWs: async (tenantId) => {
    const url = (window as any).buildWsUrl ? (window as any).buildWsUrl(tenantId) : undefined;
    async function openSocket() {
      // Prevent multiple simultaneous connection attempts
      if (isConnecting) {
        console.log('[WS] Already connecting, skipping duplicate attempt');
        return;
      }
      
      // Skip if already connected
      if (wsRef && (wsRef.readyState === WebSocket.CONNECTING || wsRef.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN)) {
        console.log('[WS] Already connected or connecting, skipping');
        return;
      }
      
      isConnecting = true;
      
      try {
        // Refresh Firebase token each (re)connect
        const { auth } = await import('../lib/firebase');
        const user = auth?.currentUser;
        if (!user) {
          isConnecting = false;
          return;
        }
        const token = await user.getIdToken(true);

        const base = (import.meta as any).env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:8080';
        const broker = (import.meta as any).env?.VITE_WS_BROKER_URL as string | undefined;
        const toWs = (u: string) => u.replace(/^http:/, 'ws:').replace(/^https:/, 'wss:');
        const wsUrl = (() => {
          if (broker && broker.trim()) return `${toWs(broker.replace(/\/$/, ''))}/ws?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
          if (url && typeof url === 'string') return url;
          return `${toWs(base)}/ws?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
        })();

        // Close previous if any
        if (wsRef) {
          try {
            wsRef.onclose = null; // Remove handlers to prevent reconnect
            wsRef.onerror = null;
            wsRef.close();
          } catch {}
          wsRef = null;
        }

        wsRef = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
        // Expose wsRef to window for verified page subscription
        (window as any).__wsRef = wsRef;
        import('./wsStore').then(({ useWsStore }) => {
          useWsStore.getState().setConnecting(wsUrl, tenantId);
          useWsStore.getState().setReadyState(wsRef?.readyState ?? 0);
        }).catch(() => {});
        isManuallyClosed = false;

        wsRef.onopen = () => {
          isConnecting = false;
          clearReconnectTimer();
          reconnectAttempts = 0;
          import('./wsStore').then(({ useWsStore }) => {
            useWsStore.getState().setOpen(wsRef?.readyState);
          }).catch(() => {});
          // Subscribe to current project for server-side routing (best-effort)
          try {
            import('./projectsStore').then(({ useProjectsStore }) => {
              const current = useProjectsStore.getState().currentProject as any;
              const pid = current?.id;
              if (pid && wsRef && wsRef.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                wsRef.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'subscribe', projectId: pid }));
                // State will be updated when we receive ws.subscribed ACK
              }
            }).catch(() => {});
          } catch {}
        };

        const scheduleReconnect = () => {
          isConnecting = false;
          if (isManuallyClosed) return;
          import('./wsStore').then(({ useWsStore }) => {
            useWsStore.getState().setClosed(undefined, wsRef?.readyState);
          }).catch(() => {});
          reconnectAttempts += 1;
          const delay = computeBackoffDelay(reconnectAttempts);
          clearReconnectTimer();
          reconnectTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
            openSocket();
          }, delay) as unknown as number;
        };

        wsRef.onclose = scheduleReconnect;
        wsRef.onerror = scheduleReconnect;

        wsRef.onmessage = (evt) => {
          try {
            const msg = JSON.parse(evt.data);
            import('./wsStore').then(({ useWsStore }) => {
              try { useWsStore.getState().noteMessage(msg?.type, msg?.data); } catch {}
            }).catch(() => {});
            
            // Notify verified.stream listeners
            if (msg?.type?.startsWith('verified.stream.')) {
              const listeners = (window as any).__verifiedWsListeners || [];
              listeners.forEach((listener: (evt: MessageEvent) => void) => {
                try {
                  listener(evt);
                } catch (e) {
                  console.error('Verified WS listener error:', e);
                }
              });
            }

            // Handle subscription ack to reflect connId and ts in diagnostics
            if (msg?.type === 'ws.subscribed' && msg?.data?.projectId) {
              import('./wsStore').then(({ useWsStore }) => {
                useWsStore.getState().setSubscribed(msg.data.projectId, msg.data.connId, msg.data.ts);
              }).catch(() => {});
            }

            if (msg?.type === 'discovery.profile' && msg.data?.profile) {
              set((state) => {
                const idx = state.sources.findIndex((s) => s.id === msg.data.sourceId);
                if (idx >= 0) {
                  // Update existing source
                  const updated = [...state.sources];
                  updated[idx] = { ...updated[idx], profile: msg.data.profile, status: 'completed' } as any;
                  return { sources: updated } as any;
                } else {
                  // Add new source if not exists (fetch from API to get full DataSource)
                  console.log('[WS] Source not found locally, fetching from API:', msg.data.sourceId);
                  if (msg.data.projectId) {
                    api.getProjectSources(msg.data.projectId).then((sources) => {
                      const source = sources.find((s) => s.id === msg.data.sourceId);
                      if (source) {
                        set((s) => ({
                          sources: [...s.sources.filter((src) => src.id !== source.id), { ...source, profile: msg.data.profile, status: 'completed' }]
                        }));
                      }
                    }).catch((e) => console.error('Failed to fetch source:', e));
                  }
                  return state as any;
                }
              });
              // Refresh interactions to include new context/profile snippets
              if (msg?.data?.projectId) {
                api.getProjectInteractions(msg.data.projectId)
                  .then((items) => set({ interactions: items }))
                  .catch((e) => console.error('Failed to refresh interactions:', e));
              }
            }
            
            if (msg?.type === 'discovery.status' && msg.data?.sourceId) {
              set((state) => {
                const idx = state.sources.findIndex((s) => s.id === msg.data.sourceId);
                if (idx >= 0) {
                  const updated = [...state.sources];
                  updated[idx] = { ...updated[idx], status: msg.data.status, __hint: msg.data?.hint, __firstProfile: !!msg.data?.firstProfile } as any;
                  return { sources: updated } as any;
                } else if (msg.data.status === 'fetching' && msg.data.projectId) {
                  // Add placeholder source for visual feedback; drop any skeleton by matching displayName
                  const displayName: string | undefined = msg.data.displayName;
                  const filtered = displayName
                    ? state.sources.filter((s) => s.displayName !== displayName && s.id !== displayName)
                    : state.sources;
                  const placeholder = {
                    id: msg.data.sourceId,
                    displayName: displayName || msg.data.sourceId,
                    status: msg.data.status,
                    kind: msg.data.kind || 'unknown',
                    __hint: msg.data?.hint,
                    __firstProfile: !!msg.data?.firstProfile,
                  } as any;
                  return { sources: [...filtered, placeholder] } as any;
                }
                return state as any;
              });
            }
            
            if (msg?.type === 'discovery.answer' && typeof msg.data?.answer === 'string') {
              set((state) => {
                const items = [...state.interactions];
                // Prefer replacing any existing Thinking... placeholder instead of appending (prevents duplicates for chat path)
                const idx = [...items].reverse().findIndex((it) => it.kind === 'discovery.answer' && it.content === 'Thinking...');
                if (idx >= 0) {
                  const realIdx = items.length - 1 - idx;
                  items[realIdx] = { ...items[realIdx], content: msg.data.answer } as any;
                } else {
                  const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
                  items.push({ id: createdAt, kind: 'discovery.answer', content: msg.data.answer, createdAt } as any);
                }
                return { answer: msg.data.answer, interactions: items } as any;
              });
            }
  
            // Route GenAI streaming events to chat store (filter by project/stream if present)
            if (typeof msg?.type === 'string' && msg.type.startsWith('genai.stream.')) {
              import('./genaiChatStore').then(({ useGenaiChatStore }) => {
                const st = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
                // Filter: must match current project if provided
                try {
                  const currentPid = st.projectId;
                  if (msg?.data?.projectId && currentPid && msg.data.projectId !== currentPid) return;
                } catch {}
                switch (msg.type) {
                  case 'genai.stream.start':
                    st.onStart();
                    break;
                  case 'genai.stream.chunk':
                    if (msg.data?.text) st.onChunk(msg.data.text);
                    break;
                  case 'genai.stream.tool_call':
                    if (Array.isArray(msg.data?.toolCalls)) st.onToolCall(msg.data.toolCalls);
                    break;
                  case 'genai.stream.tool_result':
                    if (Array.isArray(msg.data?.toolCalls)) st.onToolResult(msg.data.toolCalls);
                    break;
                  case 'genai.stream.done':
                    // Prevent duplicate processing of done events (PubSub can deliver messages multiple times)
                    const streamId = msg.data?.streamId;
                    const doneEventKey = streamId ? `done:${streamId}` : null;
                    if (doneEventKey && processedDoneEvents.has(doneEventKey)) {
                      console.log('[DiscoveryStore] Skipping duplicate genai.stream.done event', { streamId });
                      break;
                    }
                    if (doneEventKey) {
                      processedDoneEvents.add(doneEventKey);
                      // Clean up after 5 minutes to prevent memory leak
                      setTimeout(() => processedDoneEvents.delete(doneEventKey), 5 * 60 * 1000);
                    }
                    // CRITICAL: onDoneMeta must run BEFORE onDone so that usage/searchQueries/sources are in state when creating Interaction
                    st.onDoneMeta({ 
                      usage: msg.data?.usage, 
                      attributions: msg.data?.attributions,
                      searchQueries: msg.data?.searchQueries,
                      sources: msg.data?.sources
                    });
                    st.onDone();
                    break;
                  case 'genai.stream.error':
                    st.onError(msg.data?.error || 'Stream error');
                    break;
                  default:
                    break;
                }
              }).catch(() => {});
            }
  
            // Route artifact generation events (filter by project if present)
            if (typeof msg?.type === 'string' && msg.type.startsWith('artifact.')) {
              import('./artifactStore').then(({ useArtifactStore }) => {
                try {
                  import('./genaiChatStore').then(({ useGenaiChatStore }) => {
                    const pid = useGenaiChatStore.getState().projectId;
                    if (msg?.data?.projectId && pid && msg.data.projectId !== pid) return;
                    useArtifactStore.getState().handleEvent(msg);
                  }).catch(() => { useArtifactStore.getState().handleEvent(msg); });
                } catch { useArtifactStore.getState().handleEvent(msg); }
              }).catch(() => {});
            }
  
            // Document process streaming: uploaded/parsing/parsed/deleted
            if (msg?.type === 'document.process') {
              const ev = msg.data || {};
              console.log('[WS] document.process event received:', ev);
              // expose minimal bus: lastDocEvent for UI
              set((state) => ({ ...state, lastDocEvent: ev } as any));
            }
  
            // Unified analysis status: analysis.status
            if (msg?.type === 'analysis.status') {
              const ev = msg.data || {};
              console.log('[WS] analysis.status event received:', ev);
              if (ev && typeof ev.projectId === 'string' && typeof ev.kind === 'string' && typeof ev.status === 'string') {
                set({ lastAnalysisStatus: ev });
              }
            }

            // Agent updates: agent.update
            if (msg?.type === 'agent.update') {
              const update = msg.data as import('../types/agents').AgentUpdate;
              if (update && update.taskId && update.agentId) {
                console.log('[WS] agent.update event received:', update);
                import('./agentsStore').then(({ useAgentsStore }) => {
                  useAgentsStore.getState().handleUpdate(update);
                }).catch((e) => console.error('[WS] Failed to handle agent.update:', e));
              }
            }
            
            if (msg?.type === 'discovery.project' || msg?.type === 'discoveryProject') {
              console.log('[WS] New project event:', msg.data);
              // New project created - add directly to projects store
              import('./projectsStore').then(({ useProjectsStore }) => {
                const store = useProjectsStore.getState();
                const projectData = msg.data;
                
                // Check if project already exists
                const exists = store.projects.find((p) => p.id === projectData.projectId);
                if (!exists && projectData.projectId && projectData.title) {
                  // Add new project to the list
                  const newProject = {
                    id: projectData.projectId,
                    displayName: projectData.title,
                    view: 'discovery',
                    status: 'active',
                    createdAt: projectData.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
                    updatedAt: projectData.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
                  } as any;
                  
                  console.log('[WS] Adding new project to store:', newProject);
                  useProjectsStore.setState((state) => ({
                    projects: [newProject, ...state.projects],
                    currentProject: newProject, // Auto-select new project
                  }));
                }
              }).catch((e) => {
                console.error('Failed to load projectsStore:', e);
              });
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('[WS] Error parsing message:', err);
          }
        };
      } catch (e) {
        // Immediate retry plan if startup failed
        isConnecting = false;
        const delay = computeBackoffDelay(++reconnectAttempts);
        clearReconnectTimer();
        reconnectTimer = window.setTimeout(() => openSocket(), delay) as unknown as number;
      }
    }

    // Visibility/online triggers to speed up recovery (attach only once)
    if (!listenersAttached) {
      const onVisibility = () => {
        if (!document.hidden && (!wsRef || wsRef.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN)) {
          reconnectAttempts = 0;
          clearReconnectTimer();
          openSocket();
        }
      };
      const onOnline = () => {
        reconnectAttempts = 0;
        clearReconnectTimer();
        openSocket();
      };
      window.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
      window.addEventListener('online', onOnline);
      windowEventListeners = { visibilitychange: onVisibility, online: onOnline };
      listenersAttached = true;
    }

    // Initial connect
    openSocket();

    // Subscribe on project changes (in case currentProject isn't ready at ws onopen)
    // Clean up previous subscription if exists to prevent memory leaks
    if (projectsStoreUnsubscribe) {
      try {
        projectsStoreUnsubscribe();
      } catch {}
      projectsStoreUnsubscribe = null;
    }
    try {
      import('./projectsStore').then(({ useProjectsStore }) => {
        let lastPid: string | undefined;
        const unsubscribe = useProjectsStore.subscribe((st) => {
          const pid = (st as any)?.currentProject?.id as string | undefined;
          if (!pid || pid === lastPid) return;
          lastPid = pid;
          if (wsRef && wsRef.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
            try { wsRef.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'subscribe', projectId: pid })); } catch {}
            // State will be updated when we receive ws.subscribed ACK
          }
        });
        projectsStoreUnsubscribe = unsubscribe;
      }).catch(() => {});
    } catch {}

    // Expose a minimal helper for on-demand subscription (used by chat store before stream)
    try {
      (window as any).wsSubscribeProject = (pid: string) => {
        try {
          if (wsRef && wsRef.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN && pid) {
            wsRef.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'subscribe', projectId: pid }));
            // State will be updated when we receive ws.subscribed ACK
          }
        } catch {}
      };
    } catch {}
  },
}));

================================================================================

Путь: src/stores/genaiChatStore.ts
