import React from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { UserPositionAnalysis } from './UserPositionAnalysis';
import { DiscussionFlow } from './DiscussionFlow';
import { TextTask } from './TextTasksPanel';

interface AnalysisPanelProps {
  analysisTab: 'user' | 'flow';
  onAnalysisTabChange: (tab: 'user' | 'flow') => void;
  onFirstResultUser: () => void;
  onRiskUpdate: (r: any) => void;
  onFirstResultDiscussionFlow: () => void;
  onAddTextTask: (task: TextTask) => void;
  onRemoveTextTask: (taskId: string) => void;
  textTasks: TextTask[];
}

export const AnalysisPanel: React.FC<AnalysisPanelProps> = ({
  analysisTab,
  onAnalysisTabChange,
  onFirstResultUser,
  onRiskUpdate,
  onFirstResultDiscussionFlow,
  onAddTextTask,
  onRemoveTextTask,
  textTasks,
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return (
    <>
      {/* Toolbar with tabs */}
      <div
        className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-1"
        role="tablist"
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          role="tab"
          aria-selected={analysisTab === 'user'}
          onClick={() => onAnalysisTabChange('user')}
          className="px-3 py-1.5 text-12 rounded transition-colors"
          style={{
            backgroundColor:
              analysisTab === 'user'
                ? 'var(--accent-primary)'
                : 'transparent',
            color:
              analysisTab === 'user'
                ? 'var(--text-on-accent)'
                : 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
          }}
          onMouseEnter={(e) => {
            if (analysisTab !== 'user') {
              (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                'var(--white-10)';
            }
          }}
          onMouseLeave={(e) => {
            if (analysisTab !== 'user') {
              (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                'transparent';
            }
          }}
        >
          {t('unfold.sections.howYouEngage', {
            defaultValue: 'User Analysis',
          })}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          role="tab"
          aria-selected={analysisTab === 'flow'}
          onClick={() => onAnalysisTabChange('flow')}
          className="px-3 py-1.5 text-12 rounded transition-colors"
          style={{
            backgroundColor:
              analysisTab === 'flow'
                ? 'var(--accent-primary)'
                : 'transparent',
            color:
              analysisTab === 'flow'
                ? 'var(--text-on-accent)'
                : 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
          }}
          onMouseEnter={(e) => {
            if (analysisTab !== 'flow') {
              (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                'var(--white-10)';
            }
          }}
          onMouseLeave={(e) => {
            if (analysisTab !== 'flow') {
              (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                'transparent';
            }
          }}
        >
          {t('unfold.sections.discussionFlow', {
            defaultValue: 'Discussion Flow',
          })}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Content */}
      {analysisTab === 'user' && (
        <UserPositionAnalysis
          hideTitle
          onFirstResult={onFirstResultUser}
          onRiskUpdate={onRiskUpdate}
        />
      )}

      {analysisTab === 'flow' && (
        <DiscussionFlow
          onFirstResult={onFirstResultDiscussionFlow}
          onAddTextTask={onAddTextTask}
          onRemoveTextTask={onRemoveTextTask}
          textTasks={textTasks}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
};

import React from 'react';

interface AttachedDoc {
  id: string;
  filename: string;
  sizeBytes?: number;
  status: 'uploading' | 'parsing' | 'parsed' | 'failed';
  error?: string;
}

interface AttachedDocumentsProps {
  docs: AttachedDoc[];
  onRemove: (docId: string) => void;
}

const AttachedDocuments: React.FC<AttachedDocumentsProps> = ({ docs, onRemove }) => {
  if (docs.length === 0) return null;

  const formatSize = (bytes?: number): string => {
    if (!bytes) return '';
    if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes}B`;
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB`;
    return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)}MB`;
  };

  const getStatusIcon = (status: AttachedDoc['status']) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'uploading':
        return (
          <div className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" strokeWidth="2" strokeDasharray="60" strokeDashoffset="15" opacity="0.3" />
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" strokeWidth="2" strokeDasharray="60" strokeDashoffset="45" strokeLinecap="round" />
            </svg>
          </div>
        );
      case 'parsing':
        return (
          <div className="w-4 h-4 animate-pulse" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
              <path d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
            </svg>
          </div>
        );
      case 'parsed':
        return (
          <div className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: '#4ade80' }}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
              <path d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
            </svg>
          </div>
        );
      case 'failed':
        return (
          <div className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: '#f87171' }}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" strokeWidth="2" />
              <path d="M15 9l-6 6m0-6l6 6" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
            </svg>
          </div>
        );
    }
  };

  const getStatusText = (status: AttachedDoc['status']) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'uploading': return 'Uploading...';
      case 'parsing': return 'Processing...';
      case 'parsed': return 'Ready';
      case 'failed': return 'Failed';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="mb-2" style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent' }}>
      <div className="space-y-1">
        {docs.map((doc) => (
          <div
            key={doc.id}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1.5 rounded"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: doc.status === 'failed' ? 'rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.1)' : 'var(--white-06)',
            }}
          >
            {/* Status icon */}
            <div className="flex-shrink-0">
              {getStatusIcon(doc.status)}
            </div>

            {/* File info */}
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                <span
                  className="text-xs font-medium truncate"
                  style={{ 
                    color: doc.status === 'failed' ? '#f87171' : 'var(--text-heading)',
                  }}
                  title={doc.filename}
                >
                  {doc.filename}
                </span>
                {doc.sizeBytes && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
                    {formatSize(doc.sizeBytes)}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                {doc.status === 'failed' && doc.error ? doc.error : getStatusText(doc.status)}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Remove button */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onRemove(doc.id)}
              className="flex-shrink-0 w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
              style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}
              aria-label="Remove document"
              title="Remove document"
            >
              <svg className="w-3 h-3" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                <path d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AttachedDocuments;

Файл: AuthGuard.tsx
Путь: src/components/AuthGuard.tsx
================================================================================

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { AuthLoading } from './AuthLoading';
import lightLogo from '../assets/hatl-light-theme.png';
import darkLogo from '../assets/hatl-dark-theme.png';
import { ThemeContext } from './ThemeProvider';

interface AuthGuardProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

type AuthView = 'login' | 'signup' | 'reset';

const PUBLIC_DOMAINS = [
  'gmail.com', 'yahoo.com', 'hotmail.com', 'outlook.com', 'aol.com',
  'icloud.com', 'mail.com', 'protonmail.com', 'yandex.ru', 'mail.ru',
  'live.com', 'msn.com', 'me.com', 'mac.com'
];

const AuthGuard: React.FC<AuthGuardProps> = ({ children }) => {
  const { user, loading, signIn, signUp, resetPassword, signInWithGoogle } = useAuth();
  const { theme } = React.useContext(ThemeContext);
  const [currentView, setCurrentView] = useState<AuthView>('login');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState('');
  const [accountType, setAccountType] = useState<'personal' | 'corporate'>('personal');
  const [formLoading, setFormLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const validateEmail = (email: string): { isValid: boolean; error?: string } => {
    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    if (!emailRegex.test(email)) {
      return { isValid: false, error: 'Please enter a valid email address' };
    }

    if (currentView === 'signup' && accountType === 'corporate') {
      const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();
      if (PUBLIC_DOMAINS.includes(domain)) {
        return { 
          isValid: false, 
          error: 'Corporate accounts cannot use public email domains like Gmail, Yahoo, etc. Please use your company email address.' 
        };
      }
    }

    return { isValid: true };
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (formLoading) return;

    setError(null);
    setFormLoading(true);

    try {
      if (currentView === 'login') {
        await signIn(email, password);
      } else if (currentView === 'signup') {
        if (password !== confirmPassword) {
          throw new Error('Passwords do not match');
        }
        if (password.length < 6) {
          throw new Error('Password must be at least 6 characters long');
        }
        const emailValidation = validateEmail(email);
        if (!emailValidation.isValid) {
          throw new Error(emailValidation.error || 'Invalid email');
        }
        await signUp(email, password, accountType, displayName || undefined);
      } else if (currentView === 'reset') {
        const emailValidation = validateEmail(email);
        if (!emailValidation.isValid) {
          throw new Error(emailValidation.error || 'Invalid email');
        }
        await resetPassword(email);
        setError('Password reset email sent. Check your inbox.');
        setTimeout(() => setCurrentView('login'), 2000);
        return;
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'An error occurred');
    } finally {
      setFormLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const getTitle = () => {
    switch (currentView) {
      case 'login': return 'Sign In';
      case 'signup': return 'Create Account';
      case 'reset': return 'Reset Password';
    }
  };

  const getSubmitText = () => {
    if (formLoading) return 'Please wait...';
    switch (currentView) {
      case 'login': return 'Sign In';
      case 'signup': return 'Create Account';
      case 'reset': return 'Send Reset Email';
    }
  };

  // Loading state with splash
  if (loading) {
    return <AuthLoading />;
  }

  // Auth form
  if (!user) {
  return (
      <>
        <div className="auth-container">
        <div className="auth-card">
          <div className="text-center mb-8">
            <img src={theme === 'dark' ? darkLogo : lightLogo} alt="Sanskrite" className="auth-logo" />
            <h1 className="auth-title">{getTitle()}</h1>
            <p className="auth-subtitle">
              {currentView === 'login' && ''}
              {currentView === 'signup' && ''}
              {currentView === 'reset' && 'Enter your email to reset your password'}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Tabs for switching between login/signup */}
          {currentView !== 'reset' && (
            <div className="auth-tabs">
              <button
                type="button"
                className={`auth-tab ${currentView === 'login' ? 'active' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => setCurrentView('login')}
              >
                Sign In
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={`auth-tab ${currentView === 'signup' ? 'active' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => setCurrentView('signup')}
              >
                Create Account
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {error && (
            <div className={`auth-error ${error.includes('sent') ? 'success' : ''}`}>
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                Email address
              </label>
              <input
                id="email"
                type="email"
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                required
                disabled={formLoading}
                className="auth-input"
                placeholder="Enter your email"
              />
            </div>

            {currentView === 'signup' && (
              <>
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="displayName" className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                    Display Name (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="displayName"
                    type="text"
                    value={displayName}
                    onChange={(e) => setDisplayName(e.target.value)}
                    disabled={formLoading}
                    className="auth-input"
                    placeholder="Enter your display name"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-3" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                    Account Type
                  </label>
                  <div className="flex space-x-4">
                    <label className="flex items-center cursor-pointer">
                      <input 
                        type="radio" 
                        name="accountType" 
                        value="personal" 
                        checked={accountType === 'personal'} 
                        onChange={(e) => setAccountType(e.target.value as 'personal' | 'corporate')} 
                        disabled={formLoading} 
                        className="h-4 w-4"
                        style={{ accentColor: 'var(--accent-brand)' }}
                      />
                      <span className="ml-2 text-sm" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>Personal</span>
                    </label>
                    <label className="flex items-center cursor-pointer">
                      <input 
                        type="radio" 
                        name="accountType" 
                        value="corporate" 
                        checked={accountType === 'corporate'} 
                        onChange={(e) => setAccountType(e.target.value as 'personal' | 'corporate')} 
                        disabled={formLoading} 
                        className="h-4 w-4"
                        style={{ accentColor: 'var(--accent-brand)' }}
                      />
                      <span className="ml-2 text-sm" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>Corporate</span>
                    </label>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-2 text-xs" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
                    {accountType === 'corporate' ? (
                      <div>
                        <p>Use your company email address (public domains like Gmail are not allowed)</p>
                        <p className="mt-1 font-medium">
                          Corporate accounts share data within the domain:{' '}
                          <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent-brand)' }}>
                            {email.includes('@') ? email.split('@')[1] : '[domain]'}
                          </span>
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <p>Personal accounts use your email as a unique workspace</p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {currentView !== 'reset' && (
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="password" className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                  Password
                </label>
                <input
                  id="password"
                  type="password"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                  required
                  disabled={formLoading}
                  className="auth-input"
                  placeholder="Enter your password"
                />
              </div>
            )}

            {currentView === 'signup' && (
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="confirmPassword" className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                  Confirm Password
                </label>
                <input
                  id="confirmPassword"
                  type="password"
                  value={confirmPassword}
                  onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                  required
                  disabled={formLoading}
                  className="auth-input"
                  placeholder="Confirm your password"
                />
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={formLoading}
              className="auth-button"
            >
              {getSubmitText()}
            </button>

            {currentView !== 'reset' && (
              <>
                <div className="auth-divider">or</div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={async () => {
                    setError(null);
                    setFormLoading(true);
                    try {
                      await signInWithGoogle();
                    } catch (err: any) {
                      setError(err.message || 'Failed to sign in with Google');
                    } finally {
                      setFormLoading(false);
                    }
                  }}
                  disabled={formLoading}
                  className="auth-button-google"
                >
                  <svg className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path
                      fill="currentColor"
                      d="M22.56 12.25c0-.78-.07-1.53-.2-2.25H12v4.26h5.92c-.26 1.37-1.04 2.53-2.21 3.31v2.77h3.57c2.08-1.92 3.28-4.74 3.28-8.09z"
                    />
                    <path
                      fill="currentColor"
                      d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z"
                    />
                    <path
                      fill="currentColor"
                      d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.07H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.93l2.85-2.22.81-.62z"
                    />
                    <path
                      fill="currentColor"
                      d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.07l3.66 2.84c.87-2.6 3.3-4.53 6.16-4.53z"
                    />
                  </svg>
                  Sign in with Google
                </button>
              </>
            )}

            <div className="text-center text-sm">
              {currentView === 'login' ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setCurrentView('reset')}
                  className="auth-link"
                  disabled={formLoading}
                >
                  Forgot your password?
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"

import React from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';

export const BillingTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { currentUser } = useAuth();
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [subscription, setSubscription] = React.useState<any>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentUser?.uid) return;
    loadSubscription();
  }, [currentUser?.uid]);

  const loadSubscription = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const sub = await api.getSubscription();
      setSubscription(sub);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('[BillingTab] Error loading subscription:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { 
      year: 'numeric', 
      month: 'long', 
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit'
    });
  };

  const formatCurrency = (amount: number, currency: string = 'USD') => {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency: currency,
    }).format(amount);
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center" style={{ minHeight: '400px' }}>
        <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.billing.loading')}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!subscription) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center" style={{ minHeight: '400px' }}>
        <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.billing.notFound')}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isPaidTier = subscription.tier === 'pro' || subscription.tier === 'max';
  const billingHistory: Array<{
    date: string;
    amount: number;
    currency: string;
    description: string;
    status: string;
  }> = [];

  // Add current period billing if paid tier
  if (isPaidTier && subscription.currentPeriodStart) {
    const tierPrice = subscription.tier === 'pro' ? 29 : 99;
    billingHistory.push({
      date: subscription.currentPeriodStart,
      amount: tierPrice,
      currency: 'USD',
      description: `${subscription.tier.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + subscription.tier.slice(1)} Subscription - ${new Date(subscription.currentPeriodStart).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })}`,
      status: subscription.status === 'active' ? 'paid' : 'pending',
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Billing Summary */}
      {isPaidTier && (
        <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
          <div className="text-13 mb-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{t('account.billing.billingSummary')}</div>
          
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.billing.currentPlan')}:</span>
              <span className="text-13 font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
                {subscription.tier.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + subscription.tier.slice(1)}
              </span>
            </div>
            
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.billing.monthlyCost')}:</span>
              <span className="text-13 font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
                {subscription.tier === 'pro' ? '$29.00' : '$99.00'}
              </span>
            </div>

            {subscription.nextBillingDate && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.billing.nextBillingDate')}:</span>
                <span className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
                  {formatDate(subscription.nextBillingDate)}
                </span>
              </div>
            )}

            {subscription.paymentProvider && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.billing.paymentMethod')}:</span>
                <span className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
                  {subscription.paymentProvider.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + subscription.paymentProvider.slice(1)}
                </span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Billing History */}
      <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
        <div className="text-13 mb-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{t('account.billing.billingHistory')}</div>
        
        {billingHistory.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            {isPaidTier 
              ? t('account.billing.noHistoryPaid')
              : t('account.billing.noHistoryFree')}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {billingHistory.map((item, index) => (
              <div
                key={index}
                className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-10)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}
              >
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <div className="text-13 font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
                    {item.description}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-12 mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                    {formatDate(item.date)}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <div className="text-13 font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
                    {formatCurrency(item.amount, item.currency)}
                  </div>
                  <div 
                    className="text-12 mt-1"
                    style={{
                      color: item.status === 'paid' ? 'rgb(34, 197, 94)' : 'rgb(251, 191, 36)',
                    }}
                  >
                    {item.status === 'paid' ? t('account.billing.paid') : t('account.billing.pending')}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Payment Information */}
      {isPaidTier && subscription.paymentProvider === 'paypal' && (
        <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
          <div className="text-13 mb-3" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{t('account.billing.paymentInformation')}</div>
          <div className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            {t('account.billing.paypalInfo')}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useWsStore } from '../stores/wsStore';

export const BottomBar: React.FC = () => {
  const { connected, health, modalOpen, setModalOpen, getDiagnostics } = useWsStore();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleLegalClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>, type: 'terms' | 'privacy') => {
    e.preventDefault();
    navigate(`/${type}`);
  };

  return (
    <div className="bottombar">
      {/* Left side - Connection status indicator (aligned with topbar logo/settings spacing) */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4">
        <div
          style={{
            width: '5px',
            height: '5px',
            borderRadius: '50%',
            backgroundColor: health === 'ok' ? 'var(--text-primary)' : (health === 'degraded' ? 'var(--accent-warning)' : 'var(--accent-danger)'),
            transition: 'background-color 300ms ease',
          }}
          title={health === 'ok' ? 'Connected' : (health === 'degraded' ? 'Degraded' : 'Disconnected')}
          aria-label={health === 'ok' ? 'Connected' : (health === 'degraded' ? 'Degraded' : 'Disconnected')}
          onClick={() => setModalOpen(!modalOpen)}
          role="button"
          tabIndex={0}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Center - Empty for now */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4" />

      {/* Right side - Links */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4">
        <a 
          href="/privacy" 
          className="underline" 
          style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', fontSize: '11px', lineHeight: '1' }} 
          onClick={(e) => handleLegalClick(e, 'privacy')}
        >
          Privacy Notice
        </a>
        <a 
          href="/terms" 
          className="underline" 
          style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', fontSize: '11px', lineHeight: '1' }} 
          onClick={(e) => handleLegalClick(e, 'terms')}
        >
          Terms of Usage
        </a>
      </div>

      {modalOpen && (
        <div style={{ position: 'fixed', left: 0, top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)', zIndex: 1000 }} onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}>
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 16, bottom: 48, width: 520, maxWidth: '90vw', background: 'var(--bg-elevated)', color: 'var(--text-primary)', borderRadius: 8, padding: 12, boxShadow: '0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)' }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
              <div className="text-14" style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>WebSocket diagnostics</div>
              <button className="text-12" onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)} style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>Close</button>
            </div>
            <textarea readOnly value={getDiagnostics()} style={{ width: '100%', height: 260, fontFamily: 'ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace', fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 1.4, background: 'var(--bg)', color: 'var(--text-primary)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 6, padding: 8 }} />
            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
              <button className="text-12" onClick={() => { try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(getDiagnostics()); } catch {} }}>
                Copy
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';

interface BringInIndicatorProps {
  interaction: any;
}

export const BringInIndicator: React.FC<BringInIndicatorProps> = ({
  interaction,
}) => {
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore();

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (window.confirm('Delete this indicator message?')) {
      try {
        await genaiChat.deleteInteraction(interaction.id);
      } catch (e) {
        alert('Failed to delete message. Please try again.');
        console.error('[Delete] Error:', e);
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      key={interaction.id}
      className="my-1.5 flex justify-end group relative"
    >
      {/* Delete button - appears on hover */}
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label="Delete indicator message"
        className="absolute top-2 right-2 p-1.5 rounded opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity z-10"
        style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent' }}
        onClick={handleDelete}
        onMouseEnter={(e) => {
          (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
            'var(--white-10)';

import React from 'react';
import { ResponsiveContainer, LineChart, Line, BarChart, Bar, AreaChart, Area, ComposedChart, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Legend, Tooltip } from 'recharts';

interface ChatGraphMessageProps {
  chartTitle: string;
  chartType?: string;
  table: (string | number)[][];
  sources: string[];
}

const COLORS_LIGHT = [
  '#4078c0', // blue
  '#e87c22', // orange
  '#66bb6a', // green
  '#dc3987', // magenta
  '#a05abb', // purple
  '#d34088', // pink
  '#f5b800', // yellow
  '#0086b3', // cyan
];
const COLORS_DARK = [
  '#60aaff', '#eab676', '#c7f464', '#ea5d93', '#b388ff', '#f06292', '#ffd740', '#80d6ff',
];

function isUrl(text: string) {
  try { return /^https?:\/\//.test(text); } catch { return false; }
}

const ChatGraphMessage: React.FC<ChatGraphMessageProps> = ({ chartTitle, chartType = 'line', table, sources }) => {
  const [err, setErr] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  // detect theme
  const isDark = typeof window !== 'undefined' && document.body ?
    getComputedStyle(document.body).getPropertyValue('--text-heading').includes('255') : false;
  const COLORS = isDark ? COLORS_DARK : COLORS_LIGHT;

  // Validate chartType and fallback to 'line' if invalid
  const allowedTypes = ['line', 'bar', 'area', 'stackedBar', 'stackedArea', 'composed'];
  const validChartType = typeof chartType === 'string' && allowedTypes.includes(chartType) ? chartType : 'line';

  // Валидация/препроцессинг
  let content = null;
  if (!Array.isArray(table) || table.length < 2 || table[0].length < 2) {
    content = <div style={{ color: 'var(--accent-danger)' }}>Ошибка: некорректная структура данных для графика.</div>;
  } else {
    try {
      // Первая строка — X (ось: время/категории), кроме 0-й колонки
      const xLabels = table[0].slice(1);
      // Остальные строки: label = первая колонка, значения — далее
      const series: { label: string; data: (number|null)[] }[] = table.slice(1).map((row) => ({
        label: String(row[0]),
        data: row.slice(1).map((v) => {
          const n = Number(v);
          return isNaN(n) ? null : n;
        })
      }));
      // Преобразуем к виду, подходящему для recharts: массив объектов с x, [y1, y2 ...]
      const chartData = xLabels.map((x, xIdx) => {
        const obj: any = { x: String(x) };
        series.forEach((s) => {
          obj[s.label] = typeof s.data[xIdx] === 'number' ? s.data[xIdx] : null;
        });
        return obj;
      });

      // Common chart props
      const commonProps = {
        data: chartData,
        margin: { top: 14, right: 24, left: 12, bottom: 12 }
      };

      // Render series based on chart type
      const renderSeries = () => {
        return series.map((s, i) => {
          const color = COLORS[i % COLORS.length];
          switch (validChartType) {
            case 'line':
              return (
                <Line
                  key={s.label}
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey={s.label}
                  stroke={color}
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  dot={{ r: 2.5 }}
                  activeDot={{ r: 5 }}
                  connectNulls
                />
              );
            case 'bar':
              return (
                <Bar
                  key={s.label}
                  dataKey={s.label}
                  fill={color}
                />
              );
            case 'area':
              return (
                <Area
                  key={s.label}
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey={s.label}
                  stroke={color}
                  fill={color}
                  fillOpacity={0.6}
                  connectNulls
                />
              );
            case 'stackedBar':
              return (
                <Bar
                  key={s.label}
                  dataKey={s.label}
                  stackId="stack"
                  fill={color}
                />
              );
            case 'stackedArea':
              return (
                <Area
                  key={s.label}
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey={s.label}
                  stackId="stack"
                  stroke={color}
                  fill={color}
                  fillOpacity={0.6}
                  connectNulls
                />
              );
            case 'composed':
              // For composed, use bars for first series, lines for others
              return i === 0 ? (
                <Bar
                  key={s.label}
                  dataKey={s.label}
                  fill={color}
                />
              ) : (
                <Line
                  key={s.label}
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey={s.label}
                  stroke={color}
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  dot={{ r: 2.5 }}
                  activeDot={{ r: 5 }}
                  connectNulls
                />
              );
            default:
              return (
                <Line
                  key={s.label}
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey={s.label}
                  stroke={color}
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  dot={{ r: 2.5 }}
                  activeDot={{ r: 5 }}
                  connectNulls
                />
              );
          }
        });
      };

      // Select chart component based on type (children nested explicitly)
      const renderChart = () => {
        switch (validChartType) {
          case 'bar':
          case 'stackedBar':
            return (
              <BarChart data={commonProps.data} margin={commonProps.margin}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="var(--overlay-line-90)" />
                <XAxis dataKey="x" stroke="var(--text-secondary)" />
                <YAxis stroke="var(--text-secondary)" />
                <Tooltip />
                <Legend />
                {renderSeries()}
              </BarChart>
            );
          case 'area':
          case 'stackedArea':
            return (
              <AreaChart data={commonProps.data} margin={commonProps.margin}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="var(--overlay-line-90)" />
                <XAxis dataKey="x" stroke="var(--text-secondary)" />
                <YAxis stroke="var(--text-secondary)" />
                <Tooltip />
                <Legend />
                {renderSeries()}
              </AreaChart>
            );
          case 'composed':
            return (
              <ComposedChart data={commonProps.data} margin={commonProps.margin}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="var(--overlay-line-90)" />
                <XAxis dataKey="x" stroke="var(--text-secondary)" />
                <YAxis stroke="var(--text-secondary)" />
                <Tooltip />
                <Legend />
                {renderSeries()}
              </ComposedChart>
            );
          case 'line':
          default:
            return (
              <LineChart data={commonProps.data} margin={commonProps.margin}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="var(--overlay-line-90)" />
                <XAxis dataKey="x" stroke="var(--text-secondary)" />
                <YAxis stroke="var(--text-secondary)" />
                <Tooltip />
                <Legend />
                {renderSeries()}
              </LineChart>
            );
        }
      };

      content = (
        <div style={{ width: '100%', minHeight: 280 }}>
          <div className="text-[14px] font-bold mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{chartTitle}</div>
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={280}>
            {renderChart()}
          </ResponsiveContainer>
          {sources && sources.length > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-2 text-xs" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
              <div className="font-semibold mb-0.5">Источники данных:</div>
              <ul className="list-disc pl-4 space-y-0.5">
                {sources.map((src, i) => (
                  <li key={i}>
                    {isUrl(src)
                      ? <a href={src} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style={{ color: 'var(--link)', textDecoration: 'underline' }}>{src}</a>
                      : <span>{src}</span>
                    }
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr('Ошибка при построении графика: ' + (e?.message || 'unknown'));
      content = <div style={{ color: 'var(--accent-danger)' }}>Ошибка построения графика: {String(e?.message || '')}</div>;
    }
  }
  return <div className="etg-graphmessage" style={{ background: 'transparent', borderRadius: 12, padding: '18px 16px', marginTop: 2 }}>{content}</div>;
};

export default ChatGraphMessage;


================================================================================
Файл: ChatMessage.tsx
Путь: src/components/ChatMessage.tsx
================================================================================

import React from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

interface ChatMessageProps {
  role: 'user' | 'assistant';
  children: React.ReactNode;
  footer?: React.ReactNode;
  align?: 'left' | 'right';
  headerText?: string;
  thinkingSeconds?: number;
  isThinking?: boolean;
  isError?: boolean;
  bgOverride?: string;
  leftAccent?: boolean;
  averageTimingSeconds?: number | null; // Average response time estimate in seconds
}

const ChatMessage: React.FC<ChatMessageProps> = ({
  role,
  children,
  footer,
  align = 'left',
  headerText,
  thinkingSeconds,
  isThinking,
  isError,
  bgOverride,
  leftAccent,
  averageTimingSeconds,
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const messageRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const [isHighlighted, setIsHighlighted] = React.useState(false);

  // Check parent element for data-delete-hovered attribute
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (role !== 'assistant') return;
    
    const checkParent = () => {
      const parent = messageRef.current?.closest('.group');
      if (parent) {
        const hasAttribute = parent.hasAttribute('data-delete-hovered');
        setIsHighlighted(hasAttribute);
      }
    };

    // Check initially
    checkParent();

    // Use MutationObserver to watch for attribute changes
    const parent = messageRef.current?.closest('.group');
    if (parent) {
      const observer = new MutationObserver(checkParent);
      observer.observe(parent, {
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['data-delete-hovered'],
      });
      return () => observer.disconnect();
    }
  }, [role]);
  
  // Icon components for roles
  const UserIcon = () => (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-center rounded-full" style={{ 
      width: 20, 
      height: 20, 
      backgroundColor: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)',
      color: 'var(--bg-body)',
      flexShrink: 0
    }}>
      <svg className="w-3 h-3" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
        <circle cx="12" cy="8" r="3"/>
        <path d="M4 20c0-3.314 3.134-6 7-6s7 2.686 7 6"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
  );

  const RobotIcon = () => (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-center rounded-full" style={{ 
      width: 20, 
      height: 20, 
      backgroundColor: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)',
      color: 'var(--bg-body)',
      flexShrink: 0
    }}>
      <svg className="w-3 h-3" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
        <rect x="5" y="2" width="14" height="20" rx="2"/>
        <circle cx="9" cy="9" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/>
        <circle cx="15" cy="9" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/>
        <path d="M9 14h6M9 17h6"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
  );

  const header = headerText || (role === 'user' ? t('chatMessage.userRole', { defaultValue: 'you' }) : t('chatMessage.assistantRole', { defaultValue: 'assistant' }));
  const containerStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    maxWidth: align === 'right' ? '75%' : '100%',
    width: align === 'right' ? 'fit-content' : '100%',
    // For user messages use theme-aware adjusted background
    backgroundColor: bgOverride 
      ? bgOverride 
      : (role === 'user' 
          ? 'var(--user-msg-bg)' 
          : (isHighlighted ? 'var(--white-10)' : 'transparent')),
    border: 'none',
    borderLeft: leftAccent ? '2px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' : 'none',
    boxSizing: 'border-box', // Ensure border-left doesn't add to width
    minWidth: 0, // Allow flex items to shrink below content size
    // Add smooth transition for highlight effect
    transition: role === 'assistant' ? 'background-color 0.2s ease' : undefined,
  };
  
  // Build header with icon and optional timing info
  let headerContent: React.ReactNode = (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
      {role === 'user' ? <UserIcon /> : <RobotIcon />}
      {headerText && (
        <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
          {headerText}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  if (isThinking && role === 'assistant') {
    const thinkingText = t('chatMessage.thinking', { seconds: thinkingSeconds ?? 0, defaultValue: `thinking ${thinkingSeconds ?? 0} sec` });
    headerContent = (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <RobotIcon />
        {headerText ? (
          <>
            <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
              {headerText}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>•</span>
            <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
              {thinkingText}
            </span>
          </>
        ) : (
          <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
            {thinkingText}
          </span>
        )}
        {averageTimingSeconds !== null && averageTimingSeconds !== undefined && (
          <>
            <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>•</span>
            <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
              {t('chatMessage.averageResponseTime', { seconds: averageTimingSeconds, defaultValue: `average response time ${averageTimingSeconds} sec` })}
            </span>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }
  
  // Transparent, no borders; color handled by parent theme
  return (
    <div ref={messageRef} className={`rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 ${align === 'right' ? 'ml-auto' : ''}`} style={containerStyle}>
      <div className="mb-1">
        {headerContent}
      </div>
      <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
        {isError ? (
          <div>
            {t('chatMessage.errorMessage', { 
              defaultValue: 'К сожалению, не удалось обработать запрос. Мы зафиксировали техническую неполадку и уже анализируем ситуацию. Пожалуйста, повторите попытку чуть позже.' 
            })}
          </div>
        ) : (
          children
        )}
      </div>
      {footer && (
        <div className="mt-1 flex justify-end">
          {footer}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ChatMessage;

import React from 'react';

import { EvaluationDetails } from './EvaluationDetails';

interface ChatMessagesListProps {
  mergedMessages: Array<{ type: 'message' | 'interaction'; data: any }>;

    preStanceLatency: Record<string, number>;
    evaluations: Record<string, any>;

  };

  averageTimingSeconds: number | null;

    strength: string;
    model: string;
    groundingEnabled: boolean;
  };

  onToggleCollapse: (sectionId: string) => void;

  onEditFinish: (id: string) => void;

}

export const ChatMessagesList: React.FC<ChatMessagesListProps> = ({

  onEditError,

  return (

      {(() => {

        return mergedMessages.map((item) => {
          if (item.type === 'message') {
            const m = item.data;
            return (
              <MessageItem
                key={m.id}
                message={m}

                  streaming: genaiChat.streaming,
                  error: genaiChat.error,
                  messageMeta: genaiChat.messageMeta,
                  preStanceLatency: genaiChat.preStanceLatency,

                genaiThinkingSeconds={genaiThinkingSeconds}
                averageTimingSeconds={averageTimingSeconds}
                genaiSettings={{
                  strength: genaiSettings.strength,
                  model: genaiSettings.model,
                  groundingEnabled: genaiSettings.groundingEnabled,
                }}
                expandedChip={expandedChip}
                onExpandChip={onExpandChip}
              />
            );
          } else {
            // item.type === 'interaction'
            const it = item.data;
            // Render section markers
            if (
              it.kind === 'section_start' ||

                                                isExpanded
                                                  ? 'var(--white-25)'
                                                  : 'var(--white-15)';
                                          }}
                                          onMouseLeave={(
                                            e,
                                          ) => {
                                            if (
                                              needsExpand
                                            )
                                              (
                                                e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement
                                              ).style.backgroundColor =
                                                isExpanded
                                                  ? 'var(--white-20)'
                                                  : 'var(--white-10)';
                                          }}
                                        >
                                          {isExpanded
                                            ? String(
                                                q || '',
                                              )
                                            : short}
                                        </button>
                                      );
                                    },
                                  )}
                                  {attrs.map(
                                    (
                                      a: any,
                                      i: number,
                                    ) => {
                                      const chipId = `${it.id}-src-${i}`;
                                      const isExpanded =
                                        expandedChip ===
                                        chipId;
                                      const raw = String(
                                        (a as any).url ||
                                          '',
                                      ).replace(
                                        /^https?:\/\//i,
                                        '',
                                      );
                                      const parts =
                                        raw.split('/');
                                      const host =
                                        parts[0] || '';
                                      const tail =
                                        parts[1]
                                          ? `/${parts[1]}`
                                          : '';
                                      const label =
                                        host + tail ||
                                        (a as any)
                                          .title ||
                                        'link';
                                      const needsExpand =
                                        raw.length >
                                        (host + tail)
                                          .length;
                                      return (
                                        <a
                                          key={`src-${i}`}
                                          href={
                                            (a as any).url
                                          }
                                          target="_blank"
                                          rel="noreferrer"
                                          className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] underline transition-colors"
                                          style={{
                                            backgroundColor:
                                              isExpanded
                                                ? 'var(--white-20)'
                                                : 'var(--white-10)',
                                            color:
                                              'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
                                          }}
                                          onClick={(
                                            e,
                                          ) => {
                                            if (
                                              needsExpand
                                            ) {
                                              e.preventDefault();
                                              onExpandChip(
                                                isExpanded
                                                  ? null
                                                  : chipId,
                                              );
                                            }
                                          }}
                                          onMouseEnter={(
                                            e,
                                          ) => {
                                            (
                                              e.currentTarget as HTMLAnchorElement
                                            ).style.backgroundColor =
                                              isExpanded
                                                ? 'var(--white-25)'
                                                : 'var(--white-15)';
                                          }}
                                          onMouseLeave={(
                                            e,
                                          ) => {
                                            (
                                              e.currentTarget as HTMLAnchorElement
                                            ).style.backgroundColor =
                                              isExpanded
                                                ? 'var(--white-20)'
                                                : 'var(--white-10)';
                                          }}
                                        >
                                          {isExpanded
                                            ? raw
                                            : label}
                                        </a>
                                      );
                                    },
                                  )}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            );
                          } catch {
                            return null;
                          }
                        })()}
                      {!isUser && (
                        <ActionRow
                          messageId={it.id}
                          isAssistant={!isUser}
                          content={
                            it.contentSanitized ||
                            it.content
                          }
                        />
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}
                </ChatMessage>
              </div>
            );
          }
        });
      })()}
      {genaiChat.streaming &&
        (() => {
          try {
            const m =
              genaiChat.messages[
                genaiChat.messages.length - 1
              ];
            if (!m || m.role !== 'assistant') return null;
            // Don't show placeholder if message has content (streaming has started producing content)
            if (m.content && m.content.trim())
              return null;
            
            return (
              <ThinkingPlaceholder
                key={m.id}
                messageId={m.id}
                genaiThinkingSeconds={genaiThinkingSeconds}
                averageTimingSeconds={averageTimingSeconds}
              />
            );
          } catch {
            return null;
          }
        })()}
    </>
  );
};

Файл: CollapsibleText.tsx
Путь: src/components/CollapsibleText.tsx

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

interface CollapsibleTextProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  maxLines?: number;
  className?: string;
}

export const CollapsibleText: React.FC<CollapsibleTextProps> = ({
  children,
  maxLines = 7,
  className = '',
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [needsCollapse, setNeedsCollapse] = useState(false);
  const [maxHeight, setMaxHeight] = useState<number>(0);
  const contentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const isCheckingRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let resizeObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null;
    let debounceTimeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    
    const checkHeight = () => {
      if (isCheckingRef.current || !contentRef.current) return;
      
      isCheckingRef.current = true;
      
      // Temporarily disconnect ResizeObserver to prevent infinite loops
      if (resizeObserver) {
        resizeObserver.disconnect();
      }
      
      try {
        // Get computed line height
        const computedStyle = window.getComputedStyle(contentRef.current);
        const lineHeight = parseFloat(computedStyle.lineHeight);
        
        // Use line height if available, otherwise estimate (text-13 typically has ~20px line height)
        const effectiveLineHeight = lineHeight && !isNaN(lineHeight) && lineHeight > 0 ? lineHeight : 20;
        const calculatedMaxHeight = effectiveLineHeight * maxLines;
        
        // Temporarily remove max-height to measure full height
        const originalMaxHeight = contentRef.current.style.maxHeight;
        const originalOverflow = contentRef.current.style.overflow;
        contentRef.current.style.maxHeight = 'none';
        contentRef.current.style.overflow = 'visible';
        const actualHeight = contentRef.current.scrollHeight;
        contentRef.current.style.maxHeight = originalMaxHeight;
        contentRef.current.style.overflow = originalOverflow;
        
        // Only update state if values actually changed to prevent infinite loops
        setMaxHeight(prev => prev !== calculatedMaxHeight ? calculatedMaxHeight : prev);
        setNeedsCollapse(prev => {
          const newValue = actualHeight > calculatedMaxHeight;
          return prev !== newValue ? newValue : prev;
        });
      } finally {
        // Reconnect ResizeObserver after a delay to allow DOM to settle
        setTimeout(() => {
          isCheckingRef.current = false;
          if (contentRef.current && resizeObserver) {
            resizeObserver.observe(contentRef.current);
          }
        }, 50);
      }
    };

    // Debounced version for ResizeObserver
    const debouncedCheckHeight = () => {
      if (debounceTimeout) {
        clearTimeout(debounceTimeout);
      }
      debounceTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        if (!isCheckingRef.current) {
          checkHeight();
        }
      }, 100);
    };

    // Check immediately
    checkHeight();

    // Also check after delays to account for async rendering (e.g., markdown, images)
    const timeoutId1 = setTimeout(checkHeight, 100);
    const timeoutId2 = setTimeout(checkHeight, 500);
    const timeoutId3 = setTimeout(checkHeight, 1000);

    // Use ResizeObserver to detect when content size changes
    if (contentRef.current) {
      resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(debouncedCheckHeight);
      resizeObserver.observe(contentRef.current);
    }

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId1);
      clearTimeout(timeoutId2);
      clearTimeout(timeoutId3);
      if (debounceTimeout) {
        clearTimeout(debounceTimeout);
      }
      if (resizeObserver) {
        resizeObserver.disconnect();
      }
    };
  }, [children, maxLines]);

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <div
        ref={contentRef}
        style={{
          maxHeight: !isExpanded && needsCollapse && maxHeight > 0 ? `${maxHeight}px` : 'none',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          transition: 'max-height 0.2s ease-out',
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
      {needsCollapse && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsExpanded(!isExpanded)}
          className="mt-1 text-[11px] underline"
          style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}
        >
          {isExpanded ? t('chatMessage.showLess', { defaultValue: 'Less...' }) : t('chatMessage.showMore', { defaultValue: 'More...' })}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { findFirstRange } from '../lib/textHighlight';

interface ContextPanelProps {
  sectionStarts: any[];
  pinnedInteractions: any[];
  messagesRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  scrollToInteraction: (id: string) => void;
  truncateCenterWords: (s: string, headWords?: number, tailWords?: number) => string;
  onRemoveNote: (interactionId: string, noteIndex: number) => Promise<void>;
}

export const ContextPanel: React.FC<ContextPanelProps> = ({
  sectionStarts,
  pinnedInteractions,
  messagesRef,
  scrollToInteraction,
  truncateCenterWords,
  onRemoveNote,
}) => {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      {/* Sections list */}
      {sectionStarts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mb-2">

              color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
            }}
          >

              className="w-3.5 h-3.5"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
            >
              <rect
                x="4"
                y="5"
                width="16"
                height="4"
                rx="1"
                strokeWidth="2"
              />
              <rect
                x="4"
                y="11"
                width="16"
                height="4"
                rx="1"
                strokeWidth="2"
              />
              <rect
                x="4"
                y="17"
                width="16"
                height="2"
                rx="1"
                strokeWidth="2"
              />
            </svg>
            <span>Sections</span>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1">
            {sectionStarts.map((s) => (
              <button
                key={s.id}
                type="button"
                className="w-full text-left p-2 rounded transition-colors"
                style={{
                  background: 'var(--white-06)',
                  border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
                  color: 'var(--text-heading)',
                }}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                  (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                    'var(--white-12)';
                }}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                  (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                    'var(--white-06)';
                }}
                onClick={() => scrollToInteraction(s.id)}
              >
                <div className="text-12 truncate">
                  {(s as any).content || 'Section'}
                </div>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Pinned messages */}
      <div
        className="text-[11px] mb-1 mt-3 flex items-center gap-1"
        style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}
      >
        <svg
          className="w-3.5 h-3.5"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="currentColor"
          style={{ color: 'var(--accent-research)' }}
        >
          <path d="M5 5a2 2 0 012-2h10a2 2 0 012 2v16l-7-3.5L5 21V5z" />
        </svg>
        <span>Pinned messages</span>
      </div>
      {pinnedInteractions.length === 0 ? (
        <div
          className="text-12"
          style={{
            color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
          }}
        >
          No pinned messages yet.
        </div>
      ) : (
        pinnedInteractions.map((it) => (
          <div
            key={it.id}
            className="p-2 rounded text-left w-full transition-colors"
            style={{
              background: 'var(--white-06)',
              border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
            }}
          >
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => scrollToInteraction(it.id)}
                className="text-left"
                style={{ flex: 1 }}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                  (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).parentElement!.parentElement!.style.backgroundColor =
                    'var(--white-12)';
                }}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                  (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).parentElement!.parentElement!.style.backgroundColor =
                    'var(--white-06)';
                }}
              >
                <div
                  className="text-[11px] mb-1"
                  style={{
                    color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)',
                  }}
                >
                  {it.kind === 'assistant'
                    ? 'Assistant'
                    : it.kind === 'user'
                      ? 'User'
                      : it.agentProfile
                        ? 'Agent'
                        : it.kind || ''}
                </div>
                <div
                  className="text-12"
                  style={{
                    color: 'var(--text-heading)',
                    whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
                  }}
                >
                  {truncateCenterWords(
                    it.contentSanitized || it.content || '',
                  )}
                </div>
              </button>
            </div>
            {Array.isArray(it?.metadata?.notes) &&
              it.metadata!.notes!.length > 0 && (
                <div className="mt-2 space-y-1">
                  {it.metadata!.notes!.map((note: string, idx: number) => (
                    <div
                      key={idx}
                      className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 p-1 rounded"
                      style={{
                        background: 'var(--white-10)',
                      }}
                    >
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="text-left flex-1"
                        style={{
                          color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
                          whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
                        }}
                        title="Scroll to note in message"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          try {
                            const container = document.querySelector(
                              `.markdown[data-interaction-id="${it.id}"]`,
                            ) as HTMLElement | null;
                            if (container) {
                              const noteText = String(note).trim();
                              const r = noteText
                                ? findFirstRange(container, noteText)
                                : null;
                              if (r) {
                                const rect = r.getBoundingClientRect();
                                const host = messagesRef.current as HTMLElement | null;
                                if (host) {
                                  const hostRect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
                                  const offset =
                                    rect.top -
                                    hostRect.top +
                                    host.scrollTop -
                                    host.clientHeight / 2;
                                  host.scrollTo({
                                    top: Math.max(0, offset),
                                    behavior: 'smooth',
                                  });
                                } else {
                                  container.scrollIntoView({
                                    behavior: 'smooth',
                                    block: 'center',
                                  });
                                }
                              } else {
                                if (messagesRef.current) {
                                  const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
                                  const host = messagesRef.current;
                                  const hostRect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
                                  const offset =
                                    rect.top -
                                    hostRect.top +
                                    host.scrollTop -
                                    host.clientHeight / 2;
                                  host.scrollTo({
                                    top: Math.max(0, offset),
                                    behavior: 'smooth',
                                  });
                                } else {
                                  container.scrollIntoView({
                                    behavior: 'smooth',
                                    block: 'center',
                                  });
                                }
                              }
                            } else {
                              scrollToInteraction(it.id);
                            }
                          } catch (err) {
                            console.warn('[ScrollToNote] Failed', err);
                            try {
                              scrollToInteraction(it.id);
                            } catch {}
                          }
                        }}
                      >
                        <span className="text-[12px]">{note}</span>
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        aria-label="Remove note"
                        className="p-1 rounded"
                        style={{
                          background: 'transparent',
                          color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
                        }}
                        onClick={async (ev) => {
                          ev.stopPropagation();
                          await onRemoveNote(it.id, idx);
                        }}
                        onMouseEnter={(ev) => {
                          (ev.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                            'var(--white-12)';
                        }}
                        onMouseLeave={(ev) => {
                          (ev.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                            'transparent';
                        }}
                      >
                        <svg
                          className="w-3 h-3"
                          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                          fill="none"
                          stroke="currentColor"
                        >
                          <path
                            strokeLinecap="round"
                            strokeWidth={2}
                            d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"
                          />
                        </svg>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
          </div>
        ))
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { ThemeContext } from './ThemeProvider';

interface DiscoveryRequestProps {
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  onSubmit: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

const DiscoveryRequest: React.FC<DiscoveryRequestProps> = ({ value, onChange, onSubmit, disabled }) => {
  const { theme } = React.useContext(ThemeContext);
  const containerStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    borderColor: 'var(--overlay-line-90)',
    backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)',
    boxShadow: theme === 'light' ? '0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)' : 'none',
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border overflow-hidden mt-2" style={containerStyle}>
      <div className="p-3">
        <div className="flex items-end gap-3">
          <div className="flex-1">
            <textarea
              rows={3}
              value={value}
              onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="What would you like to discover? Include URLs or @telegram handles..."
              className="w-full resize-none bg-transparent outline-none"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent', border: 'none', outline: 'none', color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
              aria-label="Discovery query"
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  onSubmit();
                }
              }}
            />
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Send"
            className="flex items-center justify-center rounded-full"
            onClick={() => { if (!disabled) onSubmit(); }}
            disabled={disabled}
            style={{
              width: '32px',
              height: '32px',
              backgroundColor: 'transparent',
              opacity: disabled ? 0.6 : 1,
            }}
          >
            <svg className="w-6 h-6" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
              <path d="M8 5v14l11-7z" fill="var(--text-secondary-strong)" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default DiscoveryRequest;
