import React from 'react';
import { useDiscoveryStore } from '../stores/discoveryStore';

type Kind = 'entities' | 'facts' | 'events' | 'metrics' | 'decisions';

const kinds: Kind[] = ['entities', 'facts', 'events', 'metrics', 'decisions'];

function useCountAndStatus(kind: Kind) {
  const last = useDiscoveryStore((s: any) => s.lastAnalysisStatus);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = React.useState<boolean>(false);
  const status = (last && String(last.kind).toLowerCase() === kind) ? String(last.status || '') : '';
  const countStatus: number | undefined = (last && String(last.kind).toLowerCase() === kind && typeof last.count === 'number') ? last.count : undefined;
  const elapsedMs: number | undefined = (last && String(last.kind).toLowerCase() === kind && typeof last.elapsedMs === 'number') ? last.elapsedMs : undefined;
  return { status, countStatus, elapsedMs, expanded, setExpanded } as const;
}

function useKindItems(projectId: string, kind: Kind, expanded: boolean) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [items, setItems] = React.useState<any[]>([]);

  const load = React.useCallback(async () => {
    if (!expanded) return;
    if (!projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') { setItems([]); return; }
    setLoading(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const { api } = await import('../lib/api');
      const docs = await api.docsList(projectId);
      const filename = `${kind}.json`;
      const doc = docs.find((d: any) => String(d.filename || '').toLowerCase() === filename);
      if (!doc?.id) { setItems([]); return; }
      const blob = await api.docsDownload(projectId, doc.id);
      const text = await new Response(blob).text();
      const json = JSON.parse(text || '{}');
      const arr = Array.isArray((json as any)[kind]) ? (json as any)[kind] : [];
      setItems(arr);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(`Failed to load ${kind}`);
      setItems([]);
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  }, [projectId, kind, expanded]);

  React.useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  return { loading, error, items } as const;
}

const SectionHeader: React.FC<{ title: string; badge?: number; badgeLoading?: boolean; status?: string; onRefresh?: () => void; expanded: boolean; onToggle: () => void }>
  = ({ title, badge, badgeLoading, status, onRefresh, expanded, onToggle }) => {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-sidebar)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
      <button type="button" onClick={onToggle} className="rounded flex items-center" aria-label={expanded ? 'Collapse' : 'Expand'}
        style={{ background: 'transparent', color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
          <path d={expanded ? 'M6 15l6-6 6 6' : 'M6 9l6 6 6-6'} strokeWidth={2} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
        </svg>
      </button>
      <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{title}</div>
      {badgeLoading ? (
        <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--brand-10)', color: 'var(--blue-400)' }}>⏳</span>
      ) : (
        typeof badge === 'number' && (
          <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--brand-10)', color: 'var(--blue-400)' }}>{badge}</span>
        )
      )}
      <div style={{ flex: 1 }} />
      {status && (
        <span className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{status}</span>
      )}
      {onRefresh && (
        <button type="button" onClick={onRefresh} className="rounded px-2 py-1 text-[11px]"
          style={{ border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)', background: 'transparent', color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
          Refresh
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

const FindingsPanel: React.FC<{ projectId: string }> = ({ projectId }) => {
  const apiRef = React.useRef<typeof import('../lib/api') | null>(null);
  React.useEffect(() => { import('../lib/api').then((m) => { apiRef.current = m; }); }, []);
  const last = useDiscoveryStore((s: any) => s.lastAnalysisStatus);

  const [countMap, setCountMap] = React.useState<Partial<Record<Kind, number>>>({});
  const [loadingCounts, setLoadingCounts] = React.useState<Partial<Record<Kind, boolean>>>({});
  const isLoadingAny = React.useMemo(() => Object.values(loadingCounts).some(Boolean), [loadingCounts]);

  const loadCount = React.useCallback(async (kind: Kind) => {
    if (!projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') { setCountMap((m) => ({ ...m, [kind]: 0 })); return; }
    try {
      setLoadingCounts((m) => ({ ...m, [kind]: true }));
      const api = (apiRef.current as any)?.api || (await import('../lib/api')).api;
      const docs = await api.docsList(projectId);
      const filename = `${kind}.json`;
      const doc = docs.find((d: any) => String(d.filename || '').toLowerCase() === filename);
      if (!doc?.id) { setCountMap((m) => ({ ...m, [kind]: 0 })); return; }
      const blob = await api.docsDownload(projectId, doc.id);
      const text = await new Response(blob).text();
      const json = JSON.parse(text || '{}');
      const arr = Array.isArray((json as any)[kind]) ? (json as any)[kind] : [];
      setCountMap((m) => ({ ...m, [kind]: arr.length }));
    } catch {
      setCountMap((m) => ({ ...m, [kind]: 0 }));
    } finally {
      setLoadingCounts((m) => ({ ...m, [kind]: false }));
    }
  }, [projectId]);

  // When panel opens (mount) or project changes – preload counts for all kinds
  React.useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        await Promise.all(kinds.map((k) => cancelled ? Promise.resolve() : loadCount(k)));
      } catch {}
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [projectId, loadCount]);

  // When a kind finishes analysis, refresh its count
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!last || !projectId) return;
    try {
      const k = String(last.kind || '').toLowerCase() as Kind;
      const st = String(last.status || '').toLowerCase();
      if ((kinds as string[]).includes(k) && (st === 'done' || st === 'failed')) {
        loadCount(k as Kind);
      }
    } catch {}
  }, [last, projectId, loadCount]);

  const refresh = React.useCallback(async (kind: Kind) => {
    try {
      const api = (apiRef.current as any)?.api;
      if (!api || !projectId) return;
      switch (kind) {
        case 'entities': await api.analyzeEntities(projectId, ''); break;
        case 'facts': await api.analyzeFacts(projectId, ''); break;
        case 'events': await api.analyzeEvents(projectId, ''); break;
        case 'metrics': await api.analyzeMetrics(projectId, ''); break;
        case 'decisions': await api.analyzeDecisions(projectId, ''); break;
      }
    } catch {}
  }, [projectId]);

  const refreshAll = React.useCallback(async () => {
    for (const k of kinds) { await refresh(k); }
  }, [refresh]);

  const fmtStatus = (kind: Kind, status: string, count?: number, elapsedMs?: number) => {
    const t = (ms?: number) => (typeof ms === 'number' ? (ms < 1000 ? `${Math.round(ms)}ms` : `${(ms/1000).toFixed(1)}s`) : '');
    const plural = (n: number, one: string, many: string) => (n === 1 ? one : many);
    const s = status.toLowerCase();
    if (s === 'started') return `Analyzing ${kind}…`;
    if (s === 'done') {
      const n = typeof count === 'number' ? count : 0;
      const tt = t(elapsedMs);
      const labelFor = (baseKind: Kind) => {
        const unitOne = baseKind === 'entities' ? 'entity'
          : baseKind === 'facts' ? 'fact'
          : baseKind === 'events' ? 'event'
          : baseKind === 'metrics' ? 'metric'
          : 'decision';
        const unitMany = baseKind === 'entities' ? 'entities'
          : baseKind === 'facts' ? 'facts'
          : baseKind === 'events' ? 'events'
          : baseKind === 'metrics' ? 'metrics'
          : 'decisions';
        if (n === 0) return `found no ${unitMany}`;
        if (n === 1) return `found 1 ${unitOne}`;
        return `found ${n} ${unitMany}`;
      };
      return `${labelFor(kind)}${tt ? ` · ${tt}` : ''}`;
    }
    if (s === 'failed' || s === 'error') return `${kind} failed`;
    return s;
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)', fontWeight: 600 }}>Findings</div>
          {isLoadingAny && (
            <div className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>Refreshing…</div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button type="button" className="rounded px-2 py-1 text-[11px]" onClick={refreshAll}
            style={{ border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)', background: 'transparent', color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>Refresh all</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      {kinds.map((k) => {
        const { status, countStatus, elapsedMs, expanded, setExpanded } = useCountAndStatus(k);
        const { loading, error, items } = useKindItems(projectId, k, expanded);
        const preloaded = countMap[k];
        const count = typeof preloaded === 'number' ? preloaded : (typeof countStatus === 'number' ? countStatus : (Array.isArray(items) ? items.length : undefined));
        return (
          <div key={k} className="rounded">
            <SectionHeader
              title={k.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + k.slice(1)}
              badge={typeof count === 'number' ? count : undefined}
              badgeLoading={!!loadingCounts[k] && typeof count !== 'number'}
              status={status ? fmtStatus(k, status, count, elapsedMs) : ''}
              onRefresh={() => refresh(k)}
              expanded={expanded}
              onToggle={() => setExpanded((v) => !v)}
            />
            {expanded && (
              <div className="px-2 py-2 text-[12px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
                {loading && <div>Loading…</div>}
                {error && <div style={{ color: 'var(--accent-danger)' }}>{error}</div>}
                {!loading && !error && (
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    {Array.isArray(items) && items.length === 0 && (
                      <div className="text-[12px]">No {k} yet. Run "analyze {k}".</div>
                    )}
                    {Array.isArray(items) && items.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="grid" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '1fr', gap: 6 }}>
                        {items.map((it, i) => {
                          switch (k) {
                            case 'entities': {
                              return (
                                <div key={i} className="p-2 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-sidebar)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
                                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                    <div className="text-12 font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{it.name}</div>
                                    <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--white-10)', color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{it.type}</span>
                                  </div>
                                  {it.description && <div className="mt-1 text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{it.description}</div>}
                                </div>
                              );
                            }
                            case 'facts': {
                              return (
                                <div key={i} className="p-2 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-sidebar)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
                                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                    <div className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{it.statement}</div>
                                    {typeof it.confidence === 'number' && (
                                      <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--white-10)', color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, it.confidence))*100)}%</span>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                  {Array.isArray(it.evidence) && it.evidence.length > 0 && (
                                    <div className="mt-1 text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>Evidence: {it.evidence.join('; ')}</div>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                              );
                            }
                            case 'events': {
                              return (
                                <div key={i} className="p-2 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-sidebar)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
                                  <div className="text-12 font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{it.title}</div>
                                  <div className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{it.ts}</div>
                                  {it.summary && <div className="mt-1 text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{it.summary}</div>}
                                </div>
                              );
                            }
                            case 'metrics': {
                              return (
                                <div key={i} className="p-2 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-sidebar)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
                                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                    <div className="text-12 font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{it.label || it.key}</div>
                                    <div className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{String(it.value)}{it.unit ? ` ${it.unit}` : ''}</div>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              );
                            }
                            case 'decisions': {
                              return (
                                <div key={i} className="p-2 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-sidebar)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
                                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                    <div className="text-12 font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{it.title}</div>
                                    {it.selected && (
                                      <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--white-10)', color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{it.selected}</span>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                  {it.rationale && <div className="mt-1 text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{it.rationale}</div>}
                                </div>
                              );
                            }
                          }
                          return null;
                        })}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default FindingsPanel;

  showAccount,
  onOpenAccount,
  onOpenSettings,

  if (sideOpen || showSettings || showAccount) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <>
      {/* Account button */}

        }}
        onMouseLeave={(e) => {
          (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
            'transparent';
        }}
      >

          className="w-4 h-4"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"

        onClick={onOpenSettings}
        className="rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center justify-center"
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          left: 8,
          bottom: 48,
          width: 32,
          height: 32,
          backgroundColor: 'transparent',
          color: 'var(--text-heading)',
          border: 'none',
          zIndex: 40,
        }}
        onMouseEnter={(e) => {
          (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
            'var(--white-10)';
        }}
        onMouseLeave={(e) => {
          (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
            'transparent';
        }}
      >
        <svg
          className="w-4 h-4"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth="2"
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
        >
          <path d="M12.22 2h-.44a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v.18a2 2 0 0 1-1 1.73l-.43.25a2 2 0 0 1-2 0l-.15-.08a2 2 0 0 0-2.73.73l-.22.38a2 2 0 0 0 .73 2.73l.15.1a2 2 0 0 1 1 1.72v.51a2 2 0 0 1-1 1.74l-.15.09a2 2 0 0 0-.73 2.73l.22.38a2 2 0 0 0 2.73.73l.15-.08a2 2 0 0 1 2 0l.43.25a2 2 0 0 1 1 1.73V20a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h.44a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-.18a2 2 0 0 1 1-1.73l.43-.25a2 2 0 0 1 2 0l.15.08a2 2 0 0 0 2.73-.73l.22-.39a2 2 0 0 0-.73-2.73l-.15-.08a2 2 0 0 1-1-1.74v-.5a2 2 0 0 1 1-1.74l.15-.09a2 2 0 0 0 .73-2.73l-.22-.38a2 2 0 0 0-2.73-.73l-.15.08a2 2 0 0 1-2 0l-.43-.25a2 2 0 0 1-1-1.73V4a2 2 0 0 0-2-2z" />
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" />
        </svg>
      </button>
    </>
  );

================================================================================
Файл: LLMEvaluation.tsx
Путь: src/components/LLMEvaluation.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useGenAISettings } from '../stores/genaiSettingsStore';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { evaluateBias } from '../lib/biasEvaluation';

// Component to evaluate quality/style/biases of assistant answers and suggest system prompt improvements
export const LLMEvaluation: React.FC<{ onFirstResult?: () => void }> = ({ onFirstResult }) => {
  const [review, setReview] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [durationMs, setDurationMs] = React.useState<number | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  // PERFORMANCE FIX: Subscribe only to lengths, not entire arrays
  const interactionsLength = useGenaiChatStore((s) => s.interactions.length);
  const messagesLength = useGenaiChatStore((s) => s.messages.length);
  const streaming = useGenaiChatStore((s) => s.streaming);
  const persistedByLocalId = useGenaiChatStore((s) => (s as any).persistedByLocalId);
  const { currentUser } = useAuth();
  const { i18n: i18nCore } = useTranslation();
  
  // Get interactions/messages only when needed via getState()
  const getInteractions = React.useCallback(() => useGenaiChatStore.getState().interactions, []);
  const getMessages = React.useCallback(() => useGenaiChatStore.getState().messages, []);
  
  const hasAssistant = React.useMemo(() => {
    const messages = getMessages();
    return messages.some((m) => m.role === 'assistant' && m.content && m.content.trim().length > 0);
  }, [getMessages, messagesLength]);
  const lastAssistant = React.useMemo(() => {
    const interactions = getInteractions();
    const ints = interactions.filter((it) => it.kind === 'assistant' && (it.contentSanitized || it.content));
    return ints.length > 0 ? ints[ints.length - 1] : null;
  }, [getInteractions, interactionsLength]);
  const lastReviewedId = React.useRef<string | null>(null);
  const evaluatingRef = React.useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());

  React.useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const run = async () => {
      if (!currentUser?.uid) return;
      // Trigger only AFTER streaming completes and a new assistant message is available
      if (streaming) return;
      if (!lastAssistant) return;
      // Skip evaluations for assistant summaries generated without LLM
      try {
        const sk = String((lastAssistant as any).subkind || '').toLowerCase();
        if (sk === 'prestance.summary' || sk === 'analysis.summary') {
          lastReviewedId.current = lastAssistant.id;
          return;
        }
      } catch {}
      if (lastReviewedId.current === lastAssistant.id) return;
      
      // Prevent duplicate evaluation runs (race condition guard)
      if (evaluatingRef.current.has(lastAssistant.id)) {
        console.log('[LLMEvaluation] Already evaluating message', lastAssistant.id, '- skipping duplicate');
        return;
      }
      
      // Check if eval.bias already exists for this assistant message
      try {
        const map = persistedByLocalId || {};
        const serverId = map[lastAssistant.id];
        const reverseMap: Record<string, string[]> = {};
        Object.entries(map).forEach(([local, server]) => {
          if (!reverseMap[server as string]) reverseMap[server as string] = [];
          reverseMap[server as string].push(local);
        });
        const localIds = reverseMap[lastAssistant.id] || [];
        const interactions = getInteractions();
        const existingEvalBias = [...interactions].reverse().find((it: any) => 
          it.subkind === 'eval.bias' && 
          (it.replyTo === lastAssistant.id || (serverId && it.replyTo === serverId) || localIds.includes(it.replyTo || ''))
        );
        if (existingEvalBias) {
          lastReviewedId.current = lastAssistant.id;
          return; // Skip evaluation if it already exists
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[LLMEvaluation] Failed to check existing eval.bias', e);
      }
      
      // Mark as evaluating
      evaluatingRef.current.add(lastAssistant.id);
      
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      try {
        const started = performance.now();
        // Prefer local interactions (assistant), fallback to chat messages
        const interactions = getInteractions();
        const assistantInteractions = interactions.filter((it: any) => it.kind === 'assistant');
        let texts: string[] = [];
        if (assistantInteractions.length > 0) {
          const last = assistantInteractions.slice(Math.max(0, assistantInteractions.length - 5));
          texts = last.map((it: any) => (it.summary && it.summary.trim()) ? it.summary : it.content);
        } else {
          const messages = getMessages();
          const all = messages.filter((m) => m.role === 'assistant' && m.content && m.content.trim());
          const last = all.slice(Math.max(0, all.length - 5));
          texts = last.map((m) => m.content);
        }
        if (texts.length === 0) {
          setError('No assistant replies to evaluate yet.');
          return;
        }
        const transcript = texts.join('\n\n---\n\n');
        const lang = (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (window.localStorage.getItem('preferredLanguage') || 'RU') : 'RU').toLowerCase();
        const nowISO = new Date().toISOString();
        const prompt = `User requirement: you should create your answer in ${lang} language. Use English or other languages inline only if you use well-known and accepted in target language terms.\n\nYou are an expert LLM output reviewer.
Current date/time (trustworthy, real-time): ${nowISO}.
The ASSISTANT model that produced these replies had access to up-to-date information via web search.
Evaluate the following ASSISTANT responses (most recent last). Provide:
1) Brief quality assessment (strengths/weaknesses)
2) Style characteristics (tone, structure, clarity)
3) Potential biases/safety concerns
4) 3-5 concrete improvements to the SYSTEM INSTRUCTION to improve future answers
5) A short note referencing the five-dimension thoughtfulness rubric used for the structured score (do not include numbers here)
Important: Do not critique formatting or output length; formatting/verbosity are enforced elsewhere.
Assistant responses:
${transcript}
Respond concisely in the specified language (${lang}). Use short bullet points where appropriate. Return plain text only (no JSON/markdown). If unsure, write 'No issues found'.`;

        // Kick off async structured eval of the latest assistant message (strict JSON)
        {
          const settingsStateEval = useGenAISettings.getState();
          const evalModel = (settingsStateEval.stanceModel && settingsStateEval.stanceModel.trim()) ? settingsStateEval.stanceModel : 'gemini_fast';
        const textToEvaluate = ((lastAssistant as any)?.contentSanitized || (lastAssistant as any)?.content || '').trim();
          if (textToEvaluate) {
            (async () => {
              try {
                const preferredLang = (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (window.localStorage.getItem('preferredLanguage') || 'EN') : 'EN').toLowerCase();
                
                // Find previous USER message as context
                let prevUserText: string | null = null;
                try {
                  const allInts = useGenaiChatStore.getState().interactions;
                  const idx = allInts.findIndex((it) => it.id === (lastAssistant as any)?.id);
                  if (idx > 0) {
                    for (let i = idx - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                      if (allInts[i].kind === 'user' && allInts[i].content && (allInts[i].content as string).trim()) {
                        prevUserText = allInts[i].content as string;
                        break;
                      }
                    }
                  }
                } catch {}
                
                // Call unified evaluation function
                await evaluateBias({
                  messageId: lastAssistant.id,
                  messageRole: 'assistant',
                  textToEvaluate,
                  contextText: prevUserText || undefined,
                  evalModel,
                  preferredLang,
                });
              } catch (e) {
                console.warn('[LLMEvaluation] Assistant bias eval failed', e);
              }
            })().catch(console.error);
          }
        }

        // Check if eval.review already exists for this assistant message
        try {
          const map = persistedByLocalId || {};
          const serverId = map[lastAssistant.id];
          const reverseMap: Record<string, string[]> = {};
          Object.entries(map).forEach(([local, server]) => {
            if (!reverseMap[server as string]) reverseMap[server as string] = [];
            reverseMap[server as string].push(local);
          });
          const localIds = reverseMap[lastAssistant.id] || [];
          const interactions = getInteractions();
          const existingReview = [...interactions].reverse().find((it: any) => 
            it.subkind === 'eval.review' && 
            (it.replyTo === lastAssistant.id || (serverId && it.replyTo === serverId) || localIds.includes(it.replyTo || ''))
          );
          if (existingReview) {
            console.log('[LLMEvaluation] eval.review already exists for message', lastAssistant.id, '- skipping');
            lastReviewedId.current = lastAssistant.id;
            if (!cancelled) {
              setReview((existingReview as any).content || (existingReview as any).contentSanitized || '');
              setLoading(false);
            }
            return;
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[LLMEvaluation] Failed to check existing eval.review', e);
        }
        const settingsState2 = useGenAISettings.getState();
        const modelAlias = (settingsState2.stanceModel && settingsState2.stanceModel.trim()) ? settingsState2.stanceModel : 'gemini_fast';
        const response = await api.genaiGenerate({
          model: modelAlias,
          prompt,
          temperature: 0.2,
          maxOutputTokens: 4096,
          webSearchEnabled: true,
          toolCallingEnabled: false,
          strictJSONEnabled: false,
          systemInstruction: 'You are an expert LLM output reviewer. Always return a non-empty plain text answer in the specified language with short bullet points where appropriate.'
        });
        const finished = performance.now();
        if (!cancelled) {
          const content = (response?.content || '').trim();
          if (content) {
            setReview(content);
            setDurationMs(Math.max(1, Math.round(finished - started)));
            setError(null);
            if (lastReviewedId.current !== lastAssistant?.id) {
              onFirstResult && onFirstResult();
            }
            lastReviewedId.current = lastAssistant?.id || null;
            // Create eval.review interaction linked to the last assistant message
            if (!cancelled) {
              try {
                const evalId = Date.now().toString() + '-eval-review-a';
                const preferredLang = (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (window.localStorage.getItem('preferredLanguage') || 'EN') : 'EN').toLowerCase();
                const projectId = useGenaiChatStore.getState().projectId;
                
                // Add to local state
                useGenaiChatStore.setState((s) => ({
                  interactions: [
                    ...s.interactions,
                    {
                      id: evalId,
                      projectId: s.projectId,
                      kind: 'system',
                      subkind: 'eval.review',
                      content: content,
                      contentSanitized: content,
                      replyTo: lastAssistant?.id,
                      relations: lastAssistant?.id ? [{ type: 'evaluates', targetId: lastAssistant.id }] : undefined,
                      language: preferredLang,
                      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                    } as any,
                  ],
                } as any));
                
                // Persist to server
                if (projectId && projectId !== 'local-unfold' && lastAssistant?.id && !cancelled) {
                  (async () => {
                    try {
                      const map = (useGenaiChatStore.getState() as any).persistedByLocalId || {};
                      const serverReplyTo = map[lastAssistant.id] || lastAssistant.id;
                      
                      const payload: any = {
                        kind: 'system',
                        subkind: 'eval.review',
                        content: content,
                        replyTo: serverReplyTo,
                        relations: [{ type: 'evaluates', targetId: serverReplyTo }],
                        language: preferredLang,
                      };
                      
                      const res = await api.createProjectInteraction(projectId, payload);
                      
                      // Check cancelled before updating state
                      if (!cancelled) {
                        // Update local interaction with server ID
                        useGenaiChatStore.setState((st) => {
                          const items = [...st.interactions];
                          const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === evalId);
                          if (idx >= 0) { (items[idx] as any).id = res.id; }
                          
                          const newMap = { ...(st.persistedByLocalId || {}) } as Record<string, string>;
                          newMap[evalId] = res.id;
                          
                          return { interactions: items, persistedByLocalId: newMap } as any;
                        });
                      }
                    } catch (e) {
                      console.warn('[LLMEvaluation] Failed to persist eval.review to server', e);
                    }
                  })();
                }
              } catch (e) {
                console.warn('[LLMEvaluation] Failed to create eval.review', e);
              }
            }
          } else {
            setError('The model returned an empty review.');
          }
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.error('[LLMEvaluation] Error:', err);
        if (!cancelled) setError(err?.message || 'Failed to evaluate answers.');
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoading(false);
          // Clear evaluation flag
          if (lastAssistant?.id) {
            evaluatingRef.current.delete(lastAssistant.id);
          }
        }
      }
    };
    run();
    return () => { 
      cancelled = true;
      // Clear evaluation flag on unmount
      if (lastAssistant?.id) {
        evaluatingRef.current.delete(lastAssistant.id);
      }
    };
  }, [streaming, lastAssistant?.id, currentUser?.uid]);

  if (!hasAssistant) return null;
  const sanitizeSx = (s: string) => {
    try { return (s || '').replace(/<!--\s*@sx:[\s\S]*?-->/g, '').trim(); } catch { return s; }
  };

  return (
    <div className="mt-3 p-3">
      <div className="text-13 mb-2" style={{ color: '#669999' }}>Assistant's stance:</div>
      {error ? (
        <div className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{error}</div>
      ) : review ? (
        <>
          <div className="text-12 fade-in" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', lineHeight: '1.5' }}>
            {sanitizeSx(review)}
          </div>
          {typeof durationMs === 'number' && (
            <div className="text-[11px] mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
              Time: {durationMs} ms
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        <div className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>No review yet.</div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import TermsOfUsage from '../pages/TermsOfUsage';
import PrivacyNotice from '../pages/PrivacyNotice';

interface LegalModalProps {
  type: 'terms' | 'privacy';
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function LegalModal({ type, onClose }: LegalModalProps) {
  // Close on Escape key
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleEscape = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleEscape);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEscape);
  }, [onClose]);

  // Prevent body scroll when modal is open
  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center"
      style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)' }}
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className="relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          width: '70%',
          maxWidth: '1200px',
          height: '85vh',
          backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)',
          border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
          boxShadow: '0 12px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)'  /* Enhanced shadow for depth */
        }}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div
          className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)',
            borderBottom: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
          }}
        >
          <h2 className="text-18 font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
            {type === 'privacy' ? 'Privacy Notice' : 'Terms of Usage'}
          </h2>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 rounded-lg transition-colors"
            style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => {
              (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-10)';
            }}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => {
              (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
            }}
            aria-label="Close"
          >
            <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        <div
          className="overflow-y-auto"
          style={{
            height: 'calc(85vh - 64px)',
          }}
        >
          {type === 'privacy' ? <PrivacyNotice /> : <TermsOfUsage />}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { toggleInteractionPin, isInteractionPinned } from '../lib/interactionHelpers';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';

interface MessageActionsProps {
  interactionId: string;
  isUser: boolean;
  interaction: any;
}

export const MessageActions: React.FC<MessageActionsProps> = ({
  interactionId,
  isUser,
  interaction,
}) => {
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore();
  const isPinned = !isUser && isInteractionPinned(interaction);
  const [isDeleteHovered, setIsDeleteHovered] = React.useState(false);
  const [isPinning, setIsPinning] = React.useState(false);
  const [optimisticPinned, setOptimisticPinned] = React.useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const containerRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  
  // Use optimistic state if available, otherwise use actual state
  const displayPinned = optimisticPinned !== null ? optimisticPinned : isPinned;

  // Update data attribute on parent container when delete button is hovered
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const container = containerRef.current?.closest('.group');
    if (container) {
      if (isDeleteHovered && !isUser) {
        container.setAttribute('data-delete-hovered', 'true');
      } else {
        container.removeAttribute('data-delete-hovered');
      }
    }
  }, [isDeleteHovered, isUser]);

  const handlePinToggle = async () => {
    if (isUser || isPinning) return; // Only for assistant messages, prevent double-click
    setIsPinning(true);
    const newPinnedState = !isPinned;
    // Optimistic update: show new state immediately
    setOptimisticPinned(newPinnedState);
    
    try {
      await toggleInteractionPin(
        genaiChat.projectId,
        interactionId,
        isPinned,
      );
      // Refresh interactions to update pin state
      await genaiChat.hydrateInteractions();
      // Clear optimistic state after successful update
      setOptimisticPinned(null);
    } catch (e) {
      // Revert optimistic update on error
      setOptimisticPinned(null);
      alert('Failed to toggle pin. Please try again.');
      console.error('[Pin] Error:', e);
    } finally {
      setIsPinning(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    const targetName = isUser ? 'user message' : 'assistant response';
    if (window.confirm(`Delete this ${targetName}?`)) {
      try {
        await genaiChat.deleteInteraction(interactionId);
      } catch (e) {
        alert('Failed to delete message. Please try again.');
        console.error('[Delete] Error:', e);
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef}>
      {/* Pin button - appears on hover for assistant messages only */}
      {!isUser && (
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={displayPinned ? 'Unpin message' : 'Pin message'}
          disabled={isPinning}
          className={`absolute top-2 right-10 p-1.5 rounded transition-opacity z-10 disabled:cursor-wait ${
            isPinning ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100'
          }`}
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent' }}
          onClick={handlePinToggle}
          onMouseEnter={(e) => {
            if (!isPinning) {
              (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                'var(--white-10)';
            }
          }}
          onMouseLeave={(e) => {
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
              'transparent';
          }}
        >
          {isPinning ? (
            <svg
              className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              style={{ color: 'var(--accent-research)' }}
            >
              <circle
                cx="12"
                cy="12"
                r="10"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2"
                strokeDasharray="32"
                strokeDashoffset="24"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                opacity="0.3"
              />
            </svg>
          ) : displayPinned ? (
            <svg
              className="w-3.5 h-3.5"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill="currentColor"
              style={{ color: 'var(--accent-research)' }}
            >
              <path d="M5 5a2 2 0 012-2h10a2 2 0 012 2v16l-7-3.5L5 21V5z" />
            </svg>
          ) : (
            <svg
              className="w-3.5 h-3.5"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={2}
                d="M5 5a2 2 0 012-2h10a2 2 0 012 2v16l-7-3.5L5 21V5z"
              />
            </svg>
          )}
        </button>
      )}

      {/* Delete button - appears on hover */}
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label="Delete message"
        className="absolute top-2 right-2 p-1.5 rounded opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity z-10"
        style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent' }}
        onClick={handleDelete}
        onMouseEnter={(e) => {
          setIsDeleteHovered(true);
          (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
            'var(--white-10)';
        }}
        onMouseLeave={(e) => {
          setIsDeleteHovered(false);
          (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
            'transparent';
        }}
      >
        <svg
          className="w-3.5 h-3.5"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}
        >
          <path
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            strokeWidth={2}
            d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16"
          />
        </svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};



================================================================================
Файл: MessageItem.tsx
Путь: src/components/MessageItem.tsx
================================================================================

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { useGenAISettings } from '../stores/genaiSettingsStore';
import ChatMessage from './ChatMessage';
import { CollapsibleText } from './CollapsibleText';
import { ActionRow } from './ActionRow';
import { EvaluationDetails } from './EvaluationDetails';
import { markdownComponents } from '../lib/markdownComponents';

interface MessageItemProps {
  message: {
    id: string;
    role: 'user' | 'assistant';
    content: string;
  };
  genaiChat: {
    streaming: boolean;
    error: any;
    messageMeta?: Record<string, { headerText?: string; leftAccent?: boolean }>;
    preStanceLatency?: Record<string, number>;
    evaluations?: Record<string, any>;
  };
  genaiThinkingSeconds: number;
  averageTimingSeconds: number | null;
  genaiSettings: {
    strength?: string;
    model?: string;
    groundingEnabled?: boolean;
  };
  expandedChip: string | null;
  onExpandChip: (chipId: string | null) => void;
}

/**
 * Мемоизированный компонент для рендеринга отдельного сообщения
 * Оптимизирован для предотвращения ненужных ре-рендеров
 */
export const MessageItem = React.memo<MessageItemProps>(({
  message: m,
  genaiChat,
  genaiThinkingSeconds,
  averageTimingSeconds,
  genaiSettings,
  expandedChip,
  onExpandChip,
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const isUser = m.role === 'user';
  
  // Вычисляем состояние сообщения
  const isAssistantPlaceholder = useMemo(
    () => !isUser && genaiChat.streaming && !m.content,
    [isUser, genaiChat.streaming, m.content]
  );
  
  const isAssistantError = useMemo(
    () => !isUser && !genaiChat.streaming && !m.content && !!genaiChat.error,
    [isUser, genaiChat.streaming, m.content, genaiChat.error]
  );

  // Получаем contentSanitized для assistant сообщений
  const assistantContent = useMemo(() => {
    if (isUser) return m.content;
    
    try {
      const store = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
      const inter = store.interactions.find(
        (it) =>
          it.kind === 'assistant' &&
          (it as any).originalMessageId === m.id
      );
      if (
        inter &&
        typeof inter.contentSanitized === 'string' &&
        inter.contentSanitized.length > 0
      ) {
        return inter.contentSanitized;
      }
      return m.content;
    } catch {
      return m.content;
    }
  }, [isUser, m.id, m.content]);

  // Получаем метаданные для тегов/chips
  const messageTags = useMemo(() => {
    if (isUser) return null;
    
    try {
      const store = useGenaiChatStore.getState() as any;
      let inter = store.interactions.find(
        (it: any) =>
          it.kind === 'assistant' &&
          (it as any).originalMessageId === m.id
      ) as any;
      
      if (!inter) {
        const map: Record<string, string> = store.persistedByLocalId || {};
        const serverId = map[m.id];
        if (serverId) {
          inter = store.interactions.find((it: any) => it.id === serverId);
        }
      }
      
      const perQ = Array.isArray(inter?.searchQueries)
        ? inter.searchQueries.filter(Boolean)
        : [];
      const perS = Array.isArray(inter?.sources)
        ? inter.sources.filter(Boolean)
        : [];
      
      const qs = perQ.slice(0, 4);
      const attrs =
        perS.length > 0
          ? perS.map((url: string) => ({ url })).slice(0, 4)
          : [];
      
      if (qs.length === 0 && attrs.length === 0) return null;
      
      return { queries: qs, sources: attrs };
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }, [isUser, m.id]);

  if (isAssistantPlaceholder) {
    return null;
  }

  const headerText = !isUser
    ? genaiChat.messageMeta?.[m.id]?.headerText || 'assistant'
    : undefined;
  
  const leftAccent = !isUser
    ? !!genaiChat.messageMeta?.[m.id]?.leftAccent
    : false;

  const footer = isUser &&
    genaiChat.preStanceLatency &&
    genaiChat.preStanceLatency[m.id] ? (
      <span
        className="text-[10px]"
        style={{
          color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)',
        }}
      >
        stance:{' '}
        {(genaiChat.preStanceLatency[m.id] / 1000).toFixed(2)}s
      </span>
    ) : undefined;

  return (
    <ChatMessage
      key={m.id}
      role={isUser ? 'user' : 'assistant'}
      align={isUser ? 'right' : 'left'}
      isThinking={isAssistantPlaceholder}
      thinkingSeconds={genaiThinkingSeconds}
      averageTimingSeconds={averageTimingSeconds}
      isError={isAssistantError}
      headerText={headerText}
      leftAccent={leftAccent}
      footer={footer}
    >
      {isAssistantPlaceholder ? (
        <ThinkingPlaceholder
          genaiSettings={genaiSettings}
          genaiThinkingSeconds={genaiThinkingSeconds}
          t={t}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          {isUser ? (
            <CollapsibleText maxLines={7}>
              <div
                className="text-13 markdown"
                style={{
                  color: 'var(--text-heading)',
                }}
              >
                <ReactMarkdown
                  remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
                  components={markdownComponents}
                >
                  {m.content}
                </ReactMarkdown>
              </div>
            </CollapsibleText>
          ) : (
            <div
              className="text-13 markdown"
              style={{
                color: 'var(--text-heading)',
              }}
            >
              <ReactMarkdown
                remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
                components={markdownComponents}
              >
                {assistantContent}
              </ReactMarkdown>
            </div>
          )}
          
          {/* Action row: shows bias if available, else only buttons (assistant only) */}
          {!isUser && (
            <ActionRow
              messageId={m.id}
              isAssistant={!isUser}
              content={m.content}
            />
          )}
          
          {/* Show bias for user messages if available */}
          {isUser && genaiChat.evaluations?.[m.id] && (
            <EvaluationDetails messageId={m.id} />
          )}
          
          {/* Tags row: per-message chips */}
          {messageTags && (
            <MessageTags
              messageId={m.id}
              queries={messageTags.queries}
              sources={messageTags.sources}
              expandedChip={expandedChip}
              onExpandChip={onExpandChip}
            />
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </ChatMessage>
  );
}, (prevProps, nextProps) => {
  // Кастомная функция сравнения для оптимизации
  if (prevProps.message.id !== nextProps.message.id) return false;
  if (prevProps.message.content !== nextProps.message.content) return false;
  if (prevProps.message.role !== nextProps.message.role) return false;
  if (prevProps.genaiThinkingSeconds !== nextProps.genaiThinkingSeconds) return false;
  if (prevProps.averageTimingSeconds !== nextProps.averageTimingSeconds) return false;
  if (prevProps.expandedChip !== nextProps.expandedChip) return false;
  
  // Проверяем изменения в genaiChat
  if (prevProps.genaiChat.streaming !== nextProps.genaiChat.streaming) return false;
  if (prevProps.genaiChat.error !== nextProps.genaiChat.error) return false;
  if (prevProps.genaiChat.messageMeta?.[prevProps.message.id]?.headerText !== 
      nextProps.genaiChat.messageMeta?.[nextProps.message.id]?.headerText) return false;
  if (prevProps.genaiChat.messageMeta?.[prevProps.message.id]?.leftAccent !== 
      nextProps.genaiChat.messageMeta?.[nextProps.message.id]?.leftAccent) return false;
  if (prevProps.genaiChat.preStanceLatency?.[prevProps.message.id] !== 
      nextProps.genaiChat.preStanceLatency?.[nextProps.message.id]) return false;
  if (prevProps.genaiChat.evaluations?.[prevProps.message.id] !== 
      nextProps.genaiChat.evaluations?.[nextProps.message.id]) return false;
  
  // Проверяем изменения в genaiSettings
  if (prevProps.genaiSettings.strength !== nextProps.genaiSettings.strength) return false;
  if (prevProps.genaiSettings.model !== nextProps.genaiSettings.model) return false;
  if (prevProps.genaiSettings.groundingEnabled !== nextProps.genaiSettings.groundingEnabled) return false;
  
  return true; // Пропсы не изменились, пропускаем ре-рендер
});

MessageItem.displayName = 'MessageItem';

// Компонент для placeholder состояния "thinking"
const ThinkingPlaceholder = React.memo<{
  genaiSettings: {
    strength?: string;
    model?: string;
    groundingEnabled?: boolean;
  };
  genaiThinkingSeconds: number;
  t: (key: string, options?: any) => string;
}>(({ genaiSettings, genaiThinkingSeconds, t }) => {
  const isQuality =
    genaiSettings.strength === 'quality' ||
    /_quality$/.test(genaiSettings.model || '');
  
  const threshold = genaiSettings.groundingEnabled ? 35 : 20;
  const showComplexReasoning = isQuality && (genaiThinkingSeconds || 0) >= threshold;
  
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <div
        style={{
          width: 160,

          borderRadius: 4,

      >
        <div
          style={{

              'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--white-20), transparent)',
            animation: 'etg-shimmer 2s infinite',
          }}
        />
      </div>
      <div
        style={{
          width: 220,
          height: 10,
          borderRadius: 4,
          background: 'var(--white-06)',
          position: 'relative',
          overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
      >
        <div
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            inset: 0,
            background:
              'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--white-20), transparent)',

          }}

        </div>

ThinkingPlaceholder.displayName = 'ThinkingPlaceholder';

// Компонент для тегов/chips сообщения
const MessageTags = React.memo<{
  messageId: string;
  queries: string[];
  sources: Array<{ url: string }>;
  expandedChip: string | null;
  onExpandChip: (chipId: string | null) => void;
}>(({ messageId, queries, sources, expandedChip, onExpandChip }) => {
  return (
    <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
      {queries.map((q: string, i: number) => {
        const chipId = `${messageId}-q-${i}`;
        const isExpanded = expandedChip === chipId;
        const words = String(q || '').trim().split(/\s+/);
        const short =
          words.length > 3
            ? words.slice(0, 3).join(' ') + '…'
            : String(q || '');
        const needsExpand = words.length > 3;
        
        return (
          <button
            key={`q-${i}`}
            type="button"
            className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] transition-colors"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: isExpanded
                ? 'var(--white-20)'
                : 'var(--white-10)',
              color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
              border: 'none',
              cursor: needsExpand ? 'pointer' : 'default',
            }}
            onClick={() =>
              needsExpand && onExpandChip(isExpanded ? null : chipId)
            }
            onMouseEnter={(e) => {
              if (needsExpand)
                (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                  isExpanded ? 'var(--white-25)' : 'var(--white-15)';
            }}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => {
              if (needsExpand)
                (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                  isExpanded ? 'var(--white-20)' : 'var(--white-10)';
            }}
          >
            {isExpanded ? String(q || '') : short}
          </button>
        );
      })}
      {sources.map((a: any, i: number) => {
        const chipId = `${messageId}-src-${i}`;
        const isExpanded = expandedChip === chipId;
        const raw = String((a as any).url || '').replace(/^https?:\/\//i, '');
        const parts = raw.split('/');
        const host = parts[0] || '';
        const tail = parts[1] ? `/${parts[1]}` : '';
        const label = host + tail || (a as any).title || 'link';
        const needsExpand = raw.length > (host + tail).length;
        
        return (
          <a
            key={`src-${i}`}
            href={(a as any).url}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noreferrer"
            className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] underline transition-colors"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: isExpanded
                ? 'var(--white-20)'
                : 'var(--white-10)',
              color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
            }}
            onClick={(e) => {
              if (needsExpand) {
                e.preventDefault();
                onExpandChip(isExpanded ? null : chipId);
              }
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => {
              (e.currentTarget as HTMLAnchorElement).style.backgroundColor =
                isExpanded ? 'var(--white-25)' : 'var(--white-15)';
            }}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => {
              (e.currentTarget as HTMLAnchorElement).style.backgroundColor =
                isExpanded ? 'var(--white-20)' : 'var(--white-10)';
            }}
          >
            {isExpanded ? raw : label}
          </a>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
});

MessageTags.displayName = 'MessageTags';

import React from 'react';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm';
import rehypeRaw from 'rehype-raw';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';

export const MetricOverlay: React.FC = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore();
  
  const openKey = genaiChat.metricOverlayOpenKey || null;
  if (!openKey) return null;
  
  const cache = genaiChat.metricOverlayCache[openKey];
  const loading = !!genaiChat.metricOverlayLoading && !cache?.content;
  const content = cache?.content || '';

  const handleClose = () => {
    try {
      genaiChat.closeMetricOverlay();
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[MetricOverlay] Error closing overlay:', e);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="absolute inset-0 z-30 rounded-xl"
      style={{
        background: 'var(--bg-elevated)',
        border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
        overflow: 'hidden',
      }}
    >
      <div
        className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2"
        style={{
          borderBottom: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
        }}
      >
        <div
          className="text-13"
          style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
        >
          {cache?.metric?.metricName ||
            (cache?.metric as any)?.name ||
            cache?.metric?.id ||
            t('unfold.sections.metric')}
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="rounded-lg transition-colors"
          aria-label={t('unfold.sections.close')}
          title={t('unfold.sections.close')}
          onClick={handleClose}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'transparent',
            color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
          }}
          onMouseEnter={(e) => {
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
              'var(--white-10)';
          }}
          onMouseLeave={(e) => {
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
              'transparent';
          }}
        >
          <svg
            className="w-4 h-4"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
          >
            <path
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              strokeWidth={2}
              d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"
            />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="absolute inset-0 pt-[38px]">
        <div className="w-full h-full overflow-y-auto px-4 py-3">
        {loading ? (
          <div
            className="text-13"
            style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}
          >
            {t('unfold.status.loading', { defaultValue: 'Loading...' })}
          </div>
        ) : content ? (
          <div
            className="markdown text-13"
            style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
          >
            <ReactMarkdown
              remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
              rehypePlugins={[rehypeRaw]}
            >
              {content}
            </ReactMarkdown>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div
            className="text-13"
            style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}
          >
            {t('unfold.status.noContent', { defaultValue: 'No content available' })}
          </div>
        )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { useGenAISettings } from '../stores/genaiSettingsStore';
import { AGENT_PRESETS } from '../lib/agentPresets';
import { buildContext } from '../lib/contextBuilder';
import { mapAliasToModel } from '../lib/modelMapping';
import { TelegramFetchUpdatesTool } from '../lib/genaiTools';
import { getPreferredLanguage, getLanguageName } from '../lib/uiUtils';

interface OpponentAgentsPaletteProps {
  unfoldSubView: 'chat' | 'perspectives' | 'models' | 'pages';
  genaiChatInteractionsLength: number;
  genaiChatMessagesLength: number;
}

export const OpponentAgentsPalette: React.FC<OpponentAgentsPaletteProps> = ({
  unfoldSubView,
  genaiChatInteractionsLength,
  genaiChatMessagesLength,
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore();
  const genaiSettings = useGenAISettings();
  
  const [showOpponentAgents, setShowOpponentAgents] = useState(false);
  const [expandedAgentId, setExpandedAgentId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [opponentButtonBottom, setOpponentButtonBottom] = useState<number>(120);
  
  const opponentAgentsRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const opponentButtonRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  // Close opponent agents list on outside click
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!showOpponentAgents) return;
    
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node;
      if (
        opponentButtonRef.current && 
        opponentButtonRef.current.contains(target)
      ) {
        return; // Click on button itself - handled by onClick
      }
      if (
        opponentAgentsRef.current && 
        opponentAgentsRef.current.contains(target)
      ) {
        return; // Click inside agents list
      }
      setShowOpponentAgents(false);
    };
    
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside, {
      capture: true,
    });
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside, {
        capture: true,
      } as any);
    };
  }, [showOpponentAgents]);

  // Track UnfoldRequest container position for opponent button positioning
  useEffect(() => {
    if (unfoldSubView === 'perspectives') return;
    
    const updatePosition = () => {
      const container = document.getElementById('unfold-request-container');
      if (!container) return;
      
      // Find parent container with position: relative (the chat container)
      const parentContainer = container.closest(
        '[style*="position: relative"]',
      ) as HTMLElement;
      if (!parentContainer) return;
      
      // Calculate distance from bottom of parent container to top of UnfoldRequest
      const parentHeight = parentContainer.offsetHeight;
      const containerTop = container.offsetTop;
      const distanceFromBottom = parentHeight - containerTop;
      
      // Position button 0.5rem (8px) above UnfoldRequest
      setOpponentButtonBottom(distanceFromBottom + 8);
    };
    
    // Initial position with small delay to ensure DOM is ready
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(updatePosition, 0);
    
    // Use ResizeObserver to track size changes of UnfoldRequest
    const container = document.getElementById('unfold-request-container');
    if (!container) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      return;
    }
    
    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updatePosition();
    });
    
    resizeObserver.observe(container);
    
    // Also observe parent container for size changes
    const parentContainer = container.closest(
      '[style*="position: relative"]',
    ) as HTMLElement;
    if (parentContainer) {
      resizeObserver.observe(parentContainer);
      
      // Update on scroll (in case parent scrolls)
      parentContainer.addEventListener('scroll', updatePosition, {
        passive: true,
      });
    }
    
    // Update on window resize
    window.addEventListener('resize', updatePosition, { passive: true });
    
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      resizeObserver.disconnect();
      if (parentContainer) {
        parentContainer.removeEventListener('scroll', updatePosition);
      }
      window.removeEventListener('resize', updatePosition);
    };
  }, [unfoldSubView, genaiChatInteractionsLength, genaiChatMessagesLength]);

  // Don't render if in perspectives/models/pages view or no messages
  if (
    unfoldSubView === 'perspectives' ||
    unfoldSubView === 'models' ||
    unfoldSubView === 'pages' ||
    (genaiChatInteractionsLength === 0 && genaiChatMessagesLength === 0)
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div
      ref={opponentButtonRef}
      className="absolute"
      style={{
        bottom: `${opponentButtonBottom}px`, // Dynamically calculated from UnfoldRequest top
        right: '1rem', // Align to right edge (same padding as px-4 = 1rem)
        zIndex: 10,
        pointerEvents: 'auto',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: '8px',
      }}
    >
      {/* Agents list - appears to the left */}
      {showOpponentAgents && (
        <div
          ref={opponentAgentsRef}
          className="flex items-center gap-2"
          style={{
            animation: 'fadeInScale 0.2s ease-out',
            transformOrigin: 'right center',
          }}
        >
          {AGENT_PRESETS.map((preset) => {
            const isExpanded = expandedAgentId === preset.id;
            
            return (
              <div
                key={preset.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-2"
                style={{
                  transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
                }}
              >
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-label={preset.displayName}
                  title={preset.description}
                  onClick={async () => {
                    // If already expanded, launch the agent
                    if (isExpanded) {
                      setShowOpponentAgents(false);
                      setExpandedAgentId(null);
                      
                      try {
                        const pid = await genaiChat.ensureProject();
                        const preferredLang = getPreferredLanguage();
                        
                        // Build context using unified function (70% of context window)
                        const context = buildContext({
                          modelAlias: preset.modelAlias,
                          contextPercentage: 0.7,
                          includeAgents: true,
                        });
                        
                        console.log(
                          '[Opponent] Context built:',
                          {
                            messagesCount: context.messages.length,
                            tokenCount: context.tokenCount,
                            maxTokens: context.maxTokens,
                            charCount: context.charCount,
                          },
                        );
                        
                        // Build prompt for agent discussion
                        // Use agent's system instruction if available, otherwise use default prompt
                        const basePrompt = preset.params?.systemInstruction
                          ? `${preset.params.systemInstruction}\n\nContext from the discussion:\n${context.transcript}\n\nRespond in ${getLanguageName(preferredLang)} language.`
                          : `You are participating in a discussion as an opponent, providing a counterpoint or alternative perspective.

Your role:
- Challenge assumptions and provide alternative viewpoints
- Identify potential weaknesses or gaps in the arguments presented
- Offer constructive criticism and different perspectives
- Maintain respectful and productive discourse
- Focus on substantive arguments rather than personal attacks

Context from the discussion:
${context.transcript}

Your response should:
1. Acknowledge the key points made in the discussion
2. Present alternative perspectives or counterarguments
3. Identify any assumptions, gaps, or potential weaknesses
4. Contribute constructively to the discussion

Respond in ${getLanguageName(preferredLang)} language.`;
                        
                        const prompt = basePrompt;

                        // Get model and options
                        const modelMapping = mapAliasToModel(preset.modelAlias);
                        if (!modelMapping) {
                          console.error(
                            '[Opponent] Failed to map model alias:',
                            preset.modelAlias,
                          );
                          return;
                        }
                        const tools = preset.capabilities?.tools
                          ? genaiSettings.enableTelegramTool
                            ? [TelegramFetchUpdatesTool]
                            : undefined
                          : undefined;
                        const options: any = {
                          profile: preset.modelAlias.includes('quality')
                            ? 'quality'
                            : 'fast',
                          temperature: preset.params?.temperature ?? 0.7,
                          systemInstruction: preset.params?.systemInstruction,
                          __lang: preferredLang,
                        };

                        // Create indicator message
                        const indicatorContent = `${t('unfold.actions.opponentInvoked')} ${preset.displayName}`;
                        await genaiChat.createIndicatorMessage(
                          indicatorContent,
                          'action.opponent',
                          undefined,
                          {
                            agentProfile: {
                              provider: modelMapping.provider,
                              model: modelMapping.model,
                              capabilities: {
                                tools: !!preset.capabilities?.tools,
                                webSearch: !!preset.capabilities?.webSearch,
                                reasoning: !!preset.capabilities?.reasoning,
                              },
                              params: preset.params,
                            },
                          },
                        );

                        // Start stream with context
                        await genaiChat.startStream({
                          prompt,
                          tools,
                          options,
                          agentMeta: {
                            displayName: preset.displayName,
                            agentProfile: {
                              provider: modelMapping.provider,
                              model: modelMapping.model,
                              capabilities: {
                                tools: !!preset.capabilities?.tools,
                                webSearch: !!preset.capabilities?.webSearch,
                                reasoning: !!preset.capabilities?.reasoning,
                              },
                              params: preset.params,
                            },
                            subkind: 'agent.opponent',
                          },
                          suppressUserEcho: true,
                        });
                      } catch (err) {
                        console.error(
                          '[Opponent] Failed to start opponent discussion',
                          err,
                        );
                      }
                    } else {
                      // Expand this agent (collapse others)
                      setExpandedAgentId(preset.id);
                    }
                  }}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-all shadow-lg"
                  style={{
                    width: isExpanded ? 'auto' : '32px',
                    height: '32px',
                    backgroundColor: isExpanded
                      ? 'var(--white-15)'
                      : 'var(--bg-elevated)',
                    color: 'var(--text-heading)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(8px)',
                    opacity: 0.95,
                    padding: isExpanded ? '0 12px' : '0',
                    gap: isExpanded ? '8px' : '0',
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                    (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.opacity = '1';
                    if (!isExpanded) {
                      (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                        'var(--white-15)';
                    }
                  }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                    (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.opacity = '0.95';
                    if (!isExpanded) {
                      (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                        'var(--bg-elevated)';
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  {preset.icon || (
                    <svg
                      className="w-4 h-4"
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                      fill="none"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      strokeWidth="2"
                    >
                      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
                      <path d="M12 16v-4M12 8h.01" />
                    </svg>
                  )}
                  {isExpanded && (
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap">
                      {preset.displayName}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
      
      {/* Main opponent button - scales */}
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label={t('unfold.request.opponent')}
        title={t('unfold.request.opponentExplain')}
        onClick={() => {
          setShowOpponentAgents(!showOpponentAgents);
          if (showOpponentAgents) {
            setExpandedAgentId(null); // Reset expanded state when closing
          }
        }}
        className="flex items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-all shadow-lg"
        style={{
          width: '32px',
          height: '32px',
          backgroundColor: showOpponentAgents
            ? 'var(--white-15)'
            : 'var(--bg-elevated)',
          color: 'var(--text-heading)',
          border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(8px)',
          opacity: showOpponentAgents ? 1 : 0.95,
        }}
        onMouseEnter={(e) => {
          if (!showOpponentAgents) {
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.opacity = '1';
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-15)';
          }
        }}
        onMouseLeave={(e) => {
          if (!showOpponentAgents) {
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.opacity = '0.95';
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'var(--bg-elevated)';
          }
        }}
      >
        <svg
          className="w-4 h-4"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth="2"
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
        >
          {/* Flag - marking position/argument */}
          <path d="M4 15s1-1 4-1 5 2 8 2 4-1 4-1V3s-1 1-4 1-5-2-8-2-4 1-4 1z" />
          <line x1="4" y1="22" x2="4" y2="15" />
        </svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};



================================================================================
