                <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--white-20), transparent)', animation: 'etg-shimmer 2s infinite' }} />
              </div>
              <div style={{ height: 10, width: '80%', borderRadius: 4, background: 'var(--white-06)', position: 'relative', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--white-20), transparent)', animation: 'etg-shimmer 2s infinite' }} />
              </div>
              <div style={{ height: 10, width: '70%', borderRadius: 4, background: 'var(--white-06)', position: 'relative', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--white-20), transparent)', animation: 'etg-shimmer 2s infinite' }} />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Render markdown result (appears from bottom, like chat messages) */}
          {mdText && (
            <div className="space-y-2" style={{ flex: 'none' }}>
              {/* Article header with actions */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                <div />
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={t('unfold.perspectives.actions.copy')}
                    title={t('unfold.perspectives.actions.copy')}
                    onClick={async () => {
                      try {
                        if (!mdText) return;
                        if (navigator && 'clipboard' in navigator) {
                          await (navigator as any).clipboard.writeText(mdText);
                        } else {
                          const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
                          ta.value = mdText;
                          document.body.appendChild(ta);
                          ta.select();
                          document.execCommand('copy');
                          document.body.removeChild(ta);
                        }
                      } catch {}
                    }}
                    className="p-1 rounded"
                    style={{ background: 'transparent', color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                    onMouseEnter={(e) => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-10)'; }}
                    onMouseLeave={(e) => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'transparent'; }}
                  >
                    <svg className="w-4 h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                      <rect x="9" y="9" width="11" height="11" rx="2" strokeWidth="2" />
                      <rect x="4" y="4" width="11" height="11" rx="2" strokeWidth="2" />
                    </svg>
                  </button>
                  {savedAt && (
                    <span className="text-11" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
                      {t('unfold.perspectives.actions.savedAt', { time: savedAt })}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={t('unfold.perspectives.actions.save')}
                    title={t('unfold.perspectives.actions.save')}
                    onClick={async () => {
                      try {
                        if (!mdText) return;
                        setSaving(true); setSavedAt(null);
                        let pid = useGenaiChatStore.getState().projectId;
                        if (!pid || pid === 'local-unfold') {
                          try { pid = await (useGenaiChatStore.getState() as any).ensureProject?.(); } catch {}
                        }
                        if (!pid || typeof pid !== 'string') throw new Error('No project');
                        const fname = `perspective_${(preset || 'unknown')}.md`;
                        try {
                          const docs = await api.docsList(pid);
                          const existing = Array.isArray(docs) ? docs.find((d: any) => (d && (d.filename === fname))) : null;
                          if (existing && existing.id) {
                            await api.docsDelete(pid, existing.id);
                          }
                        } catch {}
                        await api.docsCreateFromText(pid, { filename: fname, contentType: 'text/markdown', text: mdText });
                        const dt = new Date();
                        setSavedAt(`${dt.getHours().toString().padStart(2,'0')}:${dt.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2,'0')}`);
                      } catch {
                      } finally {
                        setSaving(false);
                      }
                    }}
                    className="p-1 rounded"
                    style={{ background: 'transparent', color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', cursor: saving ? 'wait' : 'pointer' }}
                    onMouseEnter={(e) => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-10)'; }}
                    onMouseLeave={(e) => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'transparent'; }}
                    disabled={saving}
                  >
                    <svg className="w-4 h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                      <path d="M12 3v10" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
                      <path d="M8 7l4-4 4 4" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                      <rect x="4" y="13" width="16" height="7" rx="2" strokeWidth="2" />
                    </svg>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="markdown text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
                <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}>{mdText}</ReactMarkdown>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-3">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="text-12 px-2 py-1 rounded"
                  onClick={async () => {
                    try {
                      if (!mdText) return;
                      setSaving(true); setSavedAt(null);
                      let pid = useGenaiChatStore.getState().projectId;
                      if (!pid || pid === 'local-unfold') {
                        try { pid = await (useGenaiChatStore.getState() as any).ensureProject?.(); } catch {}
                      }
                      if (!pid || typeof pid !== 'string') throw new Error('No project');
                      const fname = `perspective_${(preset || 'unknown')}.md`;
                      try {
                        const docs = await api.docsList(pid);
                        const existing = Array.isArray(docs) ? docs.find((d: any) => (d && (d.filename === fname))) : null;
                        if (existing && existing.id) {
                          await api.docsDelete(pid, existing.id);
                        }
                      } catch {}
                      await api.docsCreateFromText(pid, { filename: fname, contentType: 'text/markdown', text: mdText });
                      const dt = new Date();
                      setSavedAt(`${dt.getHours().toString().padStart(2,'0')}:${dt.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2,'0')}`);
                    } catch {
                    } finally {
                      setSaving(false);
                    }
                  }}
                  disabled={saving}
                  style={{ background: 'var(--white-10)', color: 'var(--text-heading)', opacity: saving ? 0.6 : 1 }}
                >
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                    <svg className="w-4 h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                      <path d="M12 3v10" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
                      <path d="M8 7l4-4 4 4" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                      <rect x="4" y="13" width="16" height="7" rx="2" strokeWidth="2" />
                    </svg>
                    {t('unfold.perspectives.actions.saveToDocs')}
                  </span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Settings component at bottom (like UnfoldRequest) */}
        <div 
          className={`rounded-xl ${theme === 'dark' ? 'unfold-request-gradient-border' : 'border'} mt-2 relative`}
          style={{
            transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
            overflow: 'visible',
            ...(theme === 'dark' ? {
              // Dark theme: gradient border via CSS class
              backgroundColor: containerStyle.backgroundColor || 'var(--bg-input, #1A1A1A)',
              boxShadow: containerStyle.boxShadow,
            } : {
              // Light theme: regular border
              ...containerStyle,
            }),
          }}
        >
        <div className="p-3">
          {/* Label above dropdown */}
          <div className="text-12 mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
            {t('unfold.perspectives.header.analyticalPerspective')}
          </div>
          {/* Dropdown selector on first line */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
            <div className="relative" style={{ width: '33%', minWidth: 220, maxWidth: 360 }}>
              <button
                ref={buttonRef}
                id="perspective-select"
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setDropdownOpen(!dropdownOpen)}
                className="text-xs w-full text-left flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer"
                style={{ 
                  background: 'transparent', 
                  color: 'var(--text-heading)', 
                  border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)', 
                  borderRadius: 8, 
                  padding: '4px 8px',
                  outline: 'none',
                }}
              >
                <span>{presetItems.find(p => p.id === preset)?.title || t('unfold.perspectives.selector.placeholder')}</span>
                <svg className="w-4 h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" style={{ transform: dropdownOpen ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)', transition: 'transform 0.2s' }}>
                  <path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                </svg>
              </button>
              {dropdownOpen && dropdownPosition && (
                <div
                  ref={dropdownRef}
                  className="fixed rounded-lg border shadow-lg overflow-hidden"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-sidebar)',
                    borderColor: 'var(--overlay-line-90)',
                    maxHeight: '300px',
                    overflowY: 'auto',
                    zIndex: 9999,
                    top: `${dropdownPosition.top}px`,
                    left: `${dropdownPosition.left}px`,
                    width: `${dropdownPosition.width}px`,
                    transform: 'translateY(-100%)',
                    marginTop: '-4px',
                  }}
                >
                  {presetItems.map((item) => (
                    <button
                      key={item.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => { 
                        setPreset(item.id); 
                        if (item.id !== 'custom') {
                          setCustomQuery('');
                        }
                        setDropdownOpen(false); 
                        setDropdownPosition(null); 
                      }}
                      className="w-full text-left px-3 py-2 text-12 transition-colors flex items-center gap-2"
                      style={{
                        color: item.id === preset ? 'var(--text-heading)' : 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
                        background: item.id === preset ? 'var(--white-10)' : 'transparent',
                      }}
                      onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                        if (item.id !== preset) {
                          (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-06)';
                        }
                      }}
                      onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                        if (item.id !== preset) {
                          (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                        }
                      }}
                    >
                      <div style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{item.icon}</div>
                      <span>{item.title}</span>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          {/* Custom query input (shown when custom is selected) */}
          {preset === 'custom' && (
            <div className="mb-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={customQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setCustomQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={t('unfold.perspectives.custom.placeholder', { defaultValue: 'Enter your analytical perspective...' })}
                className="text-12 px-2 py-1 rounded w-full"
                style={{ 
                  background: 'transparent', 
                  color: 'var(--text-heading)', 
                  border: 'none',
                  outline: 'none'
                }}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter' && customQuery.trim() && !loading) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    void handleRun('custom', customQuery.trim());
                  }
                }}
              />
            </div>
          )}
          {error && (
            <div className="text-12 mt-2" style={{ color: 'var(--danger-50)' }}>{error}</div>
          )}
          {loading && (
            <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
              <svg className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.25" />
                <path d="M21 12a9 9 0 0 0-9-9" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
              </svg>
              <span>{t('unfold.perspectives.status.running', { seconds: runSeconds })}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          {/* Bottom: controls row (like UnfoldRequest) */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('unfold.perspectives.header.choose')}</div>
              <span className="text-11 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded" title={t('unfold.perspectives.header.langTitle')} style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', background: 'var(--white-06)' }}>{prefLangCode}</span>
              <span className="text-11 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded" title={t('unfold.perspectives.header.presetTitle')} style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', background: 'var(--white-06)' }}>{preset || '—'}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="p-1.5 rounded"
                title={t('unfold.perspectives.actions.refresh', { defaultValue: 'Refresh' })}
                onClick={() => { 
                  if (preset === 'custom' && customQuery.trim()) {
                    void handleRun(preset, customQuery.trim());
                  } else if (preset) {
                    void handleRun(preset);
                  }
                }}
                disabled={!preset || loading || (preset === 'custom' && !customQuery.trim())}
                style={{ background: 'transparent', color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', opacity: (!preset || loading || (preset === 'custom' && !customQuery.trim())) ? 0.6 : 1 }}
              >
                <svg className="w-4 h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                  <path d="M20 7h-5M20 7v5" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                  <path d="M20 12a8 8 0 1 1-2.343-5.657" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
                </svg>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={t('unfold.perspectives.actions.run')}
                className="flex items-center justify-center rounded-full"
                onClick={() => { 
                  if (preset === 'custom') {
                    if (customQuery.trim()) {
                      void handleRun(preset, customQuery.trim());
                    }
                  } else if (preset) {
                    void handleRun(preset);
                  }
                }}
                disabled={!preset || loading || (preset === 'custom' && !customQuery.trim())}
                style={{
                  width: '32px',
                  height: '32px',
                  backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                  opacity: (!preset || loading || (preset === 'custom' && !customQuery.trim())) ? 0.6 : 1,
                }}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                  if (!(!preset || loading || (preset === 'custom' && !customQuery.trim()))) {
                    const svg = e.currentTarget.querySelector('svg path');
                    if (svg) {
                      (svg as SVGPathElement).style.fill = theme === 'light' ? '#FFB366' : '#FF9538';
                    }
                  }
                }}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                  if (!(!preset || loading || (preset === 'custom' && !customQuery.trim()))) {
                    const svg = e.currentTarget.querySelector('svg path');
                    if (svg) {
                      (svg as SVGPathElement).style.fill = theme === 'dark' ? '#FF9538' : '#FFB366';
                    }
                  }
                }}
              >
                <svg className="w-6 h-6" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
                  <path d="M8 5v14l11-7z" style={{ fill: theme === 'dark' ? '#FF9538' : '#FFB366' }} />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default PerspectivesPanel;

import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { ArtifactsPanelToolbar } from './ArtifactsPanelToolbar';
import { WorkspacePanel } from './WorkspacePanel';
import { AnalysisPanel } from './AnalysisPanel';
import FindingsPanel from './FindingsPanel';
import { ExperimentalPanel } from './ExperimentalPanel';
import { ContextPanel } from './ContextPanel';

interface RightDrawerProps {
  rightPanelType: 'workspace' | 'artifacts' | 'experimental' | 'analysis' | 'context' | null;
  viewMode: string;
  showAccount: boolean;
  showSettings: boolean;
  isMobile: boolean;
  drawerWidth: number;
  setDrawerWidth: (width: number) => void;
  closeAllRightPanels: () => void;
  getPanelVisibilityStyles: (visible: boolean) => React.CSSProperties;
  // Workspace panel props
  sources: any[];
  currentProjectId: string | null;
  addMenuRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  showAddSourceMenu: boolean;
  onShowAddSourceMenuChange: (show: boolean) => void;
  onShowAddTelegramModalChange: (show: boolean) => void;
  onPreviewSource: (source: any) => void;
  onOpenDocument: (doc: { id: string; filename: string; contentType?: string; sizeBytes?: number; parseStatus?: string }) => void;
  // Analysis panel props
  handleAnalyzeEntities: () => Promise<void>;
  handleAnalyzeFacts: () => Promise<void>;
  handleAnalyzeEvents: () => Promise<void>;
  handleAnalyzeMetrics: () => Promise<void>;
  handleAnalyzeDecisions: () => Promise<void>;
  analysisTab: 'user' | 'flow';
  onAnalysisTabChange: (tab: 'user' | 'flow') => void;
  onFirstResultUser: () => void;
  onRiskUpdate: (risk: any) => void;
  onFirstResultDiscussionFlow: () => void;
  onAddTextTask: (task: any) => void;
  onRemoveTextTask: (taskId: string) => void;
  textTasks: any[];
  // Experimental panel props
  experimentalResponse: any;
  experimentalLoading: boolean;
  // Context panel props
  sectionStarts: any[];
  pinnedInteractions: any[];
  messagesRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  scrollToInteraction: (id: string) => void;
  truncateCenterWords: (s: string, headWords?: number, tailWords?: number) => string;
  onRemoveNote: (interactionId: string, noteIndex: number) => Promise<void>;
}

export const RightDrawer: React.FC<RightDrawerProps> = ({
  rightPanelType,
  viewMode,
  showAccount,
  showSettings,
  isMobile,
  drawerWidth,
  setDrawerWidth,
  closeAllRightPanels,
  getPanelVisibilityStyles,
  sources,
  currentProjectId,
  addMenuRef,
  showAddSourceMenu,
  onShowAddSourceMenuChange,
  onShowAddTelegramModalChange,
  onPreviewSource,
  onOpenDocument,
  handleAnalyzeEntities,
  handleAnalyzeFacts,
  handleAnalyzeEvents,
  handleAnalyzeMetrics,
  handleAnalyzeDecisions,
  analysisTab,
  onAnalysisTabChange,
  onFirstResultUser,
  onRiskUpdate,
  onFirstResultDiscussionFlow,
  onAddTextTask,
  onRemoveTextTask,
  textTasks,
  experimentalResponse,
  experimentalLoading,
  sectionStarts,
  pinnedInteractions,
  messagesRef,
  scrollToInteraction,
  truncateCenterWords,
  onRemoveNote,
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore();
  const drawerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Sync drawer width when resized natively
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const drawer = drawerRef.current;
    if (!drawer) return;
    
    const observer = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const width = entry.contentRect.width;
        if (Math.abs(width - drawerWidth) > 1) {
          // Avoid infinite loops
          setDrawerWidth(width);
        }
      }
    });
    
    observer.observe(drawer);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [drawerWidth, setDrawerWidth]);

  if (
    rightPanelType === null ||
    viewMode === 'graph' ||
    showAccount ||
    showSettings
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <>
      {/* Mobile overlay backdrop */}
      {isMobile && (
        <div
          onClick={closeAllRightPanels}
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
            zIndex: 40,
          }}
        />
      )}
      <div
        ref={drawerRef}
        className="min-h-0 flex flex-col drawer-resizable"
        style={{
          width: `${drawerWidth}px`,
          minWidth: '300px',
          maxWidth: '800px',
          flexShrink: 0,
          flexGrow: 0,
          position: isMobile ? 'fixed' : 'relative',
          top: isMobile ? 0 : 'auto',
          right: isMobile ? 0 : 'auto',
          bottom: isMobile ? 0 : 'auto',
          height: '100%',
          maxHeight: '100%',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          zIndex: isMobile ? 50 : 'auto',
          backgroundColor: isMobile
            ? 'var(--bg-sidebar)'
            : 'transparent',
          borderLeft: isMobile ? 'none' : '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
          ...(isMobile
            ? {
                maxWidth: '85vw',
                borderRadius: 0,
              }
            : {}),
        }}
      >
        {/* Resize handle on left edge */}
        {!isMobile && (
          <div
            onMouseDown={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              const startX = e.clientX;
              const startWidth =
                drawerRef.current?.clientWidth || drawerWidth;
              
              const onMove = (ev: MouseEvent) => {
                const delta = startX - ev.clientX; // Handle on left: moving right (ev.clientX > startX) decreases width
                const newWidth = Math.max(
                  300,
                  Math.min(800, startWidth + delta),
                );
                if (drawerRef.current) {
                  drawerRef.current.style.width = `${newWidth}px`;
                  setDrawerWidth(newWidth);
                }
              };
              
              const onUp = () => {
                window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
                window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
              };
              
              window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
              window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
            }}
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              left: -4,
              top: 0,
              bottom: 0,
              width: '8px',
              cursor: 'col-resize',
              zIndex: 10,
            }}
          />
        )}
        {/* Drawer content */}
        <div
          className="min-h-0 flex flex-col"
          style={{
            background: 'transparent',
            height: '100%',
            overflow: 'hidden',
          }}
        >
          {/* Right panel container - ALWAYS in DOM, never removed */}
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              flex: rightPanelType !== null ? 1 : 0,
              minWidth: rightPanelType !== null ? 'auto' : 0,
              visibility:
                rightPanelType !== null ? 'visible' : 'hidden',
              pointerEvents: rightPanelType !== null ? 'auto' : 'none',
              height: '100%',
              minHeight: 0,
              overflow: 'hidden',
            }}
          >
            {/* Empty spacer matching Chat | Perspectives toggle height - placed before entire panel to shift it down */}
            <div
              className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 mb-2 w-full"
              role="tablist"
              aria-label="Spacer"
              style={{
                visibility: 'hidden',
                pointerEvents: 'none',
                height: '28px',
              }}
            >
              <div className="px-2 py-1 text-12 rounded" />
              <div className="px-2 py-1 text-12 rounded" />
            </div>
            <div
              className="mt-3 p-3"
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                flex: 1,
                minHeight: 0,
                overflowY: 'auto',
              }}
            >
              <div
                className="flex items-center justify-between"
                style={{
                  position: 'sticky',
                  top: 0,
                  paddingBottom: 8,
                  marginBottom: 8,
                  zIndex: 1,
                }}
              >
                <h3
                  className="text-13 font-medium"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
                >
                  {rightPanelType === 'artifacts'
                    ? 'Workspace Artifacts'
                    : rightPanelType === 'experimental'
                      ? 'Experimental Response'
                      : rightPanelType === 'analysis'
                        ? t('unfold.sections.analysis')
                        : rightPanelType === 'context'
                          ? t('unfold.sections.contextNavigation', {
                              defaultValue: 'Context Navigation',
                            })
                          : 'Workspace'}
                </h3>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-label="Close right panel"
                  title="Close"
                  className="p-2 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                    color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                    (
                      e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement
                    ).style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-10)';
                  }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                    (
                      e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement
                    ).style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                  }}
                  onClick={closeAllRightPanels}
                >
                  <svg
                    className="w-4 h-4"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"
                    />
                  </svg>
                </button>
              </div>
              
              {/* Workspace Artifacts toolbar (top) */}
              {rightPanelType === 'artifacts' && (
                <ArtifactsPanelToolbar
                  onAnalyzeEntities={handleAnalyzeEntities}
                  onAnalyzeFacts={handleAnalyzeFacts}
                  onAnalyzeEvents={handleAnalyzeEvents}
                  onAnalyzeMetrics={handleAnalyzeMetrics}
                  onAnalyzeDecisions={handleAnalyzeDecisions}
                />
              )}
              
              {/* Panel content - always render all panels, hide inactive ones */}
              <div
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  minHeight: 0,
                  overflowY: 'auto',
                  paddingRight: 4,
                }}
              >
                {/* Workspace Panel */}
                {rightPanelType === 'workspace' && (
                  <div style={getPanelVisibilityStyles(true)}>
                    <WorkspacePanel
                      sources={sources}
                      currentProjectId={currentProjectId}
                      addMenuRef={addMenuRef}
                      showAddSourceMenu={showAddSourceMenu}
                      onShowAddSourceMenuChange={onShowAddSourceMenuChange}
                      onShowAddTelegramModalChange={onShowAddTelegramModalChange}
                      onPreviewSource={onPreviewSource}
                      onOpenDocument={onOpenDocument}
                    />
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Analysis Panel */}
                {rightPanelType === 'analysis' && (
                  <div style={getPanelVisibilityStyles(true)}>
                    <AnalysisPanel
                      analysisTab={analysisTab}
                      onAnalysisTabChange={onAnalysisTabChange}
                      onFirstResultUser={onFirstResultUser}
                      onRiskUpdate={onRiskUpdate}
                      onFirstResultDiscussionFlow={onFirstResultDiscussionFlow}
                      onAddTextTask={onAddTextTask}
                      onRemoveTextTask={onRemoveTextTask}
                      textTasks={textTasks}
                    />
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Workspace Artifacts Panel */}
                {rightPanelType === 'artifacts' && (
                  <div style={getPanelVisibilityStyles(true)}>
                    <FindingsPanel projectId={genaiChat.projectId} />
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Experimental Response Panel */}
                {rightPanelType === 'experimental' && (
                  <div style={getPanelVisibilityStyles(true)}>
                    <ExperimentalPanel
                      response={experimentalResponse}
                      loading={experimentalLoading}
                    />
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Context Navigation Panel */}
                {rightPanelType === 'context' && (
                  <div style={getPanelVisibilityStyles(true)}>
                    <ContextPanel
                      sectionStarts={sectionStarts}
                      pinnedInteractions={pinnedInteractions}
                      messagesRef={messagesRef}
                      scrollToInteraction={scrollToInteraction}
                      truncateCenterWords={truncateCenterWords}
                      onRemoveNote={onRemoveNote}
                    />
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import {
  getRightPanelButtonStyle,
  getRightPanelButtonHoverStyle,
} from '../lib/buttonStyles';
import { RightPanelType } from '../hooks/usePanelsManagement';

interface RightPanelButtonsProps {
  rightPanelType: RightPanelType;
  onPanelTypeChange: (type: RightPanelType) => void;
  hasPinned: boolean;
  hasSections: boolean;
  availUserAnalysis: boolean;
  availDiscussionFlow: boolean;
}

export const RightPanelButtons: React.FC<RightPanelButtonsProps> = ({
  rightPanelType,
  onPanelTypeChange,
  hasPinned,
  hasSections,
  availUserAnalysis,
  availDiscussionFlow,
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const handleButtonClick = (type: RightPanelType) => {
    if (type === 'artifacts') {
      // Special handling for artifacts button
      try {
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn-artifacts');
        if (btn) btn.classList.remove('etg-glow-blue');
      } catch {}
    }
    
    if (type === 'workspace') {
      // Performance logging for workspace button
      const startTime = performance.now();
      console.log('[RightPanel] Click at', startTime, 'toggle', rightPanelType !== 'workspace');
      onPanelTypeChange(rightPanelType === 'workspace' ? null : 'workspace');
      const endTime = performance.now();
      console.log('[RightPanel] setState called at', endTime, 'delay:', endTime - startTime, 'ms');
    } else {
      onPanelTypeChange(rightPanelType === type ? null : type);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseEnter = (
    e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>,
    isActive: boolean,
  ) => {
    if (!isActive) {
      e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = getRightPanelButtonHoverStyle(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseLeave = (
    e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>,
    isActive: boolean,
  ) => {
    if (!isActive) {
      e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = getRightPanelButtonStyle(false).backgroundColor;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2"
      style={{
        width: '48px',
        minWidth: '48px',
        flexShrink: 0,
        paddingTop: '76px',
      }}
    >
      {/* Workspace Library button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label={t('unfold.sections.toggleWorkspaceLibrary')}
        title={t('unfold.sections.toggleWorkspaceLibrary')}
        className="mirror-doc-btn rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300"
        style={getRightPanelButtonStyle(rightPanelType === 'workspace')}
        onClick={() => handleButtonClick('workspace')}
        onMouseEnter={(e) => handleMouseEnter(e, rightPanelType === 'workspace')}
        onMouseLeave={(e) => handleMouseLeave(e, rightPanelType === 'workspace')}
      >
        <svg
          className="w-4 h-4"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path
            d="M4 20h16a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8a2 2 0 0 0-2-2h-7.5L13 4H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2z"
            strokeWidth={2}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          />
          <path
            d="M8 10h8M8 14h6"
            strokeWidth={2}
            strokeLinecap="round"
          />
        </svg>
      </button>

      {/* Context Navigation button */}
      {(hasPinned || hasSections) && (
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={t('unfold.sections.contextNavigation')}
          title={t('unfold.sections.contextNavigation')}
          onClick={() => handleButtonClick('context')}
          className="rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300"
          style={getRightPanelButtonStyle(rightPanelType === 'context')}
          onMouseEnter={(e) => handleMouseEnter(e, rightPanelType === 'context')}
          onMouseLeave={(e) => handleMouseLeave(e, rightPanelType === 'context')}
        >
          <svg
            className="w-4 h-4"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
          >
            <path
              d="M21 10c0 7-9 13-9 13s-9-6-9-13a9 9 0 0 1 18 0z"
              strokeWidth={2}
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            />
            <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3" strokeWidth={2} />
          </svg>
        </button>
      )}

      {/* Workspace Artifacts button */}
      <button
        id="btn-artifacts"
        type="button"
        aria-label={t('unfold.sections.workspaceArtifacts')}
        title={t('unfold.sections.workspaceArtifacts')}
        onClick={() => handleButtonClick('artifacts')}
        className="rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300"
        style={getRightPanelButtonStyle(rightPanelType === 'artifacts')}
        onMouseEnter={(e) => handleMouseEnter(e, rightPanelType === 'artifacts')}
        onMouseLeave={(e) => handleMouseLeave(e, rightPanelType === 'artifacts')}
      >
        <svg
          className="w-4 h-4"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
        >
          <path
            d="M9 21h6M12 3a6 6 0 0 1 6 6c0 2.5-1.5 4.5-3 6l-1 1H9l-1-1c-1.5-1.5-3-3.5-3-6a6 6 0 0 1 6-6z"
            strokeWidth={2}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          />
          <path
            d="M9 8h6M9 12h4"
            strokeWidth={2}
            strokeLinecap="round"
          />
        </svg>
      </button>

      {/* Analysis button - shows if User Analysis or Discussion Flow is available */}
      {(availUserAnalysis || availDiscussionFlow) && (
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={t('unfold.sections.analysis', { defaultValue: 'Analysis' })}
          title={t('unfold.sections.analysis', { defaultValue: 'Analysis' })}
          onClick={() => handleButtonClick('analysis')}
          className="rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300"
          style={getRightPanelButtonStyle(rightPanelType === 'analysis')}
          onMouseEnter={(e) => handleMouseEnter(e, rightPanelType === 'analysis')}
          onMouseLeave={(e) => handleMouseLeave(e, rightPanelType === 'analysis')}
        >
          <svg
            className="w-4 h-4"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="2"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          >
            <line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12" y2="10" />
            <line x1="18" y1="20" x2="18" y2="4" />
            <line x1="6" y1="20" x2="6" y2="16" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      )}

      {/* Experimental Response button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label="Experimental Response"
        title="Experimental Response"
        onClick={() => handleButtonClick('experimental')}
        className="rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300"
        style={getRightPanelButtonStyle(rightPanelType === 'experimental')}
        onMouseEnter={(e) => handleMouseEnter(e, rightPanelType === 'experimental')}
        onMouseLeave={(e) => handleMouseLeave(e, rightPanelType === 'experimental')}
      >
        <svg
          className="w-4 h-4"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
        >
          <path
            d="M9 2v6l-3 3v8a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h8a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-8l-3-3V2"
            strokeWidth={2}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          />
          <path
            d="M9 2h6M12 10v4"
            strokeWidth={2}
            strokeLinecap="round"
          />
        </svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';

interface RiskBannerProps {
  riskBanner: {
    visible: boolean;
    level: 'High' | 'Medium' | 'Low';
    rationale: string;
  } | null;
  onDismiss: () => void;
}

export const RiskBanner: React.FC<RiskBannerProps> = ({
  riskBanner,
  onDismiss,
}) => {
  const isHigh = riskBanner?.visible && riskBanner?.level === 'High';
  
  if (!isHigh) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="rounded-lg border p-2 mb-2"
      style={{
        borderColor: 'rgba(220,20,60,0.5)',
        background: 'rgba(255,0,0,0.06)',
        color: 'var(--text-heading)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'flex-start',
        gap: 8,
      }}
    >
      <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
        <div
          className="text-12"
          style={{ color: '#cc3344', fontWeight: 600 }}
        >
          High-risk conversation
        </div>
        {riskBanner?.rationale && (
          <div
            className="text-[11px]"
            style={{
              color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
            }}
          >
            {riskBanner.rationale}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <button
        aria-label="Dismiss high-risk banner"
        title="Dismiss"
        className="rounded"
        onClick={onDismiss}
        style={{
          background: 'transparent',
          color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
        }}
      >
        <svg className="w-4 h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
          <path
            d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="2"
          />
        </svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';

interface SectionMarkerProps {
  interaction: any;
  collapsedSections: Record<string, boolean>;
  onToggleCollapse: (sectionId: string) => void;
}

export const SectionMarker: React.FC<SectionMarkerProps> = ({
  interaction,
  collapsedSections,
  onToggleCollapse,
}) => {
  const sid = (interaction.sectionId || interaction.id) as string;

  if (interaction.kind === 'section_start') {
    const collapsed = !!collapsedSections[sid];
    return (
      <div
        key={interaction.id}
        data-interaction-id={interaction.id}
        className="my-2 sticky top-0 z-10"
        style={{
          background: 'var(--surface-700)',
          border: '1px dashed var(--accent-research)',
          borderRadius: 10,
          padding: '6px 8px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
        }}
      >
        <div
          className="text-12 font-medium"
          style={{
            color: 'var(--text-heading)',
          }}
        >
          {interaction.content || 'Section'}
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="px-2 py-1 rounded text-11"
          style={{
            background: 'transparent',
            color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
          }}
          onClick={() => onToggleCollapse(sid)}
          aria-label={collapsed ? 'Expand section' : 'Collapse section'}
          title={collapsed ? 'Expand section' : 'Collapse section'}
        >
          {collapsed ? 'Expand' : 'Collapse'}
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // section_end divider
  return (
    <div
      key={interaction.id}
      className="my-2"
      style={{
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 8,
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          height: 1,
          background: 'var(--overlay-line-90)',
          flex: 1,
        }}
      />
      <div
        className="text-[10px]"
        style={{
          color: 'var(--accent-research)',
        }}
      >
        end of section
      </div>
      <div
        style={{
          height: 1,
          background: 'var(--overlay-line-90)',
          flex: 1,
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useServerStatusStore } from '../stores/serverStatusStore';

export const ServerUnavailableBanner: React.FC = () => {
  const { isAvailable, errorMessage, clearError } = useServerStatusStore();

  useEffect(() => {
    // Auto-hide error after 10 seconds
    if (!isAvailable && errorMessage) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        clearError();
      }, 10000);

      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [isAvailable, errorMessage, clearError]);

  if (isAvailable || !errorMessage) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        top: '60px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: '#fee',
        border: '1px solid #fcc',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        padding: '12px 20px',
        boxShadow: '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)',
        zIndex: 9999,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: '12px',
        maxWidth: '90%',
        animation: 'slideDown 0.3s ease-out',
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: '20px',
          height: '20px',
          borderRadius: '50%',
          backgroundColor: '#f44',
          flexShrink: 0,
        }}
      />
      <div style={{ flex: 1, color: '#600', fontSize: '14px', fontWeight: 500 }}>
        {errorMessage}
      </div>
      <button
        onClick={clearError}
        style={{
          background: 'none',
          border: 'none',
          color: '#600',
          cursor: 'pointer',
          fontSize: '18px',
          padding: '0 4px',
          lineHeight: 1,
        }}
        aria-label="Close"
      >
        ×
      </button>
      <style>{`
        @keyframes slideDown {
          from {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-20px);
          }
          to {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
          }
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
};



================================================================================
Файл: Settings.tsx
Путь: src/components/Settings.tsx
================================================================================

import React from 'react';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { ThemeContext } from './ThemeProvider';
import { useUIStore } from '../stores/uiStore';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

type TabKey = 'personal' | 'corporate';

// Popular countries with ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes
const COUNTRIES = [
  { code: 'US', name: 'United States' },
  { code: 'GB', name: 'United Kingdom' },
  { code: 'CA', name: 'Canada' },
  { code: 'AU', name: 'Australia' },
  { code: 'DE', name: 'Germany' },
  { code: 'FR', name: 'France' },
  { code: 'ES', name: 'Spain' },
  { code: 'IT', name: 'Italy' },
  { code: 'NL', name: 'Netherlands' },
  { code: 'CH', name: 'Switzerland' },
  { code: 'SE', name: 'Sweden' },
  { code: 'NO', name: 'Norway' },
  { code: 'DK', name: 'Denmark' },
  { code: 'PL', name: 'Poland' },
  { code: 'RU', name: 'Russia' },
  { code: 'UA', name: 'Ukraine' },
  { code: 'KZ', name: 'Kazakhstan' },
  { code: 'BY', name: 'Belarus' },
  { code: 'TR', name: 'Turkey' },
  { code: 'JP', name: 'Japan' },
  { code: 'CN', name: 'China' },
  { code: 'IN', name: 'India' },
  { code: 'SG', name: 'Singapore' },
  { code: 'AE', name: 'United Arab Emirates' },
  { code: 'BR', name: 'Brazil' },
  { code: 'MX', name: 'Mexico' },
  { code: 'AR', name: 'Argentina' },
];

export const Settings: React.FC = () => {
  const [active, setActive] = React.useState<TabKey>('personal');
  const [fullName, setFullName] = React.useState('');
  const [language, setLanguage] = React.useState('EN');
  const [countryCode, setCountryCode] = React.useState('');
  const [countryInput, setCountryInput] = React.useState('');
  const [showCountryDropdown, setShowCountryDropdown] = React.useState(false);
  const [parentUserId, setParentUserId] = React.useState('');
  const [gender, setGender] = React.useState('');
  const [age, setAge] = React.useState<number | ''>('');
  const { theme, setTheme } = React.useContext(ThemeContext);
  const [company, setCompany] = React.useState('');
  const [jobTitle, setJobTitle] = React.useState('');
  const [department, setDepartment] = React.useState('');
  const { currentUser } = useAuth();
  const countryInputRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const { i18n, t } = useTranslation();
  const uiLanguage = useUIStore((s) => s.uiLanguage);
  const setUiLanguage = useUIStore((s) => s.setUiLanguage);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const checkMobile = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth <= 768);
    };
    checkMobile();
    window.addEventListener('resize', checkMobile);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', checkMobile);
  }, []);

  const tabs: { key: TabKey; label: string }[] = [
    { key: 'personal', label: t('settings.tabs.personal') },
    { key: 'corporate', label: t('settings.tabs.corporate') },
  ];

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const storedLang = localStorage.getItem('preferredLanguage');
    if (storedLang && storedLang.length === 2) setLanguage(storedLang);
    
    // Load user data
    if (currentUser?.uid) {
      api.getUser(currentUser.uid).then((user) => {
        if (user.displayName) setFullName(user.displayName);
        if (user.preferredLanguage) setLanguage(user.preferredLanguage);
        if (user.countryOfResidence) {
          setCountryCode(user.countryOfResidence);
          const country = COUNTRIES.find(c => c.code === user.countryOfResidence);
          if (country) setCountryInput(country.name);
        }
        if (user.parentUserId) setParentUserId(user.parentUserId);
        if (user.gender) setGender(user.gender);
        if (typeof user.age === 'number') setAge(user.age);
        if (user.companyRef) setCompany(user.companyRef);
        if (user.jobTitle) setJobTitle(user.jobTitle);
        if (user.department) setDepartment(user.department);
      }).catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [currentUser]);

  const saveLanguage = async (code: string) => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('preferredLanguage', code);
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('lang', code.toLowerCase());
      if (currentUser?.uid) {
        await api.updateUser(currentUser.uid, { preferredLanguage: code });
      }
    } catch {}
  };

  const saveCountry = async (code: string) => {
    try {
      if (currentUser?.uid) {
        await api.updateUser(currentUser.uid, { countryOfResidence: code });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to save country:', e);
    }
  };

  const handleUiLanguageChange = (code: string) => {
    const raw = (code || 'en').toLowerCase();
    const mapped = raw === 'kz' ? 'kk' : raw;
    setUiLanguage(mapped);
    try { document.documentElement.setAttribute('lang', mapped); } catch {}
    try { i18n.changeLanguage(mapped); } catch {}
  };

  const applyTheme = (t: 'dark' | 'light') => {
    setTheme(t);
  };

  const handleCountryInputChange = (value: string) => {
    setCountryInput(value);
    setShowCountryDropdown(true);
  };

  const handleCountrySelect = (country: { code: string; name: string }) => {
    setCountryCode(country.code);
    setCountryInput(country.name);
    setShowCountryDropdown(false);
    saveCountry(country.code);
  };

  const filteredCountries = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!countryInput.trim()) return COUNTRIES;
    const query = countryInput.toLowerCase();
    return COUNTRIES.filter(c => 
      c.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || 
      c.code.toLowerCase().includes(query)
    );
  }, [countryInput]);

  // Close dropdown when clicking outside
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (countryInputRef.current && !countryInputRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setShowCountryDropdown(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl" style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent', padding: '0' }}>
      <div className={isMobile ? 'flex flex-col' : 'flex'} style={{ gap: '16px' }}>
        {/* Tabs column/row */}
        <div className={isMobile ? 'w-full' : 'flex-shrink-0'} style={{ width: isMobile ? '100%' : '220px' }}>
          <div className={isMobile ? 'flex flex-row' : 'flex flex-col'} style={{ gap: '6px' }}>
            {tabs.map(t => (
              <button
                key={t.key}
                className={`text-13 ${isMobile ? 'text-center' : 'text-left'} rounded-lg px-3 py-2 transition-colors`}
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: active === t.key ? 'var(--white-10)' : 'transparent',
                  color: 'var(--text-heading)',
                  ...(isMobile ? { flex: '1 1 0' } : {})
                }}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => { if (active !== t.key) (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-10)'; }}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => { if (active !== t.key) (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'transparent'; }}
                onClick={() => setActive(t.key)}
              >
                {t.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Divider */}
        {isMobile ? (
          <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '1px', backgroundColor: 'var(--overlay-line-90)' }} />
        ) : (
          <div style={{ width: '1px', backgroundColor: 'var(--overlay-line-90)' }} />
        )}

        {/* Content full width */}
        <div className="flex-1" style={{ paddingLeft: isMobile ? '0' : '16px' }}>
          {active === 'personal' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', marginBottom: '6px' }}>{t('settings.personal.fullName')}</label>
                <input
                  value={fullName}
                  onChange={e => setFullName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={t('settings.personal.fullNamePlaceholder')}
                  className="w-full"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent', border: 'none', outline: 'none', color: 'var(--text-heading)', padding: '8px 0', transition: 'all 120ms ease' }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                    const el = e.currentTarget as HTMLInputElement;
                    el.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-06)';
                    el.style.border = 'none';
                    el.style.borderRadius = '6px';
                    el.style.padding = '8px 8px';
                  }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                    const el = e.currentTarget as HTMLInputElement;
                    el.style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                    el.style.border = 'none';
                    el.style.borderRadius = '0';
                    el.style.padding = '8px 0';
                  }}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', marginBottom: '6px' }}>{t('settings.personal.language')}</label>
                <select
                  value={language}
                  onChange={(e) => { const code = e.target.value; setLanguage(code); saveLanguage(code); }}
                  className="lang-select"
                  style={{ padding: '8px 12px', width: '33%' }}
                >
                  <option value="EN">EN — English</option>
                  <option value="ES">ES — Español</option>
                  <option value="DE">DE — Deutsch</option>
                  <option value="RU">RU — Русский</option>
                </select>
                <div className="text-12 mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                  {t('settings.personal.languageDescription')}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', marginBottom: '6px' }}>{t('settings.personal.interfaceLanguage')}</label>
                <select
                  value={uiLanguage === 'kk' ? 'kz' : (uiLanguage || 'en')}
                  onChange={(e) => handleUiLanguageChange(e.target.value)}
                  className="lang-select"
                  style={{ padding: '8px 12px', width: '33%' }}
                >
                  <option value="en">EN — English</option>
                  <option value="es">ES — Español</option>
                  <option value="de">DE — Deutsch</option>
                  <option value="ru">RU — Русский</option>
                  <option value="kz">KZ — Қазақ</option>
                </select>
                <div className="text-12 mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                  {t('settings.personal.interfaceLanguageDescription')}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', marginBottom: '6px' }}>{t('settings.personal.countryOfResidence')}</label>
                <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '66%' }} ref={countryInputRef}>
                  <input
                    value={countryInput}
                    onChange={(e) => handleCountryInputChange(e.target.value)}
                    onFocus={() => setShowCountryDropdown(true)}
                    placeholder={t('settings.personal.selectCountry')}
                    className="w-full"
                    style={{ 
                      backgroundColor: 'transparent', 
                      border: 'none', 
                      outline: 'none', 
                      color: 'var(--text-heading)', 
                      padding: '8px 0',
                      borderBottom: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)'
                    }}
                  />
                  {showCountryDropdown && filteredCountries.length > 0 && (
                    <div 
                      className="absolute z-50 w-full mt-1 rounded-lg shadow-lg overflow-hidden"
                      style={{ 
                        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)', 
                        border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
                        maxHeight: '200px',
                        overflowY: 'auto'
                      }}
                    >
                      {filteredCountries.map((country) => (
                        <div
                          key={country.code}
                          className="px-3 py-2 cursor-pointer transition-colors text-13"
                          style={{ 
                            color: 'var(--text-heading)',
                            backgroundColor: countryCode === country.code ? 'var(--white-10)' : 'transparent'
                          }}
                          onMouseEnter={(e) => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-10)'; }}
                          onMouseLeave={(e) => { 
                            if (countryCode !== country.code) {
                              (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.backgroundColor = 'transparent'; 
                            }
                          }}
                          onClick={() => handleCountrySelect(country)}
                        >
                          {country.name} ({country.code})
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="grid" style={{ gap: '16px', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 1fr' }}>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', marginBottom: '6px' }}>{t('settings.personal.parentUserId')}</label>
                  <input
                    value={parentUserId}
                    onChange={e => setParentUserId(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={t('settings.personal.parentUserIdPlaceholder')}
                    className="w-full"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent', border: 'none', outline: 'none', color: 'var(--text-heading)', padding: '8px 0', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}
                    onBlur={async () => { try { if (currentUser?.uid) await api.updateUser(currentUser.uid, { parentUserId: parentUserId || undefined }); } catch {} }}
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', marginBottom: '6px' }}>{t('settings.personal.gender')}</label>
                  <select
                    value={gender}
                    onChange={async (e) => { const v = e.target.value; setGender(v); try { if (currentUser?.uid) await api.updateUser(currentUser.uid, { gender: v || undefined }); } catch {} }}
                    className="w-full"
                    style={{ padding: '8px 12px' }}
                  >
                    <option value="">{t('settings.personal.genderOptions.empty')}</option>
                    <option value="male">{t('settings.personal.genderOptions.male')}</option>
                    <option value="female">{t('settings.personal.genderOptions.female')}</option>
                    <option value="other">{t('settings.personal.genderOptions.other')}</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', marginBottom: '6px' }}>{t('settings.personal.age')}</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={0}
                    max={120}
                    value={age}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const val = e.target.value;
                      const num = val === '' ? '' : Number(val);
                      if (num === '' || (!Number.isNaN(num) && num >= 0 && num <= 120)) setAge(num as any);
                    }}
                    onBlur={async () => { try { if (currentUser?.uid) await api.updateUser(currentUser.uid, { age: typeof age === 'number' ? age : undefined }); } catch {} }}
                    placeholder={t('settings.personal.agePlaceholder')}
                    className="w-full"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent', border: 'none', outline: 'none', color: 'var(--text-heading)', padding: '8px 0', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', marginBottom: '6px' }}>{t('settings.personal.theme')}</label>
                <div className="flex" style={{ gap: '8px' }}>
                  <button
                    className="text-13 rounded px-3 py-2 transition-colors"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: theme === 'dark' ? 'var(--white-10)' : 'transparent', color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
                    onClick={() => applyTheme('dark')}
                  >{t('settings.personal.dark')}</button>
                  <button
                    className="text-13 rounded px-3 py-2 transition-colors"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: theme === 'light' ? 'var(--white-10)' : 'transparent', color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
                    onClick={() => applyTheme('light')}
                  >{t('settings.personal.light')}</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {active === 'corporate' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', marginBottom: '6px' }}>{t('settings.corporate.company')}</label>
                <input
                  value={company}
                  onChange={e => setCompany(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={t('settings.corporate.companyPlaceholder')}
                  className="w-full"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent', border: 'none', outline: 'none', color: 'var(--text-heading)', padding: '8px 0' }}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', marginBottom: '6px' }}>{t('settings.corporate.jobTitle')}</label>
                <input
                  value={jobTitle}
                  onChange={e => setJobTitle(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={t('settings.corporate.jobTitlePlaceholder')}
                  className="w-full"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent', border: 'none', outline: 'none', color: 'var(--text-heading)', padding: '8px 0' }}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', marginBottom: '6px' }}>{t('settings.corporate.department')}</label>
                <input
                  value={department}
                  onChange={e => setDepartment(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={t('settings.corporate.departmentPlaceholder')}
                  className="w-full"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent', border: 'none', outline: 'none', color: 'var(--text-heading)', padding: '8px 0' }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Settings;

/**
 * Модальное окно настроек
 * Вынесено из DiscoveryPage для улучшения читаемости
 */

import React from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import Settings from './Settings';
import { ModalWithHeader } from './ModalWithHeader';

export interface SettingsModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const SettingsModal: React.FC<SettingsModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <ModalWithHeader
      title={t('unfold.sections.settings')}
      onClose={onClose}
    >
      <Settings />
    </ModalWithHeader>
  );
};

Путь: src/components/SidebarPanel.tsx
