import React from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { useProjectsStore } from '../stores/projectsStore';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { isArtifact, type Artifact } from '../types/artifact';
import type { CoreDoc } from '../types/generated';

interface SidebarPanelProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onOpen: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  isMobile: boolean;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  onResetChat: () => void;
  onShowSettings: () => void;
  onShowAccount: () => void;
  onShowAdmin: () => void;
  editingProjectId: string | null;
  editingProjectName: string;
  editingInputRef: React.RefObject<HTMLInputElement | null>;
  onEditingProjectIdChange: (id: string | null) => void;
  onEditingProjectNameChange: (name: string) => void;
  onDeleteChat: (projectId: string, projectName: string) => void;
  onRenameChat: (projectId: string, newName: string) => void;
  onStartEditingProject: (projectId: string, currentName: string) => void;
  currentMode?: 'chat' | 'perspectives' | 'models' | 'pages';
  projectId?: string | null;
  onOpenDocument?: (doc: { id: string; filename: string; contentType?: string; sizeBytes?: number; parseStatus?: string }) => void;
}

export const SidebarPanel: React.FC<SidebarPanelProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onOpen,
  onClose,
  isMobile,
  isAdmin,
  onResetChat,
  onShowSettings,
  onShowAccount,
  onShowAdmin,
  editingProjectId,
  editingProjectName,
  editingInputRef,
  onEditingProjectIdChange,
  onEditingProjectNameChange,
  onDeleteChat,
  onRenameChat,
  onStartEditingProject,
  currentMode,
  projectId,
  onOpenDocument,
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const projects = useProjectsStore((s) => s.projects);
  const currentProject = useProjectsStore((s) => s.currentProject);
  const setCurrentProject = useProjectsStore((s) => s.setCurrentProject);
  const [pages, setPages] = React.useState<Artifact[]>([]);
  const [pagesLoading, setPagesLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const showPages = currentMode === 'pages';

  // Load pages when in pages mode
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!showPages || !projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') {
      setPages([]);
      return;
    }

    const loadPages = async () => {
      setPagesLoading(true);
      try {
        const docs = await api.docsList(projectId);
        const artifactsList = docs.filter((doc: CoreDoc) => isArtifact(doc)) as Artifact[];
        setPages(artifactsList);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('[SidebarPanel] Failed to load pages', err);
        setPages([]);
      } finally {
        setPagesLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadPages();
  }, [showPages, projectId]);

  if (!isOpen) {
    return (
      <div
        id="left-toggle-anchor"
        className="flex-shrink-0 ml-2 mr-2 flex flex-col"
        style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-start', marginTop: '20px' }}
      >
        <button
          onClick={onOpen}
          className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300"
          style={{ backgroundColor: '#669999', color: 'white' }}
        >
          <svg
            className="w-4 h-4"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          >
            <path
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              strokeWidth={2.5}
              d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"
            />
          </svg>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => {
            onResetChat();
          }}
          className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--newchat-bg)',
            color: 'var(--text-heading)',
            marginTop: '8px',
          }}
          onMouseEnter={(e) => {
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
              'var(--newchat-bg-hover)';
          }}
          onMouseLeave={(e) => {
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
              'var(--newchat-bg)';
          }}
        >
          <svg
            className="w-4 h-4"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
          >
            <rect
              x="3.5"
              y="3.5"
              width="17"
              height="17"
              rx="3"
              strokeWidth={2}
            />
            <path
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeWidth={2}
              d="M12 8v8M8 12h8"
            />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      {/* Mobile overlay backdrop */}
      {isMobile && (
        <div
          onClick={onClose}
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
            zIndex: 40,
          }}
        />
      )}
      <div
        className="flex-shrink-0 rounded-xl mr-4 overflow-hidden relative sidebar-panel"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input)',
          width: '320px',
          minWidth: '260px',
          maxWidth: '420px',
          ...(isMobile
            ? {
                position: 'fixed',
                top: 0,
                left: 0,
                bottom: 0,
                zIndex: 50,
                marginRight: 0,
                borderRadius: 0,
                maxWidth: '85vw',
              }
            : {}),
        }}
      >
        <div className="p-6 h-full flex flex-col">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
            {currentMode === 'pages' ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    // Switch back to chat mode via callback prop
                    // Parent component should handle mode switching
                    if (onOpenDocument) {
                      // Trigger mode switch by dispatching event that parent listens to
                      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ui.switchMode', { detail: { mode: 'chat' } }));
                    }
                  }}
                  className="p-1 rounded transition-colors"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                    color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                    (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                      'var(--white-10)';
                  }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                    (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                      'transparent';
                  }}
                  title="Back to chats"
                >
                  <svg
                    className="w-4 h-4"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M15 19l-7-7 7-7"
                    />
                  </svg>
                </button>
                <h3
                  className="text-13 font-medium"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
                >
                  Pages
                </h3>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <h3
                className="text-13 font-medium"
                style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
              >
                {t('unfold.sections.navigation')}
              </h3>
            )}
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-2 rounded-lg transition-colors"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'var(--white-10)',
                color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                  'var(--white-20)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                  'var(--white-10)';
              }}
            >
              <svg
                className="w-4 h-4"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M15 19l-7-7 7-7"
                />
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* New Chat action */}
          <div className="mb-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label={t('unfold.sections.newChat')}
              className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                color: 'var(--text-heading)',
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                  'var(--white-10)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                  'transparent';
              }}
              onClick={() => {
                onResetChat();
                if (isMobile) {
                  onClose();
                }
              }}
            >
              <svg
                className="w-4 h-4"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
              >
                <rect
                  x="3.5"
                  y="3.5"
                  width="17"
                  height="17"
                  rx="3"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                />
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M12 8v8M8 12h8"
                />
              </svg>
              <span
                className="text-13 font-medium"
                style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
              >
                {t('unfold.sections.newChat')}
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Scrollable Chats section */}
          <div
            className="mb-4 flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto"
            style={{ scrollbarGutter: 'stable' }}
          >
            {showPages ? (
              <>
                <div
                  className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide mb-2"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}
                >
                  Pages ({pages.length})
                </div>
                {pagesLoading ? (
                  <div
                    className="text-xs"
                    style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}
                  >
                    Loading...
                  </div>
                ) : pages.length === 0 ? (
                  <div
                    className="text-xs"
                    style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}
                  >
                    No pages yet
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    {pages.map((page) => (
                      <div
                        key={page.id}
                        className="px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs flex items-center gap-2 group cursor-pointer"
                        title={page.filename}
                        onClick={() => {
                          onOpenDocument?.(page);
                          if (isMobile) {
                            onClose();
                          }
                        }}
                        style={{
                          backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                        }}
                        onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                          (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.backgroundColor =
                            'var(--white-10)';
                        }}
                        onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                          (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.backgroundColor =
                            'transparent';
                        }}
                      >
                        <svg
                          className="w-3 h-3"
                          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                          fill="none"
                          stroke="currentColor"
                          style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}
                        >
                          <path
                            d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8z"
                            strokeWidth="2"
                            strokeLinecap="round"
                            strokeLinejoin="round"
                          />
                          <path
                            d="M14 2v6h6M16 13H8M16 17H8M10 9H8"
                            strokeWidth="2"
                            strokeLinecap="round"
                            strokeLinejoin="round"
                          />
                        </svg>
                        <span
                          className="flex-1 truncate"
                          style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
                        >
                          {page.filename}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div
                  className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide mb-2"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}
                >
                  {t('unfold.sections.chats')}
                </div>

                {projects.length === 0 ? (
                  <div
                    className="text-xs"
                    style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}
                  >
                    {t('unfold.sections.noChatsYet')}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    {projects.map((project) => (
                      <div
                        key={project.id}
                        className="px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs flex items-center gap-2 group cursor-pointer"
                        title={project.displayName}
                        onClick={() => {
                          if (editingProjectId !== project.id) {
                            setCurrentProject(project);
                            if (isMobile) {
                              onClose();
                            }
                          }
                        }}
                        style={{
                          backgroundColor:
                            currentProject?.id === project.id
                              ? 'var(--white-10)'
                              : 'transparent',
                        }}
                        onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                          if (
                            currentProject?.id !== project.id &&
                            editingProjectId !== project.id
                          )
                            (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.backgroundColor =
                              'var(--white-10)';
                        }}
                        onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                          if (
                            currentProject?.id !== project.id &&
                            editingProjectId !== project.id
                          )
                            (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.backgroundColor =
                              'transparent';
                        }}
                      >
                        {editingProjectId === project.id ? (
                          <>
                            <input
                              ref={editingInputRef}
                              type="text"
                              value={editingProjectName}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                onEditingProjectNameChange(e.target.value)
                              }
                              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                                if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                                  onRenameChat(project.id, editingProjectName);
                                } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                                  onEditingProjectIdChange(null);
                                  onEditingProjectNameChange('');
                                }
                              }}
                              onBlur={() => {
                                onRenameChat(project.id, editingProjectName);
                              }}
                              className="flex-1 px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-xs"
                              style={{
                                backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input, #1A1A1A)',
                                color: 'var(--text-heading)',
                                border:
                                  '1px solid var(--border-input, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1))',
                              }}
                              placeholder={t(
                                'unfold.sections.renameChatPlaceholder',
                              )}
                              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                            />
                          </>
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <span
                              className="flex-1 truncate"
                              style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
                            >
                              {project.displayName}
                            </span>
                            <button
                              className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity p-1 rounded"
                              title={t('unfold.sections.renameChat')}
                              style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent' }}
                              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                                (
                                  e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement
                                ).style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-10)';
                              }}
                              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                                (
                                  e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement
                                ).style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                              }}
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                onStartEditingProject(project.id, project.displayName);
                              }}
                            >
                              <svg
                                className="w-3.5 h-3.5"
                                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                                fill="none"
                                stroke="currentColor"
                              >
                                <path
                                  strokeLinecap="round"
                                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                                  strokeWidth={2}
                                  d="M11 5H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v11a2 2 0 002 2h11a2 2 0 002-2v-5m-1.414-9.414a2 2 0 112.828 2.828L11.828 15H9v-2.828l8.586-8.586z"
                                />
                              </svg>
                            </button>
                            <button
                              className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity p-1 rounded"
                              title={t('unfold.sections.deleteChat')}
                              style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent' }}
                              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                                (
                                  e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement
                                ).style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-10)';
                              }}
                              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                                (
                                  e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement
                                ).style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                              }}
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                onDeleteChat(project.id, project.displayName);
                              }}
                            >
                              <svg
                                className="w-3.5 h-3.5"
                                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                                fill="none"
                                stroke="currentColor"
                              >
                                <path
                                  strokeLinecap="round"
                                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                                  strokeWidth={2}
                                  d="M6 7h12M10 11v6M14 11v6M9 7l1-2h4l1 2M6 7l1 12a2 2 0 002 2h6a2 2 0 002-2l1-12"
                                />
                              </svg>
                            </button>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Bottom settings button */}
          <div className="mt-auto pt-4">
            {isAdmin && (
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={t('unfold.sections.adminAccess')}
                className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors mb-1"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                  color: 'var(--text-heading)',
                }}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                  (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                    'var(--white-10)';
                }}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                  (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                    'transparent';
                }}
                onClick={onShowAdmin}
              >
                <svg
                  className="w-4 h-4"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                >
                  <path
                    d="M12 3l7 3v6c0 5-3.5 8-7 9-3.5-1-7-4-7-9V6l7-3z"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                  />
                  <path
                    d="M9.5 12.5l1.8 1.8 3.2-3.3"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                  />
                </svg>
                <span
                  className="text-13 font-medium"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
                >
                  {t('unfold.sections.adminAccess')}
                </span>
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Account"
              className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors mb-1"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                color: 'var(--text-heading)',
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                  'var(--white-10)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                  'transparent';
              }}
              onClick={onShowAccount}
            >
              <svg
                className="w-4 h-4"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              >
                <path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2" />
                <circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4" />
              </svg>
              <span
                className="text-13 font-medium"
                style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
              >
                {t('unfold.sections.account')}
              </span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label={t('unfold.sections.settings')}
              className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                color: 'var(--text-heading)',
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                  'var(--white-10)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor =
                  'transparent';
              }}
              onClick={onShowSettings}
            >
              <svg
                className="w-4 h-4"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              >
                <path d="M12.22 2h-.44a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v.18a2 2 0 0 1-1 1.73l-.43.25a2 2 0 0 1-2 0l-.15-.08a2 2 0 0 0-2.73.73l-.22.38a2 2 0 0 0 .73 2.73l.15.1a2 2 0 0 1 1 1.72v.51a2 2 0 0 1-1 1.74l-.15.09a2 2 0 0 0-.73 2.73l.22.38a2 2 0 0 0 2.73.73l.15-.08a2 2 0 0 1 2 0l.43.25a2 2 0 0 1 1 1.73V20a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h.44a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-.18a2 2 0 0 1 1-1.73l.43-.25a2 2 0 0 1 2 0l.15.08a2 2 0 0 0 2.73-.73l.22-.39a2 2 0 0 0-.73-2.73l-.15-.08a2 2 0 0 1-1-1.74v-.5a2 2 0 0 1 1-1.74l.15-.09a2 2 0 0 0 .73-2.73l-.22-.38a2 2 0 0 0-2.73-.73l-.15.08a2 2 0 0 1-2 0l-.43-.25a2 2 0 0 1-1-1.73V4a2 2 0 0 0-2-2z" />
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" />
              </svg>
              <span
                className="text-13 font-medium"
                style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
              >
                {t('unfold.sections.settings')}
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { DataSource } from '../types/generated';

type SourceWithProfile = DataSource & { profile?: any; description?: string };

interface SourcePreviewProps {
  source: SourceWithProfile;
  onClose: () => void;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const headerStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  justifyContent: 'space-between',
  padding: '10px 12px',
  borderBottom: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
};

const titleStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  fontSize: '0.8125rem',
  lineHeight: '1.25rem',
  fontWeight: 600,
  color: 'var(--text-heading)',
};

const closeBtnStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  padding: 6,
  borderRadius: 8,
  backgroundColor: 'transparent',
  color: 'var(--text-heading)',
};

export const SourcePreview: React.FC<SourcePreviewProps> = ({ source, onClose, style }) => {
  const containerRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    function handleDown(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        onClose();
      }
    }
    function handleKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleDown);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
    };
  }, [onClose]);

  const badgeStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: 'inline-flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 6,
    padding: '2px 8px',
    borderRadius: 999,
    backgroundColor: 'var(--white-10)',
    color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
    fontSize: 11,
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      style={{
        position: 'absolute',
        top: 8,
        left: 8,
        bottom: 140,
        width: 380,
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 16px)',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)',
        border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
        borderRadius: 12,
        boxShadow: '0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)',
        zIndex: 30,
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        ...style,
      }}
      role="dialog"
      aria-label="Source preview"
    >
      <div style={headerStyle}>
        <div style={titleStyle}>
          {source.kind ? `${source.kind}` : 'source'}
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 400, color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}> — {source.displayName || source.id}</span>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="Close preview"
          style={closeBtnStyle}
          onMouseEnter={(e) => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-10)'; }}
          onMouseLeave={(e) => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'transparent'; }}
        >
          <svg className="w-4 h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div style={{ padding: 12, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
        {/* Telegram inline preview (under header) */}
        {(() => {
          const isTelegram = (source.kind === 'telegram') ||
            (!!source.sourceDetails?.channelUsername) ||
            (typeof source.id === 'string' && source.id.startsWith('@'));
          if (!isTelegram) return null;

          const username = (source.sourceDetails?.channelUsername) ||
            (typeof source.id === 'string' && source.id.startsWith('@') ? source.id.slice(1) : undefined);
          const href = username ? `https://t.me/${username}` : (source.sourceDetails?.uri || undefined);
          const display = source.displayName || (username ? `@${username}` : (source.id as string));

          return (
            <div
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 10,
                padding: 10,
                border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
                borderRadius: 10,
                backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-sidebar)',
                marginBottom: 10,
              }}
              aria-label="Telegram channel preview"
            >
              <div
                style={{
                  width: 36,
                  height: 36,
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #2AABEE 0%, #229ED9 100%)',
                  color: 'white',
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}
              >
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width={18} height={18} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                  <path d="M3 11l18-7-7 18-4-8-7-3z" stroke="currentColor" />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <div style={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-heading)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{display}</div>
                {username && (
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>@{username}</div>
                )}
              </div>
              {href && (
                <a
                  href={href}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="text-xs"
                  style={{
                    padding: '6px 10px',
                    borderRadius: 8,
                    border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
                    color: 'var(--text-heading)',
                    backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                    textDecoration: 'none',
                    whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  }}
                >
                  Open
                </a>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })()}

        {/* Basic info */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8 }}>
          <span style={badgeStyle}>{source.status || 'unknown'}</span>
          {source.trustLevel !== undefined && (
            <span style={badgeStyle}>trust: {source.trustLevel}</span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Description / Profile summary */}
        {source.profile?.motivation && (
          <div style={{ marginBottom: 8, color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{source.profile.motivation}</div>
        )}
        {!source.profile?.motivation && source.profile?.agenda?.description && (
          <div style={{ marginBottom: 8, color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{source.profile.agenda.description}</div>
        )}
        {!source.profile && source.description && (
          <div style={{ marginBottom: 8, color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{source.description}</div>
        )}

        {/* Primary goal */}
        {source.profile?.agenda?.primaryGoal && (
          <div style={{ margin: '8px 0', color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>primaryGoal:</span> {source.profile.agenda.primaryGoal}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Topics */}
        {Array.isArray(source.profile?.topics) && source.profile.topics.length > 0 && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6, marginTop: 8 }}>
            {source.profile.topics.slice(0, 10).map((t: any, i: number) => (
              <span
                key={i}
                style={{
                  padding: '2px 8px',
                  borderRadius: 999,
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--white-10)',
                  color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
                  fontSize: 11,
                }}
              >
                {t.name}{typeof t.share === 'number' ? ` ${Math.round(t.share * 100)}%` : ''}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Alignment metric */}
        {typeof source.profile?.goalAlignmentScore === 'number' && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginTop: 10, color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', fontSize: 12 }}>
            <span>alignment</span>
            <div style={{ width: 120, height: 6, borderRadius: 4, backgroundColor: 'var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  width: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(1, source.profile.goalAlignmentScore)) * 100}%`,
                  height: 6,
                  borderRadius: 4,
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-success)'
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <span>{Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, source.profile.goalAlignmentScore)) * 100)}%</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Details list */}
        <div style={{ marginTop: 12, fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
          <div><span style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>id:</span> {source.id}</div>
          {source.sourceDetails?.uri && (
            <div><span style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>uri:</span> {source.sourceDetails.uri}</div>
          )}
          {source.sourceDetails?.channelUsername && (
            <div><span style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>telegram:</span> @{source.sourceDetails.channelUsername}</div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SourcePreview;

Файл: Splash.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import lightLogo from '../assets/hatl-light-theme.png';
import darkLogo from '../assets/hatl-dark-theme.png';
import { ThemeContext } from './ThemeProvider';

type Props = { onSubmit: (query: string) => void };

export default function Splash({ onSubmit }: Props) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme } = React.useContext(ThemeContext);
  // Ensure theme has an initial value saved if none existed before
  React.useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('etg.theme');
      if (!saved) {
        localStorage.setItem('etg.theme', theme);
      }
    } catch {}
  }, [theme]);
  const [q, setQ] = React.useState('');

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-white text-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 p-6">
      <img src={theme === 'dark' ? darkLogo : lightLogo} alt="HATL" className="h-3 w-auto mb-6" />
      <form
        className="w-full max-w-xl"
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          onSubmit(q.trim());
        }}
      >
        <input
          className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 px-4 py-3 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
          placeholder={t('search.placeholder')}
          value={q}
          onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
        />
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

type Props = { error?: Error | null; onRetry?: () => void };

    <div data-theme="dark" className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6">
      <img src={darkLogo} alt="Sanskrite" className="h-4 w-auto mb-4" />

        <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">We’re experiencing a temporary issue</h1>
        <p className="text-slate-300 mb-4">
          Please try to reload the page in a minute. This issue is likely temporary.
        </p>
        <br />
        {error && (
          <pre className="text-xs text-red-400 bg-red-950/30 rounded-md p-3 overflow-auto mb-4">

  );
}

Файл: SubscriptionTab.tsx

================================================================================

import React from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';

type SubscriptionTier = 'free' | 'pro' | 'max';
type SubscriptionStatus = 'active' | 'expired' | 'cancelled';

interface Subscription {
  id: string;
  tenantId: string;
  userId: string;
  tier: SubscriptionTier;
  status: SubscriptionStatus;
  startedAt: string;
  currentPeriodStart: string;
  currentPeriodEnd: string;
  nextBillingDate?: string;
  cancelAtPeriodEnd?: boolean;
  voucherId?: string;
  paymentProvider?: string;
  paymentId?: string;
  paypalPlanId?: string;
  paypalAgreementId?: string;
  paypalSubscriptionId?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export const SubscriptionTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { currentUser, refreshSubscription } = useAuth();
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [subscription, setSubscription] = React.useState<Subscription | null>(null);
  const [voucherCode, setVoucherCode] = React.useState('');
  const [applyingVoucher, setApplyingVoucher] = React.useState(false);
  const [voucherError, setVoucherError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [voucherSuccess, setVoucherSuccess] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [upgrading, setUpgrading] = React.useState<SubscriptionTier | null>(null);
  const [cancelling, setCancelling] = React.useState(false);
  const [showCancelConfirm, setShowCancelConfirm] = React.useState(false);
  const [cancelError, setCancelError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentUser?.uid) return;
    
    // Handle PayPal redirect after payment approval
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const token = urlParams.get('token');
    const payerId = urlParams.get('PayerID');
    const subscriptionId = sessionStorage.getItem('paypal_subscription_id');
    
    if (token && payerId && subscriptionId) {
      // Clean up URL and sessionStorage
      window.history.replaceState({}, '', window.location.pathname);
      sessionStorage.removeItem('paypal_subscription_id');
      
      // Execute the subscription
      (async () => {
        try {
          setLoading(true);
          const updated = await api.executePayPalSubscription(subscriptionId);
          setSubscription(updated);
          setLoading(false);
        } catch (err: any) {
          console.error('[SubscriptionTab] Error executing PayPal subscription:', err);
          setError(err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to complete subscription');
          setLoading(false);
        }
      })();
      return;
    }
    
    loadSubscription();
  }, [currentUser?.uid]);

  const loadSubscription = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const sub = await api.getSubscription();
      setSubscription(sub);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || 'Failed to load subscription');
      console.error('[SubscriptionTab] Error loading subscription:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleApplyVoucher = async () => {
    if (!voucherCode.trim()) {
      setVoucherError(t('account.subscription.enterVoucherCode'));
      setVoucherSuccess(null);
      return;
    }

    setApplyingVoucher(true);
    setVoucherError(null);
    setVoucherSuccess(null);
    try {
      const updated = await api.applyVoucher(voucherCode.trim().toUpperCase());
      setSubscription(updated);
      setVoucherCode('');
      setVoucherSuccess(t('account.subscription.voucherApplied', { tier: getTierDisplayName(updated.tier) }));
      // Refresh subscription in AuthContext
      await refreshSubscription();
      // Clear success message after 5 seconds
      setTimeout(() => setVoucherSuccess(null), 5000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setVoucherError(err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to apply voucher');
      console.error('[SubscriptionTab] Error applying voucher:', err);
    } finally {
      setApplyingVoucher(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUpgrade = async (tier: 'pro' | 'max') => {
    setUpgrading(tier);
    try {
      const { approvalUrl, subscriptionId } = await api.createPayPalSubscription(tier);
      // Store subscriptionId for after PayPal redirect
      sessionStorage.setItem('paypal_subscription_id', subscriptionId);
      // Redirect to PayPal
      window.location.href = approvalUrl;
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('[SubscriptionTab] Error creating PayPal subscription:', err);
      alert(err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to start upgrade process');
      setUpgrading(null);
    }
  };

  const handleCancelSubscription = async () => {
    setCancelling(true);
    setCancelError(null);
    try {
      const updated = await api.cancelPayPalSubscription();
      setSubscription(updated);
      setShowCancelConfirm(false);
      await refreshSubscription();
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('[SubscriptionTab] Error cancelling subscription:', err);
      setCancelError(err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to cancel subscription');
    } finally {
      setCancelling(false);
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { 
      year: 'numeric', 
      month: 'long', 
      day: 'numeric' 
    });
  };

  const getTierDisplayName = (tier: SubscriptionTier): string => {
    if (tier === 'free') return t('account.subscription.free');
    if (tier === 'pro') return t('account.subscription.pro');
    if (tier === 'max') return t('account.subscription.max');
    // This should never happen, but TypeScript requires a return
    return String(tier).charAt(0).toUpperCase() + String(tier).slice(1);
  };

  const getTierPrice = (tier: SubscriptionTier) => {
    if (tier === 'pro') return '$29';
    if (tier === 'max') return '$99';
    return 'Free';
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center" style={{ minHeight: '400px' }}>
        <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.subscription.loading')}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center" style={{ minHeight: '400px' }}>
        <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-error)' }}>{error}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!subscription) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center" style={{ minHeight: '400px' }}>
        <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.subscription.notFound')}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isActive = subscription.status === 'active';
  const isPaidTier = subscription.tier === 'pro' || subscription.tier === 'max';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Current Subscription */}
      <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
        <div className="text-13 mb-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{t('account.subscription.currentSubscription')}</div>
        
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.subscription.tier')}:</span>
            <span className="text-13 font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
              {getTierDisplayName(subscription.tier)}
            </span>
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.subscription.status')}:</span>
            <span 
              className="text-13 px-2 py-1 rounded"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: isActive ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.1)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)',
                color: isActive ? 'rgb(34, 197, 94)' : 'rgb(239, 68, 68)',
              }}
            >
              {subscription.status === 'active' ? t('account.subscription.active') : 
               subscription.status === 'expired' ? t('account.subscription.expired') : 
               t('account.subscription.cancelled')}
            </span>
          </div>

          {isPaidTier && (
            <>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.subscription.currentPeriod')}:</span>
                <span className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
                  {formatDate(subscription.currentPeriodStart)} - {formatDate(subscription.currentPeriodEnd)}
                </span>
              </div>

              {subscription.nextBillingDate && (
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.subscription.nextBilling')}:</span>
                  <span className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
                    {formatDate(subscription.nextBillingDate)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}

              {subscription.paymentProvider && (
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.subscription.paymentMethod')}:</span>
                  <span className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
                    {subscription.paymentProvider.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + subscription.paymentProvider.slice(1)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}

              {subscription.cancelAtPeriodEnd && (
                <div className="mt-3 p-3 rounded" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.3)' }}>
                  <div className="text-12 font-medium" style={{ color: 'rgb(251, 191, 36)' }}>
                    {t('account.subscription.cancelledAtPeriodEnd')}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-11 mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                    {t('account.subscription.cancelledAtPeriodEndDescription', { date: formatDate(subscription.currentPeriodEnd) })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.subscription.started')}:</span>
            <span className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
              {formatDate(subscription.startedAt)}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Voucher Code */}
      <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
        <div className="text-13 mb-3" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{t('account.subscription.applyVoucher')}</div>
        <div className="text-12 mb-3" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
          {t('account.subscription.voucherDescription')}
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <input
            type="text"
            value={voucherCode}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setVoucherCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase());
              setVoucherError(null);
              setVoucherSuccess(null);
            }}
            placeholder={t('account.subscription.enterVoucherCode')}
            className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded text-13"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)',
              border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
              color: 'var(--text-heading)',
            }}
            onKeyPress={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                handleApplyVoucher();
              }
            }}
          />
          <button
            onClick={handleApplyVoucher}
            disabled={applyingVoucher || !voucherCode.trim()}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded text-13 font-medium transition-colors"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: applyingVoucher || !voucherCode.trim() ? 'var(--white-05)' : 'var(--accent-primary)',
              color: applyingVoucher || !voucherCode.trim() ? 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' : 'white',
              cursor: applyingVoucher || !voucherCode.trim() ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            {applyingVoucher ? t('account.subscription.applying') : t('account.subscription.apply')}
          </button>
        </div>
        {voucherError && (
          <div className="mt-2 text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-error)' }}>
            {voucherError}
          </div>
        )}
        {voucherSuccess && (
          <div className="mt-2 text-12" style={{ color: 'rgb(34, 197, 94)' }}>
            {voucherSuccess}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Upgrade Options */}
      {subscription.tier !== 'max' && (
        <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
          <div className="text-13 mb-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{t('account.subscription.upgradeSubscription')}</div>
          
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {subscription.tier === 'free' && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-10)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-13 font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{t('account.subscription.pro')}</div>
                    <div className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                      {t('account.subscription.proDescription')}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-13 font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
                    {getTierPrice('pro')}{t('account.subscription.perMonth')}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleUpgrade('pro')}
                  disabled={upgrading === 'pro'}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-2 rounded text-13 font-medium transition-colors"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: upgrading === 'pro' ? 'var(--white-05)' : 'var(--accent-primary)',
                    color: upgrading === 'pro' ? 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' : 'white',
                    cursor: upgrading === 'pro' ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  {upgrading === 'pro' ? t('account.subscription.processing') : t('account.subscription.upgradeToPro')}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {(subscription.tier === 'free' || subscription.tier === 'pro') && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-10)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-13 font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{t('account.subscription.max')}</div>
                    <div className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                      {t('account.subscription.maxDescription')}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-13 font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
                    {getTierPrice('max')}{t('account.subscription.perMonth')}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleUpgrade('max')}
                  disabled={upgrading === 'max'}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-2 rounded text-13 font-medium transition-colors"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: upgrading === 'max' ? 'var(--white-05)' : 'var(--accent-primary)',
                    color: upgrading === 'max' ? 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' : 'white',
                    cursor: upgrading === 'max' ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  {upgrading === 'max' ? t('account.subscription.processing') : t('account.subscription.upgradeToMax')}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Cancel Subscription */}
      {isPaidTier && isActive && !subscription.cancelAtPeriodEnd && (
        <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
          <div className="text-13 mb-3" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{t('account.subscription.cancelSubscription')}</div>
          <div className="text-12 mb-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            {t('account.subscription.cancelDescription')}
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowCancelConfirm(true)}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded text-13 font-medium transition-colors"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)',
              color: 'rgb(239, 68, 68)',
              border: '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)',
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            {t('account.subscription.cancelButton')}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Cancel Confirmation Modal */}
      {showCancelConfirm && (
        <div 
          className="fixed inset-0 flex items-center justify-center z-50"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)' }}
          onClick={() => !cancelling && setShowCancelConfirm(false)}
        >
          <div 
            className="p-6 rounded-lg max-w-md"
            style={{ 
              backgroundColor: 'var(--background-primary)',
              border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="text-15 font-semibold mb-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
              {t('account.subscription.confirmCancel')}
            </div>
            <div className="text-13 mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
              {t('account.subscription.cancelWarning')}
            </div>

              {t('account.subscription.cancelDetails', {

              })}
            </div>
            {cancelError && (
              <div className="mb-4 p-2 rounded text-12" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)', color: 'rgb(239, 68, 68)' }}>
                {cancelError}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowCancelConfirm(false)}
                disabled={cancelling}
                className="flex-1 px-4 py-2 rounded text-13 font-medium transition-colors"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)',
                  color: 'var(--text-heading)',
                  border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
                  cursor: cancelling ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                }}
              >
                {t('account.subscription.keepSubscription')}
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleCancelSubscription}
                disabled={cancelling}
                className="flex-1 px-4 py-2 rounded text-13 font-medium transition-colors"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: cancelling ? 'var(--white-05)' : 'rgb(239, 68, 68)',
                  color: cancelling ? 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' : 'white',
                  cursor: cancelling ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                }}
              >
                {cancelling ? t('account.subscription.cancelling') : t('account.subscription.confirmCancelButton')}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

Файл: ThemeProvider.tsx

import React from 'react';

type Theme = 'light' | 'dark';

function getSystemTheme(): Theme {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'light';
  return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
    ? 'dark'
    : 'light';
}

export const ThemeContext = React.createContext<{ theme: Theme; setTheme: (t: Theme) => void }>({
  theme: 'dark',
  setTheme: () => {},
});

export const ThemeProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [theme, setTheme] = React.useState<Theme>(() => {
    // Read from localStorage with key 'etg.theme' to match old frontend
    const saved = typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' ? (localStorage.getItem('etg.theme') as Theme | null) : null;
    // Default to dark theme when nothing is saved
    return saved ?? 'dark';
  });

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    // Use data-theme attribute instead of class
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
    localStorage.setItem('etg.theme', theme);
  }, [theme]);

  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>;
};

import React from 'react';
import ChatMessage from './ChatMessage';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { useGenAISettings } from '../stores/genaiSettingsStore';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

interface ThinkingPlaceholderProps {
  messageId: string;
  genaiThinkingSeconds: number;
  averageTimingSeconds: number | null;
}

export const ThinkingPlaceholder: React.FC<ThinkingPlaceholderProps> = ({
  messageId,
  genaiThinkingSeconds,
  averageTimingSeconds,
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore();
  const genaiSettings = useGenAISettings();

  // Don't show placeholder if this message is already in interactions (streaming completed)
  const alreadyInInteractions = genaiChat.interactions.some(
    (it) =>
      it.kind === 'assistant' &&
      (it.id === messageId || (it as any).originalMessageId === messageId),
  );

  if (alreadyInInteractions) {
    console.log(
      '[ThinkingPlaceholder] Hiding placeholder - already in interactions',
      { messageId },
    );
    return null;
  }

  const header =
    genaiChat.messageMeta?.[messageId]?.headerText || 'assistant';
  const leftAccent = !!genaiChat.messageMeta?.[messageId]?.leftAccent;
  const isQuality =
    genaiSettings.strength === 'quality' ||
    /_quality$/.test(genaiSettings.model || '');
  const threshold = genaiSettings.groundingEnabled ? 35 : 20;
  const showInfo = (genaiThinkingSeconds || 0) >= threshold && isQuality;
  const infoMsg = genaiSettings.groundingEnabled
    ? t('unfold.status.modelUpdatingAnalysis')
    : t('unfold.status.modelComplexReasoning');

  return (
    <ChatMessage
      key={messageId}
      role="assistant"
      align="left"
      isThinking={true}
      thinkingSeconds={genaiThinkingSeconds}
      isError={false}
      headerText={header}
      leftAccent={leftAccent}
      footer={undefined}
      averageTimingSeconds={averageTimingSeconds}
    >
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <div
          style={{
            width: 160,
            height: 10,
            borderRadius: 4,
            background: 'var(--white-06)',
            position: 'relative',
            overflow: 'hidden',
          }}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              inset: 0,
              background:
                'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--white-20), transparent)',
              animation: 'etg-shimmer 2s infinite',
            }}
          />
        </div>
        <div
          style={{
            width: 220,
            height: 10,
            borderRadius: 4,
            background: 'var(--white-06)',
            position: 'relative',
            overflow: 'hidden',
          }}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              inset: 0,
              background:
                'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--white-20), transparent)',
              animation: 'etg-shimmer 2s infinite',
            }}
          />
        </div>
        {showInfo && (
          <div
            className="text-[11px]"
            style={{
              color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
            }}
          >
            {infoMsg}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </ChatMessage>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useProjectsStore } from '../stores/projectsStore';
import { api } from '../lib/api';

// Inline lightweight component to fetch and display title suggestions
export const TitleSuggestions: React.FC<{ visible: boolean; onClose: () => void; onAvailableChange?: (available: boolean) => void }> = ({ visible, onClose, onAvailableChange }) => {
  const [titles, setTitles] = React.useState<string[] | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  // PERFORMANCE FIX: Subscribe only to messages.length, not entire array
  const messagesLength = useGenaiChatStore((s) => s.messages.length);
  const { currentUser } = useAuth();
  const { currentProject } = useProjectsStore();
  const appliedProjectRef = React.useRef<string | null>(null);
  const finalizedRef = React.useRef(false);
  const fetchedForProjectRef = React.useRef<string | null>(null);
  const lastProjectIdRef = React.useRef<string | null>(null);
  
  // Get messages only when needed via getState()
  const getMessages = React.useCallback(() => useGenaiChatStore.getState().messages, []);
  
  // Reset refs when project changes
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const currentPid = currentProject?.id || null;
    if (lastProjectIdRef.current !== currentPid) {
      // Project changed - reset refs
      appliedProjectRef.current = null;
      finalizedRef.current = false;
      fetchedForProjectRef.current = null;
      lastProjectIdRef.current = currentPid;
    }
  }, [currentProject?.id]);
  
  const hasAssistant = React.useMemo(() => {
    const messages = getMessages();
    return messages.some((m) => m.role === 'assistant' && m.content && m.content.trim().length > 0);
  }, [getMessages, messagesLength]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const run = async () => {
      // Require authenticated user and at least first assistant answer
      if (!currentUser?.uid) return;
      if (!hasAssistant) return;
      // Guard: operate only for the active chat project id
      let pid: string | null = null;
      try {
        pid = useGenaiChatStore.getState().projectId;
        const cpid = useProjectsStore.getState().currentProject?.id;
        if (!pid || pid === 'local-unfold' || !cpid || pid !== cpid) return;
      } catch {}
      
      // Check if title was already finalized for this project (priority check)
      try {
        const projectId = pid || currentProject?.id;
        if (projectId && projectId !== 'local-unfold' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
          finalizedRef.current = window.localStorage.getItem(`chatTitleFinal:${projectId}`) === '1';
        }
        if (finalizedRef.current) {
          // Title already finalized - reset refs for this project and skip
          if (fetchedForProjectRef.current === pid) fetchedForProjectRef.current = null;
          return;
        }
      } catch {}
      
      // Check if project already has a name (not Draft) - skip fetching if so
      try {
        const name = (useProjectsStore.getState().currentProject?.displayName || '').trim();
        if (name && name.toLowerCase() !== 'draft') {
          // Project already has a name - mark as finalized and skip
          if (pid && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
            try { window.localStorage.setItem(`chatTitleFinal:${pid}`, '1'); } catch {}
          }
          finalizedRef.current = true;
          if (fetchedForProjectRef.current === pid) fetchedForProjectRef.current = null;
          return;
        }
      } catch {}
      
      // If we already fetched titles for this project, don't fetch again
      if (fetchedForProjectRef.current === pid) return;
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        // Build messages from local interactions for better signal (summary if available)
        const st = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
        // Take up to 5 latest USER interactions (oldest->newest)
        const userInteractions = st.interactions.filter((it) => it.kind === 'user');
        const last5 = userInteractions.slice(Math.max(0, userInteractions.length - 5));
        const messages = last5.map((it) => ({
          role: 'user' as const,
          text: (it.summary && it.summary.trim()) ? it.summary : it.content,
        }));
        // If empty, fallback to chat messages
        if (messages.length === 0) {
          const chatMessages = getMessages();
          const fallbackAll = chatMessages.filter((m) => m.role === 'user');
          const fallbackLast5 = fallbackAll.slice(Math.max(0, fallbackAll.length - 5));
          const fallback: Array<{ role: 'user'; text: string }> = fallbackLast5.map((m) => ({ role: 'user', text: m.content }));
          fallback.forEach((mm) => messages.push(mm));
        }
        const res = await api.suggestChatTitles(messages as Array<{ role: 'user'|'assistant'|'system'|'note'; text: string }>);
        if (!cancelled) {
          setTitles(res);
          // Mark this project as having titles fetched
          if (pid) fetchedForProjectRef.current = pid;
        }
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) setTitles([]);
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    run();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [messagesLength, currentUser?.uid, hasAssistant, currentProject?.id, getMessages]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    try { onAvailableChange && onAvailableChange(!!(titles && titles.length > 0)); } catch {}
  }, [titles?.length]);

  // When title suggestions appear, set the first suggestion as chat title, switch view to discovery and persist
  React.useEffect(() => {
    try {
      if (!titles || titles.length === 0) return;
      const first = (titles[0] || '').trim();
      if (!first) return;
      try {
        const activePid = useGenaiChatStore.getState().projectId;
        const sidePid = useProjectsStore.getState().currentProject?.id;
        console.log('[Titles] apply candidate', { first, activePid, sidePid });
      } catch {}
      // Guard: only auto-apply for the exact active chat project id
      const activePid = ((): string | null => { try { return useGenaiChatStore.getState().projectId || null; } catch { return null; } })();
      if (!activePid || !currentProject?.id || activePid !== currentProject.id) return;
      const proj = currentProject;
      if (!proj?.id) {
        // Hydrate currentProject from genaiChat if it was created via ensureProject()
        (async () => {
          try {
            const pid = activePid;
            if (pid && pid !== 'local-unfold') {
              const p = await api.getProject(pid);
              useProjectsStore.setState((prev) => ({
                projects: [p as any, ...prev.projects.filter((x) => x.id !== (p as any).id)],
                currentProject: p as any,
              }));
            }
          } catch {}
        })();
        return;
      }
      if (appliedProjectRef.current === proj.id) return; // already applied for this project instance
      if ((proj.displayName || '').trim() === first && (proj.view || '') === 'discovery') { appliedProjectRef.current = proj.id; return; }
      (async () => {
        try {
          await api.updateProject(activePid, { displayName: first, view: 'discovery' } as any);
          console.log('[Titles] auto-applied to project', { projectId: activePid, name: first });
          
          // Get updated project data from server to ensure consistency
          let updatedProject: any;
          try {
            updatedProject = await api.getProject(activePid);
          } catch {
            // Fallback to local update if fetch fails
            updatedProject = { ...(currentProject || proj), id: activePid, displayName: first, view: 'discovery' };
          }
          
          useProjectsStore.setState((prev) => {
            const exists = prev.projects.some((p) => p.id === activePid);
            const updated = { ...updatedProject, id: activePid, displayName: first, view: 'discovery' } as any;
            console.log('[Titles] updating projects store', { exists, activePid, updated });
            return {
              projects: exists
                ? prev.projects.map((p) => (p.id === activePid ? updated : p))
                : [updated, ...prev.projects],
              currentProject: updated,
            } as any;
          });
          
          // Also refresh projects list from server to ensure consistency (especially if project was draft)
          try {
            const { fetchProjects } = useProjectsStore.getState();
            await fetchProjects('discovery');
            console.log('[Titles] refreshed projects list from server');
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[Titles] failed to refresh projects list', e);
          }
          
          appliedProjectRef.current = activePid;
          // Finalize: suppress future suggestions and hide component permanently
          try { if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.localStorage.setItem(`chatTitleFinal:${activePid}`, '1'); } catch {}
          finalizedRef.current = true;
          try { onAvailableChange && onAvailableChange(false); } catch {}
          try { onClose && onClose(); } catch {}
          setTitles(null);
        } catch {}
      })();
    } catch {}
  }, [titles && titles[0], currentProject?.id]);
  // Never render UI; only background auto-apply logic is kept
  return null;
};

import React from 'react';

export const ToolCallsDisplay: React.FC = () => {

    return null;

      {genaiChat.toolCalls.length > 0 && (
        <div
          className="text-[11px] mb-1"

        </div>

        <div
          className="text-[11px]"
          style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}
        >
          Tool results:
          <ul className="list-disc ml-4">

                <span className="font-mono">{c.name}</span>

            ))}
