import React from 'react';
import { LineChart, Line, BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, Legend, ResponsiveContainer, Cell } from 'recharts';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { ThemeContext } from './ThemeProvider';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

export const UsageTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme } = React.useContext(ThemeContext);
  const { currentUser } = useAuth();
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [usageData, setUsageData] = React.useState<{
    byModel: Record<string, {
      count: number;
      inputTokens: number;
      outputTokens: number;
      totalTokens: number;
      costUSD: number;
    }>;
    dailyTotals: Record<string, {
      inputTokens: number;
      outputTokens: number;
      totalTokens: number;
      costUSD: number;
      count: number;
    }>;
    tokenCategories?: {
      premiumTokens: {
        inputTokens: number;
        outputTokens: number;
        totalTokens: number;
        costUSD: number;
        count: number;
      };
      regularTokens: {
        inputTokens: number;
        outputTokens: number;
        totalTokens: number;
        costUSD: number;
        count: number;
      };
    };
    totals: {
      inputTokens: number;
      outputTokens: number;
      totalTokens: number;
      costUSD: number;
      count: number;
    };
    period: {
      startDate: string;
      endDate: string;
    };
  } | null>(null);

  // Separate state for paginated events
  const [eventsData, setEventsData] = React.useState<{
    events: Array<{
      id: string;
      tenantId: string;
      userId: string;
      provider: string;
      model: string;
      modelAlias?: string;
      inputTokens: number;
      outputTokens: number;
      totalTokens: number;
      costUSD: number;
      kind: string;
      createdAt: string;
    }>;
    pagination: {
      page: number;
      limit: number;
      total: number;
      totalPages: number;
    };
    period: {
      startDate: string;
      endDate: string;
    };
  } | null>(null);
  
  const [dateRange, setDateRange] = React.useState<'1d' | '7d' | '30d'>('7d');
  const [selectedStartDate, setSelectedStartDate] = React.useState<string>('');
  const [selectedEndDate, setSelectedEndDate] = React.useState<string>('');
  const [eventsPage, setEventsPage] = React.useState(1);
  const [eventsLoading, setEventsLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const eventsPerPage = 20;
  const eventsLimit = 200; // Minimum limit for efficient grouping

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentUser?.uid) return;
    
    const loadUsage = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      try {
        const endDate = selectedEndDate || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
        const startDate = selectedStartDate || (() => {
          const d = new Date();
          const days = dateRange === '1d' ? 1 : dateRange === '7d' ? 7 : 30;
          d.setDate(d.getDate() - days);
          return d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        })();
        
        const data = await api.getUsage({ startDate, endDate, granularity: dateRange });
        console.log('[UsageTab] Received data:', {
          totals: data.totals,
          dailyTotalsKeys: Object.keys(data.dailyTotals || {}),
          dailyTotalsSample: Object.entries(data.dailyTotals || {}).slice(0, 2),
          byModelKeys: Object.keys(data.byModel || {}),
          byModelSample: Object.entries(data.byModel || {}).slice(0, 2),
          byModelRaw: data.byModel,
          hasByModel: !!data.byModel,
          byModelType: typeof data.byModel,
        });
        setUsageData(data);
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err?.message || t('account.tabs.usageDetails.failedToLoad'));
        console.error('[UsageTab] Error loading usage:', err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadUsage();
  }, [currentUser?.uid, dateRange, selectedStartDate, selectedEndDate]);
  
  // Reset to page 1 when date range changes
  React.useEffect(() => {
    setEventsPage(1);
  }, [dateRange, selectedStartDate, selectedEndDate]);

  // Load paginated events separately
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentUser?.uid || !usageData) {
      console.log('[UsageTab] Skipping events load:', {
        hasUser: !!currentUser?.uid,
        hasUsageData: !!usageData,
      });
      return;
    }

    const loadEvents = async () => {
      setEventsLoading(true);
      try {
        const endDate = selectedEndDate || usageData.period.endDate;
        const startDate = selectedStartDate || usageData.period.startDate;
        
        console.log('[UsageTab] Loading events with params:', {
          startDate,
          endDate,
          page: eventsPage,
          limit: eventsLimit,
          userId: currentUser?.uid,
        });
        
        const data = await api.getUsageEvents({
          startDate,
          endDate,
          page: eventsPage,
          limit: eventsLimit,
        });
        console.log('[UsageTab] Received events data:', {
          eventsCount: data.events.length,
          pagination: data.pagination,
          period: data.period,
          firstEvent: data.events[0],
          lastEvent: data.events[data.events.length - 1],
        });
        setEventsData(data);
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.error('[UsageTab] Error loading events:', err);
        console.error('[UsageTab] Error details:', {
          message: err?.message,
          response: err?.response?.data,
          status: err?.response?.status,
        });
        // Don't show error to user, just log it
      } finally {
        setEventsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadEvents();
  }, [currentUser?.uid, usageData, eventsPage, selectedStartDate, selectedEndDate]);

  // Prepare chart data from dailyTotals
  const chartData = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!usageData?.dailyTotals) {
      console.log('[UsageTab] No dailyTotals in usageData');
      return [];
    }
    
    const entries = Object.entries(usageData.dailyTotals);
    console.log('[UsageTab] Processing dailyTotals:', {
      entriesCount: entries.length,
      firstEntry: entries[0],
      allKeys: Object.keys(usageData.dailyTotals),
    });
    
    const result = entries
      .map(([date, totals]: [string, any], index: number) => {
        // Debug: log what we're getting for first entry
        if (index === 0) {
          console.log('[UsageTab] First totals object:', totals, 'keys:', Object.keys(totals || {}), 'type:', typeof totals);
        }
        return {
          date,
          tokens: totals?.totalTokens ?? totals?.TotalTokens ?? 0,
          inputTokens: totals?.inputTokens ?? totals?.InputTokens ?? 0,
          outputTokens: totals?.outputTokens ?? totals?.OutputTokens ?? 0,
          cost: totals?.costUSD ?? totals?.CostUSD ?? 0,
          count: totals?.count ?? totals?.Count ?? 0,
        };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
    
    console.log('[UsageTab] Chart data result:', result);
    return result;
  }, [usageData]);

  // Prepare model breakdown data
  const modelData = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!usageData?.byModel) {
      console.log('[UsageTab] No byModel data');
      return [];
    }
    
    const entries = Object.entries(usageData.byModel);
    console.log('[UsageTab] Processing byModel:', {
      entriesCount: entries.length,
      firstEntry: entries[0],
      allKeys: Object.keys(usageData.byModel),
      rawByModel: usageData.byModel,
    });
    
    if (entries.length === 0) {
      console.log('[UsageTab] byModel is empty object');
      return [];
    }
    
    const result = entries
      .map(([key, stats]: [string, any], index: number) => {
        // Debug: log what we're getting for first entry
        if (index === 0) {
          console.log('[UsageTab] First byModel stats object:', stats, 'keys:', Object.keys(stats || {}), 'type:', typeof stats);
        }
        const parts = key.split(':');
        const costUSD = stats?.costUSD ?? stats?.CostUSD ?? 0;
        const totalTokens = stats?.totalTokens ?? stats?.TotalTokens ?? 0;
        const count = stats?.count ?? stats?.Count ?? 0;
        const modelName = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] : key; // Remove provider prefix
        
        return {
          model: modelName,
          provider: parts.length > 1 ? parts[0] : 'unknown',
          count: count,
          inputTokens: stats?.inputTokens ?? stats?.InputTokens ?? 0,
          outputTokens: stats?.outputTokens ?? stats?.OutputTokens ?? 0,
          totalTokens: totalTokens,
          costUSD: costUSD,
        };
      })
      .filter((item) => {
        // Filter out entries with zero tokens AND zero cost, empty model name, or invalid data
        // Show models even if cost is 0, as long as they have tokens or count
        const hasUsage = item.totalTokens > 0 || item.count > 0;
        const isValid = item.model && item.model.trim() !== '';
        const shouldInclude = hasUsage && isValid;
        
        if (!shouldInclude) {
          console.log('[UsageTab] Filtering out model:', item.model, {
            totalTokens: item.totalTokens,
            count: item.count,
            costUSD: item.costUSD,
            isValid,
          });
        }
        
        return shouldInclude;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        // Sort by cost first, then by tokens, then by count
        if (b.costUSD !== a.costUSD) {
          return b.costUSD - a.costUSD;
        }
        if (b.totalTokens !== a.totalTokens) {
          return b.totalTokens - a.totalTokens;
        }
        return b.count - a.count;
      })
      .slice(0, 10); // Top 10 models
    
    console.log('[UsageTab] Model data result:', {
      count: result.length,
      models: result.map(m => ({ model: m.model, cost: m.costUSD, tokens: m.totalTokens, count: m.count })),
    });
    return result;
  }, [usageData]);

  // Use totals from API
  const totals = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!usageData?.totals) return null;
    
    return {
      totalTokens: usageData.totals.totalTokens,
      totalCost: usageData.totals.costUSD,
      totalCount: usageData.totals.count,
    };
  }, [usageData]);

  // Calculate token category totals
  const tokenCategories = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!usageData?.tokenCategories) return null;
    return usageData.tokenCategories;
  }, [usageData]);

  // Group events by model and time proximity, or consecutive same-model events
  const groupedEvents = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!eventsData?.events || eventsData.events.length === 0) return [];
    
    const TIME_WINDOW_MS = 60000; // 60 seconds (1 minute) window for grouping
    // Sort events chronologically (oldest first) for proper consecutive checking
    const sortedEvents = [...eventsData.events].sort((a, b) => 
      new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(b.createdAt).getTime()
    );
    
    const groups: Array<{
      model: string;
      modelAlias?: string;
      kind: string;
      events: typeof sortedEvents;
      totalTokens: number;
      totalCost: number;
      startTime: Date;
      endTime: Date;
      count: number;
    }> = [];
    
    for (const event of sortedEvents) {
      const eventTime = new Date(event.createdAt).getTime();
      const eventKey = `${event.model}:${event.modelAlias || ''}:${event.kind}`;
      
      // First, try to find an existing group that matches model/alias/kind and is within time window
      let foundGroup = groups.find(group => {
        const groupKey = `${group.model}:${group.modelAlias || ''}:${group.kind}`;
        if (groupKey !== eventKey) return false;
        
        const groupStartTime = group.startTime.getTime() - TIME_WINDOW_MS;
        const groupEndTime = group.endTime.getTime() + TIME_WINDOW_MS;
        // Check if event is within expanded time window
        return eventTime >= groupStartTime && eventTime <= groupEndTime;
      });
      
      // If not found by time window, check if this event is consecutive (same model, no other models in between)
      // Find the most recent group (by endTime) that matches the same model/alias/kind
      if (!foundGroup) {
        // Find all groups with matching model/alias/kind, sorted by endTime (newest first)
        const matchingGroups = groups
          .filter(group => {
            const groupKey = `${group.model}:${group.modelAlias || ''}:${group.kind}`;
            return groupKey === eventKey;
          })
          .sort((a, b) => b.endTime.getTime() - a.endTime.getTime());
        
        // Check if this event is consecutive to any matching group
        // (event is older than group's endTime, meaning it comes right before chronologically)
        for (const group of matchingGroups) {
          if (eventTime < group.endTime.getTime()) {
            // Check if there are any other events (not in this group) between this event and the group
            // by checking original sortedEvents array
            const groupEndTime = group.endTime.getTime();
            const hasOtherModelsBetween = sortedEvents.some(otherEvent => {
              // Skip events that are already in this group
              if (group.events.some(e => e.id === otherEvent.id)) return false;
              // Skip the current event
              if (otherEvent.id === event.id) return false;
              
              const otherEventTime = new Date(otherEvent.createdAt).getTime();
              const otherEventKey = `${otherEvent.model}:${otherEvent.modelAlias || ''}:${otherEvent.kind}`;
              
              // Check if other event is between eventTime and groupEndTime and has different model
              if (otherEventTime >= eventTime && otherEventTime <= groupEndTime && otherEventKey !== eventKey) {
                return true;
              }
              return false;
            });
            
            // If no other models between, it's consecutive
            if (!hasOtherModelsBetween) {
              foundGroup = group;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      if (foundGroup) {
        // Add to existing group
        foundGroup.events.push(event);
        foundGroup.totalTokens += event.totalTokens || 0;
        foundGroup.totalCost += event.costUSD || 0;
        foundGroup.count++;
        // Update time range
        if (eventTime < foundGroup.startTime.getTime()) {
          foundGroup.startTime = new Date(event.createdAt);
        }
        if (eventTime > foundGroup.endTime.getTime()) {
          foundGroup.endTime = new Date(event.createdAt);
        }
      } else {
        // Create new group
        groups.push({
          model: event.model,
          modelAlias: event.modelAlias,
          kind: event.kind,
          events: [event],
          totalTokens: event.totalTokens || 0,
          totalCost: event.costUSD || 0,
          startTime: new Date(event.createdAt),
          endTime: new Date(event.createdAt),
          count: 1,
        });
      }
    }
    
    // Sort groups by start time (newest first)
    return groups.sort((a, b) => b.startTime.getTime() - a.startTime.getTime());
  }, [eventsData?.events]);

  const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
    const date = new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
    return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
  };

  const formatCost = (cost: number | string) => {
    const numCost = typeof cost === 'string' ? parseFloat(cost) : cost;
    if (isNaN(numCost)) return '$0.00';
    if (numCost < 0.01) return '<$0.01';
    return `US$${numCost.toFixed(2)}`;
  };

  const formatTokens = (tokens: number) => {
    if (tokens >= 1000000) return `${(tokens / 1000000).toFixed(1)}M`;
    if (tokens >= 1000) return `${(tokens / 1000).toFixed(1)}K`;
    return tokens.toString();
  };

  const formatModelName = (modelName: string): string => {
    if (!modelName) return modelName;
    
    // Handle Claude models: convert "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929" -> "claude sonnet"
    if (modelName.includes('claude-')) {
      const parts = modelName.split('-');
      if (parts.length >= 2) {
        // Extract model type (sonnet, opus, haiku, etc.)
        const modelType = parts[1];
        return `claude ${modelType}`;
      }
    }
    
    // Handle Gemini models: keep readable parts
    if (modelName.includes('gemini-')) {
      const parts = modelName.split('-');
      if (parts.length >= 2) {
        // Extract version and type (e.g., "2.5-pro", "2.5-flash-lite")
        const versionType = parts.slice(1).join(' ').replace(/\d{8}/g, '').trim(); // Remove date patterns
        return `gemini ${versionType}`;
      }
    }
    
    // Handle Grok models
    if (modelName.includes('grok-')) {
      return modelName.replace(/-/g, ' ').replace(/\d{8}/g, '').trim();
    }
    
    // Handle GPT models
    if (modelName.includes('gpt-')) {
      const parts = modelName.split('-');
      if (parts.length >= 2) {
        return parts.slice(0, 2).join(' '); // Keep "gpt-5" format
      }
    }
    
    // Default: replace dashes with spaces, remove date patterns
    return modelName.replace(/-/g, ' ').replace(/\d{8}/g, '').trim();
  };

  const formatTimeRange = (startTime: Date, endTime: Date) => {
    const start = startTime;
    const end = endTime;
    
    // If same time, show single time
    if (start.getTime() === end.getTime()) {
      return start.toLocaleString();
    }
    
    // Format dates
    const startDateStr = start.toLocaleDateString();
    const endDateStr = end.toLocaleDateString();
    const startTimeStr = start.toLocaleTimeString();
    const endTimeStr = end.toLocaleTimeString();
    
    // If same date, show date once with time range
    if (startDateStr === endDateStr) {
      return `${startDateStr}, ${startTimeStr} - ${endTimeStr}`;
    }
    
    // Different dates, show full range
    return `${start.toLocaleString()} - ${end.toLocaleString()}`;
  };

  const getProviderColor = (provider: string) => {
    const colors: Record<string, string> = {
      gemini: '#4285F4',
      openai: '#10A37F',
      anthropic: '#D97757',
      grok: '#FF6B35',
      deepseek: '#6366F1',
    };
    return colors[provider] || '#6B7280';
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center" style={{ minHeight: '400px' }}>
        <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.loading')}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center" style={{ minHeight: '400px' }}>
        <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-error)' }}>{error}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!usageData || !totals) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center" style={{ minHeight: '400px' }}>
        <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.noDataAvailable')}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Summary Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
          <div className="text-[11px] mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.totalRequests')}</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{totals.totalCount.toLocaleString()}</div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
          <div className="text-[11px] mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.totalTokens')}</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{formatTokens(totals.totalTokens)}</div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
          <div className="text-[11px] mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.totalCost')}</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{formatCost(totals.totalCost)}</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Token Categories Breakdown */}
      {tokenCategories && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
            <div className="text-[11px] mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
              {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.premiumModels')}
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
              {formatTokens(tokenCategories.premiumTokens.totalTokens)}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
              {tokenCategories.premiumTokens.count.toLocaleString()} {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.requests')} • {formatCost(tokenCategories.premiumTokens.costUSD)}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
              ({formatTokens(tokenCategories.premiumTokens.inputTokens)} {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.input')} / {formatTokens(tokenCategories.premiumTokens.outputTokens)} {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.output')})
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
            <div className="text-[11px] mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
              {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.otherModels')}
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
              {formatTokens(tokenCategories.regularTokens.totalTokens)}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
              {tokenCategories.regularTokens.count.toLocaleString()} {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.requests')} • {formatCost(tokenCategories.regularTokens.costUSD)}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
              ({formatTokens(tokenCategories.regularTokens.inputTokens)} {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.input')} / {formatTokens(tokenCategories.regularTokens.outputTokens)} {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.output')})
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Date Range Controls */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={() => setDateRange('1d')}
            className="px-3 py-1 rounded text-12"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: dateRange === '1d' ? 'var(--white-10)' : 'transparent',
              color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
            }}
          >
            1d
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setDateRange('7d')}
            className="px-3 py-1 rounded text-12"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: dateRange === '7d' ? 'var(--white-10)' : 'transparent',
              color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
            }}
          >
            7d
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setDateRange('30d')}
            className="px-3 py-1 rounded text-12"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: dateRange === '30d' ? 'var(--white-10)' : 'transparent',
              color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
            }}
          >
            30d
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <input
            type="date"
            value={selectedStartDate}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedStartDate(e.target.value)}
            className="px-2 py-1 rounded text-12"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)',
              border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
              color: 'var(--text-heading)',
            }}
          />
          <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.to')}</span>
          <input
            type="date"
            value={selectedEndDate}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedEndDate(e.target.value)}
            className="px-2 py-1 rounded text-12"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)',
              border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
              color: 'var(--text-heading)',
            }}
          />
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            const endDate = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
            const startDate = new Date();
            startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - (dateRange === '1d' ? 1 : dateRange === '7d' ? 7 : 30));
            setSelectedStartDate(startDate.toISOString().split('T')[0]);
            setSelectedEndDate(endDate);
          }}
          className="px-3 py-1 rounded text-12"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)',
            border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
            color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
          }}
        >
          {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.reset')}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Charts */}
      {chartData.length > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Daily Tokens Chart */}
          <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
            <div className="text-13 mb-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.dailyTokenUsage')}</div>
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>
              <LineChart data={chartData}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="var(--overlay-line-90)" />
                <XAxis
                  dataKey="date"
                  tickFormatter={formatDate}
                  stroke="var(--text-tertiary-weak)"
                  tick={{ fill: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}
                  style={{ fontSize: '11px' }}
                />
                <YAxis
                  tickFormatter={formatTokens}
                  stroke="var(--text-tertiary-weak)"
                  tick={{ fill: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}
                  style={{ fontSize: '11px' }}
                />
                <Tooltip
                  contentStyle={{
                    backgroundColor: theme === 'dark' ? '#1a1a1a' : '#ffffff',
                    border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    color: theme === 'dark' ? 'var(--text-heading)' : 'var(--text-primary)',
                  }}
                  itemStyle={{
                    color: theme === 'dark' ? 'var(--text-heading)' : 'var(--text-primary)',
                  }}
                  labelStyle={{
                    color: theme === 'dark' ? 'var(--text-heading)' : 'var(--text-primary)',
                  }}
                  labelFormatter={(label) => formatDate(label)}
                  formatter={(value: any, name: string) => {
                    if (name === t('account.tabs.usageDetails.total') || name === t('account.tabs.usageDetails.input') || name === t('account.tabs.usageDetails.output')) {
                      return formatTokens(value);
                    }
                    return formatTokens(value);
                  }}
                />
                <Legend 
                  wrapperStyle={{
                    color: theme === 'dark' ? 'var(--text-heading)' : 'var(--text-primary)',
                  }}
                />
                <Line
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey="tokens"
                  stroke="#4285F4"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  name={t('account.tabs.usageDetails.total')}
                  dot={{ r: 3 }}
                />
                <Line
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey="inputTokens"
                  stroke="#10A37F"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  name={t('account.tabs.usageDetails.input')}
                  dot={{ r: 3 }}
                />
                <Line
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey="outputTokens"
                  stroke="#FF6B35"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  name={t('account.tabs.usageDetails.output')}
                  dot={{ r: 3 }}
                />
              </LineChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>

          {/* Daily Cost Chart */}
          <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
            <div className="text-13 mb-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.dailyCost')}</div>
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>
              <BarChart data={chartData}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="var(--overlay-line-90)" />
                <XAxis
                  dataKey="date"
                  tickFormatter={formatDate}
                  stroke="var(--text-tertiary-weak)"
                  tick={{ fill: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}
                  style={{ fontSize: '11px' }}
                />
                <YAxis
                  tickFormatter={(value) => formatCost(value)}
                  stroke="var(--text-tertiary-weak)"
                  tick={{ fill: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}
                  style={{ fontSize: '11px' }}
                />
                <Tooltip
                  contentStyle={{
                    backgroundColor: theme === 'dark' ? '#1a1a1a' : '#ffffff',
                    border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    color: theme === 'dark' ? 'var(--text-heading)' : 'var(--text-primary)',
                  }}
                  itemStyle={{
                    color: theme === 'dark' ? 'var(--text-heading)' : 'var(--text-primary)',
                  }}
                  labelStyle={{
                    color: theme === 'dark' ? 'var(--text-heading)' : 'var(--text-primary)',
                  }}
                  labelFormatter={(label) => formatDate(label)}
                  formatter={(value: any, name: string) => {
                    if (name === 'cost' || name === t('account.tabs.usageDetails.costUSD')) {
                      const numValue = typeof value === 'number' ? value : parseFloat(value);
                      return formatCost(numValue);
                    }
                    return value;
                  }}
                />
                <Legend 
                  wrapperStyle={{
                    color: theme === 'dark' ? 'var(--text-heading)' : 'var(--text-primary)',
                  }}
                />
                <Bar dataKey="cost" fill="#10A37F" name={t('account.tabs.usageDetails.costUSD')} />
              </BarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Model Breakdown */}
      {modelData.length > 0 && (
        <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
          <div className="text-13 mb-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.usageByModel')}</div>
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={Math.max(200, modelData.length * 50)}>
            <BarChart data={modelData} layout="vertical" margin={{ top: 5, right: 30, bottom: 5, left: 10 }}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="var(--overlay-line-90)" />
              <XAxis 
                type="number" 
                stroke="var(--text-tertiary-weak)" 
                tick={{ fill: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}
                style={{ fontSize: '11px' }}
                tickFormatter={(value) => formatCost(value)}
                domain={[0, 'dataMax']}
              />
              <YAxis
                type="category"
                dataKey="model"
                width={220}
                stroke="var(--text-tertiary-weak)"
                tick={{ fill: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}
                style={{ fontSize: '11px' }}
                interval={0}
                domain={modelData.map((item) => item.model)}
                allowDataOverflow={false}
                tickFormatter={formatModelName}
              />
              <Tooltip
                contentStyle={{
                  backgroundColor: theme === 'dark' ? '#1a1a1a' : '#ffffff',
                  border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
                  borderRadius: '6px',
                  color: theme === 'dark' ? 'var(--text-heading)' : 'var(--text-primary)',
                }}
                itemStyle={{
                  color: theme === 'dark' ? 'var(--text-heading)' : 'var(--text-primary)',
                }}
                labelStyle={{
                  color: theme === 'dark' ? 'var(--text-heading)' : 'var(--text-primary)',
                }}
                labelFormatter={(label) => {
                  // Find the full model name from modelData (label is formatted, need to find original)
                  const entry = modelData.find(item => formatModelName(item.model) === label);
                  return entry ? entry.model : label;
                }}
                formatter={(value: any, name: string) => {
                  // Recharts may pass value as array for some chart types
                  const actualValue = Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] : value;
                  
                  // For "Usage by Model" chart, name is "Cost (USD)" and value is costUSD
                  if (name === t('account.tabs.usageDetails.costUSD') || name === 'costUSD') {
                    return formatCost(actualValue);
                  }
                  if (name === t('account.tabs.usageDetails.tokens') || name === 'totalTokens') {
                    return formatTokens(actualValue);
                  }
                  // Fallback: format any number < 1 as cost (likely USD)
                  if (typeof actualValue === 'number' && actualValue < 1 && actualValue > 0) {
                    return formatCost(actualValue);
                  }
                  return actualValue;
                }}
              />
              <Legend 
                wrapperStyle={{
                  color: theme === 'dark' ? 'var(--text-heading)' : 'var(--text-primary)',
                }}
              />
              <Bar dataKey="costUSD" name={t('account.tabs.usageDetails.costUSD')} radius={[0, 4, 4, 0]}>
                {modelData.map((entry, index) => (
                  <Cell key={`cell-${index}`} fill={getProviderColor(entry.provider)} />
                ))}
              </Bar>
            </BarChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* All Events Table */}
      {eventsData && eventsData.events.length > 0 && (
        <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--white-05)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.allEvents')}</div>
            <button
              onClick={async () => {
                // Export CSV functionality - export current page events
                if (!eventsData?.events) return;
                const csv = [
                  [t('account.tabs.usageDetails.date'), t('account.tabs.usageDetails.model'), t('account.tabs.usageDetails.kind'), t('account.tabs.usageDetails.tokens'), t('account.tabs.usageDetails.cost')].join(','),
                  ...eventsData.events.map(e => [
                    new Date(e.createdAt).toLocaleString(),
                    e.model,
                    e.kind,
                    e.totalTokens,
                    e.costUSD.toFixed(4),
                  ].join(',')),
                ].join('\n');
                const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `usage-${eventsData.period.startDate}-${eventsData.period.endDate}-page-${eventsData.pagination.page}.csv`;
                a.click();
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
              }}
              disabled={eventsLoading}
              className="px-3 py-1 rounded text-12"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'var(--white-10)',
                color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
              }}
            >
              {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.exportCSV')}
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full" style={{ fontSize: '12px' }}>
              <thead>
                <tr style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
                  <th className="text-left py-2 px-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.date')}</th>
                  <th className="text-left py-2 px-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.model')}</th>
                  <th className="text-left py-2 px-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.kind')}</th>
                  <th className="text-right py-2 px-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.tokens')}</th>
                  <th className="text-right py-2 px-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>{t('account.tabs.usageDetails.cost')}</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {groupedEvents
                  .slice((eventsPage - 1) * eventsPerPage, eventsPage * eventsPerPage)
                  .map((group, index) => (
                  <tr key={`group-${index}-${group.startTime.getTime()}`} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-10)' }}>
                    <td className="py-2 px-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
                      <div>
                        {formatTimeRange(group.startTime, group.endTime)}
                        {group.count > 1 && (
                          <div className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
                            {group.count} {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.events')}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
                      <div>
                        <div>{group.model}</div>
                        {group.modelAlias && (
                          <div className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
                            {group.modelAlias}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-2">
                      <span
                        className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px]"
                        style={{
                          backgroundColor: group.kind === 'included' ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.1)' : 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.1)',
                          color: group.kind === 'included' ? 'rgb(34, 197, 94)' : 'rgb(251, 191, 36)',
                        }}
                      >
                        {group.kind}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="text-right py-2 px-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
                      {formatTokens(group.totalTokens)}
                    </td>
                    <td className="text-right py-2 px-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
                      {formatCost(group.totalCost)}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
            {(groupedEvents.length > eventsPerPage || (eventsData.pagination && eventsData.pagination.totalPages > 1)) && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-4">
                <div className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
                  {eventsLoading ? (
                    t('account.tabs.usageDetails.loading')
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.showing', {
                        start: ((eventsPage - 1) * eventsPerPage) + 1,
                        end: Math.min(eventsPage * eventsPerPage, groupedEvents.length),
                        total: groupedEvents.length,
                        eventsCount: eventsData.pagination?.total || groupedEvents.length
                      })}
                      {' • '}
                      {eventsData.pagination && eventsData.pagination.totalPages > 1 && (
                        <span>~{eventsData.pagination.totalPages} {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.pages')}</span>
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setEventsPage(p => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                    disabled={eventsPage === 1 || eventsLoading}
                    className="px-3 py-1 rounded text-12"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: eventsPage === 1 || eventsLoading ? 'var(--white-05)' : 'var(--white-10)',
                      color: eventsPage === 1 || eventsLoading ? 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' : 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
                      cursor: eventsPage === 1 || eventsLoading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                      border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
                    }}
                  >
                    {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.previous')}
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setEventsPage(p => p + 1)}
                    disabled={(eventsData.pagination && eventsPage >= eventsData.pagination.totalPages) || eventsLoading}
                    className="px-3 py-1 rounded text-12"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: (eventsData.pagination && eventsPage >= eventsData.pagination.totalPages) || eventsLoading ? 'var(--white-05)' : 'var(--white-10)',
                      color: (eventsData.pagination && eventsPage >= eventsData.pagination.totalPages) || eventsLoading ? 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' : 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
                      cursor: (eventsData.pagination && eventsPage >= eventsData.pagination.totalPages) || eventsLoading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                      border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
                    }}
                  >
                    {t('account.tabs.usageDetails.next')}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

Файл: UserPositionAnalysis.tsx
Путь: src/components/UserPositionAnalysis.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { isGeneratingUserStanceAnalysis } from '../lib/userStanceAnalysis';

// Component to analyze user's position based on their interactions
export const UserPositionAnalysis: React.FC<{ onFirstResult?: () => void; onRiskUpdate?: (r: { level: string; score: number; rationale?: string } | null) => void; hideTitle?: boolean }> = ({ onFirstResult, onRiskUpdate, hideTitle = false }) => {
  const [showRiskRationale, setShowRiskRationale] = React.useState(false);
  // PERFORMANCE FIX: Subscribe only to interactions.length, not entire array
  const interactionsLength = useGenaiChatStore((s) => s.interactions.length);
  const projectId = useGenaiChatStore((s) => s.projectId);
  const { currentUser } = useAuth();
  
  // Get interactions only when needed via getState()
  const getInteractions = React.useCallback(() => useGenaiChatStore.getState().interactions, []);
  
  // Find the project-level eval.stance interaction (not tied to a specific message)
  const stanceAnalysis = React.useMemo(() => {
    try {
      const interactions = getInteractions();
      const currentProjectId = useGenaiChatStore.getState().projectId;
      return interactions.find((it) => 
        it.subkind === 'eval.stance' && 
        it.projectId === currentProjectId && 
        !it.replyTo // Project-level analysis, not tied to specific message
      ) || null;
    } catch { return null; }
  }, [getInteractions, interactionsLength, projectId]);

  const notifiedRef = React.useRef(false);
  
  // Notify on first result
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (stanceAnalysis && !notifiedRef.current) {
      notifiedRef.current = true;
      onFirstResult && onFirstResult();
      // Notify about risk if present
      if (stanceAnalysis.highRisk && onRiskUpdate) {
        try {
          onRiskUpdate({
            level: stanceAnalysis.highRisk.level,
            score: stanceAnalysis.highRisk.score,
            rationale: stanceAnalysis.highRisk.rationale,
          });
        } catch {}
      }
    }
  }, [stanceAnalysis, onFirstResult, onRiskUpdate]);

  // Check if generation is in progress
  const isLoading = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!projectId) return false;
    const chatMessages = getInteractions().filter((it) => 
      it.kind === 'user' || it.kind === 'assistant'
    );
    return isGeneratingUserStanceAnalysis(projectId, chatMessages.length);
  }, [projectId, getInteractions, interactionsLength]);

  // Do not render until there's at least one user message
  const hasUserMessages = React.useMemo(() => {
    const interactions = getInteractions();
    return interactions.some((it) => it.kind === 'user');
  }, [getInteractions, interactionsLength]);

  if (!hasUserMessages) return null;
  
  const sanitizeSx = (s: string) => {
    try { return (s || '').replace(/<!--\s*@sx:[\s\S]*?-->/g, '').trim(); } catch { return s; }
      };
  
  // Display content from stanceAnalysis
  const displayContent = stanceAnalysis 
    ? (stanceAnalysis.contentSanitized || stanceAnalysis.content)
    : null;
  
  // Display risk from stanceAnalysis
  const displayRisk = stanceAnalysis?.highRisk;
  
  // Display roles and industries from stanceAnalysis
  const displayRoles = stanceAnalysis?.roles || [];
  const displayIndustries = stanceAnalysis?.industries || [];

  return (
    <div className="mt-3 p-3">
      {!hideTitle && (<div className="text-13 mb-2" style={{ color: '#669999' }}>How you engage</div>)}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="text-12 p-3 rounded-lg" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', backgroundColor: 'var(--toolbar-bg)' }}>Analyzing...</div>
      ) : displayContent ? (
        <>
          {/* Stance section */}
          <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--toolbar-bg)' }}>
            <div className="text-12 fade-in" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)', lineHeight: '1.6', transition: 'opacity 0.2s', whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap' }}>
              {sanitizeSx(displayContent as string)}
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* Risk section */}
          {displayRisk && (
            <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--toolbar-bg)' }}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {(() => {
                  const hr = displayRisk;
                  if (!hr) return null as any;
                  
                  const level = hr.level || 'Low';
                  
                  // Determine badge text and colors based on risk level
                  let badgeText = 'This discussion is safe';
                  let bgColor = 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.1)'; // green
                  let borderColor = 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3)';
                  let textColor = 'rgb(34, 197, 94)';
                  
                  if (level === 'High') {
                    badgeText = 'High risk detected';
                    bgColor = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)'; // red
                    borderColor = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)';
                    textColor = 'rgb(239, 68, 68)';
                  } else if (level === 'Medium') {
                    badgeText = 'Moderate risk detected';
                    bgColor = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.1)'; // yellow/orange
                    borderColor = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.3)';
                    textColor = 'rgb(251, 191, 36)';
                  }
                  
                  const hasRationale = hr.rationale && hr.rationale.trim().length > 0;
                  
                  return (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => hasRationale && setShowRiskRationale(!showRiskRationale)}
                      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-medium ${hasRationale ? 'cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity' : ''}`}
                      style={{ 
                        backgroundColor: bgColor,
                        border: `1px solid ${borderColor}`,
                        color: textColor
                      }}
                      disabled={!hasRationale}
                    >
                      {badgeText}
                    </button>
                  );
                })()}
              </div>
              {showRiskRationale && displayRisk?.rationale && (
                <div className="text-[11px] mt-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
                  {displayRisk.rationale}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {/* Roles and Industries section */}
          {(displayRoles.length > 0 || displayIndustries.length > 0) && (
            <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--toolbar-bg)' }}>
              {displayRoles.length > 0 && (
                <div className="mb-2">
                  <div className="text-[11px] mb-1.5" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                    Professional roles
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
                    {displayRoles.map((r: any, idx: number) => {
                      const confidencePercent = Math.round((r.confidence || 0) * 100);
                      return (
                        <div key={idx} className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
                          <span style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{r.role}</span>
                          <span className="ml-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
                            ({confidencePercent}%)
                          </span>
                          {r.rationale && (
                            <div className="mt-0.5 ml-0" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)', fontSize: '10px' }}>
                              {r.rationale}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              {displayIndustries.length > 0 && (
                <div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] mb-1.5" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                    Industries
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
                    {displayIndustries.map((i: any, idx: number) => {
                      const confidencePercent = Math.round((i.confidence || 0) * 100);
                      return (
                        <div key={idx} className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
                          <span style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{i.industry}</span>
                          <span className="ml-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
                            ({confidencePercent}%)
                          </span>
                          {i.rationale && (
                            <div className="mt-0.5 ml-0" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)', fontSize: '10px' }}>
                              {i.rationale}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        <div className="text-12 p-3 rounded-lg" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', backgroundColor: 'var(--toolbar-bg)' }}>No clear position identified yet.</div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';

export const UserProfile: React.FC = () => {
  const { currentUser, signOut } = useAuth();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    try {
      await signOut();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Sign out error:', error);
    }
  };

  // Close dropdown when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, []);

  if (!currentUser) return null;

  return (
    <div className="relative" ref={dropdownRef}>
      {/* User avatar */}
      <button
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className="user-icon hover:opacity-80 focus:outline-none transition-opacity"
        title={currentUser.email || 'User Profile'}
      >
        {currentUser.email?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}
      </button>

      {/* Dropdown menu */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div
          className="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-64 rounded-lg shadow-lg z-50"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--overlay-deep-95)',
            borderColor: 'var(--overlay-line-90)',
            border: '1px solid',
            boxShadow: '0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)',
          }}
        >
          <div className="p-3 border-b border-solid" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="user-icon w-8 h-8">{currentUser.email?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'U'}</div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                  {currentUser.email || 'Unknown User'}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 border-b border-solid" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
            <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>ID:</span>
                <span className="font-mono truncate ml-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                  {currentUser.uid.slice(-8)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>Verified:</span>
                <span style={{ color: currentUser.emailVerified ? 'var(--accent-success)' : 'var(--accent-danger)' }}>
                  {currentUser.emailVerified ? 'Yes' : 'No'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-2">
            <button onClick={handleSignOut} className="btn btn-secondary w-full text-xs justify-start">
              <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M17 16l4-4m0 0l-4-4m4 4H7m6 4v1a3 3 0 01-3 3H6a3 3 0 01-3-3V7a3 3 0 013-3h4a3 3 0 013 3v1"
                />
              </svg>
              Sign Out
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};








================================================================================

Путь: src/components/WorkspaceLibrary.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';

interface Document {
  id: string;
  filename: string;
  contentType?: string;
  sizeBytes?: number;
  parseStatus?: string;
  createdAt?: string;
}

interface Source {
  id: string;
  displayName: string;
  kind: string;
  status?: string;
}

interface WorkspaceLibraryProps {
  projectId: string | null;
  onDocumentDelete?: (docId: string) => void;
  onSourceDelete?: (sourceId: string) => void;
  onOpenDocument?: (doc: Document) => void;
}

const WorkspaceLibrary: React.FC<WorkspaceLibraryProps> = ({ 
  projectId, 
  onDocumentDelete,
  onSourceDelete,
  onOpenDocument,
}) => {
  const [documents, setDocuments] = React.useState<Document[]>([]);
  const [sources, setSources] = React.useState<Source[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const pendingAttachedDocIds = useGenaiChatStore((state) => state.pendingAttachedDocIds);
  const setPendingAttachedDocIds = useGenaiChatStore((state) => state.setPendingAttachedDocIds);

  // PERF: Track mount time
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mountTime = performance.now();
    console.log('[WorkspaceLibrary] Component mounted at', mountTime);
    return () => {
      const unmountTime = performance.now();
      console.log('[WorkspaceLibrary] Component unmounted at', unmountTime, 'lifetime:', unmountTime - mountTime, 'ms');
    };
  }, []);

  // Load documents when projectId changes
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') return;
    
    const loadDocuments = async () => {
      const startTime = performance.now();
      console.log('[WorkspaceLibrary] Starting document load at', startTime);
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const docs = await api.docsList(projectId);
        const endTime = performance.now();
        console.log('[WorkspaceLibrary] Document load completed at', endTime, 'took', endTime - startTime, 'ms');
        setDocuments(docs || []);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('[WorkspaceLibrary] Failed to load documents', err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadDocuments();
  }, [projectId]);

  const getFileIcon = (filename: string, contentType?: string) => {
    const ext = filename.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase();
    const type = contentType?.toLowerCase() || '';

    // PDF
    if (ext === 'pdf' || type.includes('pdf')) {
      return (
        <svg className="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
          <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8z" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          <path d="M14 2v6h6M10 14h4M10 18h4M10 10h1" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
        </svg>
      );
    }

    // Word documents
    if (ext === 'doc' || ext === 'docx' || type.includes('word') || type.includes('document')) {
      return (
        <svg className="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
          <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8z" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          <path d="M14 2v6h6M9 15l2 2 4-4" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
        </svg>
      );
    }

    // CSV / TSV
    if (ext === 'csv' || ext === 'tsv' || type.includes('csv')) {
      return (
        <svg className="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
          <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8z" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          <path d="M14 2v6h6M8 13h8M8 17h8M8 9h2" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
        </svg>
      );
    }

    // Markdown
    if (ext === 'md' || type.includes('markdown')) {
      return (
        <svg className="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
          <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8z" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          <path d="M14 2v6h6M11 14l-2-2v4M13 14l2-2v4" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
        </svg>
      );
    }

    // Text files (default)
    return (
      <svg className="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
        <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8z" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
        <path d="M14 2v6h6M16 13H8M16 17H8M10 9H8" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
      </svg>
    );
  };

  const getSourceIcon = (kind: string) => {
    switch (kind.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'telegram':
        return (
          <svg className="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
            <path d="M12 2C6.48 2 2 6.48 2 12s4.48 10 10 10 10-4.48 10-10S17.52 2 12 2zm4.64 6.8c-.15 1.58-.8 5.42-1.13 7.19-.14.75-.42 1-.68 1.03-.58.05-1.02-.38-1.58-.75-.88-.58-1.38-.94-2.23-1.5-.99-.65-.35-1.01.22-1.59.15-.15 2.71-2.48 2.76-2.69a.2.2 0 00-.05-.18c-.06-.05-.14-.03-.21-.02-.09.02-1.49.95-4.22 2.79-.4.27-.76.41-1.08.4-.36-.01-1.04-.2-1.55-.37-.63-.2-1.12-.31-1.08-.66.02-.18.27-.36.74-.55 2.92-1.27 4.86-2.11 5.83-2.51 2.78-1.16 3.35-1.36 3.73-1.36.08 0 .27.02.39.12.1.08.13.19.14.27-.01.06.01.24 0 .38z"/>
          </svg>
        );
      case 'web':
      case 'url':
        return (
          <svg className="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" strokeWidth="2" />
            <path d="M2 12h20M12 2a15.3 15.3 0 014 10 15.3 15.3 0 01-4 10 15.3 15.3 0 01-4-10 15.3 15.3 0 014-10z" strokeWidth="2" />
          </svg>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <svg className="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
            <path d="M3 3h7l7 7v11a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2z" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          </svg>
        );
    }
  };

  const formatSize = (bytes?: number): string => {
    if (!bytes) return '';
    if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes}B`;
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB`;
    return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)}MB`;
  };

  const handleDocumentDelete = async (doc: Document, e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (e) e.stopPropagation();
    if (!projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') return;
    
    try {
      await api.docsDelete(projectId, doc.id);
      setDocuments(prev => prev.filter(d => d.id !== doc.id));
      onDocumentDelete?.(doc.id);
      console.log('[WorkspaceLibrary] Document deleted', { docId: doc.id });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[WorkspaceLibrary] Failed to delete document', err);
    }
  };

  const handleSourceDelete = async (source: Source) => {
    // TODO: Implement source deletion when API is ready
    console.log('[WorkspaceLibrary] Source delete requested', { sourceId: source.id });
    onSourceDelete?.(source.id);
  };

  const getDocumentDisplayName = (filename: string) => {
    try {
      const f = (filename || '').toLowerCase();
      if (f === 'entities.json') return 'Entities container';
      if (f === 'facts.json') return 'Facts container';
      if (f === 'events.json') return 'Events container';
      if (f === 'metrics.json') return 'Metrics container';
      if (f === 'decisions.json') return 'Decisions container';
      return filename;
    } catch {
      return filename;
    }
  };

  const handleDocumentToggle = (docId: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const isAttached = pendingAttachedDocIds.includes(docId);
    if (isAttached) {
      setPendingAttachedDocIds(pendingAttachedDocIds.filter(id => id !== docId));
    } else {
      setPendingAttachedDocIds([...pendingAttachedDocIds, docId]);
    }
  };

  if (!projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-8 text-center" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
        <span className="text-xs">No documents, no sources. Nothing.<br />But you may add or create.</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-8" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
        <div className="animate-pulse text-xs">Loading...</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isEmpty = documents.length === 0 && sources.length === 0;

  if (isEmpty) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-8 px-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
        <svg className="w-12 h-12 mb-2 opacity-30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
          <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8z" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          <path d="M14 2v6h6M16 13H8M16 17H8M10 9H8" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
        </svg>
        <span className="text-xs text-center">Your workspace library is empty</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Documents section */}
      {documents.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <h4 className="text-xs font-medium mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
            Documents ({documents.length})
          </h4>
          <div className="space-y-1">
            {documents.map((doc) => {
              const isAttached = pendingAttachedDocIds.includes(doc.id);
              return (
                <div
                  key={doc.id}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1.5 rounded group hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
                >
                  {/* Checkbox for attaching to context */}
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={isAttached}
                    onChange={() => {}}
                    onClick={(e) => handleDocumentToggle(doc.id, e)}
                    className="flex-shrink-0 w-4 h-4 rounded cursor-pointer"
                    style={{ 
                      accentColor: 'var(--accent-primary)',
                      cursor: 'pointer'
                    }}
                    aria-label="Attach to context"
                    title="Attach to context for next message"
                  />

                  {/* Icon and file info - clickable to open */}
                  <div
                    className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-1 min-w-0 cursor-pointer"
                    onClick={() => onOpenDocument?.(doc)}
                  >
                    {/* Icon */}
                    <div className="flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                      {getFileIcon(doc.filename, doc.contentType)}
                    </div>

                    {/* File info */}
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="text-xs font-medium truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }} title={doc.filename}>
                        {getDocumentDisplayName(doc.filename)}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
                        {formatSize(doc.sizeBytes)}
                        {doc.parseStatus && ` • ${doc.parseStatus}`}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Delete button */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => handleDocumentDelete(doc, e)}
                    className="flex-shrink-0 w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 hover:bg-white/10 transition-all"
                    style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}
                    aria-label="Delete document"
                    title="Delete document"
                  >
                    <svg className="w-3 h-3" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                      <path d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                    </svg>
                  </button>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Sources section (future) */}
      {sources.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <h4 className="text-xs font-medium mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
            Sources ({sources.length})
          </h4>
          <div className="space-y-1">
            {sources.map((source) => (
              <div
                key={source.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1.5 rounded group hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
              >
                {/* Icon */}
                <div className="flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                  {getSourceIcon(source.kind)}
                </div>

                {/* Source info */}
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="text-xs font-medium truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }} title={source.displayName}>
                    {source.displayName}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
                    {source.kind}
                    {source.status && ` • ${source.status}`}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Delete button */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSourceDelete(source)}
                  className="flex-shrink-0 w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 hover:bg-white/10 transition-all"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}
                  aria-label="Delete source"
                  title="Delete source"
                >
                  <svg className="w-3 h-3" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                  </svg>
                </button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default WorkspaceLibrary;
