import React from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import WorkspaceLibrary from './WorkspaceLibrary';

interface WorkspacePanelProps {
  sources: any[];
  currentProjectId: string | null;
  addMenuRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  showAddSourceMenu: boolean;
  onShowAddSourceMenuChange: (value: boolean) => void;
  onShowAddTelegramModalChange: (value: boolean) => void;
  onPreviewSource: (source: any) => void;
  onOpenDocument: (doc: any) => void;
}

const getSourceIcon = (kind?: string) => {
  if (kind === 'web') {
    return (
      <svg
        className="w-3 h-3"
        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
      >
        <path
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          strokeWidth={2}
          d="M6 5c7.18 0 13 5.82 13 13"
        />
        <path
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          strokeWidth={2}
          d="M6 11a7 7 0 017 7"
        />
        <path
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          strokeWidth={2}
          d="M5 18a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0z"
        />
      </svg>
    );
  } else if (kind === 'telegram') {
    return (
      <svg
        className="w-3 h-3"
        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
      >
        <path
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          strokeWidth={2}
          d="M3 11l18-7-7 18-4-8-7-3z"
        />
      </svg>
    );
  }
  return (
    <svg
      className="w-3 h-3"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
    >
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" strokeWidth={2} />
    </svg>
  );
};

const renderSourceCard = (
  source: any,
  onPreviewSource: (source: any) => void,
) => {
  const isFetched = source.status === 'completed' || !!source.profile;
  const inferredKind =
    source.kind ||
    (typeof source.id === 'string' && source.id.startsWith('@')
      ? 'telegram'
      : undefined);

  return (
    <div
      key={source.id}
      className="text-xs rounded-2xl cursor-pointer"
      style={{
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-sidebar)',
        border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
      }}
      role="button"
      onClick={() => onPreviewSource(source)}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2">
        {isFetched ? (
          <svg
            className="w-3 h-3"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            style={{ color: 'var(--accent-success)' }}
          >
            <path
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              strokeWidth={2}
              d="M9 12l2 2 4-4"
            />
            <path
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              strokeWidth={2}
              d="M12 22C6.477 22 2 17.523 2 12S6.477 2 12 2s10 4.477 10 10-4.477 10-10 10z"
            />
          </svg>
        ) : (
          getSourceIcon(inferredKind)
        )}
        <span>
          <strong style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>
            {inferredKind || 'source'}
          </strong>{' '}
          {source.displayName || source.id}
        </span>
        <span className="ml-auto">
          {source.status === 'processing' && (
            <span
              className="animate-pulse"
              style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}
            >
              ...
            </span>
          )}
          {source.status === 'failed' && (
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent-danger)' }}>failed</span>
          )}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div
        className="px-3 pb-2"
        style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}
      >
        {source.profile?.motivation ? (
          <span>{source.profile.motivation}</span>
        ) : source.profile?.agenda?.description ? (
          <span>{source.profile.agenda.description}</span>
        ) : source.status === 'processing' ? (
          <span
            className="animate-pulse"
            style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}
          >
            ...
          </span>
        ) : !isFetched &&
          (source as any).__firstProfile &&
          (source as any).__hint === 'profilingNewSource' ? (
          <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
            Our system is establishing the channel's analytical profile based
            on its content.
          </span>
        ) : source.description ? (
          <span>{source.description}</span>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {source.profile?.agenda?.primaryGoal && (
        <div
          className="ml-5 mt-1 rounded mb-1"
          style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}
        >
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
              primaryGoal:
            </span>{' '}
            {source.profile.agenda.primaryGoal}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {source.profile && (
        <div className="px-3 pb-3 space-y-2 mt-2">
          {source.profile.topics && source.profile.topics.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
              {source.profile.topics.slice(0, 6).map((t: any, i: number) => (
                <span
                  key={i}
                  className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px]"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: 'var(--white-10)',
                    color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
                  }}
                >
                  {t.name}
                  {typeof t.share === 'number'
                    ? ` ${Math.round(t.share * 100)}%`
                    : ''}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {(typeof source.profile.trustScore === 'number' ||
            typeof source.profile.goalAlignmentScore === 'number') && (
            <div
              className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px]"
              style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}
            >
              {typeof source.profile.goalAlignmentScore === 'number' && (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span>alignment</span>
                  <div
                    className="w-24 h-1.5 rounded"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--overlay-line-90)' }}
                  >
                    <div
                      className="h-1.5 rounded"
                      style={{
                        width: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(1, source.profile.goalAlignmentScore)) * 100}%`,
                        backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-success)',
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <span>
                    {Math.round(
                      Math.max(
                        0,
                        Math.min(1, source.profile.goalAlignmentScore),
                      ) * 100,
                    )}
                    %
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
              {typeof source.profile.trustScore === 'number' && (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span>trust</span>
                  <div
                    className="w-24 h-1.5 rounded"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--overlay-line-90)' }}
                  >
                    <div
                      className="h-1.5 rounded"
                      style={{
                        width: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(1, source.profile.trustScore)) * 100}%`,
                        backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-success)',
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <span>
                    {Math.round(
                      Math.max(0, Math.min(1, source.profile.trustScore)) * 100,
                    )}
                    %
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    d="M5 11a7 7 0 017 7"
                  />
                  <circle
                    cx="6"

                    r="1.5"
                    fill="currentColor"
                  />
                </svg>
                <span className="text-13">RSS</span>
              </button>

              {/* Document upload */}
              <label
                className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-b-xl text-left cursor-pointer"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                  color: 'var(--text-heading)',
                }}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                  (e.currentTarget as HTMLLabelElement).style.backgroundColor =
                    'var(--white-10)';
                }}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                  (e.currentTarget as HTMLLabelElement).style.backgroundColor =
                    'transparent';
                }}
              >
                <input
                  type="file"
                  accept=".txt,.md,.csv,.tsv,application/pdf,application/msword,application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document,text/plain,text/markdown,text/csv,text/tab-separated-values"
                  style={{ display: 'none' }}
                  onChange={async (e) => {
                    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
                    if (!file) return;
                    try {
                      onShowAddSourceMenuChange(false);
                      const pid =
                        useGenaiChatStore.getState().projectId ||
                        (await useGenaiChatStore.getState().ensureProject());
                      const doc = await api.docsUpload(pid as string, file);
                      try {
                        await api.docsParse(pid as string, doc.id);
                      } catch {}
                    } catch (err) {
                      console.error(
                        '[Discovery] Document upload failed',
                        err,
                      );
                    } finally {
                      (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
                    }
                  }}
                />
                <svg
                  className="w-4 h-4"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    d="M7 3h7l4 4v14a2 2 0 01-2 2H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2z"
                  />
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    d="M14 3v4h4"
                  />
                </svg>
                <span className="text-13">Document</span>
              </label>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <WorkspaceLibrary
        projectId={genaiChat.projectId}
        onDocumentDelete={(docId: string) => {
          console.log('[DiscoveryPage] Document deleted', { docId });
          // Optionally refresh interactions or handle cleanup
        }}
        onOpenDocument={onOpenDocument}
      />
    </>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { api } from '../../lib/api';

export const DecisionsList: React.FC<{ projectId: string }> = ({ projectId }) => {
  const [items, setItems] = React.useState<Array<{ title: string; selected?: string; rationale?: string }>>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState<boolean>(false);
  const reload = React.useCallback(async () => {
    if (!projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') return;
    setLoading(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const docs = await api.docsList(projectId);
      const ddoc = docs.find((d: any) => String(d.filename || '').toLowerCase() === 'decisions.json');
      if (!ddoc?.id) { setItems([]); setLoading(false); return; }
      const blob = await api.docsDownload(projectId, ddoc.id);
      const text = await new Response(blob).text();
      const json = JSON.parse(text || '{}');
      const arr = Array.isArray(json?.decisions) ? json.decisions : [];
      setItems(arr);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError('Failed to load decisions');
      setItems([]);
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  }, [projectId]);
  React.useEffect(() => { reload(); }, [reload]);
  const count = items.length;
  const header = (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1" style={{ border: 'none', background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><path d="M4 12h8M12 12l4-4M12 12l4 4" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"/><circle cx="4" cy="12" r="2"/></svg>
        <span className="text-[11px] font-medium">Decisions ({count})</span>
      </div>
      <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" style={{ transform: open ? 'rotate(90deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)', transition: 'transform 0.15s ease' }}><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>
    </button>
  );
  if (loading) return <div className="text-11" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>Loading…</div>;
  if (error) return <div className="text-11" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-danger)' }}>{error}</div>;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      {header}
      {open && (
        <div className="grid" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '1fr', gap: 6 }}>
          {items.length === 0 && (
            <div className="text-11 px-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>No decisions yet. Run "analyze decisions".</div>
          )}
          {items.map((d, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="p-2 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-elevated)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="text-12 font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{d.title}</div>
                {d.selected && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--white-10)', color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{d.selected}</span>
                )}
              </div>
              {d.rationale && <div className="mt-1 text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{d.rationale}</div>}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { api } from '../../lib/api';

export const EntitiesList: React.FC<{ projectId: string }> = ({ projectId }) => {
  const [items, setItems] = React.useState<Array<{ id?: string; name: string; type: string; description?: string; excluded?: boolean }>>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState<boolean>(false);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = React.useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const reload = React.useCallback(async () => {
    if (!projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') return;
    setLoading(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const docs = await api.docsList(projectId);
      const ents = docs.find((d: any) => String(d.filename || '').toLowerCase() === 'entities.json');
      if (!ents?.id) { setItems([]); setLoading(false); return; }
      const blob = await api.docsDownload(projectId, ents.id);
      const text = await new Response(blob).text();
      const json = JSON.parse(text || '{}');
      const arr = Array.isArray(json?.entities) ? json.entities : [];
      setItems(arr.filter((e: any) => !e?.excluded));
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError('Failed to load entities');
      setItems([]);
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  }, [projectId]);
  React.useEffect(() => { reload(); }, [reload]);

  const count = items.length;

  const typeIcon = (t: string) => {
    const stroke = 'currentColor';
    switch (t) {
      case 'person':
        return (<svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke={stroke}><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="3"/><path d="M4 20c0-3.314 3.134-6 7-6s7 2.686 7 6"/></svg>);
      case 'organization_or_platform':
        return (<svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke={stroke}><path d="M21 16V8a2 2 0 00-1-1.73l-7-4a2 2 0 00-2 0l-7 4A2 2 0 003 8v8a2 2 0 001 1.73l7 4a2 2 0 002 0l7-4A2 2 0 0021 16z"/><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="1"/><path d="M7.5 10l2.5 1.45v2.9L7.5 16.5"/><path d="M16.5 10L14 11.45v2.9l2.5 1.45"/><path d="M16.5 16.5l-2.5-1.45v-2.9l2.5-1.45"/></svg>);
      case 'project_or_product':
        return (<svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke={stroke}><path d="M12 2L2 7l10 5 10-5-10-5z"/><path d="M2 17l10 5 10-5"/><path d="M2 12l10 5 10-5"/></svg>);
      case 'classifier_or_standard':
        return (<svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke={stroke}><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M7 10h3M7 14h3M7 7h6"/><circle cx="15.5" cy="12.5" r="2.5"/></svg>);
      case 'classification_code':
        return (<svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke={stroke}><rect x="5" y="4" width="14" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M8 9h8M8 12h8M8 15h4"/></svg>);
      case 'regulatory_document':
        return (<svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke={stroke}><path d="M7 3h10l5 5v13H7z"/><path d="M7 3v7h7"/><path d="M9 13h6M9 17h6"/></svg>);
      case 'government_agency':
        return (<svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke={stroke}><rect x="4" y="3" width="16" height="16" rx="1"/><path d="M4 7h16M8 11h8M8 15h6"/><path d="M8 3v4M16 3v4"/></svg>);
      case 'contract_document':
        return (<svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke={stroke}><path d="M6 2h12v20H6z"/><path d="M9 7h6M9 11h6M9 15h4"/><path d="M6 2l3 6-3 6M18 2l-3 6 3 6"/></svg>);
      case 'location':
        return (<svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke={stroke}><path d="M12 2L2 7l10 5 10-5-10-5z"/><path d="M2 17l10 5 10-5"/><path d="M2 12l10 5 10-5"/></svg>);
      default:
        return (<svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke={stroke}><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/></svg>);
    }
  };

  const header = (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1" style={{ border: 'none', background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><rect x="4" y="5" width="16" height="4" rx="1"/><rect x="4" y="11" width="16" height="4" rx="1"/><rect x="4" y="17" width="16" height="2" rx="1"/></svg>
        <span className="text-[11px] font-medium">Entities ({count})</span>
      </div>
      <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" style={{ transform: open ? 'rotate(90deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)', transition: 'transform 0.15s ease' }}><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>
    </button>
  );

  if (loading) return <div className="text-11" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>Loading…</div>;
  if (error) return <div className="text-11" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-danger)' }}>{error}</div>;
  if (items.length === 0) return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      {header}
      {open && (<div className="text-11 px-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>No entities yet. Run "analyze entities".</div>)}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      {header}
      {open && (
        <div className="grid" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '1fr', gap: 6 }}>
          {items.map((e, i) => {
            const key = `${e.name}-${e.type}-${i}`;
            const isExp = !!expanded[key];
            return (
              <button
                key={key}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setExpanded((s) => ({ ...s, [key]: !isExp }))}
                className="p-2 rounded text-left w-full"
                style={{ background: 'var(--bg-elevated)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{typeIcon(e.type)}</span>
                    <span className="text-12 font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{e.name}</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--white-10)', color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{e.type}</span>
                </div>
                {isExp && e.description && (
                  <div className="mt-1 text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{e.description}</div>
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export const EventsList: React.FC<{ projectId: string }> = ({ projectId }) => {
  const [items, setItems] = React.useState<Array<{ ts: string; title: string; summary?: string }>>([]);

        <div className="grid" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '1fr', gap: 6 }}>
          {items.length === 0 && (
            <div className="text-11 px-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>No events yet. Run "analyze events".</div>
          )}
          {items.map((e, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="p-2 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-elevated)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
              <div className="text-12 font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{e.title}</div>
              <div className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{e.ts}</div>
              {e.summary && <div className="mt-1 text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{e.summary}</div>}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { api } from '../../lib/api';

export const FactsList: React.FC<{ projectId: string }> = ({ projectId }) => {
  const [items, setItems] = React.useState<Array<{ statement: string; confidence?: number; evidence?: string[] }>>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState<boolean>(false);
  const reload = React.useCallback(async () => {
    if (!projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') return;
    setLoading(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const docs = await api.docsList(projectId);
      const fdoc = docs.find((d: any) => String(d.filename || '').toLowerCase() === 'facts.json');
      if (!fdoc?.id) { setItems([]); setLoading(false); return; }
      const blob = await api.docsDownload(projectId, fdoc.id);
      const text = await new Response(blob).text();
      const json = JSON.parse(text || '{}');
      const arr = Array.isArray(json?.facts) ? json.facts : [];
      setItems(arr);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError('Failed to load facts');
      setItems([]);
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  }, [projectId]);
  React.useEffect(() => { reload(); }, [reload]);
  const count = items.length;
  const header = (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1" style={{ border: 'none', background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><path d="M3 4h18v4H3zM3 10h18v10H3z"/><path d="M6 13h6M6 17h10" strokeLinecap="round"/></svg>
        <span className="text-[11px] font-medium">Facts ({count})</span>
      </div>
      <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" style={{ transform: open ? 'rotate(90deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)', transition: 'transform 0.15s ease' }}><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>
    </button>
  );
  if (loading) return <div className="text-11" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>Loading…</div>;
  if (error) return <div className="text-11" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-danger)' }}>{error}</div>;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      {header}
      {open && (
        <div className="grid" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '1fr', gap: 6 }}>
          {items.length === 0 && (
            <div className="text-11 px-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>No facts yet. Run "analyze facts".</div>
          )}
          {items.map((f, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="p-2 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-elevated)', border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)' }}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>{f.statement}</div>
                {typeof f.confidence === 'number' && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ background: 'var(--white-10)', color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>{Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, f.confidence))*100)}%</span>
                )}
              </div>
              {Array.isArray(f.evidence) && f.evidence.length > 0 && (
                <div className="mt-1 text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>Evidence: {f.evidence.join('; ')}</div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import { useState, useMemo, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';

export function useAnalysisManagement() {
  const [showUserAnalysis, setShowUserAnalysis] = useState(false);
  const [showLLMReview, setShowLLMReview] = useState(false);
  const [showDiscussionFlow, setShowDiscussionFlow] = useState(false);
  const [badgeUser, setBadgeUser] = useState(false);
  const [badgeLLM, setBadgeLLM] = useState(false);
  const [badgeFlow, setBadgeFlow] = useState(false);
  const [availUserAnalysis, setAvailUserAnalysis] = useState(false);
  const [availLLMReview, setAvailLLMReview] = useState(false);
  const [availDiscussionFlow, setAvailDiscussionFlow] = useState(false);
  const [riskBanner, setRiskBanner] = useState<null | {
    visible: boolean;
    level: 'High' | 'Medium' | 'Low';
    rationale: string;
  }>(null);
  const [isHighRisk, setIsHighRisk] = useState(false);
  const [expandedChip, setExpandedChip] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore();
  const genaiChatInteractionsLength = useGenaiChatStore(
    (state) => state.interactions.length,
  );
  
  const getInteractions = useCallback(
    () => useGenaiChatStore.getState().interactions,
    [],
  );

  const hasAssistant = useMemo(() => {
    const interactions = getInteractions();
    return interactions.some(
      (it) => it.kind === 'assistant' && (it.contentSanitized || it.content),
    );
  }, [getInteractions, genaiChatInteractionsLength]);

  // Detect server-provided user stance (eval.stance linked to a user message)
  const stanceFromInteractionsTop = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      const interactions = getInteractions();
      const ints = [...interactions].reverse();
      const userIds = new Set(
        ints.filter((it) => it.kind === 'user').map((it) => it.id),
      );
      return ints.find(
        (it) =>
          it.subkind === 'eval.stance' && it.replyTo && userIds.has(it.replyTo),
      );
    } catch {
      return null as any;
    }
  }, [getInteractions, genaiChatInteractionsLength]);

  // If server already sent stance, make the User button available
  useEffect(() => {
    setAvailUserAnalysis(!!stanceFromInteractionsTop);
  }, [stanceFromInteractionsTop]);

  // Discussion Flow is always available now
  useEffect(() => {
    setAvailDiscussionFlow(true);
  }, []);

  // Callback for DiscussionFlow onFirstResult
  const onFirstResultDiscussionFlow = useCallback(() => {
    setBadgeFlow(false);
    setAvailDiscussionFlow(true);
  }, []);

  // Derive high-risk state from interactions
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const st = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
      const hi = [...st.interactions]
        .reverse()
        .find(
          (it) => (it as any).highRisk && (it as any).highRisk.level === 'High',
        );
      if (hi && (hi as any).highRisk) {
        const rationale = (hi as any).highRisk.rationale || '';
        setIsHighRisk(true as any);
        setRiskBanner((prev) =>
          prev
            ? { ...prev, rationale: rationale || prev.rationale || '' }
            : prev,
        );
      } else {
        setIsHighRisk(false as any);
      }
    } catch {}
  }, [genaiChat.interactions.length]);

  return {
    showUserAnalysis,
    setShowUserAnalysis,
    showLLMReview,
    setShowLLMReview,
    showDiscussionFlow,
    setShowDiscussionFlow,
    badgeUser,
    setBadgeUser,
    badgeLLM,
    setBadgeLLM,
    badgeFlow,
    setBadgeFlow,
    availUserAnalysis,
    setAvailUserAnalysis,
    availLLMReview,
    setAvailLLMReview,
    availDiscussionFlow,
    setAvailDiscussionFlow,
    riskBanner,
    setRiskBanner,
    isHighRisk,
    setIsHighRisk,
    expandedChip,
    setExpandedChip,
    hasAssistant,
    stanceFromInteractionsTop,
    onFirstResultDiscussionFlow,
  };
}

Файл: useArtifactsAnalysis.ts
Путь: src/hooks/useArtifactsAnalysis.ts
================================================================================

import { useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';

/**
 * Hook для управления анализом артефактов (entities, facts, events, metrics, decisions)
 */
export function useArtifactsAnalysis() {
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore();

  const waitForWsSubscribed = useCallback(
    async (projectId: string, timeoutMs = 1500) => {
      const start = Date.now();
      while (true) {
        try {
          const ws = (await import('../stores/wsStore')).useWsStore.getState();
          if (ws.connected && ws.subscribedProjectId === projectId) break;
        } catch {}
        if (Date.now() - start > timeoutMs) break;
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 60));
      }
    },
    [],
  );

  const createAnalyzeHandler = useCallback(
    (type: 'entities' | 'facts' | 'events' | 'metrics' | 'decisions') => {
      return async () => {
        try {
          const pid = await genaiChat.ensureProject();
          try {
            if ((window as any).wsSubscribeProject && pid) {
              (window as any).wsSubscribeProject(pid);
              await waitForWsSubscribed(pid);
            }
          } catch {}
          
          const api = (await import('../lib/api')).api;
          let res;
          
          switch (type) {
            case 'entities':
              res = await api.analyzeEntities(pid, '');
              break;
            case 'facts':
              res = await api.analyzeFacts(pid, '');
              break;
            case 'events':
              res = await api.analyzeEvents(pid, '');
              break;
            case 'metrics':
              res = await api.analyzeMetrics(pid, '');
              break;
            case 'decisions':
              res = await api.analyzeDecisions(pid, '');
              break;
          }
          
          try {
            console.log(`[Analyze${type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1)}] queued:`, res);
          } catch {}
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(`[Analyze${type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1)}] failed:`, error);
        }
      };
    },
    [genaiChat, waitForWsSubscribed],
  );

  return {
    handleAnalyzeEntities: createAnalyzeHandler('entities'),
    handleAnalyzeFacts: createAnalyzeHandler('facts'),
    handleAnalyzeEvents: createAnalyzeHandler('events'),
    handleAnalyzeMetrics: createAnalyzeHandler('metrics'),
    handleAnalyzeDecisions: createAnalyzeHandler('decisions'),
  };
}

Файл: useAutoScroll.ts
Путь: src/hooks/useAutoScroll.ts
================================================================================

import { useEffect, RefObject, useRef } from 'react';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';

/**
 * Hook для автоматической прокрутки контейнера вниз при изменении зависимостей
 */
export function useAutoScroll(
  containerRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement>,
  dependencies: any[]
) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (containerRef.current) {
      containerRef.current.scrollTop = containerRef.current.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, dependencies);
}

/**
 * Hook для автоматической прокрутки с задержкой (для гидратации)
 */
export function useAutoScrollDelayed(
  containerRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement>,
  dependencies: any[]
) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (dependencies[0] > 0 && containerRef.current) {
      // Small delay to ensure DOM has updated
      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        if (containerRef.current) {
          containerRef.current.scrollTop = containerRef.current.scrollHeight;
        }
      }, 100);
      return () => clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    }
  }, dependencies);
}

/**
 * Комплексный хук для автоматической прокрутки с поддержкой:
 * - Прокрутки при изменении проекта
 * - Прокрутки после гидратации
 * - Прокрутки при новых взаимодействиях
 * - Прокрутки при завершении стриминга
 */
export function useAdvancedAutoScroll(
  containerRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>,
  options?: {
    interactionsLength?: number;
    streaming?: boolean;
    hydrating?: boolean;
    projectId?: string | null;
  }
) {
  const lastScrollInteractionLength = useRef<number>(0);
  const lastScrollStreamingState = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const lastProjectIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore();
  const genaiChatInteractionsLength = useGenaiChatStore(
    (state) => state.interactions.length,
  );
  const genaiChatStreaming = useGenaiChatStore((state) => state.streaming);
  const genaiChatHydrating = useGenaiChatStore((state) => state.hydrating);
  const genaiChatProjectId = useGenaiChatStore((state) => state.projectId);

  const interactionsLength = options?.interactionsLength ?? genaiChatInteractionsLength;
  const streaming = options?.streaming ?? genaiChatStreaming;
  const hydrating = options?.hydrating ?? genaiChatHydrating;
  const projectId = options?.projectId ?? genaiChatProjectId;

  // Auto-scroll to bottom when switching to another chat/project
  useEffect(() => {
    if (projectId && projectId !== lastProjectIdRef.current) {
      // Project changed - scroll to bottom after a short delay to ensure DOM is updated
      lastProjectIdRef.current = projectId;
      // Reset scroll position tracking for new project
      lastScrollInteractionLength.current = 0;
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (containerRef.current) {
          containerRef.current.scrollTop = containerRef.current.scrollHeight;
        }
      }, 100);
    }
  }, [projectId, containerRef]);

  // Auto-scroll to bottom after hydration completes (when interactions are loaded)
  // Only scroll if this is the initial load (lastScrollInteractionLength is 0)
  // Don't scroll if hydration completes after updating existing interactions (e.g., pinning)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hydrating && interactionsLength > 0 && containerRef.current) {
      // Only scroll if this is the first load (no interactions were tracked before)
      // This prevents scrolling when updating existing interactions (like pinning)
      if (lastScrollInteractionLength.current === 0) {
        // Small delay to ensure DOM has rendered
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (containerRef.current) {
            containerRef.current.scrollTop = containerRef.current.scrollHeight;
          }
        }, 50);
        // Update tracked length after initial scroll
        lastScrollInteractionLength.current = interactionsLength;
      } else {
        // Update tracked length even if we don't scroll (for consistency)
        lastScrollInteractionLength.current = interactionsLength;
      }
    }
  }, [hydrating, interactionsLength, containerRef]);

  // Auto-scroll on new interactions or when streaming completes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;

    const currentLength = interactionsLength;
    const currentStreaming = streaming;

    // Scroll when new interaction is added (length increased)
    if (currentLength > lastScrollInteractionLength.current) {
      lastScrollInteractionLength.current = currentLength;
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (containerRef.current) {
          containerRef.current.scrollTop = containerRef.current.scrollHeight;
        }
      });
      return;
    }

    // Scroll when streaming completes (was streaming, now stopped)
    if (
      lastScrollStreamingState.current &&
      !currentStreaming &&
      currentLength > 0
    ) {
      lastScrollStreamingState.current = currentStreaming;
      // Small delay to ensure DOM has updated after streaming completes
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (containerRef.current && !streaming) {
          containerRef.current.scrollTop = containerRef.current.scrollHeight;
        }
      }, 50);
      return;
    }

    lastScrollStreamingState.current = currentStreaming;
  }, [interactionsLength, streaming, containerRef]);
}

export function useChatManagement() {
  const [experimentalResponse, setExperimentalResponse] = useState<ExperimentalResponse | null>(null);
  const [experimentalLoading, setExperimentalLoading] = useState(false);
  const lastUserMessageIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  );
  
  const getInteractions = useCallback(
    () => useGenaiChatStore.getState().interactions,
    [],
  );

  // Clear text tasks and experimental response when project changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setTextTasks([]);
    setTextTasksApplying(false);
    setExperimentalResponse(null);
    setExperimentalLoading(false);
    lastUserMessageIdRef.current = null;
  }, [projectId]);

  // Track new user messages and generate experimental response when panel is open
  useEffect(() => {
    const rightPanelType = null; // This should come from props or context
    if (rightPanelType !== 'experimental') return;
    
    const interactions = getInteractions();
    const userInteractions = interactions.filter(
      (it: any) => it.kind === 'user',
    );
    if (userInteractions.length === 0) return;
    
    const lastUserInteraction = userInteractions[userInteractions.length - 1];
    const messageId = lastUserInteraction.id;
    
    if (
      !messageId ||
      messageId === lastUserMessageIdRef.current ||
      !lastUserInteraction.content?.trim()
    ) {
      return;
    }
    
    lastUserMessageIdRef.current = messageId;
    setExperimentalLoading(true);
    
    generateExperimentalResponse(lastUserInteraction.content, messageId)
      .then((response) => {
        if (response) {
          setExperimentalResponse(response);
        }
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        console.error('[ExperimentalResponse] Failed to generate', error);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        setExperimentalLoading(false);
      });
  }, [userInteractionsCount, getInteractions]);

  const handleAddTextTask = useCallback((task: TextTask) => {
    setTextTasks((prev) => {
      if (prev.some((t) => t.id === task.id)) {
        return prev;
      }
      return [...prev, task];
    });
  }, []);

  const handleRemoveTextTask = useCallback((taskId: string) => {
    setTextTasks((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== taskId));
  }, []);

  const handleApplyTextTasks = useCallback(() => {
    if (textTasks.length === 0) return;
    setTextTasksApplying(true);
    try {
      const container = document.getElementById('unfold-request-container');
      if (container) {
        const textarea = container.querySelector(
          'textarea',
        ) as HTMLTextAreaElement;
        if (textarea) {
          const numberedList = textTasks
            .map((task, idx) => `${idx + 1}. ${task.prompt}`)
            .join('\n');
          
          const nativeInputValueSetter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(
            window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,
            'value',
          )?.set;
          if (nativeInputValueSetter) {
            nativeInputValueSetter.call(textarea, numberedList);
          } else {
            textarea.value = numberedList;
          }
          const inputEvent = new Event('input', { bubbles: true });
          textarea.dispatchEvent(inputEvent);
          textarea.focus();
          setTimeout(() => {
            textarea.setSelectionRange(
              textarea.value.length,
              textarea.value.length,
            );
          }, 0);
        }
      }
      setTextTasks([]);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[DiscoveryPage] Failed to apply text tasks', e);
    } finally {
      setTextTasksApplying(false);
    }
  }, [textTasks]);

  return {
    experimentalResponse,
    setExperimentalResponse,
    experimentalLoading,
    setExperimentalLoading,
    textTasks,
    setTextTasks,
    textTasksApplying,
    handleAddTextTask,
    handleRemoveTextTask,
    handleApplyTextTasks,
  };
}

Файл: useChatMessages.ts
Путь: src/hooks/useChatMessages.ts

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';

export type MergedItem = { 
  type: 'message' | 'interaction'; 
  data: any; 
  timestamp: number; 
};

/**
 * Hook для объединения messages и interactions с правильной сортировкой
 */
export function useChatMessages() {
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore();
  const genaiChatStreaming = useGenaiChatStore((state) => state.streaming);

  const mergedItems = useMemo(() => {
    const merged: MergedItem[] = [];

    // Add interactions first (user, assistant, and section markers)
    // This ensures interactions are processed before messages during streaming
    // Exclude perspective interactions (kind='note' with subkind starting with 'perspective.')
    genaiChat.interactions
      .filter((it) => {
        // Exclude perspective interactions
        if (it.kind === 'note' && typeof it.subkind === 'string' && it.subkind.startsWith('perspective.')) {
          return false;
        }
        // Exclude perspective analysis interactions
        if (it.kind === 'system' && typeof it.subkind === 'string' && it.subkind.startsWith('perspective.') && it.subkind.endsWith('.analysis')) {
          return false;
        }
        return it.kind === 'user' || it.kind === 'assistant' || it.kind === 'action' || it.kind === 'section_start' || it.kind === 'section_end';
      })
      .forEach((it) => {
        let ts = 0;
        // First, try to get timestamp from originalMessageId (for messages created during streaming)
        // This ensures user and assistant messages from the same stream have consistent timestamps
        try {
          const originalMsgId = (it as any).originalMessageId;
          if (originalMsgId && typeof originalMsgId === 'string') {
            const parsedTs = parseInt(originalMsgId.split('-')[0]);
            if (!Number.isNaN(parsedTs) && parsedTs > 0) {
              ts = parsedTs;
            }
          }
        } catch {}
        // Fallback to createdAt if originalMessageId timestamp not available
        if (ts === 0) {
          try {
            const ca: any = (it as any).createdAt;
            if (ca && typeof ca.seconds === 'number') {
              ts = ca.seconds * 1000;
            } else if (typeof ca === 'string') {
              const d = Date.parse(ca);
              if (!Number.isNaN(d)) ts = d;
            } else if (typeof ca === 'number') {
              ts = ca;
            }
          } catch {}
        }
        merged.push({ type: 'interaction', data: it, timestamp: ts });
      });

    // Add filtered messages (only during streaming, and not already in interactions)
    // These are typically assistant messages that are being streamed
    if (genaiChatStreaming) {
      genaiChat.messages.forEach((m) => {
        const hasInteraction = genaiChat.interactions.some((it) => 
          (it as any).originalMessageId === m.id || it.id === m.id
        );
        if (!hasInteraction) {
          // Parse timestamp from id (format: "timestamp-role")
          // Use Date.now() as fallback to ensure new messages appear at the end, not at the beginning
          const parsedTs = parseInt(m.id.split('-')[0]);
          const ts = (!Number.isNaN(parsedTs) && parsedTs > 0) ? parsedTs : Date.now();
          merged.push({ type: 'message', data: m, timestamp: ts });
        }
      });
    }

    // Sort by timestamp; on ties, ensure user appears before assistant/other
    const priority = (item: MergedItem) => {
      try {
        if (item.type === 'interaction') {
          const k = String(item.data?.kind || '').toLowerCase();
          if (k === 'user') return 1;
          if (k === 'assistant') return 3;
          return 2; // section markers, action
        } else {
          const r = String(item.data?.role || '').toLowerCase();
          return r === 'user' ? 1 : 3;
        }
      } catch { return 2; }
    };
    merged.sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.timestamp !== b.timestamp) return a.timestamp - b.timestamp;
      return priority(a) - priority(b);
    });

    return merged;
  }, [genaiChat.interactions, genaiChat.messages, genaiChatStreaming]);

  return mergedItems;
}

Файл: useChatTimers.ts
Путь: src/hooks/useChatTimers.ts
================================================================================

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { useGenAISettings } from '../stores/genaiSettingsStore';
import { getAverageTiming } from '../lib/timingCache';
import { mapAliasToModel } from '../lib/modelMapping';

/**
 * Hook для управления таймерами чата
 */
export function useChatTimers() {
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore();
  const genaiSettings = useGenAISettings();
  const genaiChatStreaming = useGenaiChatStore((state) => state.streaming);
  const genaiThinkingIntervalRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const [genaiThinkingSeconds, setGenaiThinkingSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [averageTimingSeconds, setAverageTimingSeconds] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // GenAI thinking seconds timer: runs until first chunk arrives
  useEffect(() => {
    const msgs = useGenaiChatStore.getState().messages;
    const last = msgs[msgs.length - 1];
    // Check if we're waiting for the first chunk: streaming is active, last message is assistant, and content is empty
    const awaitingFirstChunk = !!(genaiChatStreaming && last && last.role === 'assistant' && !last.content);
    
    if (awaitingFirstChunk) {
      // Start timer if not already running
      if (!genaiThinkingIntervalRef.current) {
        setGenaiThinkingSeconds(0);
        genaiThinkingIntervalRef.current = window.setInterval(() => {
          setGenaiThinkingSeconds((s) => s + 1);
        }, 1000) as unknown as number;
        
        // Fetch average timing estimate (without token count) - cached for 30 minutes
        const modelMapping = mapAliasToModel(genaiSettings.model);
        if (modelMapping) {
          getAverageTiming(modelMapping.provider, modelMapping.model)
            .then((timing) => {
              setAverageTimingSeconds(timing);
            })
            .catch((err) => {
              console.error('[useChatTimers] Failed to get average timing:', err);
              setAverageTimingSeconds(null);
            });
        } else {
          setAverageTimingSeconds(null);
        }
      }
    } else {
      // Stop timer when first chunk arrives or streaming stops
      if (genaiThinkingIntervalRef.current) {
        window.clearInterval(genaiThinkingIntervalRef.current);
        genaiThinkingIntervalRef.current = null;
        // Don't reset averageTimingSeconds here - keep it until next request
      }
    }
  }, [genaiChatStreaming, genaiChat.messages.length, genaiSettings.model]);

  // Cleanup genai thinking timer on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (genaiThinkingIntervalRef.current) {
        window.clearInterval(genaiThinkingIntervalRef.current);
        genaiThinkingIntervalRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  return {
    genaiThinkingSeconds,
    averageTimingSeconds,
  };
}

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';

export type MergedItem = {
  type: 'message' | 'interaction';
  data: any;
  timestamp: number;
};

/**
 * Хук для подготовки объединенного списка сообщений и взаимодействий
 */
export function useMergedMessages() {
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore();
  const streaming = genaiChat.streaming;

  return useMemo(() => {
    const merged: MergedItem[] = [];

    // Add interactions first (user, assistant, and section markers)
    // This ensures interactions are processed before messages during streaming
    // Exclude perspective interactions (kind='note' with subkind starting with 'perspective.')
    genaiChat.interactions
      .filter((it) => {
        // Exclude perspective interactions
        if (
          it.kind === 'note' &&
          typeof it.subkind === 'string' &&
          it.subkind.startsWith('perspective.')
        ) {
          return false;
        }
        // Exclude perspective analysis interactions
        if (
          it.kind === 'system' &&
          typeof it.subkind === 'string' &&
          it.subkind.startsWith('perspective.') &&
          it.subkind.endsWith('.analysis')
        ) {
          return false;
        }
        // Exclude document attachments (they are context, not chat content)
        if (it.subkind === 'document.attach') {
          return false;
        }
        return (
          it.kind === 'user' ||
          it.kind === 'assistant' ||
          it.kind === 'action' ||
          it.kind === 'section_start' ||
          it.kind === 'section_end'
        );
      })
      .forEach((it) => {
        let ts = 0;
        // First, try to get timestamp from originalMessageId (for messages created during streaming)
        // This ensures user and assistant messages from the same stream have consistent timestamps
        try {
          const originalMsgId = (it as any).originalMessageId;
          if (originalMsgId && typeof originalMsgId === 'string') {
            const parsedTs = parseInt(originalMsgId.split('-')[0]);
            if (!Number.isNaN(parsedTs) && parsedTs > 0) {
              ts = parsedTs;
            }
          }
        } catch {}
        // Fallback to createdAt if originalMessageId timestamp not available
        if (ts === 0) {
          try {
            const ca: any = (it as any).createdAt;
            if (ca && typeof ca.seconds === 'number') {
              ts = ca.seconds * 1000;
            } else if (typeof ca === 'string') {
              const d = Date.parse(ca);
              if (!Number.isNaN(d)) ts = d;
            } else if (typeof ca === 'number') {
              ts = ca;
            }
          } catch {}
        }
        merged.push({
          type: 'interaction',
          data: it,
          timestamp: ts,
        });
      });

    // Add filtered messages (only during streaming, and not already in interactions)
    // These are typically assistant messages that are being streamed
    if (streaming) {
      genaiChat.messages.forEach((m) => {
        const hasInteraction = genaiChat.interactions.some(
          (it) =>
            (it as any).originalMessageId === m.id || it.id === m.id,
        );
        if (!hasInteraction) {
          // Parse timestamp from id (format: "timestamp-role")
          // Use Date.now() as fallback to ensure new messages appear at the end, not at the beginning
          const parsedTs = parseInt(m.id.split('-')[0]);
          const ts =
            !Number.isNaN(parsedTs) && parsedTs > 0 ? parsedTs : Date.now();
          merged.push({
            type: 'message',
            data: m,
            timestamp: ts,
          });
        }
      });
    }

    // Sort by timestamp; on ties, ensure user appears before assistant/other
    const priority = (item: MergedItem) => {
      try {
        if (item.type === 'interaction') {
          const k = String(item.data?.kind || '').toLowerCase();
          if (k === 'user') return 1;
          if (k === 'assistant') return 3;
          return 2; // section markers, action
        } else {
          const r = String(item.data?.role || '').toLowerCase();
          return r === 'user' ? 1 : 3;
        }
      } catch {
        return 2;
      }
    };
    merged.sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.timestamp !== b.timestamp) return a.timestamp - b.timestamp;
      return priority(a) - priority(b);
    });

    return merged;
  }, [
    genaiChat.interactions,
    genaiChat.messages,
    streaming,
  ]);
}

Файл: useModals.ts

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { api } from '../lib/api';

type ModalType = 'settings' | 'account' | 'admin' | null;
type StaticPageType = 'privacy' | 'terms' | null;

/**
 * Hook для управления модальными окнами и статическими страницами
 */
export function useModals() {
  const { currentUser } = useAuth();
  const [activeModal, setActiveModal] = useState<ModalType>(null);
  const [staticPage, setStaticPage] = useState<StaticPageType>(null);
  const [isAdmin, setIsAdmin] = useState(false);

  // Background-load user preferred language and admin status
  useEffect(() => {
    const loadUserData = async () => {
      try {
        const uid = currentUser?.uid;
        if (!uid) return;
        const user = await api.getUser(uid);
        try {
          const role = (user as any)?.role || '';
          setIsAdmin(
            typeof role === 'string' && role.toLowerCase() === 'admin',
          );
        } catch {}
        const code = (
          user?.preferredLanguage ||
          localStorage.getItem('preferredLanguage') ||
          'EN'
        ).toUpperCase();
        if (code && code.length === 2) {
          localStorage.setItem('preferredLanguage', code);
        }
      } catch {}
    };
    loadUserData();
  }, [currentUser?.uid]);

  const closeAllModals = useCallback(() => {
    setActiveModal(null);
    setStaticPage(null);
  }, []);

  const openSettings = useCallback(() => {
    closeAllModals();
    setActiveModal('settings');
  }, [closeAllModals]);

  const openAccount = useCallback(() => {
    closeAllModals();
    setActiveModal('account');
  }, [closeAllModals]);

  const openAdmin = useCallback(() => {
    closeAllModals();
    setActiveModal('admin');
  }, [closeAllModals]);

  return {
    showSettings: activeModal === 'settings',
    showAccount: activeModal === 'account',
    showAdmin: activeModal === 'admin',
    staticPage,
    setStaticPage,
    isAdmin,
    openSettings,
    openAccount,
    openAdmin,
    closeAllModals,
  };
}

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useProjectsStore } from '../stores/projectsStore';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';

export function useProjectsManagement() {
  const [editingProjectId, setEditingProjectId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editingProjectName, setEditingProjectName] = useState<string>('');
  const editingInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  
  const { currentProject, deleteProject, updateProject, setCurrentProject } = useProjectsStore();
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore();

  const resetChatState = useCallback(() => {
    genaiChat.reset();
    setCurrentProject(null);
  }, [genaiChat, setCurrentProject]);

  const handleDeleteChat = async (projectId: string, projectName: string) => {
    if (!confirm(`Delete "${projectName}"?`)) return;
    
    try {
      // Check if the deleted chat is currently open
      const isCurrentChat =
        currentProject?.id === projectId || genaiChat.projectId === projectId;
      
      await deleteProject(projectId);
      
      // If we deleted the current chat, reset it like "New Chat"
      if (isCurrentChat) {
        resetChatState();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to delete chat:', error);
    }
  };

  const handleRenameChat = async (projectId: string, newName: string) => {
    if (!newName.trim()) {
      setEditingProjectId(null);
      return;
    }
    
    try {
      await updateProject(projectId, { displayName: newName.trim() });
      setEditingProjectId(null);
      setEditingProjectName('');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to rename chat:', error);
    }
  };

  const startEditingProject = (projectId: string, currentName: string) => {
    setEditingProjectId(projectId);
    setEditingProjectName(currentName);
    setTimeout(() => {
      editingInputRef.current?.focus();
      editingInputRef.current?.select();
    }, 0);
  };

  return {
    editingProjectId,
    setEditingProjectId,
    editingProjectName,
    setEditingProjectName,
    editingInputRef,
    resetChatState,
    handleDeleteChat,
    handleRenameChat,
    startEditingProject,
  };
}

Файл: useSourcesManagement.ts
Путь: src/hooks/useSourcesManagement.ts
================================================================================

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useDiscoveryStore } from '../stores/discoveryStore';
import { useProjectsStore } from '../stores/projectsStore';
import { getPreferredLanguage } from '../lib/uiUtils';
import { api } from '../lib/api';

export function useSourcesManagement() {
  const [previewSource, setPreviewSource] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [showAddSourceMenu, setShowAddSourceMenu] = useState(false);
  const addMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const [showAddTelegramModal, setShowAddTelegramModal] = useState(false);
  const [tgInput, setTgInput] = useState('');
  const [tgSubmitting, setTgSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [tgError, setTgError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const { executeDiscovery, fetchProjectSources } = useDiscoveryStore();
  const currentProject = useProjectsStore((s) => s.currentProject);

  // Close add source menu on outside click or Escape
  useEffect(() => {
    function onDocMouseDown(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (!showAddSourceMenu) return;
      if (
        addMenuRef.current &&
        !addMenuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)
      ) {
        setShowAddSourceMenu(false);
      }
    }
    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setShowAddSourceMenu(false);
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDocMouseDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDocMouseDown);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    };
  }, [showAddSourceMenu]);

  const normalizeTelegramInput = (value: string): string | null => {
    const v = (value || '').trim();
    if (!v) return null;
    const linkMatch = v.match(
      /(?:https?:\/\/)?(?:t\.me|telegram\.me)\/([A-Za-z0-9_]{3,})/i,
    );
    if (linkMatch && linkMatch[1]) return '@' + linkMatch[1];
    const atMatch = v.match(/^@([A-Za-z0-9_]{3,})$/);
    if (atMatch && atMatch[1]) return '@' + atMatch[1];
    const bare = v.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9_]{3,})$/);
    if (bare && bare[1]) return '@' + bare[1];
    return null;
  };

  const addTelegramSource = async () => {
    setTgError(null);
    const handle = normalizeTelegramInput(tgInput);
    if (!handle) {
      setTgError('Enter @username or t.me/username');
      return;
    }
    // Pre-seed skeleton (pending source)
    const pending = {
      id: handle,
      kind: 'telegram' as const,
      status: 'fetching',
    };
    const store = useDiscoveryStore.getState();
    store.setPendingSources([...(store as any).pendingSources, pending]);
    if (currentProject?.id) {
      // Merge pending skeleton into visible list right away
      fetchProjectSources(currentProject.id);
    }

    setTgSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const lang = getPreferredLanguage();
      await executeDiscovery({
        projectId: currentProject?.id || '',
        queryText: handle, // minimal context; backend ignores for existing project
        language: lang,
        sources: { web: [], telegram: [handle] },
      });
      setShowAddTelegramModal(false);
      setTgInput('');
    } catch (e: any) {
      setTgError(e?.message || 'Failed to add channel');
    } finally {
      setTgSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const parseSourcesFromQuery = (text: string) => {
    // Normalize accidental '@' before URLs (e.g., @https://...)
    const normalized = text.trim().replace(/@(?=https?:\/\/)/g, '');
    
    // Extract URLs
    const rawUrls = [
      ...(normalized.match(
        /https?:\/\/[\w.-]+(?:\/[\w\-._~:\/?#[\]@!$&'()*+,;=%]+)?/gi,
      ) || []),
      ...(normalized.match(
        /\bwww\.[\w.-]+(?:\/[\w\-._~:\/?#[\]@!$&'()*+,;=%]+)?/gi,
      ) || []),
    ];
    
    const normalizeUrl = (u: string) => {
      let v = u.trim();
      if (/^www\./i.test(v)) v = `https://${v}`;
      v = v.replace(/[)\],.;]+$/g, ''); // Strip trailing punctuation
      return v;
    };
    
    const webSources = Array.from(new Set(rawUrls.map(normalizeUrl)));

    // Extract Telegram handles
    const tgHandles = new Set<string>();
    
    // t.me / telegram.me links
    const tgLinks =
      normalized.match(
        /(?:https?:\/\/)?(?:t\.me|telegram\.me)\/([A-Za-z0-9_]{3,})/gi,
      ) || [];
    tgLinks.forEach((m) => {
      const grp = m.match(/(?:t\.me|telegram\.me)\/([A-Za-z0-9_]{3,})/i);
      if (grp && grp[1]) tgHandles.add(`@${grp[1]}`);
    });
    
    // @username tokens
    const ats = normalized.match(/(^|\s)@([A-Za-z0-9_]{3,})\b/g) || [];
    ats.forEach((m) => {
      const grp = m.match(/@([A-Za-z0-9_]{3,})/);
      if (grp && grp[1]) tgHandles.add(`@${grp[1]}`);
    });

    return {
      web: webSources,
      telegram: Array.from(tgHandles),
    };
  };

  return {
    previewSource,
    setPreviewSource,
    showAddSourceMenu,
    setShowAddSourceMenu,
    addMenuRef,
    showAddTelegramModal,
    setShowAddTelegramModal,
    tgInput,
    setTgInput,
    tgSubmitting,
    tgError,
    addTelegramSource,
    parseSourcesFromQuery,
  };
}

Файл: useTextEditing.ts
Путь: src/hooks/useTextEditing.ts

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';

/**
 * Hook для управления состоянием редактирования текста
 */
export function useTextEditing() {
  const [frozenEdits, setFrozenEdits] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [editErrors, setEditErrors] = useState<Record<string, string | null>>({});
  const [editLast, setEditLast] = useState<Record<string, { selected: string; request: string }>>({});
  const [editSeconds, setEditSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [editHighlight, setEditHighlight] = useState<Record<string, { start: number; end: number }>>({});

  // Timer для отслеживания времени редактирования
  useEffect(() => {
    const anyFrozen = Object.values(frozenEdits).some(Boolean);
    if (!anyFrozen) {
      setEditSeconds(0);
      return;
    }
    const id = window.setInterval(() => setEditSeconds((s) => s + 1), 1000);
    return () => {
      window.clearInterval(id);
    };
  }, [frozenEdits]);

  const handleEditStart = useCallback((interactionId: string) => {
    setFrozenEdits((s) => ({ ...s, [interactionId]: true }));
  }, []);

  const handleEditFinish = useCallback((interactionId: string) => {
    setFrozenEdits((s) => ({ ...s, [interactionId]: false }));
  }, []);

  const handleEditError = useCallback((interactionId: string, error: string) => {
    setEditErrors((s) => ({ ...s, [interactionId]: error }));
  }, []);

  const handleEditUpdate = useCallback((interactionId: string, newContent: string) => {
    useGenaiChatStore.setState(
      (s) =>
        ({
          interactions: s.interactions.map((x) =>
            x.id === interactionId
              ? { ...x, contentSanitized: newContent }
              : x,
          ),
        }) as any,
    );
    setEditErrors((s) => ({ ...s, [interactionId]: null }));
  }, []);

  const handleSaveRequest = useCallback((interactionId: string, selectedText: string, request: string) => {
    setEditLast((s) => ({
      ...s,
      [interactionId]: { selected: selectedText, request },
    }));
  }, []);

  return {
    frozenEdits,
    editErrors,
    editLast,
    editSeconds,
    editHighlight,
    setEditHighlight,
    handleEditStart,
    handleEditFinish,
    handleEditError,
    handleEditUpdate,
    handleSaveRequest,
  };
}
