/**
 * Хук для управления выделением текста и плавающей кнопкой редактирования
 * Вынесено из DiscoveryPage для улучшения читаемости и переиспользования
 */

import { useEffect, useRef, RefObject } from 'react';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { handleEditTextWithPalette, EditTextOptions } from '../lib/textEditHandler';

export interface UseTextSelectionOptions {
  containerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  onEditStart?: (interactionId: string) => void;
  onEditFinish?: (interactionId: string) => void;
  onEditError?: (interactionId: string, error: string) => void;
  onEditUpdate?: (interactionId: string, newContent: string) => void;
  onSaveRequest?: (interactionId: string, selectedText: string, request: string) => void;
}

export function useTextSelection(options: UseTextSelectionOptions) {
  const {
    containerRef,
    onEditStart,
    onEditFinish,
    onEditError,
    onEditUpdate,
  } = options;

  const selectionBtnRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const selectionMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const isSelectingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);

  function isNodeInside(el: Node | null, root: HTMLElement): boolean {
    if (!el) return false;
    const element =
      el.nodeType === 3
        ? (el.parentElement as HTMLElement | null)
        : (el as HTMLElement);
    return !!element && (element === root || root.contains(element));
  }

  // Создание плавающей кнопки
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectionBtnRef.current) {
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Selection action');
      btn.setAttribute('title', 'Selection action');
      btn.tabIndex = -1;
      Object.assign(btn.style, {
        position: 'fixed',
        width: '28px',
        height: '28px',
        borderRadius: '9999px',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)',
        border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
        color: 'var(--text-heading)',
        display: 'none',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        zIndex: '60',
        boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)',
        userSelect: 'none',
      } as CSSStyleDeclaration);
      btn.innerHTML =
        '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';
      btn.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
      });
      btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
        if (selectionBtnRef.current)
          selectionBtnRef.current.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-10)';
      });
      btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        if (selectionBtnRef.current)
          selectionBtnRef.current.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--bg-elevated)';
      });
      document.body.appendChild(btn);
      selectionBtnRef.current = btn as HTMLButtonElement;
    }

    return () => {
      if (selectionBtnRef.current?.parentElement) {
        selectionBtnRef.current.parentElement.removeChild(
          selectionBtnRef.current,
        );
        selectionBtnRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  // Создание плавающего меню
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectionMenuRef.current) {
      const menu = document.createElement('div');
      Object.assign(menu.style, {
        position: 'fixed',
        display: 'none',
        gap: '6px',
        padding: '6px',
        borderRadius: '10px',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)',
        border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
        boxShadow: '0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)',
        zIndex: '61',
        alignItems: 'center',
      } as CSSStyleDeclaration);

      const mkBtn = (label: string, icon: 'edit' | 'note') => {
        const b = document.createElement('button');
        b.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        Object.assign(b.style, {
          fontSize: '12px',
          lineHeight: '18px',
          padding: '4px 8px',
          borderRadius: '8px',
          background: 'transparent',
          color: 'var(--text-heading)',
          border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
          display: 'inline-flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: '6px',
        } as CSSStyleDeclaration);

        // Build icon using SVG namespace
        const ns = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
        const svg = document.createElementNS(ns, 'svg');
        svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 24 24');
        svg.setAttribute('width', '14');
        svg.setAttribute('height', '14');
        svg.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
        svg.setAttribute('stroke', 'currentColor');
        svg.setAttribute('stroke-width', '2');
        svg.setAttribute('stroke-linecap', 'round');
        svg.setAttribute('stroke-linejoin', 'round');

        if (icon === 'edit') {
          const p1 = document.createElementNS(ns, 'path');
          p1.setAttribute('d', 'M3 21l3-1 11-11-2-2L4 18l-1 3z');
          const p2 = document.createElementNS(ns, 'path');
          p2.setAttribute('d', 'M14 4l2 2');
          svg.appendChild(p1);
          svg.appendChild(p2);
        } else {
          const rect = document.createElementNS(ns, 'rect');
          rect.setAttribute('x', '4');
          rect.setAttribute('y', '3');
          rect.setAttribute('width', '16');
          rect.setAttribute('height', '18');
          rect.setAttribute('rx', '2');
          const p1 = document.createElementNS(ns, 'path');
          p1.setAttribute('d', 'M12 8v8');
          const p2 = document.createElementNS(ns, 'path');
          p2.setAttribute('d', 'M8 12h8');
          svg.appendChild(rect);
          svg.appendChild(p1);
          svg.appendChild(p2);
        }

        const labelSpan = document.createElement('span');
        labelSpan.textContent = label;
        b.appendChild(svg);
        b.appendChild(labelSpan);
        b.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
        });

        if (icon === 'edit') {
          b.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            try {
              const sel = window.getSelection();
              if (!sel || sel.isCollapsed || sel.rangeCount === 0) return;
              const range = sel.getRangeAt(0);
              const startEl = (
                range.startContainer.nodeType === 3
                  ? range.startContainer.parentElement
                  : (range.startContainer as Element)
              ) as Element | null;
              if (!startEl) return;
              const markdownRoot = startEl.closest(
                '.markdown',
              ) as HTMLElement | null;
              if (!markdownRoot) return;
              const interId =
                markdownRoot.getAttribute('data-interaction-id') || '';
              const selectedText = sel.toString();
              const store = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
              const inter = store.interactions.find((it) => it.id === interId);
              if (!inter) return;

              const full = (
                inter?.contentSanitized ||
                inter?.content ||
                ''
              ).toString();
              const displayed = (markdownRoot.innerText || '').toString();
              const meta = store.messageMeta[interId];
              const agentName = meta?.headerText || 'agent';
              const prof = meta?.agentProfile;

              const editOptions: EditTextOptions = {
                interactionId: interId,
                selectedText,
                fullText: full,
                displayedText: displayed,
                agentName,
                agentProfile: prof,
                onUpdate: (id, newContent) => {
                  if (onEditUpdate) {
                    onEditUpdate(id, newContent);
                  } else {
                    useGenaiChatStore.setState(
                      (s) =>
                        ({
                          interactions: s.interactions.map((x) =>
                            x.id === id
                              ? { ...x, contentSanitized: newContent }
                              : x,
                          ),
                        }) as any,
                    );
                  }
                },
                onError: (id, error) => {
                  if (onEditError) {
                    onEditError(id, error);
                  }
                },
                onStart: (id) => {
                  if (onEditStart) {
                    onEditStart(id);
                  }
                },
                onFinish: (id) => {
                  if (onEditFinish) {
                    onEditFinish(id);
                  }
                },
                onSaveRequest: options.onSaveRequest,
              };

              await handleEditTextWithPalette(editOptions);
            } catch (e: any) {
              console.warn('Edit selection failed', e);
            }
          });
        }

        return b;
      };

      const editBtn = mkBtn('Ask to edit selected', 'edit');
      const notesBtn = mkBtn('Add to Notes', 'note');

      // Wire Add to Notes
      if (notesBtn) {
        notesBtn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          try {
            const sel = window.getSelection?.()?.toString()?.trim() || '';
            if (!sel) {
              console.warn('[AddToNotes] No selection found');
              return;
            }
            const range = document.getSelection()?.getRangeAt(0);
            const startEl = range
              ? ((range.startContainer.nodeType === 3
                  ? range.startContainer.parentElement
                  : (range.startContainer as Element)) as Element | null)
              : null;
            const interId =
              startEl
                ?.closest('.markdown')
                ?.getAttribute('data-interaction-id') || '';
            if (!interId) {
              console.warn('[AddToNotes] No interaction ID found');
              return;
            }
            const store = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
            const it = store.interactions.find((x: any) => x.id === interId);
            if (!it) {
              console.warn('[AddToNotes] Interaction not found', {
                interId,
                availableIds: store.interactions
                  .map((x: any) => x.id)
                  .slice(0, 5),
              });
              return;
            }
            const projectId = store.projectId;
            if (!projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') {
              console.warn('[AddToNotes] Invalid project ID', { projectId });
              return;
            }
            const map = (store as any).persistedByLocalId || {};
            const serverId = map[it.id] || it.id;
            const meta = it.metadata || {};
            const notes = Array.isArray(meta.notes) ? [...meta.notes] : [];
            notes.push(sel);
            await api.updateProjectInteraction(projectId, serverId, {
              metadata: { pinned: true, notes },
            });
            await store.hydrateInteractions();
            // Hide selection UI and clear selection after successful add
            if (selectionMenuRef.current)
              selectionMenuRef.current.style.display = 'none';
            if (selectionBtnRef.current)
              selectionBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
            setTimeout(() => {
              const s = window.getSelection && window.getSelection();
              if (s && s.removeAllRanges) s.removeAllRanges();
            }, 100);
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn('[AddToNotes] failed', err);
          }
        });
      }

      menu.appendChild(editBtn);
      menu.appendChild(notesBtn);
      menu.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
      });
      document.body.appendChild(menu);
      selectionMenuRef.current = menu;
    }

    return () => {
      if (selectionMenuRef.current?.parentElement) {
        selectionMenuRef.current.parentElement.removeChild(
          selectionMenuRef.current,
        );
        selectionMenuRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [onEditStart, onEditFinish, onEditError, onEditUpdate]);

  // Обработка изменений выделения
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;
    const containerEl = container as HTMLElement;

    let selectionThrottle = 0 as any;

    function handleSelectionChange() {
      const ae = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      if (
        ae &&
        (ae.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ||
          ae.tagName === 'INPUT' ||
          ae.isContentEditable)
      ) {
        if (selectionBtnRef.current)
          selectionBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
        if (selectionMenuRef.current)
          selectionMenuRef.current.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      const now = performance.now();
      if (selectionThrottle && now - selectionThrottle < 16) return;
      selectionThrottle = now;

      if (isSelectingRef.current) {
        return;
      }

      const sel = document.getSelection();
      if (!sel || sel.isCollapsed || sel.rangeCount === 0) {
        if (selectionBtnRef.current)
          selectionBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
        if (selectionMenuRef.current)
          selectionMenuRef.current.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      const range = sel.getRangeAt(0);
      if (!range) {
        if (selectionBtnRef.current)
          selectionBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      const startEl = (
        range.startContainer.nodeType === 3
          ? range.startContainer.parentElement
          : (range.startContainer as Element)
      ) as Element | null;
      const endEl = (
        range.endContainer.nodeType === 3
          ? range.endContainer.parentElement
          : (range.endContainer as Element)
      ) as Element | null;

      if (!startEl || !endEl) {
        if (selectionBtnRef.current)
          selectionBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      if (
        !isNodeInside(startEl, containerEl) ||
        !isNodeInside(endEl, containerEl)
      ) {
        if (selectionBtnRef.current)
          selectionBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      const inMarkdown = !!(
        startEl.closest('.markdown') || endEl.closest('.markdown')
      );
      if (!inMarkdown) {
        if (selectionBtnRef.current)
          selectionBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      const rects = range.getClientRects();
      const rect = rects.length > 0 ? rects : [range.getBoundingClientRect()];
      if (!rect || rect.length === 0) {
        if (selectionBtnRef.current)
          selectionBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      let minTop = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
      let maxBottom = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
      for (let i = 0; i < rect.length; i++) {
        const r = rect[i];
        if (!r) continue;
        minTop = Math.min(minTop, r.top);
        maxBottom = Math.max(maxBottom, r.bottom);
      }

      if (!isFinite(minTop) || !isFinite(maxBottom)) {
        if (selectionBtnRef.current)
          selectionBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      const containerRect = containerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      const buttonSize = 28;
      const gap = 8;
      const top = Math.min(
        Math.max((minTop + maxBottom) / 2 - buttonSize / 2, 4),
        window.innerHeight - buttonSize - 4,
      );
      const leftCandidate = (containerRect?.left || 0) - gap - buttonSize;
      const left = Math.max(4, leftCandidate);

      if (selectionBtnRef.current) {
        selectionBtnRef.current.style.top = `${top}px`;
        selectionBtnRef.current.style.left = `${left}px`;
        selectionBtnRef.current.style.display = 'flex';
        selectionBtnRef.current.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (selectionBtnRef.current)
            selectionBtnRef.current.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
        }, 180);
      }

      if (selectionMenuRef.current) {
        selectionMenuRef.current.style.top = `${Math.round(top - 2)}px`;
        selectionMenuRef.current.style.left = `${Math.round(left + buttonSize + 8)}px`;
      }
    }

    const onScrollOrResize = () => {
      const sel = document.getSelection();
      if (!sel || sel.isCollapsed) {
        if (selectionBtnRef.current)
          selectionBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
      } else {
        handleSelectionChange();
      }
    };

    const onPointerDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const btn = selectionBtnRef.current;
      const menu = selectionMenuRef.current;
      if (btn && (e.target === btn || btn.contains(e.target as Node))) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (menu) {
          const visible = menu.style.display !== 'none';
          if (!visible) {
            const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
            const top = rect.top;
            const left = rect.right + 8;
            menu.style.top = `${Math.round(top - 2)}px`;
            menu.style.left = `${Math.round(left)}px`;
            menu.style.display = 'flex';
          } else {
            menu.style.display = 'none';
          }
        }
        return;
      }
      if (menu && (e.target === menu || menu.contains(e.target as Node))) {
        e.preventDefault();
        return;
      }
      if (menu) menu.style.display = 'none';
      setTimeout(() => handleSelectionChange(), 0);
    };

    const onContainerPointerDown = () => {
      isSelectingRef.current = true;
      if (selectionBtnRef.current)
        selectionBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
      if (selectionMenuRef.current)
        selectionMenuRef.current.style.display = 'none';
    };

    const onContainerPointerUp = () => {
      isSelectingRef.current = false;
      setTimeout(() => handleSelectionChange(), 50);
    };

    document.addEventListener('selectionchange', handleSelectionChange);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScrollOrResize, { passive: true } as any);
    window.addEventListener('resize', onScrollOrResize);
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown);
    container.addEventListener('pointerdown', onContainerPointerDown);
    container.addEventListener('pointerup', onContainerPointerUp);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('selectionchange', handleSelectionChange);
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScrollOrResize as any);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', onScrollOrResize);
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown);
      container.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onContainerPointerDown);
      container.removeEventListener('pointerup', onContainerPointerUp);
    };
  }, [containerRef]);

  return {
    selectionBtnRef,
    selectionMenuRef,
  };
}

Файл: useWebSocketConnection.ts
Путь: src/hooks/useWebSocketConnection.ts
================================================================================

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useDiscoveryStore } from '../stores/discoveryStore';

/**
 * Hook для управления WebSocket соединением
 */
export function useWebSocketConnection() {
  const { currentUser } = useAuth();
  const { connectWs } = useDiscoveryStore();
  const wsInitialized = useRef(false);

  // Separate effect for WebSocket to prevent duplicate connections
  useEffect(() => {
    if (wsInitialized.current) return;
    
    const tenantId = currentUser?.email || '';
    if (tenantId) {
      wsInitialized.current = true;
      connectWs(tenantId);
    }
  }, [currentUser?.email, connectWs]);
}

import React from 'react';

export type AgentPreset = {
  id: string;
  displayName: string;
  description: string;
  expectedOutcome?: string;
  useCases?: string[];
  provider: 'gemini' | 'openai' | 'grok' | 'claude';
  modelAlias: 'gemini_quality' | 'gemini_balanced' | 'gemini_fast' | 'gpt_quality' | 'gpt_balanced' | 'gpt_fast' | 'grok_quality' | 'grok_balanced' | 'grok_fast' | 'claude_balanced' | 'claude_fast';
  capabilities?: { tools?: boolean; webSearch?: boolean; reasoning?: boolean; refinePrevious?: boolean };
  params?: { temperature?: number; systemInstruction?: string };
  // If true, the primary model should immediately respond to this agent's reply
  requireImmediatePrimaryReply?: boolean;
  // Icon component as React element
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
};

// Two predefined presets available on the frontend without requiring backend storage.
// These can be used by UI (e.g., Bring In) to select a model for the next turn.
export const AGENT_PRESETS: AgentPreset[] = [
  {
    id: 'evidence-builder',
    displayName: 'Evidence Builder',
    description: 'Deepens and verifies AI responses by building a comprehensive evidence base through rigorous fact-checking and authoritative sources.',
    expectedOutcome: 'Enriched response with verified claims, inline citations, source list, explicit assumptions, and flagged unverifiable content.',
    useCases: ['Verify factual claims in response', 'Add authoritative sources and citations', 'Identify assumptions and limitations', 'Build evidence-based analysis'],
    provider: 'gemini',
    modelAlias: 'gemini_quality',
    capabilities: { tools: true, webSearch: true, reasoning: true, refinePrevious: true },
    params: {
      temperature: 0.3,
      systemInstruction: `You are an Evidence Builder agent. Your task is to deepen and verify AI responses by building a comprehensive evidence base.

APPROACH:
1. Review the original AI response and identify all factual claims, data points, and assertions
2. Verify each claim using authoritative sources (official statistics, peer-reviewed research, government data, reputable databases)
3. Use web search actively to find and cite verifiable sources
4. Expand on verified points with additional context and nuance
5. When using logical approximations or assumptions:
   - State them explicitly as such
   - Justify why they are reasonable
   - Explain how they were applied to the analysis
6. Flag any claims that cannot be verified or lack sufficient evidence

RESPONSE STRUCTURE:
- Begin with a deepened version of the original response, enriched with verified information
- Integrate citations naturally [1], [2], etc.
- Clearly mark any unverifiable claims or areas of uncertainty
- Maintain the same language as the original response

MANDATORY CLOSING SECTION:

---
EVIDENCE SUMMARY

Sources Used:
Format each source on a separate line with a bullet point (•). Example:
• Author, A. (Year). Title. Publisher. — Description
• Author, B. (Year). Title. URL — Description
CRITICAL: Each source MUST be on its own line. Do NOT write sources as a continuous paragraph.

Assumptions & Approximations:
• [Assumption 1]: How it was interpreted and applied
• [Assumption 2]: How it was interpreted and applied
[...]

Could Not Verify:
• [Claim that lacks sufficient evidence or reliable sources]
[...]

PRINCIPLES:
- Transparency over certainty: admit when evidence is weak
- Quality over quantity: prefer one strong source over multiple weak ones
- Context matters: consider temporal and geographical limitations of data
- No fabrication: never invent facts or sources`
    },
    requireImmediatePrimaryReply: false,
    icon: React.createElement('svg', {
      className: 'w-4 h-4',
      viewBox: '0 0 24 24',
      fill: 'none',

import axios, { AxiosInstance } from 'axios';
import { auth } from './firebase';
import type { User, Project, DataSource } from '../types';
import type { AnalyzeRequest, AnalyzeResponse } from '../types/stance';

const API_BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:8080';

class ApiClient {
  private client: AxiosInstance;

  constructor() {
    this.client = axios.create({
      baseURL: API_BASE_URL,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
    });

    // Add auth token interceptor
    this.client.interceptors.request.use(async (config) => {
      const user = auth?.currentUser;
      if (user) {
        const token = await user.getIdToken();
        config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
      }
      return config;
    });

    // Add response interceptor to handle errors
    this.client.interceptors.response.use(
      (response) => {
        // On successful response, mark server as available
        import('../stores/serverStatusStore').then(({ useServerStatusStore }) => {
          useServerStatusStore.getState().setServerAvailable();
        }).catch(() => {});
        return response;
      },
      (error) => {
        // Check if it's a network error (CORS, server down, etc.)
        if (!error.response) {
          // Network error - no response from server
          import('../stores/serverStatusStore').then(({ useServerStatusStore }) => {
            useServerStatusStore.getState().setServerUnavailable('Server is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.');
          }).catch(() => {});
        } else if (error.response.status >= 500) {
          // Server error (5xx)
          import('../stores/serverStatusStore').then(({ useServerStatusStore }) => {
            useServerStatusStore.getState().setServerUnavailable('Server error. Please try again later.');
          }).catch(() => {});
        }
        return Promise.reject(error);
      }
    );
  }

  // Waitlist
  async waitlistJoin(data: { email: string; note?: string }): Promise<{ ok: boolean }> {
    const response = await this.client.post<{ ok: boolean }>(`/api/v1/waitlist`, data);
    return response.data;
  }

  async waitlistCheck(email: string): Promise<{ found: boolean; status?: string }> {
    const response = await this.client.get<{ found: boolean; status?: string }>(`/api/v1/waitlist`, { params: { email } });
    return response.data;
  }

  async waitlistList(status?: 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected'): Promise<Array<{ id: string; email: string; status: string; note?: string; invitedBy?: string; createdAt: string; updatedAt: string }>> {
    const params = status ? { status } : {};
    const response = await this.client.get<{ items: Array<{ id: string; email: string; status: string; note?: string; invitedBy?: string; createdAt: string; updatedAt: string }> | null | undefined }>(`/api/v1/waitlist/list`, { params });
    return Array.isArray(response.data?.items) ? response.data.items : [];
  }

  async waitlistApprove(email: string): Promise<{ ok: boolean }> {
    const response = await this.client.post<{ ok: boolean }>(`/api/v1/waitlist/approve`, { email });
    return response.data;
  }

  // --- Verified URL Analysis ---
  async verifiedCreate(url: string, model?: string): Promise<{ code: string; url: string; status: string }> {
    // Use proxy endpoint (Cloud Function) instead of direct backend call
    // The proxy adds x-functions-key header for system authentication
    const proxyUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_VERIFIED_PROXY_URL;
    if (!proxyUrl) {
      throw new Error('VITE_VERIFIED_PROXY_URL is not configured. Please set it in environment variables.');
    }
    const payload: { url: string; model?: string } = { url };
    if (model) {
      payload.model = model;
    }
    const res = await axios.post(`${proxyUrl}/verified`, payload);
    return res.data as any;
  }

  async docsDownload(projectId: string, docId: string): Promise<Blob> {
    try {
      const res = await this.client.get(`/api/v1/projects/${projectId}/docs/${docId}/download`, { responseType: 'blob' });
      return res.data as Blob;
    } catch (e: any) {
      // Fallback: if server returns 400 NO_STORAGE, fetch doc and synthesize blob from extractedText
      const status = e?.response?.status;
      if (status === 400) {
        try {
          const meta = await this.client.get(`/api/v1/projects/${projectId}/docs`);
          const arr = (meta.data as any[]) || [];
          const found = arr.find((d: any) => d && (d.id === docId));
          if (found && typeof found.extractedText === 'string') {
            const ct = typeof found.contentType === 'string' && found.contentType ? found.contentType : 'application/octet-stream';
            return new Blob([found.extractedText], { type: ct });
          }
        } catch {}
      }
      throw e;
    }
  }

  async docsExportToDocx(projectId: string, docId: string): Promise<Blob> {
    const res = await this.client.post(`/api/v1/projects/${projectId}/docs/${docId}/export`, {}, { responseType: 'blob' });
    return res.data as Blob;
  }

  async suggestChatTitles(messages: Array<{ role: 'user'|'assistant'|'system'|'note'; text: string }>, language?: string): Promise<string[]> {
    const transcript = messages.map(m => `- ${m.role}: ${m.text}`).join('\n');
    const lang = (language || (localStorage.getItem('preferredLanguage') || 'EN')).toLowerCase();
    const prompt = `User requirement: you should create your answer in ${lang} language. Use English or other languages inline only if you use well-known and accepted in target language terms.\n\nYou are naming a chat based on its conversation.\n\nTranscript (most recent last):\n${transcript}\n\nTask: Propose 3 concise, specific, non-generic titles that reflect the supposed user's intent behind the conversation. Each <= 35 characters. Titles must: (1) reflect the user's specific interest in the topic overall based on the user's own requests; (2) present distinct viewpoints/angles on the user's context (not duplicates, different perspectives).\nReturn strictly JSON only, no markdown/code fences, matching this shape: { "titles": ["title1", "title2", "title3"] }.`;
    try {
      const res = await this.client.post<{ ok: boolean; result: any }>(`/api/v1/ai/structured`, {
        prompt,
        minCapabilityScore: 6,
        maxOutputSize: 512,
      });
      const obj = res.data?.result;
      const arr = Array.isArray(obj?.titles) ? obj.titles : [];
      return arr.filter((x: any) => typeof x === 'string');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

Файл: artifactPersistence.ts
Путь: src/lib/artifactPersistence.ts

import { api } from './api';
import type { SxEntityMark, SxMonitorMetric } from '../types/sx';

/**
 * Сохраняет артефакты на сервер, объединяя с существующими данными
 * @param projectId ID проекта
 * @param newEntities новые entities для добавления
 * @param newMetrics новые metrics для добавления
 */
export async function persistArtifacts(
  projectId: string,
  newEntities: SxEntityMark[],
  newMetrics: SxMonitorMetric[]
): Promise<void> {
  if (!projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') return;
  if (newEntities.length === 0 && newMetrics.length === 0) return;

  try {
    // Загружаем существующие документы
    const docs = await api.docsList(projectId);
    
    // Обрабатываем entities
    if (newEntities.length > 0) {
      const entitiesDoc = docs.find((d: any) => String(d.filename || '').toLowerCase() === 'entities.json');
      let existingEntities: any[] = [];
      
      if (entitiesDoc?.id) {
        try {
          const blob = await api.docsDownload(projectId, entitiesDoc.id);
          const text = await new Response(blob).text();
          const json = JSON.parse(text || '{}');
          existingEntities = Array.isArray(json.entities) ? json.entities : [];
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[Artifacts] Failed to load existing entities, starting fresh', e);
        }
      }
      
      // Объединяем: добавляем только новые (по name + kind/type)
      // Используем type для существующих (может быть kind в старых данных)
      const seen = new Set(existingEntities.map((e: any) => 
        `${String(e.type || e.kind || 'other').toLowerCase()}:${String(e.name || '').toLowerCase()}`
      ));
      
      const mergedEntities = [...existingEntities];
      for (const entity of newEntities) {
        const entityType = entity.kind || 'other';
        const key = `${String(entityType).toLowerCase()}:${String(entity.name || '').toLowerCase()}`;
        if (!seen.has(key)) {
          seen.add(key);
          // Преобразуем SxEntityMark в формат entities.json (используем kind как type)
          mergedEntities.push({
            name: entity.name,
            type: entityType,
            description: entity.description,
            ...(entity.aliases && entity.aliases.length > 0 ? { aliases: entity.aliases } : {}),
            ...(entity.tags && entity.tags.length > 0 ? { tags: entity.tags } : {}),
          });
        }
      }
      
      // Сохраняем обратно
      const entitiesJson = JSON.stringify({ entities: mergedEntities }, null, 2);
      await api.docsCreateFromText(projectId, {
        filename: 'entities.json',
        contentType: 'application/json',
        text: entitiesJson,
        description: 'Entities extracted from chat interactions',
      });
    }
    
    // Обрабатываем metrics
    if (newMetrics.length > 0) {
      const metricsDoc = docs.find((d: any) => String(d.filename || '').toLowerCase() === 'metrics.json');
      let existingMetrics: any[] = [];
      
      if (metricsDoc?.id) {
        try {
          const blob = await api.docsDownload(projectId, metricsDoc.id);
          const text = await new Response(blob).text();
          const json = JSON.parse(text || '{}');
          existingMetrics = Array.isArray(json.metrics) ? json.metrics : [];
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[Artifacts] Failed to load existing metrics, starting fresh', e);
        }
      }
      
      // Объединяем: добавляем только новые (по metricName/id)
      const seen = new Set(existingMetrics.map((m: any) => 
        String(m.id || m.metricName || m.label || m.key || '').toLowerCase()
      ));
      
      const mergedMetrics = [...existingMetrics];
      for (const metric of newMetrics) {
        const key = String(metric.id || metric.metricName || '').toLowerCase();
        if (key && !seen.has(key)) {
          seen.add(key);
          // Преобразуем SxMonitorMetric в формат metrics.json
          // Note: SxMonitorMetric это описание метрики для мониторинга, а не значение
          // В metrics.json хранятся фактические значения, поэтому сохраняем как есть или адаптируем
          mergedMetrics.push({
            label: metric.metricName,
            key: metric.id || metric.metricName,
            description: metric.description,
            ...(metric.unit ? { unit: metric.unit } : {}),
            ...(metric.frequency ? { frequency: metric.frequency } : {}),
            ...(metric.thresholds ? { thresholds: metric.thresholds } : {}),
            ...(metric.priority ? { priority: metric.priority } : {}),
            // Не добавляем value, так как это описание метрики, а не значение
          });
        }
      }
      
      // Сохраняем обратно
      const metricsJson = JSON.stringify({ metrics: mergedMetrics }, null, 2);
      await api.docsCreateFromText(projectId, {
        filename: 'metrics.json',
        contentType: 'application/json',
        text: metricsJson,
        description: 'Metrics extracted from chat interactions',
      });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Artifacts] Failed to persist artifacts', error);
    // Не бросаем ошибку, чтобы не прерывать основной поток
  }
}

Файл: biasEvaluation.ts
Путь: src/lib/biasEvaluation.ts

import { api } from './api';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';

/**
 * Evaluates bias and thoughtfulness for a message (user or assistant).
 * @param messageId - ID of the message to evaluate
 * @param messageRole - 'user' or 'assistant'
 * @param textToEvaluate - Content to evaluate
 * @param contextText - Optional context (user message for assistant eval, assistant reply for user eval)
 * @param evalModel - Model to use for evaluation (e.g., 'grok_fast')
 * @param preferredLang - Target language for evaluation ('ru', 'en', 'kk', etc.)
 * @returns Promise that resolves when evaluation is complete
 */
// Track message IDs for which evaluation is in progress to prevent duplicate requests
const evaluatingBias = new Set<string>();

export async function evaluateBias(params: {
  messageId: string;
  messageRole: 'user' | 'assistant';
  textToEvaluate: string;
  contextText?: string;
  evalModel: string;
  preferredLang: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  const { messageId, messageRole, textToEvaluate, contextText, evalModel, preferredLang } = params;

  // Check if evaluation is already in progress for this message
  if (evaluatingBias.has(messageId)) {
    console.log('[BiasEval] Evaluation already in progress, skipping', { messageId, messageRole });
    return;
  }

  // Check if eval.bias already exists for this message
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
  const map = (genaiChat as any).persistedByLocalId || {};
  const serverId = map[messageId] || messageId;
  const reverseMap: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  Object.entries(map).forEach(([local, server]) => {
    if (!reverseMap[server as string]) reverseMap[server as string] = [];
    reverseMap[server as string].push(local);
  });
  const localIds = reverseMap[messageId] || [];
  const existingEvalBias = [...genaiChat.interactions].reverse().find((it: any) => 
    it.subkind === 'eval.bias' && 
    (it.replyTo === messageId || (serverId && it.replyTo === serverId) || localIds.includes(it.replyTo || ''))
  );
  if (existingEvalBias) {
    console.log('[BiasEval] eval.bias already exists, skipping', { messageId, messageRole });
    return;
  }

  // Mark as evaluating
  evaluatingBias.add(messageId);

  const langName = (() => {
    switch (preferredLang) {
      case 'ru': return 'Russian';
      case 'en': return 'English';
      case 'kk':
      case 'kz': return 'Kazakh';
      default: return 'Russian';
    }
  })();

  const biasDict = [
    'confirmation_bias',
    'selection_bias',
    'framing_bias',
    'recency_bias',
    'availability_bias',
    'cultural_bias',
    'geo_linguistic_bias',
    'authority_bias',
    'safety_over_caution_skew',
    'overclaiming',
    'overgeneralization',
    'loaded_language'
  ];

  const schema = {
    type: 'object',
    additionalProperties: false,
    properties: {
      biasLevel: { type: 'number', minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
      categories: {
        type: 'array',
        minItems: 1,
        maxItems: 2,
        items: {
          type: 'object',
          additionalProperties: false,
          properties: {
            code: { type: 'string', enum: biasDict },
            explanation: { type: 'string', minLength: 10, maxLength: 600 }
          },
          required: ['code', 'explanation']
        }
      },
      thoughtfulnessLevel: { type: 'number', minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
      thoughtfulnessDimensions: {
        type: 'object',
        additionalProperties: false,
        properties: {
          analyticalDepth: { type: 'number', minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
          epistemicHumility: { type: 'number', minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
          alternativeConsideration: { type: 'number', minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
          evidenceReasoningQuality: { type: 'number', minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
          practicalGrounding: { type: 'number', minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
        },
        required: [
          'analyticalDepth',
          'epistemicHumility',
          'alternativeConsideration',
          'evidenceReasoningQuality',
          'practicalGrounding'
        ]
      }
    },
    required: ['biasLevel', 'categories', 'thoughtfulnessLevel', 'thoughtfulnessDimensions']
  } as any;

  const schemaText = JSON.stringify(schema, null, 2);
  const dictText = JSON.stringify(biasDict);

  // Build context and target blocks based on role
  const ctxBlock = contextText && contextText.trim().length > 0
    ? (messageRole === 'assistant'
        ? `USER_MESSAGE (context, do NOT evaluate this text):\n${contextText}\n\n`
        : `ASSISTANT_REPLY (context, do NOT evaluate this text):\n${contextText}\n\n`)
    : '';

  const targetBlock = messageRole === 'assistant'
    ? `ASSISTANT_REPLY (to evaluate):\n${textToEvaluate}`
    : `USER_MESSAGE (to evaluate):\n${textToEvaluate}`;

  const evalInstruction = messageRole === 'assistant'
    ? `Evaluate ONLY the ASSISTANT_REPLY both standalone and IN RELATION to USER_MESSAGE (if provided). Do NOT assess the user's content.`
    : `Evaluate ONLY the USER_MESSAGE. Do NOT assess the assistant's content.`;

  const promptEval = `In this request, you act as an external expert specializing in discussion evaluation, and you must return your assessment strictly following the provided schema in JSON format. Return ONLY JSON (no prose, no markdown, no code fences).

User requirement: you should create your answer in ${langName} language. Use English or other languages inline only if you use well-known and accepted in target language terms.

Field names (exact):
- Required: biasLevel, categories, thoughtfulnessLevel, thoughtfulnessDimensions
- categories: array of 1–2 objects, each with 'code' (from DICTIONARY) and 'explanation' (how this bias manifests in the evaluated text; 1–3 sentences).

Bias scale (biasLevel 0..1):
- 0.0–0.1: neutral; balanced alternatives; neutral language.
- 0.2–0.4: mild tilt; some alternatives missing; occasional preference.
- 0.5–0.7: pronounced tilt; one-sided argument; emotive language appears.
- 0.8–1.0: strong advocacy; ignores counterfacts; categorical claims.

THOUGHTFULNESS SCALE (0.0–1.0): Evaluate across FIVE dimensions. Each dimension must be scored in 0.1 increments. The overall thoughtfulnessLevel MUST be the MEAN of the five dimensions, rounded to one decimal (0.1).

DIMENSION 1: Analytical Depth
0.0–0.3: Surface-level; restates question; binary conclusions; no causal reasoning
0.4–0.6: Identifies 1–2 factors; basic causality; limited mechanism explanation
0.7–0.8: Multi-factor analysis; explores mechanisms; shows interactions between factors
0.9–1.0: Systems-level thinking; second-order effects; identifies non-obvious dependencies

DIMENSION 2: Epistemic Humility
0.0–0.3: Presents all claims as certainties; no acknowledgment of limits
0.4–0.6: Single hedge ("this might" / "generally") without explaining uncertainty sources
0.7–0.8: Multiple explicit uncertainty markers; names what is unknown; discusses confidence levels
0.9–1.0: Distinguishes knowns/unknowns/unknowables; explains why confidence varies; identifies what would change assessment

DIMENSION 3: Alternative Consideration
0.0–0.3: Single path; no alternatives mentioned
0.4–0.6: Mentions alternatives but doesn't explore trade-offs
0.7–0.8: Explores 2+ alternatives with explicit trade-offs for each
0.9–1.0: Compares alternatives on multiple dimensions; discusses context-dependency of choice; identifies decision criteria

DIMENSION 4: Evidence & Reasoning Quality
0.0–0.3: Assertions without support; anecdotal reasoning; logical fallacies present
0.4–0.6: Some supporting reasoning but gaps/leaps present; informal logic
0.7–0.8: Structured argument; reasoning explicit; minimal logical gaps
0.9–1.0: Rigorous reasoning chain; anticipates objections; cites evidence types (even if not specific sources); distinguishes correlation/causation

DIMENSION 5: Practical Grounding
0.0–0.3: Abstract theory only; no real-world constraints; ignores implementation
0.4–0.6: Mentions constraints but doesn't integrate them; generic recommendations
0.7–0.8: Discusses real constraints (resources, time, politics); context-specific guidance
0.9–1.0: Anticipates implementation challenges; discusses failure modes; provides decision heuristics for ambiguous cases

SCORING INSTRUCTIONS:
1) Score each dimension independently (0.0–1.0 in 0.1 increments)
2) thoughtfulnessLevel = mean(dimensions), rounded to 0.1
3) A response can score high on depth but low on humility → the average must reflect all
4) Generic LLM responses typically score 0.4–0.6 (not 0.9)
5) Reserve 0.8+ for genuinely exceptional reasoning

EXAMPLES:
Low (0.2): "Just do X. It's the best approach."
→ Depth: 0.1, Humility: 0.0, Alternatives: 0.0, Evidence: 0.2, Grounding: 0.3 = 0.12

Medium (0.5): "X is generally better because [reason]. However, Y might work in some cases."
→ Depth: 0.4, Humility: 0.5, Alternatives: 0.5, Evidence: 0.5, Grounding: 0.6 = 0.5

High (0.8): "X offers [trade-off 1] while Y provides [trade-off 2]. Choice depends on [factors]. Uncertainty exists around [specific aspect] because [reason]. In [context A], prefer X; in [context B], Y may be better. Implementation risks include [failure modes]."
→ Depth: 0.8, Humility: 0.8, Alternatives: 0.9, Evidence: 0.8, Grounding: 0.8 = 0.82

DICTIONARY for categories.code (English tokens only):
${dictText}

The JSON MUST conform EXACTLY to this schema (no additional keys, types must match):
${schemaText}

${ctxBlock}${targetBlock}

${evalInstruction} Return only the JSON.`;

  const langDirective = `You MUST produce all output strictly in ${langName} language. Use English only for technical terms or code if they are standard industry terms.`;

  const res = await api.genaiGenerate({
    model: evalModel,
    prompt: promptEval,
    strictJSONEnabled: true,
    jsonSchema: schema,
    maxOutputTokens: 4096,
    webSearchEnabled: false,
    systemInstruction: langDirective,
  });

  // Parse response
  let parsed: any = null;
  try {
    if (typeof res?.content === 'string') {
      const s = res.content.trim();
      if (s.startsWith('{') || s.startsWith('[')) parsed = JSON.parse(s);
    }
    const rawJSON = (res as any)?.rawJSON;
    if (!parsed && typeof rawJSON === 'string') {
      const s2 = rawJSON.trim();
      if (s2.startsWith('{') || s2.startsWith('[')) parsed = JSON.parse(s2);
    }
    if (!parsed && typeof res?.content === 'string') {
      const m = res.content.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
      if (m && m[0]) {
        parsed = JSON.parse(m[0]);
      }
    }
  } catch (pe) {
    console.warn('[BiasEval] parse failed', pe, { contentPreview: (res?.content || '').slice(0, 200) });
  }

  if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') {
    console.log('[BiasEval] no structured JSON parsed, skipping eval');
    return;
  }

  // Build evaluation object
  const clamp01 = (n: any) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(n) || 0));
  const dimsObj = (() => {
    try {
      const d = parsed?.thoughtfulnessDimensions || {};
      if (!d || typeof d !== 'object') return undefined;
      return {
        analyticalDepth: clamp01(d.analyticalDepth),
        epistemicHumility: clamp01(d.epistemicHumility),
        alternativeConsideration: clamp01(d.alternativeConsideration),
        evidenceReasoningQuality: clamp01(d.evidenceReasoningQuality),
        practicalGrounding: clamp01(d.practicalGrounding),
      };
    } catch { return undefined; }
  })();

  const thLevel = (() => {
    if (typeof parsed?.thoughtfulnessLevel === 'number') return clamp01(parsed.thoughtfulnessLevel);
    if (dimsObj && Object.values(dimsObj).every((v) => typeof v === 'number')) {
      const vals = Object.values(dimsObj) as number[];
      return Math.round((vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / vals.length) * 10) / 10;
    }
    return clamp01(parsed?.thoughtfulness);
  })();

  const ev = {
    biasLevel: clamp01(parsed?.biasLevel),
    thoughtfulnessLevel: thLevel,
    thoughtfulness: thLevel,
    thoughtfulnessDimensions: dimsObj,
    categories: Array.isArray(parsed?.categories)
      ? parsed.categories
          .filter((c: any) => c && typeof c.code === 'string')
          .slice(0, 2)
          .map((c: any) => ({ code: String(c.code), explanation: typeof c.explanation === 'string' ? c.explanation : '' }))
      : []
  } as any;

  // Update local state
  useGenaiChatStore.getState().setEvaluation(messageId, ev);

  // Create eval.bias interaction
  try {
    const evalId = Date.now().toString() + '-eval-bias-' + (messageRole === 'assistant' ? 'a' : 'u');
    const projectId = useGenaiChatStore.getState().projectId;

    // Add to local state first
    useGenaiChatStore.setState((s) => ({
      interactions: [
        ...s.interactions,
        {
          id: evalId,
          projectId: s.projectId,
          kind: 'system',
          subkind: 'eval.bias',
          content: JSON.stringify(ev),
          contentSanitized: JSON.stringify(ev),
          replyTo: messageId,
          relations: [{ type: 'evaluates', targetId: messageId }],
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        } as any,
      ],
    } as any));

    // Persist to server (async, don't block UI)
    if (projectId && projectId !== 'local-unfold') {
      (async () => {
        try {
          const map = (useGenaiChatStore.getState() as any).persistedByLocalId || {};
          const serverReplyTo = map[messageId] || messageId;

          const payload: any = {
            kind: 'system',
            subkind: 'eval.bias',
            content: JSON.stringify(ev),
            replyTo: serverReplyTo,
            relations: [{ type: 'evaluates', targetId: serverReplyTo }],
          };

          const res = await api.createProjectInteraction(projectId, payload);

          // Update local interaction with server ID
          useGenaiChatStore.setState((st) => {
            const items = [...st.interactions];
            const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === evalId);
            if (idx >= 0) { (items[idx] as any).id = res.id; }

            const newMap = { ...(st.persistedByLocalId || {}) } as Record<string, string>;
            newMap[evalId] = res.id;

            return { interactions: items, persistedByLocalId: newMap } as any;
          });
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[BiasEval] Failed to persist to server', e);
        }
      })();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[BiasEval] Failed to create eval.bias', e);
  } finally {
    // Always remove from evaluating set
    evaluatingBias.delete(messageId);
  }
}
