/**
 * Unified context builder for LLM requests
 * Collects context from interactions and messages, limiting to 70% of model's context window
 */

import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { getModelContextWindow, mapProviderStrengthToModel, type GenAIModel } from '../stores/genaiSettingsStore';

export interface ContextMessage {
  role: 'user' | 'assistant';
  content: string;
}

export interface BuildContextOptions {
  /**
   * Model alias to determine context window (e.g., 'gemini_fast', 'gpt_quality')
   * If not provided, uses current settings
   */
  modelAlias?: string;
  
  /**
   * Percentage of context window to use (default: 0.7 = 70%)
   */
  contextPercentage?: number;
  
  /**
   * Whether to exclude certain interaction kinds (e.g., 'note' with specific subkinds)
   */
  excludeKinds?: Array<{ kind: string; subkindPattern?: string }>;
  
  /**
   * Whether to include agent messages (messages with agentProfile)
   */
  includeAgents?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Builds context transcript from interactions and messages, limiting to specified percentage of context window
 * 
 * @param options - Configuration options
 * @returns Object with transcript string and metadata
 */
export function buildContext(options: BuildContextOptions = {}): {
  transcript: string;
  messages: ContextMessage[];
  tokenCount: number;
  charCount: number;
  maxTokens: number;
} {
  const {
    modelAlias,
    contextPercentage = 0.7,
    excludeKinds = [],
    includeAgents = true,
  } = options;

  // Get model and context window
  let contextWindow: number;
  if (modelAlias) {
    contextWindow = getModelContextWindow(modelAlias as GenAIModel);
  } else {
    const { useGenAISettings } = require('../stores/genaiSettingsStore');
    const settings = useGenAISettings.getState();
    const alias = mapProviderStrengthToModel(settings.provider, settings.strength);
    contextWindow = getModelContextWindow(alias);
  }
  
  const maxContextTokens = contextWindow ? Math.floor(contextWindow * contextPercentage) : Infinity;
  const maxChars = Math.floor(maxContextTokens * 4); // Rough estimate: ~4 chars per token

  // Get interactions and messages
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
  const interactions = genaiChat.interactions || [];
  const messages = genaiChat.messages || [];

  // Collect messages from interactions first (they are persisted)
  const contextMessages: ContextMessage[] = [];
  
  // Process interactions
  interactions.forEach((it: any) => {
    if (!it) return;
    
    // Check exclusions
    const shouldExclude = excludeKinds.some(excl => {
      if (it.kind !== excl.kind) return false;
      if (excl.subkindPattern && typeof it.subkind === 'string') {
        return it.subkind.startsWith(excl.subkindPattern);
      }
      return true;
    });
    if (shouldExclude) return;
    
    // Include user and assistant interactions
    if (it.kind === 'user' || it.kind === 'assistant') {
      const isUser = it.kind === 'user';
      const text = String(it.content || '').trim();
      if (text) {
        contextMessages.push({
          role: isUser ? 'user' : 'assistant',
          content: text,
        });
      }
    }
  });

  // Fallback to messages if we don't have enough interactions
  if (contextMessages.length < 3 && messages.length > 0) {
    messages.forEach((m: any) => {
      const text = String(m?.content || '').trim();
      if (!text) return;
      
      const role = String(m?.role || '').toLowerCase();
      const isUser = role === 'user' || role === 'discovery.query';
      const isAssistant = role === 'assistant' || role === 'discovery.answer' || role === 'note';
      
      // Include agent messages if requested
      const hasAgentProfile = includeAgents && (m as any).agentProfile;
      
      if ((isUser || isAssistant || hasAgentProfile) && text) {
        // Avoid duplicates - check if we already have this content
        const isDuplicate = contextMessages.some(
          cm => cm.content === text && cm.role === (isUser ? 'user' : 'assistant')
        );
        if (!isDuplicate) {
          contextMessages.push({
            role: isUser ? 'user' : 'assistant',
            content: text,
          });
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // Filter to fit within context limit (take from the end)
  let totalChars = 0;
  const selectedMessages: ContextMessage[] = [];
  
  // Go backwards from the end until we hit the limit
  for (let i = contextMessages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const msg = contextMessages[i];
    const msgChars = msg.content.length;
    
    // Stop if adding this message would exceed limit (but allow at least one message)
    if (totalChars + msgChars > maxChars && selectedMessages.length > 0) {
      break;
    }
    
    selectedMessages.unshift(msg);
    totalChars += msgChars;
  }

  // Build transcript
  const transcript = selectedMessages.map(m => `${m.role}: ${m.content}`).join('\n\n');
  const tokenCount = Math.ceil(totalChars / 4);

  return {
    transcript,
    messages: selectedMessages,
    tokenCount,
    charCount: totalChars,
    maxTokens: maxContextTokens,
  };
}




================================================================================
Файл: discussionFlowAnalysis.ts
Путь: src/lib/discussionFlowAnalysis.ts
================================================================================

import { api } from './api';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { useGenAISettings, getModelContextWindow } from '../stores/genaiSettingsStore';
import { getPreferredLanguage, getLanguageName } from './uiUtils';

// Track generation in progress to prevent duplicate requests
const generatingAnalyses = new Set<string>();

/**
 * Check if analysis generation is in progress for a given project
 */
export function isGeneratingDiscussionFlowAnalysis(projectId: string, messageCount: number): boolean {
  const analysisKey = `${projectId}:${messageCount}`;
  return generatingAnalyses.has(analysisKey);
}

export interface BlindSpot {
  text: string;
  practical_relevance: number; // 0..1
}

export interface ThinkingType {
  type: 'exploratory' | 'decision-making' | 'explanatory' | 'validating' | 'synthesizing' | 'planning' | 'argumentative' | 'modeling' | 'communication' | 'tool-making';
  score: number; // 0..1
  manifestation?: string; // Brief explanation of how this thinking type manifests in the discussion text (1-2 sentences, max 300 chars)
}

export interface DiscussionFlowAnalysis {
  blindSpots: BlindSpot[];
  frameShiftRecommendations: string[];
  frame: string;
  confidence: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
  thinkingTypes?: ThinkingType[]; // Up to 2 dominant thinking types with scores
  // Assistant stance and risk profile (from eval.stance)
  assistantStance?: string;
  assistantRiskProfile?: {
    score: number;
    level: 'High' | 'Medium' | 'Low';
    rationale: string;
    triggerCategories: string[];
  };
}

/**
 * Generates structured analysis for discussion flow (blind spots, frame shift recommendations, frame, confidence).
 * Creates an interaction with subkind 'discussion.flow.analysis'.
 * 
 * @param projectId - Project ID
 * @param chatMessages - Array of chat messages (user, assistant, agent only)
 * @param existingAnalysis - Previous analysis if exists (for incremental update)
 * @param lastPair - Last pair of messages (user message and assistant/agent response) for incremental update
 * @returns Promise that resolves when analysis generation is complete
 */
export async function generateDiscussionFlowAnalysis(
  projectId: string,
  chatMessages: Array<{ role: string; content: string }>,
  existingAnalysis?: DiscussionFlowAnalysis | null,
  lastPair?: Array<{ role: string; content: string }>
): Promise<void> {
  if (!projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') {
    console.log('[DiscussionFlowAnalysis] Skipping for local project');
    return;
  }

  // Check if generation is already in progress
  const analysisKey = `${projectId}:${chatMessages.length}`;
  if (generatingAnalyses.has(analysisKey)) {
    return;
  }

  // Check if analysis interaction already exists
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
  const analysisSubkind = 'discussion.flow.analysis';
  const existingAnalysisInteraction = genaiChat.interactions.find((it) => 
    it.subkind === analysisSubkind && it.projectId === projectId
  );

  // Only skip if we have existing interaction AND not doing incremental update AND not forcing refresh
  // Allow regeneration when existingAnalysis is explicitly null (refresh case) or undefined (new generation)
  // Skip only if existingAnalysisInteraction exists AND we're not doing incremental update AND existingAnalysis is not null/undefined
  const isRefresh = existingAnalysis === null; // Explicit null means refresh
  const isIncremental = existingAnalysis && lastPair; // Both present means incremental
  
  if (existingAnalysisInteraction && !isIncremental && !isRefresh && existingAnalysis === undefined) {
    console.log('[DiscussionFlowAnalysis] Already exists, skipping', { projectId });
    return;
  }

  // Mark as generating
  generatingAnalyses.add(analysisKey);

  try {
    const settingsState = useGenAISettings.getState();
    
    // Use stance model/provider settings (same as Perspectives)
    const evalModel = (settingsState.stanceModel && settingsState.stanceModel.trim()) 
      ? settingsState.stanceModel 
      : 'gemini_fast';
    const preferredLang = getPreferredLanguage();
    const langName = getLanguageName(preferredLang);

    // Get context window and limit to 70%
    const contextWindow = getModelContextWindow(evalModel);
    const maxContextTokens = contextWindow ? Math.floor(contextWindow * 0.7) : Infinity;

    // Build transcript from messages
    let transcript = '';
    if (existingAnalysis && lastPair) {
      // Incremental update: use previous analysis + recent context (last 3-5 message pairs) + last pair
      // Get recent message pairs for context (but limit to avoid exceeding context window)
      const messagesForAnalysis = chatMessages.filter(m => 
        m.role === 'user' || m.role === 'assistant' || (m.role && (m as any).agentProfile)
      );
      
      // Extract recent message pairs (last 3-5 pairs, excluding the lastPair which we'll add separately)
      const recentPairs: Array<Array<{ role: string; content: string }>> = [];
      let userMsg: { role: string; content: string } | null = null;
      
      // Rough token estimation: ~4 chars per token
      const maxContextChars = Math.floor(maxContextTokens * 4);
      let contextChars = 0;
      const existingAnalysisChars = JSON.stringify(existingAnalysis, null, 2).length;
      const lastPairChars = lastPair.map(m => `${m.role}: ${m.content}`).join('\n').length;
      const basePromptChars = 2000; // Rough estimate for prompt overhead
      const availableChars = maxContextChars - existingAnalysisChars - lastPairChars - basePromptChars;
      
      // Go backwards from the end, but skip the last pair (it's already in lastPair)
      for (let i = messagesForAnalysis.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const msg = messagesForAnalysis[i];
        
        // Skip if this is part of lastPair
        let isLastPair = false;
        for (const lp of lastPair) {
          if (lp.content === msg.content && lp.role === msg.role) {
            isLastPair = true;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (isLastPair) {
          continue;
        }
        
        const msgChars = (msg.content || '').length;
        
        if (msg.role === 'assistant' || (msg.role && (msg as any).agentProfile)) {
          if (userMsg) {
            const pairChars = userMsg.content.length + msgChars + 50; // +50 for formatting
            if (contextChars + pairChars > availableChars && recentPairs.length > 0) {
              break; // Don't exceed available context
            }
            recentPairs.unshift([userMsg, msg]);
            contextChars += pairChars;
            userMsg = null;
            if (recentPairs.length >= 5) break; // Limit to 5 recent pairs
          }
        } else if (msg.role === 'user') {
          userMsg = msg;
        }
      }
      
      // Build context section
      const recentContext = recentPairs.length > 0 
        ? `\n\nRECENT DISCUSSION CONTEXT (last ${recentPairs.length} message pairs):\n${recentPairs.map(pair => pair.map(m => `${m.role}: ${m.content}`).join('\n')).join('\n\n')}`
        : '';
      
      transcript = `PREVIOUS ANALYSIS:\n${JSON.stringify(existingAnalysis, null, 2)}${recentContext}\n\nLAST MESSAGE PAIR (new):\n${lastPair.map(m => `${m.role}: ${m.content}`).join('\n')}`;
    } else {
      // Full analysis: use all messages (limit to 70% of context)
      const messagesForAnalysis = chatMessages.filter(m => 
        m.role === 'user' || m.role === 'assistant' || (m.role && (m as any).agentProfile)
      );
      
      // Rough token estimation: ~4 chars per token
      let totalChars = 0;
      const maxChars = Math.floor(maxContextTokens * 4);
      const selectedMessages: Array<{ role: string; content: string }> = [];
      
      // Take messages from the end until we hit the limit
      for (let i = messagesForAnalysis.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const msg = messagesForAnalysis[i];
        const msgChars = (msg.content || '').length;
        if (totalChars + msgChars > maxChars && selectedMessages.length > 0) {
          break;
        }
        selectedMessages.unshift(msg);
        totalChars += msgChars;
      }
      
      transcript = selectedMessages.map(m => `${m.role}: ${m.content}`).join('\n\n');
    }

    if (!transcript || transcript.trim().length === 0) {
      console.log('[DiscussionFlowAnalysis] No transcript available');
      return;
    }

    // Schema for structured response
    const riskCategories = [
      'medical_or_mental_health',
      'self_harm_or_life_threats',
      'law_immigration_tax_finance_investments_insurance',
      'relationships_abuse_children_vulnerable_groups',
      'safety_emergency',
    ];
    const schema = {
      type: 'object',
      additionalProperties: false,
      properties: {
        blindSpots: {
          type: 'array',
          minItems: 2,
          maxItems: 8,
          items: {
            type: 'object',
            additionalProperties: false,
            properties: {
              text: {
                type: 'string',
                minLength: 10,
                maxLength: 300,
                description: 'Blind spot or gap in the discussion that needs to be addressed'
              },
              practical_relevance: {
                type: 'number',
                minimum: 0,
                maximum: 1,
                description: 'Practical relevance score from 0 to 1, indicating how relevant this blind spot is for practical decision-making'
              }
            },
            required: ['text', 'practical_relevance']
          }
        },
        frameShiftRecommendations: {
          type: 'array',
          minItems: 0,
          maxItems: 2,
          items: {
            type: 'string',
            minLength: 20,
            maxLength: 500,
            description: 'Recommendation for shifting the discussion frame to be more effective in achieving the presumed goal. Should formulate how the discussion frame could be reframed for better effectiveness.'
          }
        },
        frame: {
          type: 'string',
          minLength: 20,
          maxLength: 200,
          description: 'Brief, focused identification of the discussion frame - the core goal or primary question the user is pursuing. Should be concise (max 200 chars), not a detailed summary of the entire discussion. Focus on the essential purpose, not all details.'
        },
        confidence: {
          type: 'string',
          enum: ['low', 'medium', 'high'],
          description: 'Confidence level in the analysis. Should be low on early stages of discussion, medium as more context accumulates, high when discussion is well-developed.'
        },
        thinkingTypes: {
          type: 'array',
          minItems: 0,
          maxItems: 2,
          items: {
            type: 'object',
            additionalProperties: false,
            properties: {
              type: {
                type: 'string',
                enum: ['exploratory', 'decision-making', 'explanatory', 'validating', 'synthesizing', 'planning', 'argumentative', 'modeling', 'communication', 'tool-making'],
                description: 'Type of thinking dominant in the discussion'
              },
              score: {
                type: 'number',
                minimum: 0,
                maximum: 1,
                description: 'Score from 0 to 1 indicating how dominant this thinking type is in the discussion'
              },
              manifestation: {
                type: 'string',
                minLength: 20,
                maxLength: 300,
                description: 'Brief explanation (1-2 sentences, max 300 chars) describing how this thinking type manifests in the discussion. Describe the manifestation itself (e.g., "Comparing options and evaluating criteria..."), NOT addressing the user (avoid "User compares..." or "Пользователь сравнивает..."). Focus on the thinking pattern, not who performs it. Provide specific examples from USER messages. REQUIRED: This field must always be included.'
              }
            },
            required: ['type', 'score', 'manifestation']
          },
          description: 'Up to 2 dominant thinking types identified in the discussion, sorted by score (highest first). Each score represents how much this thinking type dominates (0 = not present, 1 = completely dominant). Scores should sum to approximately 1.0 if both are present. Each thinking type MUST include a manifestation field explaining how it manifests in the discussion text.'
        },
        assistantStance: {
          type: 'string',
          minLength: 1,
          maxLength: 600,
          description: '1-2 concise sentences (<=100 words) that state what the assistant seems to be asserting/pursuing in the most recent assistant response, avoiding moral judgement and unsupported assumptions. Only analyze the LAST assistant message in the transcript.'
        },
        assistantRiskProfile: {
          type: 'object',
          additionalProperties: false,
          properties: {
            score: { type: 'number', minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
            level: { type: 'string', enum: ['High', 'Medium', 'Low'] },
            rationale: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 600 },
            triggerCategories: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string', enum: riskCategories }, minItems: 0 },
          },
          required: ['score', 'level', 'rationale', 'triggerCategories'],
          description: 'EU AI Act risk assessment for the most recent assistant response. High risk auto-triggers (must set level to High ONLY if the content provides PERSONAL, ACTIONABLE guidance): medical/mental health, self-harm/suicide/life threats, law/immigration/tax/finance/investments/insurance (personal advice only), relationships/abuse/children/vulnerable groups (personal situations only), safety/emergency (personal instructions). RISK LEVEL RULES: High: score in [0.7, 1], Medium: score in [0.3, 0.7), Low: score in [0, 0.3).'
        }
      },
      required: ['blindSpots', 'frameShiftRecommendations', 'frame', 'confidence']
    } as any;

    const schemaText = JSON.stringify(schema, null, 2);

    // Prompt
    const updateMode = existingAnalysis && lastPair;
    const prompt = updateMode
      ? `Preferred language: ${langName}.

You are an expert analyst reviewing a discussion flow analysis. Your most valuable contribution is evaluating whether the team is asking the RIGHT question, not just answering their stated question well.

Task:
1. Review the PREVIOUS ANALYSIS provided
2. Review the RECENT DISCUSSION CONTEXT (last 3-5 message pairs) to understand the flow
3. Review the LAST MESSAGE PAIR (new user message and assistant/agent response)
4. Update the analysis incrementally based on the new information, MINIMIZING CHANGES to preserve stability
5. Analyze the LAST assistant/agent response for stance and risk profile

CRITICAL: INCREMENTAL UPDATE REQUIREMENTS:
- DO NOT reformulate the entire analysis. Keep most of the previous analysis unchanged.
- Only modify elements that are DIRECTLY affected by the new message pair.
- Preserve elements that are still relevant and have not been addressed or changed.
- Frame: Only update if the discussion direction has clearly shifted. Otherwise, keep it mostly the same, perhaps with minor refinements.
- Confidence: Should generally increase as discussion develops, but don't change it unless there's a clear reason.

What to UPDATE:
- Blind Spots: 
  * Remove items that have been explicitly addressed or resolved in the new messages
  * Add new blind spots only if they are revealed by the new messages
  * Keep existing blind spots that are still relevant and not addressed
  * Preserve the structure and phrasing of items that remain unchanged
  * Update practical_relevance scores if new information changes their relevance
  * Each blind spot must include a practical_relevance score (0..1) indicating how relevant it is for practical decision-making
- Frame Shift Recommendations:
  * Only update if the new messages reveal a significantly different framing opportunity
  * Keep existing recommendations if they are still relevant
  * Maximum 2 recommendations total
- Frame:
  * Only refine if the discussion direction has clearly shifted
  * Keep most of the previous frame description if it's still accurate
  * Minor refinements are acceptable, but avoid complete reformulation
  * MUST be concise (max 200 chars) - focus on the core goal/question, not a detailed summary
- Confidence:
  * Should generally increase as discussion develops
  * Low: < 3 message pairs, Medium: 3-8 pairs, High: > 8 pairs
  * Only change if there's a clear reason based on discussion maturity
- Thinking Types:
  * Only update if discussion clearly shifts to different thinking types
  * Keep existing thinking types if discussion continues in same mode
  * CRITICAL: When analyzing thinking types, prioritize USER messages FIRST, then assistant responses SECOND. The thinking type should reflect how the USER is engaging with the discussion, not primarily how the assistant responds.
  * If updating, identify up to 2 dominant types with scores (0..1), sorted by score
  * REQUIRED: For each type, provide a manifestation explanation (1-2 sentences, STRICTLY MAX 300 characters) describing how it manifests in the discussion. CRITICAL FORMAT: Describe the manifestation itself (e.g., "Comparing options and evaluating criteria..."), NOT addressing the user (avoid "User compares..." or "Пользователь сравнивает..."). Focus on the thinking pattern itself, not who performs it. Base analysis on USER messages first, then assistant responses. Include specific examples from USER messages. The explanation MUST NOT exceed 300 characters. This field is MANDATORY and must be included in every thinking type object.
  * Types: exploratory, decision-making, explanatory, validating, synthesizing, planning, argumentative, modeling, communication, tool-making
- Assistant Stance and Risk Profile:
  * ALWAYS update these fields based on the LAST assistant/agent response in the transcript
  * Extract stance: 1-2 concise sentences (<=100 words) stating what the assistant seems to be asserting/pursuing
  * Assess risk profile: EU AI Act risk assessment with score 0..1 and derived level
  * High risk auto-triggers (set level to High ONLY if content provides PERSONAL, ACTIONABLE guidance):
    - Медицинское/психическое здоровье, фарма/дозировки/отмена препаратов (только персональные рекомендации)
    - Самоповреждение/суицид/угрозы жизни и безопасности (всегда High при инструкциях)
    - Право/иммиграция/налоги/личные финансы/инвестиции/страхование (только персональные советы)
    - Отношения/абьюз/дети/уязвимые группы (только персональные ситуации и советы)
    - Безопасность/экстренные ситуации (персональные инструкции)
  * RISK LEVEL RULES: High: score in [0.7, 1], Medium: score in [0.3, 0.7), Low: score in [0, 0.3)

FRAME ASSESSMENT LOGIC (from consulting perspective):
- Is this the right problem to solve?
- Are they addressing symptoms vs. root causes?
- Is there a more strategic question one level up/down?
- Suggest alternative framings if current one is suboptimal
- The highest value is often in reframing the question itself, not just answering it better

STYLE REQUIREMENTS:
- Blind Spots: Each should identify a specific gap, assumption, or missing consideration. 10-300 characters each. Each blind spot must include a practical_relevance score (0..1) indicating how relevant it is for practical decision-making. Higher scores indicate blind spots that, if addressed, would have more immediate practical impact on the discussion goals.
- Frame Shift Recommendations: Each should formulate how the discussion frame could be reframed to be more effective in achieving the presumed goal. Consider: Is this the right problem? Are they addressing symptoms vs. root causes? Is there a more strategic question one level up/down? Suggest alternative framings if current one is suboptimal. Maximum 2 recommendations. 20-500 characters each. Only include if a meaningful frame shift would improve effectiveness.
- Frame: Should capture the CORE goal or primary question the user is pursuing. Must be BRIEF and FOCUSED (20-200 characters). Do NOT summarize the entire discussion - identify the essential purpose only. Example: "Understanding AI chip competition between Google and Nvidia" NOT "User asked about Google chips, then requested visualization, then asked about market share, then discussed business models..." Focus on the main objective, not all details.
- Confidence: Should reflect the maturity of the discussion. Low for early stages (< 3 turns), medium for developing (3-8 turns), high for well-developed (> 8 turns).

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Frame shift recommendations should be specific and actionable - not generic advice
- Only include frame shift recommendations if there is a meaningful way to reframe the discussion for better effectiveness
- Frame MUST be concise (max 200 chars) - focus on the core goal/question, NOT a detailed summary of the entire discussion
- PRESERVE STABILITY: Keep unchanged elements from the previous analysis unless they are directly affected by new information

User requirement: you should create your answer in ${langName} language. Use English or other languages inline only if you use well-known and accepted in target language terms.

The JSON MUST conform EXACTLY to this schema (no additional keys, types must match):
${schemaText}

${transcript}`
      : `Preferred language: ${langName}.

You are an expert analyst reviewing a discussion flow. Your most valuable contribution is evaluating whether the team is asking the RIGHT question, not just answering their stated question well.

Task:
1. Analyze the discussion transcript
2. Identify blind spots (gaps, assumptions, missing considerations)
3. Identify the discussion frame (what goals the user is likely trying to achieve)
4. Identify up to 2 dominant thinking types with scores (0..1)
5. Assess confidence level based on discussion maturity
6. Formulate frame shift recommendations: how could the discussion frame be reframed to be more effective in achieving the presumed goal?
7. Analyze the LAST assistant/agent response for stance and risk profile

THINKING TYPES ANALYSIS:
Identify up to 2 dominant thinking types from these options:
- exploratory: Exploring unknowns, mapping context, identifying gaps (e.g., "What don't we know?", "How are things connected?")
- decision-making: Comparing options, making choices, evaluating criteria (e.g., "Which option is better?", "What should we do?")
- explanatory: Explaining concepts, documenting, teaching (e.g., "How does this work?", "Why is this important?")
- validating: Checking assumptions, critiquing, finding flaws (e.g., "Is this correct?", "What could go wrong?")
- synthesizing: Finding patterns, summarizing, extracting insights (e.g., "What are the key takeaways?", "What patterns emerge?")
- planning: Creating roadmaps, organizing tasks, structuring implementation (e.g., "How do we implement this?", "What are the steps?")
- argumentative: Building arguments, defending positions, making cases (e.g., "Why is this right?", "What's the evidence?")
- modeling: Creating frameworks, structuring knowledge, building ontologies (e.g., "How should we think about this?", "What's the structure?")
- communication: Engaging stakeholders, conveying messages, managing relationships (e.g., "How do we explain this?", "Who needs to know?")
- tool-making: Creating questions, methods, checklists, thinking tools (e.g., "What questions should we ask?", "How do we approach this?")

CRITICAL: When analyzing thinking types, prioritize USER messages FIRST, then assistant responses SECOND. The thinking type should reflect how the USER is engaging with the discussion, not primarily how the assistant responds.

For each identified thinking type:
- Assign a score from 0 to 1 indicating dominance (scores should sum to approximately 1.0 if both types are present)
- REQUIRED: Provide a manifestation explanation (1-2 sentences, STRICTLY MAX 300 characters) describing how this thinking type manifests in the discussion. CRITICAL FORMAT: Describe the manifestation itself (e.g., "Comparing options and evaluating criteria..."), NOT addressing the user (avoid "User compares..." or "Пользователь сравнивает..."). Focus on the thinking pattern itself, not who performs it. Base analysis on USER messages first, then assistant responses. Include specific examples from USER messages. The explanation MUST NOT exceed 300 characters. This field is MANDATORY and must be included in every thinking type object.
- Sort by score (highest first)

ASSISTANT STANCE AND RISK PROFILE ANALYSIS:
- Extract stance from the LAST assistant/agent response: 1-2 concise sentences (<=100 words) that state what the assistant seems to be asserting/pursuing, avoiding moral judgement and unsupported assumptions
- Assess risk profile: EU AI Act risk assessment with score 0..1 and derived level
- High risk auto-triggers (must set level to High ONLY if the content provides PERSONAL, ACTIONABLE guidance in these areas; general/educational discussion does NOT trigger High):
  - Медицинское/психическое здоровье, фарма/дозировки/отмена препаратов (только персональные рекомендации)
  - Самоповреждение/суицид/угрозы жизни и безопасности (всегда High при инструкциях)
  - Право/иммиграция/налоги/личные финансы/инвестиции/страхование (только персональные советы)
  - Отношения/абьюз/дети/уязвимые группы (только персональные ситуации и советы)
  - Безопасность/экстренные ситуации (персональные инструкции)
- RISK LEVEL RULES: High: score in [0.7, 1], Medium: score in [0.3, 0.7), Low: score in [0, 0.3)
- Use triggerCategories strictly from DICTIONARY (English tokens only): ${JSON.stringify(riskCategories)}

FRAME ASSESSMENT LOGIC (from consulting perspective):
- Is this the right problem to solve?
- Are they addressing symptoms vs. root causes?
- Is there a more strategic question one level up/down?
- Suggest alternative framings if current one is suboptimal
- The highest value is often in reframing the question itself, not just answering it better

STYLE REQUIREMENTS:
- Blind Spots: Each should identify a specific gap, assumption, or missing consideration. 10-300 characters each. Each blind spot must include a practical_relevance score (0..1) indicating how relevant it is for practical decision-making. Higher scores indicate blind spots that, if addressed, would have more immediate practical impact on the discussion goals. Include 2-8 items.
- Frame Shift Recommendations: Each should formulate how the discussion frame could be reframed to be more effective. Consider: Is this the right problem? Are they addressing symptoms vs. root causes? Is there a more strategic question one level up/down? Suggest alternative framings if current one is suboptimal. Maximum 2 recommendations. 20-500 characters each. Only include if a meaningful frame shift would improve effectiveness.
- Frame: Should capture the CORE goal or primary question the user is pursuing. Must be BRIEF and FOCUSED (20-200 characters). Do NOT summarize the entire discussion - identify the essential purpose only. Example: "Understanding AI chip competition between Google and Nvidia" NOT "User asked about Google chips, then requested visualization, then asked about market share, then discussed business models..." Focus on the main objective, not all details.
- Confidence: Should reflect the maturity of the discussion. Low for early stages (< 3 turns), medium for developing (3-8 turns), high for well-developed (> 8 turns).

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- All content must be grounded in the discussion transcript provided
- Frame MUST be concise (max 200 chars) - focus on the core goal/question, NOT a detailed summary of the entire discussion
- Frame shift recommendations should be specific and actionable - not generic advice
- Only include frame shift recommendations if there is a meaningful way to reframe the discussion for better effectiveness
- Confidence should be low if discussion has fewer than 3 message pairs, medium for 3-8 pairs, high for more than 8 pairs

User requirement: you should create your answer in ${langName} language. Use English or other languages inline only if you use well-known and accepted in target language terms.

The JSON MUST conform EXACTLY to this schema (no additional keys, types must match):
${schemaText}

DISCUSSION TRANSCRIPT:
${transcript}`;

    const langDirective = `You MUST produce all output strictly in ${langName} language. Use English only for technical terms or code if they are standard industry terms.`;

    const res = await api.genaiGenerate({
      model: evalModel,
      prompt,
      strictJSONEnabled: true,
      jsonSchema: schema,
      maxOutputTokens: 2048,
      webSearchEnabled: false,
      systemInstruction: langDirective,
    });

    // Save raw API response for debugging (BEFORE parsing, so we can see what failed)
    const rawResponse = {
      content: res?.content,
      rawJSON: (res as any)?.rawJSON,
      toolCalls: (res as any)?.toolCalls,
      model: res?.model,
      usage: res?.usage,
    };

    // Parse response
    let parsed: any = null;
    try {
      // First, check if result is in toolCalls (structured output via function calling)
      const toolCalls = (res as any)?.toolCalls;
      if (toolCalls && Array.isArray(toolCalls) && toolCalls.length > 0) {
        // Look for return_structured tool call
        const returnStructured = toolCalls.find((tc: any) => 
          tc && typeof tc === 'object' && 
          (tc.name === 'return_structured' || tc.functionName === 'return_structured')
        );
        if (returnStructured) {
          const args = returnStructured.arguments || returnStructured.functionArguments;
          if (typeof args === 'string') {
            try {
              parsed = JSON.parse(args);
            } catch (e) {
              // Ignore parse error, will try other sources
            }
          } else if (typeof args === 'object' && args !== null) {
            // Already parsed object
            parsed = args;
          }
        }
      }
      
      // If not found in toolCalls, try content
      if (!parsed && typeof res?.content === 'string') {
        const s = res.content.trim();
        if (s.startsWith('{') || s.startsWith('[')) parsed = JSON.parse(s);
      }
      const rawJSON = (res as any)?.rawJSON;
      if (!parsed && typeof rawJSON === 'string') {
        const s2 = rawJSON.trim();
        if (s2.startsWith('{') || s2.startsWith('[')) parsed = JSON.parse(s2);
      }
      if (!parsed && typeof res?.content === 'string') {
        const m = res.content.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
        if (m && m[0]) {
          parsed = JSON.parse(m[0]);
        }
      }
    } catch (pe) {
      console.warn('[DiscussionFlowAnalysis] parse failed', pe, { contentPreview: (res?.content || '').slice(0, 200) });
    }

    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || !Array.isArray(parsed.blindSpots) || !Array.isArray(parsed.frameShiftRecommendations) || typeof parsed.frame !== 'string' || !['low', 'medium', 'high'].includes(parsed.confidence)) {
      console.log('[DiscussionFlowAnalysis] no valid analysis parsed, skipping');
      
      // Save raw response even if parsing failed, so user can see what went wrong
      try {
        const analysisId = existingAnalysisInteraction?.id || (Date.now().toString() + '-discussion-flow-analysis-failed');
        useGenaiChatStore.setState((s) => {
          const items = [...s.interactions];
          const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === analysisId);
          if (idx >= 0) {
            (items[idx] as any).rawResponse = rawResponse;
            (items[idx] as any).parseError = true;
          } else {
            items.push({
              id: analysisId,
              projectId: s.projectId,
              kind: 'note',
              subkind: analysisSubkind,
              content: '',
              contentSanitized: '',
              rawResponse: rawResponse,
              parseError: true,
              createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            } as any);
          }
          return { interactions: items } as any;
        });
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[DiscussionFlowAnalysis] Failed to save raw response', e);
      }
      
      return;
    }
    
    // Validate that arrays contain valid items (strings or objects with text property)
    const isValidBlindSpot = (item: any): boolean => {
      if (typeof item === 'string') return item.trim().length > 0;
      if (typeof item === 'object' && item !== null) {
        return typeof item.text === 'string' && item.text.trim().length > 0 &&
               typeof item.practical_relevance === 'number' && !isNaN(item.practical_relevance);
      }
      return false;
    };
    
    const isValidRecommendation = (item: any): boolean => {
      if (typeof item === 'string') return item.trim().length > 0;
      if (typeof item === 'object' && item !== null) {
        return typeof (item.text || item.textValue || item.value || item.description || item.content || item.recommendation) === 'string';
      }
      return false;
    };
    
    // Check if arrays have valid items
    if (!parsed.blindSpots.some(isValidBlindSpot) || !parsed.frameShiftRecommendations.every((r: any) => !r || isValidRecommendation(r))) {
      console.log('[DiscussionFlowAnalysis] arrays contain invalid items, skipping');
      return;
    }

    // Extract and validate analysis
    const clamp01 = (n: any) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(n) || 0));
    
    const analysis: DiscussionFlowAnalysis = {
      blindSpots: parsed.blindSpots
        .filter((b: any) => {
          // Support both old format (string) and new format (object)
          if (typeof b === 'string') {
            return b.trim().length > 0;
          }
          if (typeof b === 'object' && b !== null) {
            return b.text && typeof b.text === 'string' && b.text.trim().length > 0 &&
                   typeof b.practical_relevance === 'number' && !isNaN(b.practical_relevance);
          }
          return false;
        })
        .slice(0, 8)
        .map((b: any) => {
          // Convert old format to new format if needed
          if (typeof b === 'string') {
            return {
              text: b.trim(),
              practical_relevance: 0.5 // Default relevance for old format
            };
          }
          return {
            text: b.text.trim(),
            practical_relevance: clamp01(b.practical_relevance)
          };
        }),
      frameShiftRecommendations: parsed.frameShiftRecommendations
        .filter((r: any) => r && typeof r === 'string' && r.trim().length > 0)
        .slice(0, 2)
        .map((r: any) => r.trim()),
      frame: parsed.frame.trim(),
      confidence: parsed.confidence as 'low' | 'medium' | 'high',
    };

    // Extract assistant stance and risk profile if present
    if (parsed.assistantStance && typeof parsed.assistantStance === 'string' && parsed.assistantStance.trim()) {
      analysis.assistantStance = parsed.assistantStance.trim();
    }
    if (parsed.assistantRiskProfile && typeof parsed.assistantRiskProfile === 'object') {
      const rp = parsed.assistantRiskProfile;
      if (typeof rp.score === 'number' && typeof rp.level === 'string' && ['High', 'Medium', 'Low'].includes(rp.level) && typeof rp.rationale === 'string' && Array.isArray(rp.triggerCategories)) {
        analysis.assistantRiskProfile = {
          score: clamp01(rp.score),
          level: rp.level as 'High' | 'Medium' | 'Low',
          rationale: rp.rationale.trim(),
          triggerCategories: rp.triggerCategories.filter((cat: any) => typeof cat === 'string'),
        };
      }
    }
    // Extract thinking types if present
    if (parsed.thinkingTypes && Array.isArray(parsed.thinkingTypes)) {
      const validThinkingTypes = parsed.thinkingTypes
        .filter((tt: any) => 
          tt && 
          typeof tt === 'object' && 
          typeof tt.type === 'string' && 
          typeof tt.score === 'number' && 
          !isNaN(tt.score) &&
          ['exploratory', 'decision-making', 'explanatory', 'validating', 'synthesizing', 'planning', 'argumentative', 'modeling', 'communication', 'tool-making'].includes(tt.type)
        )
        .slice(0, 2)
        .map((tt: any) => ({
          type: tt.type as ThinkingType['type'],
          score: clamp01(tt.score),
          manifestation: tt.manifestation && typeof tt.manifestation === 'string' 
            ? tt.manifestation.trim().slice(0, 300) 
            : undefined
        }))
        .sort((a: ThinkingType, b: ThinkingType) => b.score - a.score); // Sort by score descending
      
      if (validThinkingTypes.length > 0) {
        analysis.thinkingTypes = validThinkingTypes;
      }
    }

    if (analysis.blindSpots.length < 2 || !analysis.frame) {
      return;
    }

    // Create or update discussion.flow.analysis interaction
    try {
      const analysisId = existingAnalysisInteraction?.id || (Date.now().toString() + '-discussion-flow-analysis');
      const analysisData = analysis;
      
      // Save raw API response for debugging
      const rawResponse = {
        content: res?.content,
        rawJSON: (res as any)?.rawJSON,
        toolCalls: (res as any)?.toolCalls,
        model: res?.model,
        usage: res?.usage,
      };

      if (existingAnalysisInteraction) {
        // Update existing interaction
        useGenaiChatStore.setState((s) => {
          const items = [...s.interactions];
          const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === analysisId);
          if (idx >= 0) {
            (items[idx] as any).content = JSON.stringify(analysisData);
            (items[idx] as any).contentSanitized = JSON.stringify(analysisData);
            (items[idx] as any).rawResponse = rawResponse;
          }
          return { interactions: items } as any;
        });

        // Update on server
        (async () => {
          try {
            await api.updateProjectInteraction(projectId, analysisId, {
              content: JSON.stringify(analysisData),
              contentSanitized: JSON.stringify(analysisData),
            });
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[DiscussionFlowAnalysis] Failed to update on server', e);
          }
        })();
      } else {
        // Create new interaction
        useGenaiChatStore.setState((s) => ({
          interactions: [
            ...s.interactions,
            {
              id: analysisId,
              projectId: s.projectId,
              kind: 'note',
              subkind: analysisSubkind,
              content: JSON.stringify(analysisData),
              contentSanitized: JSON.stringify(analysisData),
              rawResponse: rawResponse,
              createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            } as any,
          ],
        } as any));

        // Persist to server (async, don't block UI)
        (async () => {
          try {
            const payload: any = {
              kind: 'note',
              subkind: analysisSubkind,
              content: JSON.stringify(analysisData),
            };

            const res = await api.createProjectInteraction(projectId, payload);

            // Update local interaction with server ID
            useGenaiChatStore.setState((st) => {
              const items = [...st.interactions];
              const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === analysisId);
              if (idx >= 0) {
                (items[idx] as any).id = res.id;
              }

              const newMap = { ...(st.persistedByLocalId || {}) } as Record<string, string>;
              newMap[analysisId] = res.id;

              return { interactions: items, persistedByLocalId: newMap } as any;
            });
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[DiscussionFlowAnalysis] Failed to persist to server', e);
          }
        })();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[DiscussionFlowAnalysis] Failed to create/update analysis interaction', e);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[DiscussionFlowAnalysis] Failed to generate analysis', e);
  } finally {
    // Always remove from generating set
    generatingAnalyses.delete(analysisKey);
  }
}

/**
 * Утилиты для обработки highlight в тексте сообщений
 */

export interface EditHighlight {
  start: number;
  end: number;
}

/**
 * Применяет highlight к тексту сообщения для отображения редактирования
 */
export function applyEditHighlight(
  content: string,
  highlight: EditHighlight | undefined,
): string {
  if (!highlight) return content;

  const { start, end } = highlight;
  if (
    typeof start !== 'number' ||
    typeof end !== 'number' ||
    start < 0 ||
    end <= start ||
    end > content.length
  ) {
    return content;
  }

  const pre = content.slice(0, start);
  const mid = content.slice(start, end);
  const post = content.slice(end);

  // Escape HTML и обернуть в span с highlight стилем
  const escapedMid = mid.replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
  const span = `<span class="etg-edit-hl" style="background: rgba(255, 230, 150, 0.6); padding: 0 2px; border-radius: 3px;">${escapedMid}</span>`;

  return pre + span + post;
}

import { api } from './api';
import { getPreferredLanguage, getLanguageName } from './uiUtils';

export interface ExperimentalResponse {
  reasoningChain: string;
  sources: Array<{ url: string; snippet: string }>;
  fullResponse: string;
  userMessage: string;
}

// Track generation state to prevent duplicates
const generatingForMessages = new Set<string>();

/**
 * Generates experimental response using two-step process:
 * 1. gemini_fast with web search to create a detailed reasoning chain with facts
 * 2. grok_fast to generate full response based on reasoning chain
 */
export async function generateExperimentalResponse(
  userMessage: string,
  messageId: string
): Promise<ExperimentalResponse | null> {
  // Prevent duplicate generation
  if (generatingForMessages.has(messageId)) {
    return null;
  }
  
  generatingForMessages.add(messageId);
  
  try {
    const preferredLang = getPreferredLanguage();
    const langName = getLanguageName(preferredLang);
    
    // Get current date for reasoning
    const currentDate = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    
    // Step 1: Generate detailed reasoning chain with gemini_fast + web search
    const reasoningPrompt = `Develop a detailed reasoning chain for this user query. Think through the question step by step, exploring different angles and perspectives. Use web search to obtain the most current data and facts. Include specific facts, data points, statistics, and concrete information relevant to the query. Consider different perspectives where applicable.

CURRENT DATE: ${currentDate}

IMPORTANT: Use the most recent and relevant data available, especially in knowledge domains where the rate of change is high (technology, current events, science, economics, etc.). Prioritize data from ${currentDate} or the most recent period available.

Structure your reasoning chain as follows:
- Develop your thinking step by step, with each step building on the previous one
- Include specific facts, numbers, statistics, dates, and concrete data points relevant to the query
- Consider different perspectives and angles where applicable
- Use comparisons and concrete examples when relevant
- Formulate and test hypotheses if applicable to the query
- At the end, explicitly list the web page URLs (website addresses starting with http:// or https://) that you found through web search, with brief snippets explaining their relevance

CRITICAL: Make your reasoning concrete and factual. Include specific data, numbers, dates, and verifiable information. Avoid vague formulations. Think deeply and comprehensively about the query.

CRITICAL ABOUT SOURCES: 
- Web search is enabled for this query. Use it to find current information from the web.
- Sources are web page URLs (website addresses) that you found through web search.
- You MUST explicitly list the actual URLs (starting with http:// or https://) of web pages you found via web search in your response text.
- Only include real, actual URLs of web pages that you actually found through web search. Do NOT invent, make up, or fabricate URLs or sources.
- Format sources as: URL - brief description (e.g., "https://example.com/article - explains the statistics on X")
- If you don't have real sources from web search, don't list any rather than inventing them.
- These URLs will be extracted from your response and used by the next model, so they must be actual URLs of web pages you found.

User query:
${userMessage}`;

    const langDirective = `You MUST produce all output strictly in ${langName} language. Use English only for technical terms or code if they are standard industry terms.`;

    const reasoningResponse = await api.genaiGenerate({
      model: 'gemini_fast',
      prompt: reasoningPrompt,
      webSearchEnabled: true,
      systemInstruction: langDirective,
      maxOutputTokens: 4096,
    });

    if (!reasoningResponse?.content) {
      console.warn('[ExperimentalResponse] No reasoning chain content received');
      return null;
    }

    // Step 2: Generate full response with grok_fast
    // Extract sources from reasoning response for inclusion in prompt
    const sourcesList: Array<{ url: string; snippet: string }> = [];
    
    // Try to extract sources from attributions if available
    if (reasoningResponse.attributions && Array.isArray(reasoningResponse.attributions)) {
      reasoningResponse.attributions.forEach((attr: any) => {
        if (attr.url) {
          sourcesList.push({
            url: attr.url,
            snippet: attr.title || attr.url,
          });
        }
      });
    }
    
    // Try to extract sources from reasoning text (look for URLs and snippets)
    const reasoningText = reasoningResponse.content;
    if (reasoningText) {
      const urlRegex = /(https?:\/\/[^\s\)]+)/g;
      const matches = reasoningText.match(urlRegex);
      if (matches) {
        matches.forEach((url) => {
          // Find snippet after URL (next line or in parentheses)
          const urlIndex = reasoningText.indexOf(url);
          const afterUrl = reasoningText.slice(urlIndex + url.length, urlIndex + url.length + 200);
          const snippetMatch = afterUrl.match(/[:\-]\s*([^\n]+)/);
          const snippet = snippetMatch ? snippetMatch[1].trim() : url;
          
          if (!sourcesList.some((s) => s.url === url)) {
            sourcesList.push({ url, snippet });
          }
        });
      }
    }
    
    const sourcesText = sourcesList.length > 0
      ? `\n\nSOURCES FROM REASONING CHAIN (YOU MUST USE THESE WHEN REFERENCING INFORMATION):\n${sourcesList.map((s, i) => `${i + 1}. ${s.url} - ${s.snippet}`).join('\n')}\n`
      : '';
    
    const fullResponsePrompt = `Here is the original user query: ${userMessage}

Here is a detailed reasoning chain with facts and data related to this query:
${reasoningResponse.content}${sourcesText}

Generate a complete, well-structured response based on the user query - primarily, and the reasoning chain as a secondary source of information. CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:

1. RESPONSE FORMAT AND STYLE:
   - Analyze the original user query to independently determine the most appropriate response format and style (e.g., essay, blog post, LinkedIn post, analytical discussion, report, philosophical reflection, etc.)
   - Do NOT rely on any style recommendations from the reasoning chain - determine format solely based on the user's query
   - Use appropriate tone, structure, and presentation style for the determined format
   - Match the format to what the user's query naturally suggests

2. USE REASONING CHAIN: Extract and use concrete numbers, statistics, dates, facts, and insights from the reasoning chain. Cite specific figures, percentages, and data points explicitly. Prioritize the most recent data mentioned in the reasoning chain.

3. STRUCTURE: Organize your response logically, drawing from the reasoning chain but adapting it to your determined format. The structure should flow naturally for the chosen format.

4. COMPARISONS: When the reasoning chain includes comparisons, explicitly perform them in your response. State both values and explain the difference.

5. HYPOTHESES: If the reasoning chain includes hypotheses, address them explicitly - test them, verify if they hold, or explain why they might or might not be valid.

6. MANDATORY SOURCE USAGE: If sources are provided above (from the reasoning chain), you MUST use them when referencing information. When citing facts, statistics, or data from the reasoning chain, explicitly reference the corresponding source URL from the provided sources list. Do not use information without attributing it to the appropriate source when sources are available.

7. NO NEW SOURCES: Do not introduce new sources or links that were not in the reasoning chain. Base your response strictly on the reasoning chain and its sources. If sources are provided, use only those sources.

8. COMPLETE ANSWER: Provide a comprehensive answer that incorporates insights from the reasoning chain, while maintaining natural flow, readability, and the determined format/style.

Generate the response now:`;

    const fullResponse = await api.genaiGenerate({
      model: 'grok_fast',
      prompt: fullResponsePrompt,
      systemInstruction: langDirective,
      maxOutputTokens: 8192,
    });

    if (!fullResponse?.content) {
      console.warn('[ExperimentalResponse] No full response content received');
      return null;
    }

    return {
      reasoningChain: reasoningResponse.content,
      sources: sourcesList,
      fullResponse: fullResponse.content,
      userMessage,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[ExperimentalResponse] Generation failed', error);
    return null;
  } finally {
    generatingForMessages.delete(messageId);
  }
}

Файл: frameExpansions.ts

import { api } from './api';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { useGenAISettings } from '../stores/genaiSettingsStore';
import { getPreferredLanguage, getLanguageName } from './uiUtils';

// Track message IDs for which generation is in progress to prevent duplicate requests
const generatingExpansions = new Set<string>();

/**
 * Generates frame expansion suggestions for an LLM response.
 * Creates an interaction with subkind 'eval.frame_expansions' linked to the assistant message.
 * 
 * @param assistantMessageId - ID of the assistant message to analyze (can be local or server ID)
 * @param assistantContent - Content of the assistant's response
 * @param userMessages - Optional array of user messages (up to 2 most recent) that prompted this response
 * @returns Promise that resolves when expansion generation is complete
 */
export async function generateFrameExpansions(
  assistantMessageId: string,
  assistantContent: string,
  userMessages?: string[]
): Promise<void> {
  // Check if generation is already in progress for this message
  if (generatingExpansions.has(assistantMessageId)) {
    return;
  }

  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
  const projectId = genaiChat.projectId;
  
  // Resolve server ID from local ID mapping
  const map = (genaiChat as any).persistedByLocalId || {};
  const serverId = map[assistantMessageId] || assistantMessageId;
  
  // Build reverse map for bidirectional lookup
  const reverseMap: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  Object.entries(map).forEach(([local, server]) => {
    if (!reverseMap[server as string]) reverseMap[server as string] = [];
    reverseMap[server as string].push(local);
  });
  const localIds = reverseMap[assistantMessageId] || [];
  
  // Check if expansion interaction already exists
  const existingExpansion = genaiChat.interactions.find((it) => 
    it.subkind === 'eval.frame_expansions' && 
    (it.replyTo === assistantMessageId || it.replyTo === serverId || localIds.includes(it.replyTo || '') ||
     (it.relations && it.relations.some((r) => r.targetId === assistantMessageId || r.targetId === serverId)))
  );
  
  if (existingExpansion) {
    return;
  }

  // Mark as generating
  generatingExpansions.add(assistantMessageId);

  try {
    const settingsState = useGenAISettings.getState();
    
    // Use stance model/provider settings
    const evalModel = (settingsState.stanceModel && settingsState.stanceModel.trim()) 
      ? settingsState.stanceModel 
      : 'gemini_fast';
    const preferredLang = getPreferredLanguage();
    const langName = getLanguageName(preferredLang);

    // Schema for structured response
    const schema = {
      type: 'object',
      additionalProperties: false,
      properties: {
        expansions: {
          type: 'array',
          minItems: 3,
          maxItems: 5,
          items: {
            type: 'object',
            additionalProperties: false,
            properties: {
              question: {
                type: 'string',
                minLength: 10,
                maxLength: 200,
                description: 'Question in 2nd person form suggesting how to expand the frame or view from another angle'
              }
            },
            required: ['question']
          }
        }
      },
      required: ['expansions']
    } as any;

    const schemaText = JSON.stringify(schema, null, 2);

    // Build context block with user messages if available (up to 2 most recent)
    const userMessagesFiltered = userMessages?.filter((msg) => msg && msg.trim().length > 0) || [];
    const userContextBlock = userMessagesFiltered.length > 0
      ? `ORIGINAL USER QUESTIONS (context for understanding what prompted this response, chronological order - oldest first):\n${userMessagesFiltered.map((msg, idx) => `${idx + 1}. ${msg}`).join('\n\n')}\n\n`
      : '';

    // Prompt in English (as required)
    const prompt = `You are an expert at analyzing responses and identifying ways to expand their frame or view them from alternative perspectives.

Task:
1. Look at the following LLM response (just received)
2. Assess how much the frame could be expanded or viewed from another angle to complement it
3. Generate 3-5 concise, simple questions suggesting alternative angles or expansions

STYLE REQUIREMENTS:
- Maximum 15-20 words per question
- Use natural, conversational language (like asking a friend)
- One clear idea per question
- Avoid complex nested clauses, long lists, or multiple conditions in one sentence
- Don't use meta-phrases like "expanding the frame" or "alternative perspectives" - just suggest the alternative directly

QUESTION FORMAT:
- Use simple question structures: "What about...?", "Have you considered...?", "Would [specific suggestion] work?"
- Keep it brief and direct - let the suggestion itself convey the alternative perspective
- If mentioning examples, limit to 1-2 items maximum
- Write as if speaking naturally, not formally

AVOID:
- Long sentences with multiple clauses (e.g., "Хотели бы вы рассмотреть расширение рамок ответа, добавив варианты с акцентом на...")
- Explaining reasons or conditions within the question
- Formal language or meta-commentary about the expansion process
- Questions longer than 20 words
- Complex nested structures with multiple "such as", "where", "which", "that" clauses

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Avoid superficial suggestions that might be driven solely by the volume of training data or generic patterns
- Focus on meaningful, context-specific expansions that genuinely add depth or alternative perspectives
- Each suggestion should be substantive and relevant to the specific content and user's original question
- Do not propose expansions that are obvious, trivial, or could apply to any response regardless of content

EXAMPLES OF GOOD QUESTIONS (concise, direct):
- "What about eco-friendly destinations like Malaysia or Vietnam?"
- "Have you considered combining Thailand with Cambodia for cultural tours?"
- "Would educational activities for children in warm countries work?"

BAD EXAMPLE (too complex - avoid this style):
- "Хотели бы вы рассмотреть расширение рамок ответа, добавив варианты с акцентом на экологически чистые направления, такие как Малайзия или Вьетнам, где сочетается тропическая теплота, семейные активности и относительно низкие затраты на транспорт из Казахстана?"

User requirement: you should create your answer in ${langName} language. Use English or other languages inline only if you use well-known and accepted in target language terms.

The JSON MUST conform EXACTLY to this schema (no additional keys, types must match):
${schemaText}

${userContextBlock}LLM RESPONSE TO ANALYZE:
${assistantContent}`;

    const langDirective = `You MUST produce all output strictly in ${langName} language. Use English only for technical terms or code if they are standard industry terms.`;

    const res = await api.genaiGenerate({
      model: evalModel,
      prompt,
      strictJSONEnabled: true,
      jsonSchema: schema,
      maxOutputTokens: 2048,
      webSearchEnabled: false,
      systemInstruction: langDirective,
    });

    // Parse response
    let parsed: any = null;
    try {
      if (typeof res?.content === 'string') {
        const s = res.content.trim();
        if (s.startsWith('{') || s.startsWith('[')) parsed = JSON.parse(s);
      }
      const rawJSON = (res as any)?.rawJSON;
      if (!parsed && typeof rawJSON === 'string') {
        const s2 = rawJSON.trim();
        if (s2.startsWith('{') || s2.startsWith('[')) parsed = JSON.parse(s2);
      }
      if (!parsed && typeof res?.content === 'string') {
        const m = res.content.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
        if (m && m[0]) {
          parsed = JSON.parse(m[0]);
        }
      }
    } catch (pe) {
      console.warn('[FrameExpansions] parse failed', pe, { contentPreview: (res?.content || '').slice(0, 200) });
    }

    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || !Array.isArray(parsed.expansions)) {
      console.log('[FrameExpansions] no valid expansions parsed, skipping');
      return;
    }

    // Extract and validate expansions
    const expansions = parsed.expansions
      .filter((e: any) => e && typeof e.question === 'string' && e.question.trim().length > 0)
      .slice(0, 5)
      .map((e: any) => ({ question: e.question.trim() }));

    if (expansions.length < 3) {
      return;
    }

    // Create eval.frame_expansions interaction
    try {
      const evalId = Date.now().toString() + '-eval-frame-expansions';
      const expansionData = { expansions };

      // Add to local state first
      useGenaiChatStore.setState((s) => ({
        interactions: [
          ...s.interactions,
          {
            id: evalId,
            projectId: s.projectId,
            kind: 'system',
            subkind: 'eval.frame_expansions',
            content: JSON.stringify(expansionData),
            contentSanitized: JSON.stringify(expansionData),
            replyTo: assistantMessageId,
            relations: [{ type: 'expands', targetId: assistantMessageId }],
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          } as any,
        ],
      } as any));

      // Persist to server (async, don't block UI)
      if (projectId && projectId !== 'local-unfold') {
        (async () => {
          try {
            const map = (useGenaiChatStore.getState() as any).persistedByLocalId || {};
            const serverReplyTo = map[assistantMessageId] || assistantMessageId;

            const payload: any = {
              kind: 'system',
              subkind: 'eval.frame_expansions',
              content: JSON.stringify(expansionData),
              replyTo: serverReplyTo,
              relations: [{ type: 'expands', targetId: serverReplyTo }],
            };

            const res = await api.createProjectInteraction(projectId, payload);

            // Update local interaction with server ID and update replyTo/relations if needed
            useGenaiChatStore.setState((st) => {
              const items = [...st.interactions];
              const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === evalId);
              if (idx >= 0) {
                (items[idx] as any).id = res.id;
                // Update replyTo and relations.targetId to use server ID if they reference assistantMessageId
                if (items[idx].replyTo === assistantMessageId && serverReplyTo !== assistantMessageId) {
                  (items[idx] as any).replyTo = serverReplyTo;
                }
                if (items[idx].relations && Array.isArray(items[idx].relations)) {
                  items[idx].relations = items[idx].relations!.map((r: any) => {
                    if (r.targetId === assistantMessageId && serverReplyTo !== assistantMessageId) {
                      return { ...r, targetId: serverReplyTo };
                    }
                    return r;
                  });
                }
              }

              const newMap = { ...(st.persistedByLocalId || {}) } as Record<string, string>;
              newMap[evalId] = res.id;

              return { interactions: items, persistedByLocalId: newMap } as any;
            });
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[FrameExpansions] Failed to persist to server', e);
          }
        })();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[FrameExpansions] Failed to create eval.frame_expansions interaction', e);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[FrameExpansions] Failed to generate expansions', e);
  } finally {
    // Always remove from generating set
    generatingExpansions.delete(assistantMessageId);
  }
}

Файл: graphDataParser.ts

/**
 * Утилиты для парсинга graph data из взаимодействий
 */

export interface GraphData {
  chartTitle: string;
  chartType?: string;
  table: (string | number)[][];
  sources: string[];
}

const ALLOWED_CHART_TYPES = [
  'line',
  'bar',
  'area',
  'stackedBar',
  'stackedArea',
  'composed',
] as const;

export type ChartType = typeof ALLOWED_CHART_TYPES[number];

/**
 * Парсит graph data из взаимодействия
 */
export function parseGraphData(interaction: any): GraphData | null {
  // Если уже есть graphData, используем его
  let gd = interaction.graphData as GraphData | undefined;
  if (gd) {
    return gd;
  }

  // Если subkind не 'graph', возвращаем null
  if (interaction.subkind !== 'graph') {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    let content = String(
      interaction.contentSanitized || interaction.content || '',
    ).trim();

    // Удаляем code fences
    content = content.replace(/^```[a-zA-Z]*\n([\s\S]*?)\n```$/m, '$1').trim();

    let parsed: any = null;

    // Пытаемся распарсить JSON
    if (content.startsWith('{') || content.startsWith('[')) {
      parsed = JSON.parse(content);
    } else {
      // Ищем JSON в тексте
      const match = content.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
      if (match && match[0]) {
        parsed = JSON.parse(match[0]);
      }
    }

    // Валидация структуры
    if (
      parsed &&
      typeof parsed === 'object' &&
      typeof parsed.chartTitle === 'string' &&
      Array.isArray(parsed.table) &&
      Array.isArray(parsed.sources)
    ) {
      const chartType: ChartType =
        typeof parsed.chartType === 'string' &&
        ALLOWED_CHART_TYPES.includes(parsed.chartType as ChartType)
          ? (parsed.chartType as ChartType)
          : 'line';

      return {
        chartTitle: parsed.chartTitle,
        chartType,
        table: parsed.table,
        sources: parsed.sources,
      };
    }
  } catch {
    // Игнорируем ошибки парсинга
  }

  return null;
}

/**
 * Утилиты для работы с bidirectional mapping между local и server IDs
 */

import { api } from './api';

/**
 * Создает reverse map для поиска local IDs по server ID
 */
export function createReverseMap(
  persistedByLocalId: Record<string, string>,
): Record<string, string[]> {
  const reverseMap: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  Object.entries(persistedByLocalId).forEach(([local, server]) => {
    const serverKey = server as string;
    if (!reverseMap[serverKey]) {
      reverseMap[serverKey] = [];
    }
    reverseMap[serverKey].push(local);
  });
  return reverseMap;
}

/**
 * Находит все local IDs для данного server ID
 */
export function getLocalIdsForServerId(
  serverId: string,
  persistedByLocalId: Record<string, string>,
): string[] {
  const reverseMap = createReverseMap(persistedByLocalId);
  return reverseMap[serverId] || [];
}

/**
 * Находит eval.bias interaction для данного message ID
 */
export function findEvalBiasInteraction(
  messageId: string,
  interactions: any[],
  persistedByLocalId: Record<string, string>,
): any | null {
  const localIds = getLocalIdsForServerId(messageId, persistedByLocalId);
  
  return (
    [...interactions]
      .reverse()
      .find(
        (n) =>
          n.subkind === 'eval.bias' &&
          (n.replyTo === messageId || localIds.includes(n.replyTo || '')),
      ) || null
  );
}

/**
 * Проверяет, закреплено ли взаимодействие
 */
export function isInteractionPinned(interaction: any): boolean {
  return !!interaction?.metadata?.pinned;
}

/**
 * Переключает статус закрепления взаимодействия
 */
export async function toggleInteractionPin(
  projectId: string,
  interactionId: string,
  currentlyPinned: boolean,
): Promise<void> {
  await api.updateProjectInteraction(projectId, interactionId, {
    metadata: {
      pinned: !currentlyPinned,
    },
  });
}

import React from 'react';
import ReactMarkdown, { Components } from 'react-markdown';
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm';
import rehypeRaw from 'rehype-raw';

/**
 * Общие компоненты для рендеринга markdown в сообщениях
 */
export const markdownComponents: Components = {
  p: (
    props: React.DetailedHTMLProps<
      React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>,
      HTMLParagraphElement
    >,
  ) => <div {...props} className="md-p" />,
  a: (
    props: React.DetailedHTMLProps<
      React.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>,
      HTMLAnchorElement
    >,
  ) => (
    <a {...props} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="underline" />
  ),
  code: (
    props: {
      inline?: boolean;
      className?: string;
      children?: React.ReactNode;
    } & React.DetailedHTMLProps<
      React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>,
      HTMLElement
    >,
  ) => {
    const { inline, className, children, ...rest } = props;
    const text =
      typeof children === 'string'
        ? children
        : Array.isArray(children)
          ? children.join('')
          : String(children ?? '');
    const isSingleLineBlock =
      !inline &&
      !/\n/.test(text) &&
      text.trim().length > 0 &&
      text.trim().length <= 80;
    if (inline || isSingleLineBlock) {
      return (
        <code
          {...rest}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--white-10)',
            padding: '0 3px',
            borderRadius: 4,
          }}
        >
          {text}
        </code>
      );
    }
    return <code {...rest} className={className}>{children}</code>;
  },
  ul: (
    props: React.DetailedHTMLProps<
      React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLUListElement>,
      HTMLUListElement
    >,
  ) => <ul {...props} style={{ paddingLeft: '1.25rem' }} />,
  ol: (
    props: React.DetailedHTMLProps<
      React.OlHTMLAttributes<HTMLOListElement>,
      HTMLOListElement
    >,
  ) => <ol {...props} style={{ paddingLeft: '1.25rem' }} />,
};

/**
 * Компонент для рендеринга markdown с общими настройками
 */
export const MarkdownRenderer: React.FC<{
  content: string;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
  useRaw?: boolean;
  skipWrapper?: boolean;
}> = ({ content, className = 'text-13 markdown', style, useRaw = false, skipWrapper = false }) => {
  const markdownContent = (
    <ReactMarkdown
      remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
      rehypePlugins={useRaw ? [rehypeRaw] : []}
      components={markdownComponents}
    >
      {content}
    </ReactMarkdown>
  );

  if (skipWrapper) {
    return markdownContent;
  }

  return (
    <div className={className} style={style}>
      {markdownContent}
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * Утилиты для нормализации markdown текста
 * Используется для поиска и замены текста в markdown с сохранением форматирования
 */

export interface NormalizedMarkdown {
  normalized: string;
  mapIdx: number[];
}

/**
 * Нормализует markdown текст, удаляя форматирование и создавая маппинг индексов
 */
export function normalizeMarkdown(markdown: string): NormalizedMarkdown {
  const normalized: string[] = [];
  const mapIdx: number[] = [];
  const len = markdown.length;
  let i = 0;
  let atLineStart = true;

  const pushChar = (ch: string, origIdx: number) => {
    normalized.push(ch);
    mapIdx.push(origIdx);
    atLineStart = ch === '\n';
  };

  while (i < len) {
    const ch = markdown[i];
    const nxt = markdown[i + 1];

    if (atLineStart) {
      // Пропускаем заголовки (#)
      if (ch === '#') {
        while (i < len && markdown[i] === '#') i++;
        while (i < len && markdown[i] === ' ') i++;
        continue;
      }
      // Пропускаем blockquotes (>)
      if (ch === '>') {
        i++;
        if (markdown[i] === ' ') i++;
        continue;
      }
      // Пропускаем списки (-)
      if (ch === '-' && markdown[i + 1] === ' ') {
        i += 2;
        continue;
      }
    }

    // Пропускаем жирный/курсив (** или __)
    if ((ch === '*' && nxt === '*') || (ch === '_' && nxt === '_')) {
      i += 2;
      continue;
    }

    // Пропускаем одинарные markdown символы (*, _, ~)
    if (ch === '*' || ch === '_' || ch === '~') {
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    // Обрабатываем inline code (`)
    if (ch === '`') {
      i++;
      while (i < len && markdown[i] !== '`') {
        pushChar(markdown[i], i);
        i++;
      }
      if (i < len && markdown[i] === '`') i++;
      continue;
    }

    // Пропускаем ссылки [text](url)
    if (ch === '[') {
      i++;
      while (i < len && markdown[i] !== ']') {
        pushChar(markdown[i], i);
        i++;
      }
      if (i < len && markdown[i] === ']') i++;
      if (i < len && markdown[i] === '(') {
        while (i < len && markdown[i] !== ')') i++;
        if (i < len && markdown[i] === ')') i++;
      }
      continue;
    }

    // Пропускаем изображения ![alt](url)
    if (ch === '!' && markdown[i + 1] === '[') {
      i += 2;
      while (i < len && markdown[i] !== ']') i++;
      if (i < len && markdown[i] === ']') i++;
      if (i < len && markdown[i] === '(') {
        while (i < len && markdown[i] !== ')') i++;
        if (i < len && markdown[i] === ')') i++;
      }
      continue;
    }

    // Обрабатываем переносы строк
    if (ch === '\n' || ch === '\r') {
      pushChar('\n', i);
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    pushChar(ch, i);
    i++;
  }

  const normalizedStr = normalized
    .join('')
    .replace(/[\u00A0\u202F]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\r/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

  return {
    normalized: normalizedStr,
    mapIdx,
  };
}

/**
 * Находит позицию текста в нормализованном markdown и возвращает оригинальные индексы
 */
export function findTextInNormalizedMarkdown(
  markdown: string,
  searchText: string,
): { start: number; end: number } | null {
  const { normalized, mapIdx } = normalizeMarkdown(markdown);
  const normalizedSearch = searchText
    .replace(/[\u00A0\u202F]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\r/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  const pos = normalized.indexOf(normalizedSearch);
  if (pos < 0) return null;

  const startOrig = mapIdx[pos];
  const endMapIdx = mapIdx[pos + normalizedSearch.length - 1];
  const endOrig =
    typeof endMapIdx === 'number' ? endMapIdx + 1 : startOrig + searchText.length;

  return { start: startOrig, end: endOrig };
}

/**
 * Заменяет текст в markdown с сохранением форматирования
 */
export function replaceTextInMarkdown(
  markdown: string,
  searchText: string,
  replacement: string,
): string {
  const pos = findTextInNormalizedMarkdown(markdown, searchText);
  if (pos) {
    return (
      markdown.slice(0, pos.start) + replacement + markdown.slice(pos.end)
    );
  }
  // Fallback: простая замена
  return markdown.replace(searchText, replacement);
}
