/**
 * Human-readable interpretations for meta-analysis metrics
 */

export interface MetaInsight {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  sentiment: 'positive' | 'neutral' | 'negative';
}

/**
 * Generate key insights from aggregate metrics
 */
export function generateKeyInsights(agg: any): MetaInsight[] {
  const insights: MetaInsight[] = [];
  
  // Effectiveness insight
  const effectiveness = agg.effectiveness || 0;
  if (effectiveness >= 0.7) {
    insights.push({
      title: 'Effective dialog',
      description: 'You maintain clear focus and structure in your conversations',
      sentiment: 'positive'
    });
  } else if (effectiveness >= 0.5) {
    insights.push({
      title: 'Moderate effectiveness',
      description: 'Your dialogs are functional but could benefit from clearer structure',
      sentiment: 'neutral'
    });
  } else {
    insights.push({
      title: 'Room for improvement',
      description: 'Consider being more specific and structured in your requests',
      sentiment: 'negative'
    });
  }

  // Structure insight
  const structure = agg.structureScore || 0;
  if (structure >= 0.7) {
    insights.push({
      title: 'Well-structured requests',
      description: 'Your messages are organized and easy to follow',
      sentiment: 'positive'
    });
  } else if (structure < 0.5) {
    insights.push({
      title: 'Needs more structure',
      description: 'Try breaking complex requests into clear steps or bullet points',
      sentiment: 'negative'
    });
  }

  // Focus retention insight
  const focus = agg.focusRetention || 0;
  if (focus >= 0.7) {
    insights.push({
      title: 'Strong focus',
      description: 'You stay on topic and maintain conversation continuity',
      sentiment: 'positive'
    });
  } else if (focus < 0.5) {
    insights.push({
      title: 'Scattered focus',
      description: 'Topics shift frequently - try maintaining thread continuity',
      sentiment: 'negative'
    });
  }

  // Thinking depth (from lastResults)
  const thinkingDepth = agg.lastResults?.thinking?.depth?.label;
  if (thinkingDepth === 'Systemic' || thinkingDepth === 'Deep') {
    insights.push({
      title: 'Deep thinking',
      description: 'You explore problems thoroughly and consider interconnections',
      sentiment: 'positive'
    });
  } else if (thinkingDepth === 'Shallow' || thinkingDepth === 'Basic') {
    insights.push({
      title: 'Surface-level exploration',
      description: 'Consider diving deeper into problem analysis',
      sentiment: 'neutral'
    });
  }

  return insights.slice(0, 3); // Max 3 insights
}

/**

 * Provider names must match backend/internal/http/genai.go determineProvider() output (lowercase)
 * Model names must match backend/internal/ai/model_manager.go model definitions
 */
export function mapAliasToModel(alias: string): { provider: string; model: string } | null {
  const mapping: Record<string, { provider: string; model: string }> = {
    // Gemini models
    'gemini_fast': { provider: 'gemini', model: 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite' },
    'gemini_balanced': { provider: 'gemini', model: 'gemini-2.5-flash' },
    'gemini_quality': { provider: 'gemini', model: 'gemini-2.5-pro' },
    
    // OpenAI models
    'gpt_fast': { provider: 'openai', model: 'gpt-5-nano' },
    'gpt_balanced': { provider: 'openai', model: 'gpt-5-mini' },
    'gpt_quality': { provider: 'openai', model: 'gpt-5' },
    
    // Grok models
    'grok_fast': { provider: 'grok', model: 'grok-4-fast-non-reasoning' },
    'grok_balanced': { provider: 'grok', model: 'grok-4-fast-reasoning' },
    'grok_quality': { provider: 'grok', model: 'grok-4-0709' },
    
    // Claude models (provider is 'anthropic' in usage metrics)
    'claude_fast': { provider: 'anthropic', model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001' },
    'claude_balanced': { provider: 'anthropic', model: 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929' },
    
    // DeepSeek models
    'deepseek_fast': { provider: 'deepseek', model: 'deepseek-chat' },
    'deepseek_quality': { provider: 'deepseek', model: 'deepseek-reasoner' },
  };

  const result = mapping[alias] || null;
  
  return result;
}

Файл: perspectiveAnalysis.ts

import { api } from './api';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { useGenAISettings } from '../stores/genaiSettingsStore';
import { getPreferredLanguage, getLanguageName } from './uiUtils';

// Track perspective IDs for which generation is in progress to prevent duplicate requests
const generatingAnalyses = new Set<string>();

export interface PerspectiveAnalysis {
  title: string;
  keyPoints: string[];
  blindSpots: string[];
}

/**
 * Generates structured analysis for a perspective (title, key points, blind spots).
 * Creates an interaction with subkind 'perspective.{preset}.analysis' linked to the perspective.
 * 
 * @param perspectiveId - ID of the perspective interaction (can be local or server ID)
 * @param perspectiveContent - Content of the perspective (markdown text)
 * @param preset - Preset type (e.g., 'consulting', 'themes')
 * @returns Promise that resolves when analysis generation is complete
 */
export async function generatePerspectiveAnalysis(
  perspectiveId: string,
  perspectiveContent: string,
  preset: string
): Promise<void> {
  // Check if generation is already in progress for this perspective
  if (generatingAnalyses.has(perspectiveId)) {
    console.log('[PerspectiveAnalysis] Generation already in progress, skipping', { perspectiveId });
    return;
  }

  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
  const projectId = genaiChat.projectId;
  
  if (!projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') {
    console.log('[PerspectiveAnalysis] Skipping for local project');
    return;
  }

  // Resolve server ID from local ID mapping
  const map = (genaiChat as any).persistedByLocalId || {};
  const serverId = map[perspectiveId] || perspectiveId;
  
  // Build reverse map for bidirectional lookup
  const reverseMap: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  Object.entries(map).forEach(([local, server]) => {
    if (!reverseMap[server as string]) reverseMap[server as string] = [];
    reverseMap[server as string].push(local);
  });
  const localIds = reverseMap[perspectiveId] || [];
  
  // Check if analysis interaction already exists
  const analysisSubkind = `perspective.${preset}.analysis`;
  const existingAnalysis = genaiChat.interactions.find((it) => {
    if (it.subkind !== analysisSubkind) return false;
    // Check replyTo
    if (it.replyTo === perspectiveId || it.replyTo === serverId || localIds.includes(it.replyTo || '')) {
      return true;
    }
    // Check relations
    if (it.relations && Array.isArray(it.relations)) {
      return it.relations.some((r: any) => 
        r.targetId === perspectiveId || r.targetId === serverId || localIds.includes(r.targetId || '')
      );
    }
    return false;
  });
  
  if (existingAnalysis) {
    console.log('[PerspectiveAnalysis] Already exists, skipping', { perspectiveId, analysisId: existingAnalysis.id });
    return;
  }

  // Mark as generating
  generatingAnalyses.add(perspectiveId);

  try {
    const settingsState = useGenAISettings.getState();
    
    // Use stance model/provider settings
    const evalModel = (settingsState.stanceModel && settingsState.stanceModel.trim()) 
      ? settingsState.stanceModel 
      : 'gemini_fast';
    const preferredLang = getPreferredLanguage();
    const langName = getLanguageName(preferredLang);

    // Schema for structured response
    const schema = {
      type: 'object',
      additionalProperties: false,
      properties: {
        title: {
          type: 'string',
          minLength: 5,
          maxLength: 100,
          description: 'Concise title summarizing this perspective (max 100 characters)'
        },
        keyPoints: {
          type: 'array',
          minItems: 3,
          maxItems: 8,
          items: {
            type: 'string',
            minLength: 10,
            maxLength: 200,
            description: 'Concrete, specific action, recommendation, question, or next step explicitly stated anywhere in the perspective text. First check for explicit sections (e.g., "Key Questions", "Next Steps", "Where to Dig Deeper"). If such sections exist, extract from them. If not, scan the entire text for imperative statements, explicit questions, specific next steps, or concrete recommendations. Must be actionable and specific (e.g., "Ask: What is the maximum budget?", "Stop generating new ideas and focus on choosing from three concepts", "Segment criteria separately for 8-year-old and 12-year-old children"). Extract verbatim or closely paraphrased - do not summarize or generalize.'
          }
        },
        blindSpots: {
          type: 'array',
          minItems: 2,
          maxItems: 6,
          items: {
            type: 'string',
            minLength: 10,
            maxLength: 200,
            description: 'Blind spot or gap in the discussion that needs to be addressed'
          }
        }
      },
      required: ['title', 'keyPoints', 'blindSpots']
    } as any;

    const schemaText = JSON.stringify(schema, null, 2);

    // Prompt in preferred language
    const prompt = `You are an expert analyst reviewing a perspective analysis of a discussion.

Task:
1. Review the following perspective analysis
2. Extract a concise title that captures the essence of this perspective
3. Identify 3-8 key points that are direct actions, recommendations, questions, or next steps explicitly stated in the perspective text
4. Identify 2-6 blind spots or gaps in the discussion that this perspective reveals but doesn't fully address

STYLE REQUIREMENTS:
- Title: Concise, specific, max 100 characters. Should capture the unique angle of this perspective.
- Key Points: Extract concrete, specific actions, recommendations, questions, or next steps that are explicitly stated anywhere in the text. First, check for explicit sections like "КЛЮЧЕВЫЕ ВОПРОСЫ" (Key Questions), "Самый важный следующий шаг" (Most Important Next Step), "ГДЕ СТОИТ КОПАТЬ ГЛУБЖЕ" (Where to Dig Deeper), or similar labeled sections. If such sections exist, extract from them. If not, scan the entire text for:
  * Direct imperative statements (e.g., "Провести квалификацию...", "Прекратить генерацию...", "Сфокусироваться на...")
  * Explicit questions formulated as recommendations (e.g., "Задать вопрос: 'Какой бюджет?'")
  * Specific next steps or actions stated directly (e.g., "Следующий шаг: ...", "Необходимо...", "Следует...")
  * Concrete recommendations that can be acted upon (e.g., "Сегментировать критерии для 8-летних и 12-летних детей отдельно")
Each point should be a verbatim or closely paraphrased action/recommendation/question from the text. Do not summarize or generalize - extract the exact actionable items. 10-200 characters each.
- Blind Spots: Each should identify a specific gap, assumption, or missing consideration. 10-200 characters each. These are areas that need resolution or deeper exploration.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- All content must be grounded in the perspective text provided
- Key Points must be directly extracted verbatim or closely paraphrased from the text
- Look for explicit recommendations, questions, actions, or next steps throughout the entire text, not just in labeled sections
- Identify actionable items by their structure: imperative verbs, direct questions, explicit recommendations, specific next steps
- Extract the exact wording or close paraphrase - do not summarize, generalize, or create meta-commentary
- Each Key Point should be a concrete, specific item that can be acted upon immediately
- If explicit sections exist, prioritize them; if not, extract from anywhere in the text where concrete actions/recommendations/questions are stated
- Avoid generic advice - only extract what is explicitly stated as a recommendation, question, or action in the text
- Be specific and grounded in the actual text

User requirement: you should create your answer in ${langName} language. Use English or other languages inline only if you use well-known and accepted in target language terms.

The JSON MUST conform EXACTLY to this schema (no additional keys, types must match):
${schemaText}

PERSPECTIVE ANALYSIS TO REVIEW:
${perspectiveContent}`;

    const langDirective = `You MUST produce all output strictly in ${langName} language. Use English only for technical terms or code if they are standard industry terms.`;

    console.log('[PerspectiveAnalysis] sending structured request', { model: evalModel, promptChars: prompt.length });

    const res = await api.genaiGenerate({
      model: evalModel,
      prompt,
      strictJSONEnabled: true,
      jsonSchema: schema,
      maxOutputTokens: 2048,
      webSearchEnabled: false,
      systemInstruction: langDirective,
    });

    // Parse response
    let parsed: any = null;
    try {
      if (typeof res?.content === 'string') {
        const s = res.content.trim();
        if (s.startsWith('{') || s.startsWith('[')) parsed = JSON.parse(s);
      }
      const rawJSON = (res as any)?.rawJSON;
      if (!parsed && typeof rawJSON === 'string') {
        const s2 = rawJSON.trim();
        if (s2.startsWith('{') || s2.startsWith('[')) parsed = JSON.parse(s2);
      }
      if (!parsed && typeof res?.content === 'string') {
        const m = res.content.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
        if (m && m[0]) {
          parsed = JSON.parse(m[0]);
        }
      }
    } catch (pe) {
      console.warn('[PerspectiveAnalysis] parse failed', pe, { contentPreview: (res?.content || '').slice(0, 200) });
    }

    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || typeof parsed.title !== 'string' || !Array.isArray(parsed.keyPoints) || !Array.isArray(parsed.blindSpots)) {
      console.log('[PerspectiveAnalysis] no valid analysis parsed, skipping');
      return;
    }

    // Extract and validate analysis
    const analysis: PerspectiveAnalysis = {
      title: parsed.title.trim(),
      keyPoints: parsed.keyPoints
        .filter((p: any) => p && typeof p === 'string' && p.trim().length > 0)
        .slice(0, 8)
        .map((p: any) => p.trim()),
      blindSpots: parsed.blindSpots
        .filter((b: any) => b && typeof b === 'string' && b.trim().length > 0)
        .slice(0, 6)
        .map((b: any) => b.trim()),
    };

    if (analysis.keyPoints.length < 3 || analysis.blindSpots.length < 2) {
      console.log('[PerspectiveAnalysis] insufficient analysis data', { keyPoints: analysis.keyPoints.length, blindSpots: analysis.blindSpots.length });
      return;
    }

    console.log('[PerspectiveAnalysis] generated analysis', { title: analysis.title, keyPoints: analysis.keyPoints.length, blindSpots: analysis.blindSpots.length, model: evalModel, perspectiveId });

    // Create perspective.{preset}.analysis interaction
    try {
      const analysisId = Date.now().toString() + '-perspective-analysis';
      const analysisData = analysis;

      // Add to local state first
      useGenaiChatStore.setState((s) => ({
        interactions: [
          ...s.interactions,
          {
            id: analysisId,
            projectId: s.projectId,
            kind: 'system',
            subkind: analysisSubkind,
            content: JSON.stringify(analysisData),
            contentSanitized: JSON.stringify(analysisData),
            replyTo: perspectiveId,
            relations: [{ type: 'analyzes', targetId: perspectiveId }],
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          } as any,
        ],
      } as any));

      // Persist to server (async, don't block UI)
      (async () => {
        try {
          const map = (useGenaiChatStore.getState() as any).persistedByLocalId || {};
          const serverReplyTo = map[perspectiveId] || perspectiveId;

          const payload: any = {
            kind: 'system',
            subkind: analysisSubkind,
            content: JSON.stringify(analysisData),
            replyTo: serverReplyTo,
            relations: [{ type: 'analyzes', targetId: serverReplyTo }],
          };

          const res = await api.createProjectInteraction(projectId, payload);

          // Update local interaction with server ID and update replyTo/relations if needed
          useGenaiChatStore.setState((st) => {
            const items = [...st.interactions];
            const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === analysisId);
            if (idx >= 0) {
              (items[idx] as any).id = res.id;
              // Update replyTo and relations.targetId to use server ID if they reference perspectiveId
              if (items[idx].replyTo === perspectiveId && serverReplyTo !== perspectiveId) {
                (items[idx] as any).replyTo = serverReplyTo;
              }
              if (items[idx].relations && Array.isArray(items[idx].relations)) {
                items[idx].relations = items[idx].relations!.map((r: any) => {
                  if (r.targetId === perspectiveId && serverReplyTo !== perspectiveId) {
                    return { ...r, targetId: serverReplyTo };
                  }
                  return r;
                });
              }
            }

            const newMap = { ...(st.persistedByLocalId || {}) } as Record<string, string>;
            newMap[analysisId] = res.id;

            return { interactions: items, persistedByLocalId: newMap } as any;
          });

          console.log('[PerspectiveAnalysis] persisted to server', { analysisId, serverId: res.id, perspectiveId });
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[PerspectiveAnalysis] Failed to persist to server', e);
        }
      })();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[PerspectiveAnalysis] Failed to create analysis interaction', e);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[PerspectiveAnalysis] Failed to generate analysis', e);
  } finally {
    // Always remove from generating set
    generatingAnalyses.delete(perspectiveId);
  }
}

Файл: projectTitleGeneration.ts

import { api } from './api';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { useProjectsStore } from '../stores/projectsStore';

// Track project IDs for which title generation is in progress to prevent duplicate requests
const generatingTitle = new Set<string>();

/**
 * Generates a project title based on conversation history.
 * @param projectId - ID of the project to generate title for
 * @param preferredLang - Target language ('ru', 'en', 'kk', etc.)
 * @returns Promise that resolves when title generation is complete
 */
export async function generateProjectTitle(params: {
  projectId: string;
  preferredLang: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  const { projectId, preferredLang } = params;

  // Skip if projectId is invalid
  if (!projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') {
    console.log('[ProjectTitle] Skipping - invalid projectId', { projectId });
    return;
  }

  // Check if title generation is already in progress for this project
  if (generatingTitle.has(projectId)) {
    console.log('[ProjectTitle] Generation already in progress, skipping', { projectId });
    return;
  }

  // Check if project already has a proper name (not Draft or empty)
  try {
    // Fetch project directly from server to ensure we have latest data
    let projectData: any = null;
    try {
      projectData = await api.getProject(projectId);
      console.log('[ProjectTitle] Fetched project data', { projectId, displayName: projectData?.displayName });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[ProjectTitle] Failed to fetch project, using currentProject', e);
      // Fallback to currentProject if fetch fails
      projectData = useProjectsStore.getState().currentProject;
    }

    const projectName = (projectData?.displayName || '').trim();
    if (projectName && projectName.toLowerCase() !== 'draft' && projectName.length > 0) {
      console.log('[ProjectTitle] Project already has a name, skipping', { projectId, projectName });
      return;
    }

    // Also check if title was already finalized for this project (localStorage check)
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const finalized = window.localStorage.getItem(`chatTitleFinal:${projectId}`) === '1';
      if (finalized) {
        console.log('[ProjectTitle] Title already finalized, skipping', { projectId });
        return;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[ProjectTitle] Failed to check project name', e);
  }

  // Mark as generating
  generatingTitle.add(projectId);

  try {
    const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
    
    // Build messages from interactions for better signal (use summary if available)
    const userInteractions = genaiChat.interactions.filter((it) => it.kind === 'user');
    const last5 = userInteractions.slice(Math.max(0, userInteractions.length - 5));
    const messages = last5.map((it) => ({
      role: 'user' as const,
      text: (it.summary && it.summary.trim()) ? it.summary : it.content,
    }));

    // If empty, fallback to chat messages
    if (messages.length === 0) {
      const chatMessages = genaiChat.messages.filter((m) => m.role === 'user');
      const fallbackLast5 = chatMessages.slice(Math.max(0, chatMessages.length - 5));
      fallbackLast5.forEach((m) => {
        messages.push({ role: 'user', text: m.content });
      });
    }

    // Skip if no messages
    if (messages.length === 0) {
      console.log('[ProjectTitle] No messages found, skipping', { projectId });
      generatingTitle.delete(projectId);
      return;
    }

    const langName = (() => {
      switch (preferredLang) {
        case 'ru': return 'Russian';
        case 'en': return 'English';
        case 'kk':
        case 'kz': return 'Kazakh';
        default: return 'Russian';
      }
    })();

    const transcript = messages.map((m) => `- ${m.role}: ${m.text}`).join('\n');

    const prompt = `User requirement: you should create your answer in ${langName} language. Use English or other languages inline only if you use well-known and accepted in target language terms.

You are generating a concise, descriptive title for a chat project based on its conversation.

Conversation transcript (most recent last):
${transcript}

Requirements:
- Title must be brief and descriptive (2-6 words)
- Use title case
- No quotes or special formatting
- Reflect the user's main intent or topic
- Be specific and non-generic

Return strictly JSON only, no markdown/code fences, matching this shape: { "title": "Your Title Here" }.

Example: {"title": "Climate Change Policies"}`;

    console.log('[ProjectTitle] Calling aiStructured', { projectId });
    const res = await api.aiStructured({
      prompt,
      minCapabilityScore: 6,
      maxOutputSize: 512,
    });
    console.log('[ProjectTitle] Received response from aiStructured', { 
      projectId, 
      ok: res?.ok,
      hasResult: !!res?.result,
      result: res?.result
    });

    // Parse response - aiStructured returns already parsed JSON in result field
    let parsed: any = null;
    if (res?.ok && res?.result && typeof res.result === 'object') {
      parsed = res.result;
      console.log('[ProjectTitle] Using result from aiStructured', { parsed });
    } else {
      console.warn('[ProjectTitle] aiStructured returned invalid response', { res });
      generatingTitle.delete(projectId);
      return;
    }

    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || !parsed.title || typeof parsed.title !== 'string') {
      console.log('[ProjectTitle] No valid title parsed, skipping', { parsed });
      generatingTitle.delete(projectId);
      return;
    }

    const title = parsed.title.trim();
    
    // Sanitize title: remove quotes, limit length
    const sanitizedTitle = title.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '').trim();
    if (sanitizedTitle.length === 0 || sanitizedTitle.length > 80) {
      console.log('[ProjectTitle] Invalid title length, skipping', { sanitizedTitle });
      generatingTitle.delete(projectId);
      return;
    }

    // Verify projectId is still valid before updating
    // Fetch project again to ensure we have latest data
    let currentProject: any = null;
    try {
      currentProject = await api.getProject(projectId);
      console.log('[ProjectTitle] Verifying project before update', { projectId, displayName: currentProject?.displayName });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[ProjectTitle] Failed to fetch project for verification, using currentProject', e);
      currentProject = useProjectsStore.getState().currentProject;
    }
    
    if (!currentProject || currentProject.id !== projectId) {
      console.warn('[ProjectTitle] Project changed during generation, aborting', { 
        expectedProjectId: projectId, 
        currentProjectId: currentProject?.id 
      });
      generatingTitle.delete(projectId);
      return;
    }

    // Update project with new title
    try {
      await api.updateProject(projectId, { 
        displayName: sanitizedTitle, 
        view: 'discovery' 
      } as any);
      
      console.log('[ProjectTitle] Successfully updated project', { projectId, title: sanitizedTitle });

      // Get updated project data from server to ensure consistency
      let updatedProject: any;
      try {
        updatedProject = await api.getProject(projectId);
      } catch {
        // Fallback to local update if fetch fails
        updatedProject = { ...currentProject, id: projectId, displayName: sanitizedTitle, view: 'discovery' };
      }

      // Update projects store
      useProjectsStore.setState((prev) => {
        const exists = prev.projects.some((p) => p.id === projectId);
        const updated = { ...updatedProject, id: projectId, displayName: sanitizedTitle, view: 'discovery' } as any;
        return {
          projects: exists
            ? prev.projects.map((p) => (p.id === projectId ? updated : p))
            : [updated, ...prev.projects],
          currentProject: updated,
        } as any;
      });

      // Refresh projects list from server to ensure consistency
      try {
        const { fetchProjects } = useProjectsStore.getState();
        await fetchProjects('discovery');
        console.log('[ProjectTitle] Refreshed projects list from server');
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[ProjectTitle] Failed to refresh projects list', e);
      }

      // Mark as finalized to prevent future suggestions
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        try {
          window.localStorage.setItem(`chatTitleFinal:${projectId}`, '1');
        } catch {}
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[ProjectTitle] Failed to update project', e);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[ProjectTitle] Title generation failed', e);
  } finally {
    // Always remove from generating set
    generatingTitle.delete(projectId);
  }
}

import type { SxInstruction } from '../types/sx';

const ALLOWED_TYPES = new Set(['entity_mark', 'monitor_metric', 'watchlist_add', 'link_reference']);

export function sanitizeSx(text: string): string {
  try {
    return (text || '').replace(/<!--\s*@sx:[\s\S]*?-->/g, '').trim();
  } catch {
    return text;
  }
}

export function parseSxInstructionsFromContent(text: string): { sanitized: string; instructions: SxInstruction[] } {
  const instructions: SxInstruction[] = [] as any;
  if (!text || typeof text !== 'string') return { sanitized: text, instructions };
  try {
    const regex = /<!--\s*@sx:([\s\S]*?)-->/g;
    let match: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((match = regex.exec(text)) !== null) {
      const raw = (match[1] || '').trim();
      try {
        const obj = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (!obj || obj.v !== '1' || !ALLOWED_TYPES.has(obj.type)) {
          console.warn('[sx] Dropped invalid object', obj);
          continue;
        }
        // minimal per-type checks
        if (obj.type === 'entity_mark') {
          if (typeof obj.id !== 'string' || typeof obj.name !== 'string') { console.warn('[sx] entity_mark missing id/name'); continue; }
        } else if (obj.type === 'monitor_metric') {
          if (typeof obj.id !== 'string' && typeof obj.name !== 'string') { console.warn('[sx] monitor_metric missing id/name'); continue; }
        } else if (obj.type === 'watchlist_add') {
          if (typeof obj.id !== 'string') { console.warn('[sx] watchlist_add missing id'); continue; }
          if (obj.items && !Array.isArray(obj.items)) { console.warn('[sx] watchlist_add items not array'); continue; }
        } else if (obj.type === 'link_reference') {
          if (typeof obj.relation !== 'string' || typeof obj.fromId !== 'string' || typeof obj.toId !== 'string') { console.warn('[sx] link_reference missing fields'); continue; }
        }
        instructions.push(obj as SxInstruction);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[sx] JSON parse error', e);
      }
    }
  } catch {}
  const sanitized = sanitizeSx(text);
  return { sanitized, instructions };
}

/**
 * Обработчик редактирования выделенного текста в сообщениях
 * Вынесено из DiscoveryPage для улучшения читаемости и переиспользования
 */

import React from 'react';
import { api } from './api';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { useGenAISettings } from '../stores/genaiSettingsStore';
import { HATL_ONE_INSTRUCTIONS } from './hatlInstructions';
import {
  getPreferredLanguage,
  getSxSystemInstructionShort,
} from './uiUtils';
import { replaceTextInMarkdown } from './markdownNormalizer';
import AgentPalette from '../components/AgentPalette';

export interface EditTextOptions {
  interactionId: string;
  selectedText: string;
  fullText: string;
  displayedText: string;
  agentName: string;
  agentProfile?: any;
  onUpdate: (interactionId: string, newContent: string) => void;
  onError: (interactionId: string, error: string) => void;
  onStart: (interactionId: string) => void;
  onFinish: (interactionId: string) => void;
  onSaveRequest?: (interactionId: string, selectedText: string, request: string) => void;
}

/**
 * Очищает ответ модели от code fences и кавычек
 */
function stripFences(s: string): string {
  let t = s.trim();
  t = t.replace(/^```[a-zA-Z]*\n([\s\S]*?)\n```$/m, '$1').trim();
  t = t
    .replace(/^```[\s\S]*?```$/m, (m) =>
      m
        .replace(/^```[a-zA-Z]*\n?/, '')
        .replace(/\n?```$/, ''),
    )
    .trim();
  if (
    (t.startsWith('"') && t.endsWith('"')) ||
    (t.startsWith("'") && t.endsWith("'"))
  ) {
    t = t.slice(1, -1);
  }
  return t.trim();
}

/**
 * Обрабатывает редактирование текста через AgentPalette
 */
export async function handleEditTextWithPalette(
  options: EditTextOptions,
): Promise<void> {
  const {
    interactionId,
    selectedText,
    fullText,
    displayedText,
    agentName,
    agentProfile,
    onUpdate,
    onError,
    onStart,
    onFinish,
    onSaveRequest,
  } = options;

  try {
    const preferredLang = getPreferredLanguage();
    const anchor = (await import('./uiUtils')).getAnchorRect();

    const ctxNode = React.createElement(
      'div',
      null,
      React.createElement(
        'div',
        null,
        React.createElement('b', null, 'Fragment:'),
        ' ',
        selectedText.slice(0, 200),
        selectedText.length > 200 ? '…' : '',
      ),
      React.createElement(
        'div',
        { style: { marginTop: 4 } },
        React.createElement('b', null, 'Answer (head):'),
        ' ',
        (fullText || '').slice(0, 160),
        fullText.length > 160 ? '…' : '',
      ),
    );

    const submit = async (request: string) => {
      if (!request.trim()) return;
      onStart(interactionId);
      
      // Save request for retry
      if (onSaveRequest) {
        onSaveRequest(interactionId, selectedText, request);
      }

      const prompt = `User requirement: you should create your answer in ${preferredLang} language. Use English or other languages inline only if you use well-known and accepted in target language terms.\n\nYou are ${agentName}. We provide the full assistant answer (FULL_ANSWER) and a specific fragment (SELECTED_FRAGMENT) the user wants to modify. The user request is (USER_REQUEST).\n\nReturn ONLY the updated fragment. Preserve the fragment's existing formatting and structure where possible, and use Markdown appropriately (headings ###, lists, emphasis, blank lines) if it helps readability and does not contradict the request. Do not add any preface, labels, or explanations. Do not wrap the result in code fences. Do NOT return JSON.\n\nFULL_ANSWER:\n${fullText}\n\nSELECTED_FRAGMENT:\n${selectedText}\n\nUSER_REQUEST:\n${request}\n`;

      const settings = useGenAISettings.getState();
      const useModel = agentProfile?.model || settings.model;
      const sxSystemInstruction = getSxSystemInstructionShort();

      const genaiOptions: any = {
        profile: /_quality$/i.test(useModel || '') ? 'quality' : 'fast',
        modelOverride: useModel,
        groundingEnabled: settings.groundingEnabled,
        temperature: settings.temperature,
        maxOutputTokens: Math.max(512, settings.maxOutputTokens || 1024),
        systemInstruction:
          [
            settings.systemInstruction || '',
            HATL_ONE_INSTRUCTIONS,
            sxSystemInstruction,
          ]
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join('\n\n')
            .trim() || undefined,
      };

      try {
        const started = performance.now();
        const originalIndex = displayedText.indexOf(selectedText);
        const small = selectedText.length < 200;

        console.log('[EditSelected] sending', {
          provider: agentProfile?.provider,
          model: useModel,
          promptChars: prompt.length,
          fragmentChars: selectedText.length,
          answerChars: fullText.length,
          originalIndex,
          requestPreview: small
            ? request
            : `${request.slice(0, 120)}${request.length > 120 ? '…' : ''}`,
          fragmentPreview: small
            ? selectedText
            : `${selectedText.slice(0, 120)}…${selectedText.slice(-120)}`,
        });

        const res = await api.genaiGenerate({
          model: useModel,
          prompt,
          strictJSONEnabled: false,
          maxOutputTokens: genaiOptions.maxOutputTokens,
          webSearchEnabled: false,
          systemInstruction: genaiOptions.systemInstruction,
        });

        const rawOut = (res?.content || '').toString();
        let cleaned = stripFences(rawOut);
        let updated = cleaned;
        let outFormat: 'json' | 'plain' = 'plain';

        try {
          const obj = JSON.parse(cleaned);
          if (obj && typeof obj === 'object' && !Array.isArray(obj)) {
            const k = Object.keys(obj)[0];
            if (k) {
              updated = String((obj as any)[k] ?? '').trim();
              outFormat = 'json';
            }
          }
        } catch {}

        updated = stripFences(updated);
        if (!updated) throw new Error('Empty model response');

        const eq = updated === selectedText;
        const headFrom = selectedText.slice(0, 120);
        const tailFrom =
          selectedText.length > 240
            ? selectedText.slice(-120)
            : selectedText.slice(
                Math.max(0, selectedText.length - 120),
              );
        const headTo = updated.slice(0, 120);
        const tailTo =
          updated.length > 240
            ? updated.slice(-120)
            : updated.slice(Math.max(0, updated.length - 120));
        const delta = Math.abs(updated.length - selectedText.length);

        let newContentSanitized = '';
        try {
          const md = fullText;
          newContentSanitized = replaceTextInMarkdown(
            md,
            selectedText,
            updated,
          );
        } catch {
          newContentSanitized = displayedText.replace(selectedText, updated);
        }

        onUpdate(interactionId, newContentSanitized);

        const finished = performance.now();
        console.log('[EditSelected] result', {
          ms: Math.max(1, Math.round(finished - started)),
          updatedChars: updated.length,
          eq,
          delta,
          headFrom,
          tailFrom,
          headTo,
          tailTo,
          replacedOnce: true,
          fullIndex: originalIndex,
          outFormat,
          insertedPreview:
            updated.length < 200
              ? updated
              : `${updated.slice(0, 120)}…${updated.slice(-80)}`,
        });

        if (eq) {
          onError(
            interactionId,
            'No change produced. Try clarifying the edit request.',
          );
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        console.error('[EditSelected] error', {
          error: e?.message || String(e),
        });
        onError(interactionId, e?.message || 'Edit failed');
      } finally {
        onFinish(interactionId);
      }
    };

    // Mount AgentPalette (edit)
    const mount = document.createElement('div');
    document.body.appendChild(mount);
    const rootMod = await import('react-dom/client');
    const root = rootMod.createRoot(mount);
    const onClose = () => {
      try {
        root.unmount();
        mount.remove();
      } catch {}
    };
    root.render(
      React.createElement(AgentPalette as any, {
        mode: 'edit',
        visible: true,
        title: 'Edit selected fragment',
        subtitle: agentName,
        anchorRect: anchor,
        contextNode: ctxNode,
        submitLabel: 'Apply',
        onClose,
        onSubmitAsk: (t: string) => {
          onClose();
          submit(t);
        },
      }),
    );
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.warn('Edit selection failed', e);
    onError(interactionId, e?.message || 'Edit failed');
    onFinish(interactionId);
  }
}

/**
 * Обрабатывает редактирование текста напрямую (без палитры)
 * Используется для повторной попытки после ошибки
 */
export async function handleEditTextDirect(
  options: EditTextOptions & { request: string },
): Promise<void> {
  const {
    interactionId,
    selectedText,
    fullText,
    displayedText,
    agentName,
    agentProfile,
    request,
    onUpdate,
    onError,
    onStart,
    onFinish,
  } = options;

  onStart(interactionId);

  try {
    const preferredLang = getPreferredLanguage();
    const settings = useGenAISettings.getState();
    const useModel = agentProfile?.model || settings.model;
    const sxSystemInstruction = getSxSystemInstructionShort();

    const prompt = `User requirement: you should create your answer in ${preferredLang} language. Use English or other languages inline only if you use well-known and accepted in target language terms.\n\nYou are ${agentName}. We provide the full assistant answer (FULL_ANSWER) and a specific fragment (SELECTED_FRAGMENT) the user wants to modify. The user request is (USER_REQUEST).\n\nReturn ONLY the updated fragment. Preserve the fragment's existing formatting and structure where possible, and use Markdown appropriately (headings ###, lists, emphasis, blank lines) if it helps readability and does not contradict the request. Do not add any preface, labels, or explanations. Do not wrap the result in code fences. Do NOT return JSON.\n\nFULL_ANSWER:\n${fullText}\n\nSELECTED_FRAGMENT:\n${selectedText}\n\nUSER_REQUEST:\n${request}\n`;

    const genaiOptions: any = {
      profile: /_quality$/i.test(useModel || '') ? 'quality' : 'fast',
      modelOverride: useModel,
      groundingEnabled: settings.groundingEnabled,
      temperature: settings.temperature,
      maxOutputTokens: Math.max(512, settings.maxOutputTokens || 1024),
      systemInstruction:
        [
          settings.systemInstruction || '',
          HATL_ONE_INSTRUCTIONS,
          sxSystemInstruction,
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join('\n\n')
          .trim() || undefined,
    };

    const res = await api.genaiGenerate({
      model: useModel,
      prompt,
      strictJSONEnabled: false,
      maxOutputTokens: genaiOptions.maxOutputTokens,
      webSearchEnabled: false,
      systemInstruction: genaiOptions.systemInstruction,
    });

    const rawOut = (res?.content || '').toString();
    let cleaned = stripFences(rawOut);

    try {
      const obj = JSON.parse(cleaned);
      if (obj && typeof obj === 'object' && !Array.isArray(obj)) {
        const k = Object.keys(obj)[0];
        if (k) {
          cleaned = String((obj as any)[k] ?? '').trim();
        }
      }
    } catch {}

    const updated = stripFences(cleaned);
    if (!updated) throw new Error('Empty model response');

    let newContentSanitized = '';
    try {
      const md = fullText;
      newContentSanitized = replaceTextInMarkdown(md, selectedText, updated);
    } catch {
      newContentSanitized = displayedText.replace(selectedText, updated);
    }

    onUpdate(interactionId, newContentSanitized);
  } catch (err: any) {
    onError(interactionId, err?.message || 'Edit failed');
  } finally {
    onFinish(interactionId);
  }
}

/**
 * Text highlighting utilities for notes
 * Supports CSS Custom Highlight API with DOM fallback
 */

interface HighlightRange {
  text: string;
  noteIndex: number;
}

/**
 * Build ranges for a search string that may span multiple text nodes.
 * This works by concatenating textContent of all text nodes and mapping back to node offsets.
 */
export function findTextRangesAcrossNodes(container: Element, searchText: string): Range[] {
  const ranges: Range[] = [];
  if (!container || !searchText) return ranges;

  // Collect text nodes and lengths
  const textNodes: Array<{ node: Text; length: number }> = [];
  const walker = document.createTreeWalker(container, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
  let node: Node | null;
  let full = '';
  while ((node = walker.nextNode())) {
    const t = node as Text;
    const chunk = t.nodeValue || '';
    textNodes.push({ node: t, length: chunk.length });
    full += chunk;
  }
  if (!full) return ranges;

  // Find all occurrences in the concatenated string
  let idx = 0;
  while (true) {
    const found = full.indexOf(searchText, idx);
    if (found === -1) break;
    const startAbs = found;
    const endAbs = found + searchText.length;

    // Map absolute positions to node + offset
    let acc = 0;
    let startNode: Text | null = null;
    let startOffset = 0;
    let endNode: Text | null = null;
    let endOffset = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < textNodes.length; i++) {
      const { node: n, length } = textNodes[i];
      const nextAcc = acc + length;
      if (!startNode && startAbs >= acc && startAbs <= nextAcc) {
        startNode = n;
        startOffset = startAbs - acc;
      }
      if (!endNode && endAbs >= acc && endAbs <= nextAcc) {
        endNode = n;
        endOffset = endAbs - acc;
        break;
      }
      acc = nextAcc;
    }

    if (startNode && endNode) {
      const r = document.createRange();
      try {
        r.setStart(startNode, startOffset);
        r.setEnd(endNode, endOffset);
        ranges.push(r);
      } catch {}
    }

    idx = found + Math.max(1, searchText.length); // advance to avoid infinite loop on empty
  }

  return ranges;
}

/**
 * Find the first range (cross-node aware) for a note text
 */
export function findFirstRange(container: Element, noteText: string): Range | null {
  const ranges = findTextRangesAcrossNodes(container, noteText);
  return ranges.length > 0 ? ranges[0] : null;
}

/**
 * Highlight notes in a message using CSS Custom Highlight API (modern browsers)
 */
function highlightWithCustomAPI(container: Element, notes: string[]): boolean {
  if (typeof CSS === 'undefined' || !CSS.highlights) return false;

  try {
    const allRanges: Range[] = [];
    notes.forEach((noteText) => {
      const ranges = findTextRangesAcrossNodes(container, noteText);
      allRanges.push(...ranges);
    });

    CSS.highlights.set('note-highlight', new Highlight(...allRanges));
    return true;
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[Highlight] Custom Highlight API failed', e);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Highlight notes using DOM manipulation (fallback for older browsers)
 */
function highlightWithDOM(container: Element, notes: string[]): void {
  // Remove existing highlights
  container.querySelectorAll('.note-highlight').forEach((el) => {
    const parent = el.parentNode;
    if (parent) {
      parent.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(el.textContent || ''), el);
      parent.normalize(); // Merge adjacent text nodes
    }
  });

  notes.forEach((noteText, idx) => {
    const ranges = findTextRangesAcrossNodes(container, noteText);
    // Process ranges in reverse to maintain correct positions
    ranges.reverse().forEach((range) => {
      const mark = document.createElement('mark');
      mark.className = 'note-highlight';
      mark.setAttribute('data-note-index', String(idx));
      mark.title = `Note ${idx + 1}`;
      try {
        range.surroundContents(mark);
      } catch (e) {
        try {
          const contents = range.extractContents();
          mark.appendChild(contents);
          range.insertNode(mark);
        } catch {}
      }
    });
  });
}

/**
 * Clear all highlights from a container
 */
export function clearHighlights(container: Element): void {
  container.querySelectorAll('.note-highlight').forEach((el) => {
    const parent = el.parentNode;
    if (parent) {
      parent.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(el.textContent || ''), el);
      parent.normalize();
    }
  });
}

/**
 * Apply a single global CSS Highlight containing ranges across all containers.
 */
export function applyGlobalHighlight(pairs: Array<{ container: Element; notes: string[] }>): boolean {
  if (typeof CSS === 'undefined' || !CSS.highlights) return false;
  try {
    const all: Range[] = [];
    for (const { container, notes } of pairs) {
      const valid = (notes || []).filter((n) => n && n.trim().length > 0);
      for (const note of valid) {
        all.push(...findTextRangesAcrossNodes(container, note));
      }
    }
    CSS.highlights.set('note-highlight', new Highlight(...all));
    return true;
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[Highlight] applyGlobalHighlight failed', e);
    return false;
  }
}

export function clearGlobalHighlight(): void {
  if (typeof CSS !== 'undefined' && CSS.highlights) {
    try { CSS.highlights.delete('note-highlight'); } catch {}
  }
}

/**
 * Highlight notes in a message container
 */
export function highlightNotes(container: Element, notes: string[]): void {
  if (!container || !notes || notes.length === 0) {
    clearHighlights(container);
    return;
  }
  const validNotes = notes.filter((n) => n && n.trim().length > 0);
  if (validNotes.length === 0) {
    clearHighlights(container);
    return;
  }
  const customAPISuccess = highlightWithCustomAPI(container, validNotes);
  if (!customAPISuccess) {
    highlightWithDOM(container, validNotes);
  }
}

import { api } from './api';

interface TimingCacheEntry {
  estimatedSeconds: number | null;
  cachedAt: number; // timestamp in milliseconds
}

// Cache for 30 minutes
const CACHE_TTL_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;

// Maximum cache size to prevent memory leaks (keep last 100 entries)
const MAX_CACHE_SIZE = 100;

// In-memory cache: key is "provider:model"
const cache = new Map<string, TimingCacheEntry>();

/**
 * Get average timing estimate for a model (without token count)
 * Uses 30-minute cache to avoid excessive API calls
 */
export async function getAverageTiming(
  provider: string,
  model: string
): Promise<number | null> {
  const cacheKey = `${provider}:${model}`;
  const cached = cache.get(cacheKey);

  // Check if cache is valid
  if (cached && Date.now() - cached.cachedAt < CACHE_TTL_MS) {
    return cached.estimatedSeconds;
  }

  // Fetch from API
  try {
    const result = await api.getAverageTiming({
      provider,
      model,
    });

    // Cache the result
    cache.set(cacheKey, {
      estimatedSeconds: result.estimatedSeconds,
      cachedAt: Date.now(),
    });

    // Enforce maximum cache size to prevent memory leaks
    if (cache.size > MAX_CACHE_SIZE) {
      // Remove oldest entries (by cachedAt timestamp)
      const entries = Array.from(cache.entries());
      entries.sort((a, b) => a[1].cachedAt - b[1].cachedAt);
      const toRemove = entries.slice(0, cache.size - MAX_CACHE_SIZE);
      for (const [key] of toRemove) {
        cache.delete(key);
      }
    }

    return result.estimatedSeconds;
  } catch (error) {
    // Return cached value if available, even if expired
    if (cached) {
      return cached.estimatedSeconds;
    }
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Clear the cache (useful for testing or forced refresh)
 */
export function clearTimingCache(): void {
  cache.clear();
}

/**
 * UI utility functions for common UI operations
 */

/**
 * Get user's preferred language from localStorage
 * Returns lowercase 2-letter code (default: 'en')
 */
export function getPreferredLanguage(): string {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'en';
  const preferred = (localStorage.getItem('preferredLanguage') || 'EN').toLowerCase();
  return preferred && preferred.length === 2 ? preferred : 'en';
}

/**
 * Convert language code to full language name for prompts
 */
export function getLanguageName(langCode: string): string {
  const code = langCode.toLowerCase();
  switch (code) {
    case 'ru': return 'Russian';
    case 'en': return 'English';
    case 'kk':
    case 'kz': return 'Kazakh';
    default: return 'English';
  }
}

/**
 * Get anchor rectangle for modals/palettes, with fallback chain
 * Returns rect with top, left, width, height, or null if element not found
 */
export function getAnchorRect(): { top: number; left: number; width: number; height: number } | null {
  try {
    const el = (document.querySelector('#unfold-request-container') || 
                document.querySelector('#app') || 
                document.body) as HTMLElement;
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { top: rect.top - 8, left: rect.left, width: rect.width, height: rect.height };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Generate SX system instruction (short version)
 * Used for edit operations and simple interactions
 */
export function getSxSystemInstructionShort(): string {
  return `Hidden-instructions protocol (do not show to users):\n- When you need to output service instructions (entities, metrics, watchlist, relations), emit ONLY HTML comments <!-- @sx:{JSON} -->.`;
}

/**
 * Generate SX system instruction (full version)
 * Used for agent interactions with full context
 */
export function getSxSystemInstructionFull(): string {
  return (
    `Hidden-instructions protocol (do not show to users):\n` +
    `- When you need to output service instructions (entities, metrics to monitor, watchlist, relations), emit ONLY HTML comments of the form <!-- @sx:{JSON} -->.\n` +
    `- JSON must be valid and match v: "1" with one of types: entity_mark, monitor_metric, watchlist_add, link_reference.\n` +
    `- Do not duplicate @sx content in visible markdown. Keep normal answer readable.\n` +
    `- Examples: <!-- @sx:{"v":"1","type":"entity_mark","id":"ent-001","kind":"person","name":"…","description":"…"} -->`
  );
}

Файл: userStanceAnalysis.ts

import { api } from './api';
import { useGenaiChatStore } from '../stores/genaiChatStore';
import { useGenAISettings, getModelContextWindow } from '../stores/genaiSettingsStore';
import { getPreferredLanguage, getLanguageName } from './uiUtils';

// Track generation in progress to prevent duplicate requests
const generatingAnalyses = new Set<string>();

/**
 * Check if analysis generation is in progress for a given project
 */
export function isGeneratingUserStanceAnalysis(projectId: string, messageCount: number): boolean {
  const analysisKey = `${projectId}:${messageCount}`;
  return generatingAnalyses.has(analysisKey);
}

export interface UserStanceAnalysis {
  stance: string;
  riskProfile: {
    score: number;
    level: 'High' | 'Medium' | 'Low';
    rationale: string;
    triggerCategories: string[];
  };
  roles?: Array<{
    role: string;
    confidence: number;
    rationale: string;
  }>;
  industries?: Array<{
    industry: string;
    confidence: number;
    rationale: string;
  }>;
}

/**
 * Generates structured analysis for user stance (position, roles, industries, risk profile).
 * Creates an interaction with subkind 'eval.stance'.
 * 
 * @param projectId - Project ID
 * @param chatMessages - Array of chat messages (user, assistant, agent only)
 * @param existingAnalysis - Previous analysis if exists (for incremental update)
 * @param lastPair - Last pair of messages (user message and assistant/agent response) for incremental update
 * @returns Promise that resolves when analysis generation is complete
 */
export async function generateUserStanceAnalysis(
  projectId: string,
  chatMessages: Array<{ role: string; content: string }>,
  existingAnalysis?: UserStanceAnalysis | null,
  lastPair?: Array<{ role: string; content: string }>
): Promise<void> {
  if (!projectId || projectId === 'local-unfold') {
    console.log('[UserStanceAnalysis] Skipping for local project');
    return;
  }

  // Check if generation is already in progress
  const analysisKey = `${projectId}:${chatMessages.length}`;
  if (generatingAnalyses.has(analysisKey)) {
    return;
  }

  // Check if analysis interaction already exists
  const genaiChat = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
  const analysisSubkind = 'eval.stance';
  const existingAnalysisInteraction = genaiChat.interactions.find((it) => 
    it.subkind === analysisSubkind && it.projectId === projectId && !it.replyTo
  );

  // Only skip if we have existing interaction AND not doing incremental update AND not forcing refresh
  const isRefresh = existingAnalysis === null; // Explicit null means refresh
  const isIncremental = existingAnalysis && lastPair; // Both present means incremental
  
  if (existingAnalysisInteraction && !isIncremental && !isRefresh && existingAnalysis === undefined) {
    console.log('[UserStanceAnalysis] Already exists, skipping', { projectId });
    return;
  }

  // Mark as generating
  generatingAnalyses.add(analysisKey);

  try {
    const settingsState = useGenAISettings.getState();
    
    // Use stance model/provider settings
    const evalModel = (settingsState.stanceModel && settingsState.stanceModel.trim()) 
      ? settingsState.stanceModel 
      : 'gemini_fast';
    const preferredLang = getPreferredLanguage();
    const langName = getLanguageName(preferredLang);

    // Get context window and limit to 70%
    const contextWindow = getModelContextWindow(evalModel);
    const maxContextTokens = contextWindow ? Math.floor(contextWindow * 0.7) : Infinity;

    // Build transcript from messages
    let transcript = '';
    if (existingAnalysis && lastPair) {
      // Incremental update: use previous analysis + recent context (last 3-5 message pairs) + last pair
      const messagesForAnalysis = chatMessages.filter(m => 
        m.role === 'user' || m.role === 'assistant' || (m.role && (m as any).agentProfile)
      );
      
      // Extract recent message pairs (last 3-5 pairs, excluding the lastPair which we'll add separately)
      const recentPairs: Array<Array<{ role: string; content: string }>> = [];
      let userMsg: { role: string; content: string } | null = null;
      
      // Rough token estimation: ~4 chars per token
      const maxContextChars = Math.floor(maxContextTokens * 4);
      let contextChars = 0;
      const existingAnalysisChars = JSON.stringify(existingAnalysis, null, 2).length;
      const lastPairChars = lastPair.map(m => `${m.role}: ${m.content}`).join('\n').length;
      const basePromptChars = 2000; // Rough estimate for prompt overhead
      const availableChars = maxContextChars - existingAnalysisChars - lastPairChars - basePromptChars;
      
      // Go backwards from the end, but skip the last pair (it's already in lastPair)
      for (let i = messagesForAnalysis.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const msg = messagesForAnalysis[i];
        
        // Skip if this is part of lastPair
        let isLastPair = false;
        for (const lp of lastPair) {
          if (lp.content === msg.content && lp.role === msg.role) {
            isLastPair = true;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (isLastPair) {
          continue;
        }
        
        const msgChars = (msg.content || '').length;
        
        if (msg.role === 'assistant' || (msg.role && (msg as any).agentProfile)) {
          if (userMsg) {
            const pairChars = userMsg.content.length + msgChars + 50; // +50 for formatting
            if (contextChars + pairChars > availableChars && recentPairs.length > 0) {
              break; // Don't exceed available context
            }
            recentPairs.unshift([userMsg, msg]);
            contextChars += pairChars;
            userMsg = null;
            if (recentPairs.length >= 5) break; // Limit to 5 recent pairs
          }
        } else if (msg.role === 'user') {
          userMsg = msg;
        }
      }
      
      // Build context section
      const recentContext = recentPairs.length > 0 
        ? `\n\nRECENT DISCUSSION CONTEXT (last ${recentPairs.length} message pairs):\n${recentPairs.map(pair => `user: ${pair[0].content}\nassistant: ${pair[1].content}`).join('\n\n')}`
        : '';
      
      transcript = `PREVIOUS ANALYSIS:\n${JSON.stringify(existingAnalysis, null, 2)}${recentContext}\n\nLAST MESSAGE PAIR (new):\nuser: ${lastPair[0].content}\nassistant: ${lastPair[1].content}`;
    } else {
      // Full analysis: use all messages (limit to 70% of context)
      const messagesForAnalysis = chatMessages.filter(m => 
        m.role === 'user' || m.role === 'assistant' || (m.role && (m as any).agentProfile)
      );
      
      // Build pairs: user + assistant
      const pairs: Array<Array<{ role: string; content: string }>> = [];
      let userMsg: { role: string; content: string } | null = null;
      
      // Rough token estimation: ~4 chars per token
      let totalChars = 0;
      const maxChars = Math.floor(maxContextTokens * 4);
      
      // Go backwards from the end
      for (let i = messagesForAnalysis.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const msg = messagesForAnalysis[i];
        const msgChars = (msg.content || '').length;
        
        if (msg.role === 'assistant' || (msg.role && (msg as any).agentProfile)) {
          if (userMsg) {
            const pairChars = userMsg.content.length + msgChars + 50; // +50 for formatting
            if (totalChars + pairChars > maxChars && pairs.length > 0) {
              break;
            }
            pairs.unshift([userMsg, msg]);
            totalChars += pairChars;
            userMsg = null;
          }
        } else if (msg.role === 'user') {
          userMsg = msg;
        }
      }
      
      transcript = pairs.map(pair => `user: ${pair[0].content}\nassistant: ${pair[1].content}`).join('\n\n');
    }

    if (!transcript || transcript.trim().length === 0) {
      console.log('[UserStanceAnalysis] No transcript available');
      return;
    }

    // Schema for structured response
    const riskCategories = [
      'medical_or_mental_health',
      'self_harm_or_life_threats',
      'law_immigration_tax_finance_investments_insurance',
      'relationships_abuse_children_vulnerable_groups',
      'safety_emergency',
    ];
    const schema = {
      type: 'object',
      additionalProperties: false,
      properties: {
        stance: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 600 },
        riskProfile: {
          type: 'object',
          additionalProperties: false,
          properties: {
            score: { type: 'number', minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
            level: { type: 'string', enum: ['High', 'Medium', 'Low'] },
            rationale: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 600 },
            triggerCategories: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string', enum: riskCategories }, minItems: 0 },
          },
          required: ['score', 'level', 'rationale', 'triggerCategories'],
        },
        roles: {
          type: 'array',
          minItems: 0,
          maxItems: 3,
          items: {
            type: 'object',
            additionalProperties: false,
            properties: {
              role: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 100 },
              confidence: { type: 'number', minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
              rationale: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 300 },
            },
            required: ['role', 'confidence', 'rationale'],
          },
        },
        industries: {
          type: 'array',
          minItems: 0,
          maxItems: 3,
          items: {
            type: 'object',
            additionalProperties: false,
            properties: {
              industry: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 100 },
              confidence: { type: 'number', minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
              rationale: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 300 },
            },
            required: ['industry', 'confidence', 'rationale'],
          },
        },
      },
      required: ['stance', 'riskProfile'],
    } as any;

    const schemaText = JSON.stringify(schema, null, 2);
    const categoriesText = JSON.stringify(riskCategories);

    // Prompt
    const updateMode = existingAnalysis && lastPair;
    const prompt = updateMode
      ? `You are an expert analyst reviewing a user stance analysis. Your task is to analyze USER MESSAGES to understand the user's position, roles, industries, and risk profile.

Task:
1. Review the PREVIOUS ANALYSIS provided
2. Review the RECENT DISCUSSION CONTEXT (last 3-5 message pairs) to understand how the user responds to assistant messages
3. Review the LAST MESSAGE PAIR (new user message and assistant/agent response)
4. Update the analysis incrementally based on the new information, MINIMIZING CHANGES to preserve stability

CRITICAL: INCREMENTAL UPDATE REQUIREMENTS:
- DO NOT reformulate the entire analysis. Keep most of the previous analysis unchanged.
- Only modify elements that are DIRECTLY affected by the new message pair.
- Preserve elements that are still relevant and have not been addressed or changed.

CRITICAL: ANALYSIS FOCUS:
- Your analysis MUST be based PRIMARILY on USER MESSAGES only.
- Assistant messages are provided ONLY for context to understand:
  * What the user is responding to or referring to
  * How the user reacts to different types of responses
  * The context that shapes the user's questions and statements
- DO NOT extract facts or information from assistant messages - they are for context only.
- Focus on analyzing the USER's intent, position, and behavior patterns.

What to UPDATE:
- Stance: Only update if the user's intent or position has clearly shifted based on new user messages. Otherwise, keep it mostly the same, perhaps with minor refinements. Format the stance text as structured paragraphs: use clear paragraph breaks (\n\n) to separate different aspects or points. Each paragraph should focus on one main idea or aspect of the user's engagement pattern. Aim for 2-4 paragraphs, each containing 1-3 sentences.
- Risk Profile: Update based on new USER requests and intent revealed in the new user message. Assess risk based on what the USER seeks, not assistant responses.
- Roles: Only update if new user messages reveal different professional roles. Keep existing roles that are still relevant.
- Industries: Only update if new user messages reveal different industries. Keep existing industries that are still relevant.

User requirement: you should create your answer in ${langName} language. Use English or other languages inline only if you use well-known and accepted in target language terms.
All natural-language fields (stance, riskProfile.rationale, roles, industries) must be written strictly in the required language.

The JSON MUST conform EXACTLY to this schema (no additional keys, types must match):
${schemaText}

${transcript}`
      : `You are an expert analyst reviewing user interactions. Your task is to analyze USER MESSAGES to understand the user's position, roles, industries, and risk profile.

CRITICAL: ANALYSIS FOCUS:
- Your analysis MUST be based PRIMARILY on USER MESSAGES only.
- Assistant messages are provided ONLY for context to understand:
  * What the user is responding to or referring to
  * How the user reacts to different types of responses
  * The context that shapes the user's questions and statements
- DO NOT extract facts or information from assistant messages - they are for context only.
- Focus on analyzing the USER's intent, position, and behavior patterns.

Task: From the USER MESSAGES below, neutrally extract:
- stance: Write DIRECTLY to the user in SECOND PERSON ("you"). Do NOT describe the user in the third person. State what you seem to be pursuing, your perspective and deep intent, avoiding moral judgement and unsupported assumptions. Base this ONLY on what the user expresses, not on assistant content. Format the stance text as structured paragraphs: use clear paragraph breaks (\n\n) to separate different aspects or points. Each paragraph should focus on one main idea or aspect of the user's engagement pattern. Aim for 2-4 paragraphs, each containing 1-3 sentences. Total length should be 50-200 words.
- riskProfile: EU AI Act risk assessment with score 0..1 and derived level. If you need to reference the user in rationale, also use SECOND PERSON ("you"). Assess risk based on USER requests and intent, not assistant responses.
- roles: Identify up to 3 professional roles that best describe the user's position in the professional world. A role is WHO the user likely is professionally (e.g., "Software Engineer", "Product Manager", "Marketing Director", "Data Scientist", "UX Designer", "Consultant", "Entrepreneur", "Researcher", "Teacher", "Doctor", "Lawyer", etc.). Each role must include:
  * role: The professional role name (1-100 characters, write in ${langName} language)
  * confidence: Confidence score 0..1 indicating how confident you are that this role matches the user's professional context based on the discussion
  * rationale: Brief explanation (1-300 characters) why this role fits the discussion, written in ${langName} language
  Consider what professional role would be most characteristic of such a discussion. Order by confidence (highest first). Include only roles you can identify with reasonable confidence (confidence >= 0.3).
- industries: Identify up to 3 industries that best describe whose interests the user represents, if they were part of a company, professional community, or other structured organization. An industry is WHAT professional domain/industry the user likely operates in (e.g., "Technology/Software", "Healthcare", "Finance", "Education", "Retail/E-commerce", "Manufacturing", "Consulting", "Media/Entertainment", "Real Estate", "Legal Services", "Non-profit", "Government", etc.). Each industry must include:
  * industry: The industry name (1-100 characters, write in ${langName} language)
  * confidence: Confidence score 0..1 indicating how confident you are that this industry matches the user's professional context based on the discussion
  * rationale: Brief explanation (1-300 characters) why this industry fits the discussion, written in ${langName} language
  Consider what industry would be most characteristic of such a discussion. Order by confidence (highest first). Include only industries you can identify with reasonable confidence (confidence >= 0.3).

High risk auto-triggers (must set level to High ONLY if the user seeks PERSONAL, ACTIONABLE advice in these areas; general or educational discussion does NOT trigger High):
- Медицинское/психическое здоровье, фарма/дозировки/отмена препаратов — только персональные рекомендации/советы по здоровью, диагнозам, схемам/дозировкам/отмене; НЕ включает общие сведения, новости фарма/здравполитики, обсуждение индустрии или науки без личных указаний.
- Самоповреждение/суицид/угрозы жизни и безопасности — всегда High при признаках просьбы о помощи/инструкциях.
- Право/иммиграция/налоги/личные финансы/инвестиции/страхование — только персональные советы, инвестиционные рекомендации, налоговое/юридическое планирование; НЕ включает макроэкономику, монетарную/бюджетную политику, институциональные финансы, общие обзоры рынков/экономики.
- Отношения/абьюз/дети/уязвимые группы — только персональные ситуации и советы; НЕ включает абстрактные рассуждения, социологию/культуру без личного контекста.
- Безопасность/экстренные ситуации — персональные инструкции/советы по действиям в ЧС.
General note: classify as High only when guidance could materially impact an individual's health, safety, legal or personal financial outcomes; otherwise lower level.
RISK LEVEL RULES:
- High: score in [0.7, 1]
- Medium: score in [0.3, 0.7)
- Low: score in [0, 0.3)
Use triggerCategories strictly from DICTIONARY (English tokens only):
${categoriesText}

User requirement: you should create your answer in ${langName} language. Use English or other languages inline only if you use well-known and accepted in target language terms.
All natural-language fields (stance, riskProfile.rationale, roles, industries) must be written strictly in the required language.

The JSON MUST conform EXACTLY to this schema (no additional keys, types must match):
${schemaText}

CONVERSATION TRANSCRIPT (user messages are what you analyze, assistant messages are for context only):
${transcript}`;

    const langDirective = `You MUST produce all output strictly in ${langName} language. Use English only for technical terms or code if they are standard industry terms.`;

    const res = await api.genaiGenerate({
      model: evalModel,
      prompt,
      strictJSONEnabled: true,
      jsonSchema: schema,
      maxOutputTokens: Math.max(2048, 4096),
      webSearchEnabled: true,
      systemInstruction: langDirective,
    });

    // Save raw API response for debugging
    const rawResponse = {
      content: res?.content,
      rawJSON: (res as any)?.rawJSON,
      toolCalls: (res as any)?.toolCalls,
      model: res?.model,
      usage: res?.usage,
    };

    // Parse response
    let parsed: any = null;
    try {
      if (typeof res?.content === 'string') {
        const s = res.content.trim();
        if (s.startsWith('{') || s.startsWith('[')) parsed = JSON.parse(s);
      }
      const rawJSON = (res as any)?.rawJSON;
      if (!parsed && typeof rawJSON === 'string') {
        const s2 = rawJSON.trim();
        if (s2.startsWith('{') || s2.startsWith('[')) parsed = JSON.parse(s2);
      }
      if (!parsed && typeof res?.content === 'string') {
        const m = res.content.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
        if (m && m[0]) parsed = JSON.parse(m[0]);
      }
    } catch (pe) {
      console.warn('[UserStanceAnalysis] parse failed', pe, { contentPreview: (res?.content || '').slice(0, 200) });
    }

    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || typeof parsed.stance !== 'string' || !parsed.riskProfile) {
      console.log('[UserStanceAnalysis] no valid analysis parsed, skipping');
      
      // Save raw response even if parsing failed
      try {
        const analysisId = existingAnalysisInteraction?.id || (Date.now().toString() + '-user-stance-analysis-failed');
        useGenaiChatStore.setState((s) => {
          const items = [...s.interactions];
          const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === analysisId);
          if (idx >= 0) {
            (items[idx] as any).rawResponse = rawResponse;
            (items[idx] as any).parseError = true;
          } else {
            items.push({
              id: analysisId,
              projectId: s.projectId,
              kind: 'system',
              subkind: analysisSubkind,
              content: '',
              contentSanitized: '',
              rawResponse: rawResponse,
              parseError: true,
              createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            } as any);
          }
          return { interactions: items } as any;
        });
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[UserStanceAnalysis] Failed to save raw response', e);
      }
      
      return;
    }
    
    // Extract and validate analysis
    const clamp01 = (n: any) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(n) || 0));
    
    const analysis: UserStanceAnalysis = {
      stance: parsed.stance.trim(),
      riskProfile: {
        score: clamp01(parsed.riskProfile.score),
        level: parsed.riskProfile.level as 'High' | 'Medium' | 'Low',
        rationale: parsed.riskProfile.rationale.trim(),
        triggerCategories: (parsed.riskProfile.triggerCategories || []).filter((cat: any) => typeof cat === 'string'),
      },
    };

    // Extract roles if present
    if (parsed.roles && Array.isArray(parsed.roles)) {
      analysis.roles = parsed.roles
        .filter((r: any) => r && typeof r === 'object' && typeof r.role === 'string' && r.role.trim() && typeof r.confidence === 'number' && typeof r.rationale === 'string' && r.rationale.trim())
        .slice(0, 3)
        .map((r: any) => ({
          role: r.role.trim(),
          confidence: clamp01(r.confidence),
          rationale: r.rationale.trim(),
        }));
    }

    // Extract industries if present
    if (parsed.industries && Array.isArray(parsed.industries)) {
      analysis.industries = parsed.industries
        .filter((i: any) => i && typeof i === 'object' && typeof i.industry === 'string' && i.industry.trim() && typeof i.confidence === 'number' && typeof i.rationale === 'string' && i.rationale.trim())
        .slice(0, 3)
        .map((i: any) => ({
          industry: i.industry.trim(),
          confidence: clamp01(i.confidence),
          rationale: i.rationale.trim(),
        }));
    }

    if (!analysis.stance || analysis.stance.trim().length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    // Create or update eval.stance interaction
    try {
      const analysisId = existingAnalysisInteraction?.id || (Date.now().toString() + '-user-stance-analysis');
      const analysisData = analysis;
      
      // Save raw API response for debugging
      const rawResponse = {
        content: res?.content,
        rawJSON: (res as any)?.rawJSON,
        toolCalls: (res as any)?.toolCalls,
        model: res?.model,
        usage: res?.usage,
      };

      if (existingAnalysisInteraction) {
        // Update existing interaction
        useGenaiChatStore.setState((s) => {
          const items = [...s.interactions];
          const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === analysisId);
          if (idx >= 0) {
            (items[idx] as any).content = JSON.stringify(analysisData);
            (items[idx] as any).contentSanitized = analysisData.stance;
            (items[idx] as any).rawResponse = rawResponse;
            (items[idx] as any).highRisk = analysisData.riskProfile;
            (items[idx] as any).roles = analysisData.roles;
            (items[idx] as any).industries = analysisData.industries;
          }
          return { interactions: items } as any;
        });

        // Update on server
        (async () => {
          try {
            await api.updateProjectInteraction(projectId, analysisId, {
              content: JSON.stringify(analysisData),
              contentSanitized: analysisData.stance,
              highRisk: analysisData.riskProfile,
              roles: analysisData.roles,
              industries: analysisData.industries,
            });
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[UserStanceAnalysis] Failed to update on server', e);
          }
        })();
      } else {
        // Create new interaction
        useGenaiChatStore.setState((s) => ({
          interactions: [
            ...s.interactions,
            {
              id: analysisId,
              projectId: s.projectId,
              kind: 'system',
              subkind: analysisSubkind,
              content: JSON.stringify(analysisData),
              contentSanitized: analysisData.stance,
              rawResponse: rawResponse,
              highRisk: analysisData.riskProfile,
              roles: analysisData.roles,
              industries: analysisData.industries,
              language: preferredLang,
              createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            } as any,
          ],
        } as any));

        // Persist to server (async, don't block UI)
        (async () => {
          try {
            const payload: any = {
              kind: 'system',
              subkind: analysisSubkind,
              content: JSON.stringify(analysisData),
              contentSanitized: analysisData.stance,
              language: preferredLang,
            };
            if (analysisData.riskProfile) payload.highRisk = analysisData.riskProfile;
            if (analysisData.roles && analysisData.roles.length > 0) payload.roles = analysisData.roles;
            if (analysisData.industries && analysisData.industries.length > 0) payload.industries = analysisData.industries;

            const res = await api.createProjectInteraction(projectId, payload);

            // Update local interaction with server ID
            useGenaiChatStore.setState((st) => {
              const items = [...st.interactions];
              const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === analysisId);
              if (idx >= 0) {
                (items[idx] as any).id = res.id;
              }

              const newMap = { ...(st.persistedByLocalId || {}) } as Record<string, string>;
              newMap[analysisId] = res.id;

              return { interactions: items, persistedByLocalId: newMap } as any;
            });
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[UserStanceAnalysis] Failed to persist to server', e);
          }
        })();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[UserStanceAnalysis] Failed to create/update analysis interaction', e);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[UserStanceAnalysis] Failed to generate analysis', e);
  } finally {
    // Always remove from generating set
    generatingAnalyses.delete(analysisKey);
  }
}

export function apiBaseToWs(baseUrl: string) {
  if (baseUrl.startsWith('https://')) return 'wss://' + baseUrl.slice('https://'.length);
  if (baseUrl.startsWith('http://')) return 'ws://' + baseUrl.slice('http://'.length);
  return baseUrl.replace(/^https?:/, (m) => (m === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:'));
}

export function buildWsUrl(tenantId: string) {
  const broker = (import.meta as any).env?.VITE_WS_BROKER_URL as string | undefined;
  if (broker && broker.trim()) {
    const b = broker.replace(/\/$/, '');
    return `${b}/ws`;
  }
  const base = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:8080').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const wsBase = apiBaseToWs(base);
  return `${wsBase}/ws`;
}

  const truncateCenterWords = (
    s: string,
    headWords: number = 12,
    tailWords: number = 12,
  ) => {
    try {
      const t = (s || '').toString().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      if (!t) return t;
      const words = t.split(' ');
      if (words.length <= headWords + tailWords + 2) return t;
      const head = words.slice(0, headWords).join(' ');
      const tail = words.slice(-tailWords).join(' ');
      return `${head} … ${tail}`;
    } catch {
      return s as any;
    }

        const host = messagesRef.current;
        const hostRect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
        const offset =
          rect.top - hostRect.top + host.scrollTop - host.clientHeight / 2;
        host.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, offset), behavior: 'smooth' });
      } else if (el && typeof el.scrollIntoView === 'function') {
        // Fallback if messagesRef is not available
        el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      }

  const handleExecuteDiscovery = async () => {
    if (running || !queryText.trim()) {
      console.log('[Discovery] Blocked:', {

      });
      return;
    }
