      alert(
        'Please include at least one source (URL or @telegram handle) in your query',
      );

      ...parsed.web.map((url) => ({

        kind: 'web' as const,

      ...parsed.telegram.map((handle) => ({

      // Keep running=true until first answer arrives via WS or timeout fires
      if (discoveryTimeoutRef.current) {
        window.clearTimeout(discoveryTimeoutRef.current);
      }
      discoveryTimeoutRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
        console.warn('[Discovery] Timeout waiting for first answer');
        setRunning(false);
        discoveryTimeoutRef.current = null;
      }, 90000) as unknown as number;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Discovery] Failed to execute:', error);
      setRunning(false);
    }
  };

                // In graph mode, prioritize graph instruction by putting it first
                            const combinedSystemInstruction =
                              unfoldMode === 'graph'
                  ? [
                      graphSystemInstruction,
                  genaiSettings.systemInstruction || '',
                  HATL_ONE_INSTRUCTIONS,
                  sxSystemInstruction,
                                  ]
                                    .filter(Boolean)
                                    .join('\n\n')
                                    .trim() || undefined
                  : [
                      genaiSettings.systemInstruction || '',
                      HATL_ONE_INSTRUCTIONS,
                      sxSystemInstruction,
                                  ]
                                    .filter(Boolean)
                                    .join('\n\n')
                                    .trim() || undefined;

                const options: any = {
                  // profile is used only for gemini fallback; keep for compatibility
                              profile:
                                model === 'gemini_quality' ? 'quality' : 'fast',
                  modelOverride: model,
                  groundingEnabled: genaiSettings.groundingEnabled,
                  temperature: genaiSettings.temperature,
                  maxOutputTokens: genaiSettings.maxOutputTokens,
                  systemInstruction: combinedSystemInstruction,
                };
              // Capture previous assistant reply (if any) BEFORE starting stream
              const stBefore = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
              let prevAssistantText: string | null = null;
              try {
                              const aiInter = stBefore.interactions.filter(
                                (it) => it.kind === 'assistant',
                              );
                if (aiInter.length > 0) {
                  const last = aiInter[aiInter.length - 1];
                                prevAssistantText =
                                  last.summary && last.summary.trim()
                                    ? last.summary
                                    : last.content || null;
                } else {
                                const priorMsgs = stBefore.messages.filter(
                                  (m) =>
                                    m.role === 'assistant' &&
                                    m.content &&
                                    m.content.trim(),
                                );
                                if (priorMsgs.length > 0)
                                  prevAssistantText =
                                    priorMsgs[priorMsgs.length - 1].content;
                }
              } catch {}
                // UnfoldRequest clears itself after submit
                            await genaiChat.startStream({
                              prompt,
                              tools,
                              options: { ...options, __lang: preferredLang },
                            });
              // Fire-and-forget: structured bias evaluation for the USER message we just sent
              try {
                const st = useGenaiChatStore.getState();
                              const userMsgs = st.messages.filter(
                                (mm) => mm.role === 'user',
                              );
                              const lastUser =
                                userMsgs.length > 0
                                  ? userMsgs[userMsgs.length - 1]
                                  : null;
                const textToEvaluate = (prompt || '').trim();
                if (lastUser && textToEvaluate) {
                  (async () => {
                    try {
                                    const settingsStateEval =
                                      useGenAISettings.getState();
                                    const evalModel =
                                      settingsStateEval.stanceModel &&
                                      settingsStateEval.stanceModel.trim()
                                        ? settingsStateEval.stanceModel
                                        : 'gemini_fast';
                                    const preferredLang =
                                      getPreferredLanguage();
                      
                      // Call unified evaluation function
                      await evaluateBias({
                        messageId: lastUser.id,
                        messageRole: 'user',
                        textToEvaluate,
                                      contextText:
                                        prevAssistantText || undefined,
                        evalModel,
                        preferredLang,
                      });
                    } catch (e) {
                                    console.warn(
                                      '[UserStanceEval] User bias eval failed',
                                      e,
                                    );
                    }
                  })().catch(console.error);
                }
              } catch {}
              }}
              disabled={genaiChat.streaming || !queryText.trim()}
            />
            </div>
            )}
            {/* Resizer handle at right edge of center column */}
            <div
              className="chat-resizer"
              style={{ 
                right: -4,
                        pointerEvents:
                          rightPanelType !== null ? 'none' : 'auto',
              }}
              onMouseDown={(e) => {
                const root = document.documentElement;
                const startX = e.clientX;
                        const startWidth =
                          messagesRef.current?.parentElement?.clientWidth || 0;
                        const initial =
                          getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue(
                            '--center-col-width',
                          );
                const onMove = (ev: MouseEvent) => {
                  const delta = ev.clientX - startX;
                  const newWidth = Math.max(480, startWidth + delta);
                          root.style.setProperty(
                            '--center-col-width',
                            `${newWidth}px`,
                          );
                };
                const onUp = () => {
                  window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
                  window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
                };
                window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
                window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
              }}
            />
          </div>
        ) : (
        /* Interactions + input container with internal scroll */
        <div className="w-full px-4 flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-0">
          {/* Interactions history (LLM answers etc.) */}
                    <div
                      ref={messagesRef}
                      className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-1 min-h-[160px]"
                      style={{
                        contentVisibility: 'auto',
                        containIntrinsicSize: '800px 600px',
                      }}
                    >
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {/* Skeleton loading during hydration */}
              {genaiChat.hydrating && interactions.length === 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-2 py-2">
                            <div
                              style={{
                                height: 14,
                                borderRadius: 4,
                                background: 'var(--white-06)',
                                position: 'relative',
                                overflow: 'hidden',
                              }}
                            >
                              <div
                                style={{
                                  position: 'absolute',
                                  inset: 0,
                                  background:
                                    'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--white-20), transparent)',
                                  animation: 'etg-shimmer 2s infinite',
                                }}
                              />
                  </div>
                            <div
                              style={{
                                height: 10,
                                width: '90%',
                                borderRadius: 4,
                                background: 'var(--white-06)',
                                position: 'relative',
                                overflow: 'hidden',
                              }}
                            >
                              <div
                                style={{
                                  position: 'absolute',
                                  inset: 0,
                                  background:
                                    'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--white-20), transparent)',
                                  animation: 'etg-shimmer 2s infinite',
                                }}
                              />
                  </div>
                            <div
                              style={{
                                height: 10,
                                width: '80%',
                                borderRadius: 4,
                                background: 'var(--white-06)',
                                position: 'relative',
                                overflow: 'hidden',
                              }}
                            >
                              <div
                                style={{
                                  position: 'absolute',
                                  inset: 0,
                                  background:
                                    'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--white-20), transparent)',
                                  animation: 'etg-shimmer 2s infinite',
                                }}
                              />
                  </div>
                            <div
                              style={{
                                height: 10,
                                width: '70%',
                                borderRadius: 4,
                                background: 'var(--white-06)',
                                position: 'relative',
                                overflow: 'hidden',
                              }}
                            >
                              <div
                                style={{
                                  position: 'absolute',
                                  inset: 0,
                                  background:
                                    'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--white-20), transparent)',
                                  animation: 'etg-shimmer 2s infinite',
                                }}
                              />
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              {interactions
                          .filter(
                            (it) =>
                              it.kind === 'discovery.query' ||
                              it.kind === 'discovery.answer',
                          )
                .map((it) => {
                  const isUser = it.kind === 'discovery.query';
                  const containerStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
                              backgroundColor: isUser
                                ? 'var(--brand-10)'
                                : 'transparent',
                              border: isUser
                                ? '1px solid var(--brand-25)'
                                : 'none',
                    maxWidth: '75%',
                  };
                  return (
                              <div
                                key={it.id}
                                className={`rounded-2xl px-3 py-2 ${isUser ? 'ml-auto' : ''}`}
                                style={containerStyle}
                              >
                                <div
                                  className="text-[10px] mb-1"
                                  style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}
                                >
                                  {isUser ? 'you' : 'assistant'}
                                </div>
                                <div
                                  className="text-xs"
                                  style={{
                                    color: 'var(--text-heading)',
                                    whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
                                    wordBreak: 'break-word',
                                  }}
                                >
                        {it.content}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                          })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Status indicator */}
          {(running || entitiesAnalyzing) && (
            <div className="px-1 pb-2">
                        <div
                          className="text-xs flex items-center gap-2"
                          style={{
                            textAlign: 'left',
                            color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
                          }}
                        >
                          <span
                            className="animate-pulse"
                            style={{
                              width: '8px',
                              height: '8px',
                              borderRadius: '9999px',
                              backgroundColor: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
                            }}
                          />
                {running ? (
                  <span>Thinking... {thinkingSeconds}s</span>
                ) : (
                  <span>Analyzing entities…</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {/* TODO(metrics): aggregate stance/bias metrics per participant and per thread once backend summary API is available */}

          {/* Input box */}
          <DiscoveryRequest
            value={queryText}
            onChange={setQueryText}
            onSubmit={async () => {
              if (running || !queryText.trim()) return;
              if (currentProject?.id) {
                const lang = getPreferredLanguage();
                setRunning(true);
                try {
                            await sendChatMessage(
                              currentProject.id,
                              queryText,
                              lang,
                            );
                  setQueryText('');
                } finally {
                  setRunning(false);
                }
              } else {
                handleExecuteDiscovery();
              }
            }}
            disabled={running || !queryText.trim()}
          />
        </div>
        )}
        {previewSource && (
          <SourcePreview
            source={previewSource}
            onClose={() => setPreviewSource(null)}
            style={{ top: 0, left: '12px', width: 760, maxWidth: 760 }}
          />
        )}

        {/* Add Telegram modal */}
        <TelegramAddModal
          isOpen={showAddTelegramModal}
          onClose={() => setShowAddTelegramModal(false)}
          input={tgInput}
          onInputChange={setTgInput}
          onSubmit={addTelegramSource}
          isSubmitting={tgSubmitting}
          error={tgError}
        />
        </>
        )}
        </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right drawer: appears when any drawer is open */}
        <RightDrawer
          rightPanelType={rightPanelType}
          viewMode={viewMode}
          showAccount={showAccount}
          showSettings={showSettings}
          isMobile={isMobile}
          drawerWidth={drawerWidth}
          setDrawerWidth={setDrawerWidth}
          closeAllRightPanels={closeAllRightPanels}
          getPanelVisibilityStyles={getPanelVisibilityStyles}
          sources={sources}
          currentProjectId={currentProject?.id || null}
          addMenuRef={addMenuRef}
          showAddSourceMenu={showAddSourceMenu}
          onShowAddSourceMenuChange={setShowAddSourceMenu}
          onShowAddTelegramModalChange={setShowAddTelegramModal}
          onPreviewSource={setPreviewSource}
          onOpenDocument={setActiveDoc}
          handleAnalyzeEntities={handleAnalyzeEntities}
          handleAnalyzeFacts={handleAnalyzeFacts}
          handleAnalyzeEvents={handleAnalyzeEvents}
          handleAnalyzeMetrics={handleAnalyzeMetrics}
          handleAnalyzeDecisions={handleAnalyzeDecisions}
          analysisTab={analysisTab}
          onAnalysisTabChange={setAnalysisTab}
          onFirstResultUser={() => {
            setBadgeUser(true);
            setAvailUserAnalysis(true);
          }}
          onRiskUpdate={(r) => {
            const high = !!(r && r.level === 'High');
            setIsHighRisk(high);
            if (high) {
              setRiskBanner((prev) =>
                prev && prev.visible === false
                  ? prev
                  : {
                      visible: true,
                      level: 'High',
                      rationale: r?.rationale || '',
                    },
              );
            } else if (!r) {
              setRiskBanner(null);
            }
          }}
          onFirstResultDiscussionFlow={onFirstResultDiscussionFlow}
          onAddTextTask={handleAddTextTask}
          onRemoveTextTask={handleRemoveTextTask}
          textTasks={textTasks}
          experimentalResponse={experimentalResponse}
          experimentalLoading={experimentalLoading}
          sectionStarts={sectionStarts}
          pinnedInteractions={pinnedInteractions}
          messagesRef={messagesRef}
          scrollToInteraction={scrollToInteraction}
          truncateCenterWords={truncateCenterWords}
          onRemoveNote={handleRemoveNote}
        />

        {/* Right buttons column - always visible */}
        <RightPanelButtons
          rightPanelType={rightPanelType}
          onPanelTypeChange={setRightPanelType}
          hasPinned={hasPinned}
          hasSections={hasSections}
          availUserAnalysis={availUserAnalysis}
          availDiscussionFlow={availDiscussionFlow}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default DiscoveryPage;

            <li><strong>Account Identifier:</strong> A unique identifier linking the child's sub-account to the Parent's account;</li>
            <li><strong>User-Generated Content:</strong> Text inputs, queries, prompts, and conversations with the AI system;</li>
            <li><strong>Usage Data:</strong> Timestamps, session duration, features used, and interaction patterns;</li>
            <li><strong>Device Information:</strong> Device type, operating system, browser type (automatically collected);</li>
            <li><strong>Content Moderation Data:</strong> Results of automated content filtering and safety checks.</li>
          </ul>

          </p>

            <li><strong>Behavioral Monitoring:</strong> Conversation patterns are monitored for signs of concerning topics or crisis situations;</li>
            <li><strong>Keyword and Phrase Blocking:</strong> Lists of prohibited words and phrases trigger additional scrutiny or conversation redirection.</li>

Файл: ShareViewPage.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm';
import rehypeRaw from 'rehype-raw';
import ChatGraphMessage from '../components/ChatGraphMessage';
import ChatMessage from '../components/ChatMessage';
import { api } from '../lib/api';

export default function ShareViewPage() {
  const { token } = useParams<{ token: string }>();
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [data, setData] = React.useState<any | null>(null);
  const [theme, setTheme] = React.useState<'light' | 'dark'>('dark');

  React.useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        if (!token) { setError('Missing token'); setLoading(false); return; }
        const res = await api.shareGetPublic(token);
        if (mounted) { setData(res); setLoading(false); }
      } catch (e: any) {
        if (mounted) { setError('Unavailable or expired'); setLoading(false); }
      }
    })();
    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, [token]);

  // Load theme from localStorage on mount and apply to document
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme') as 'light' | 'dark' | null;
    if (savedTheme) {
      setTheme(savedTheme);
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', savedTheme);
    } else {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
    }
  }, []);

  // Apply theme changes to document element
  React.useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
  }, [theme]);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    const newTheme = theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
    setTheme(newTheme);
    localStorage.setItem('theme', newTheme);
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-root)', color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
        Loading…
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !data) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-root)' }}>
        <div className="w-full max-w-lg text-center">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold mb-3" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
            Link Unavailable or Expired
          </h1>
          <p className="text-base mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
            The public link to this project is no longer valid or has expired.
          </p>
          <p className="text-sm" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            Please contact the project owner to request an updated link.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const proj = data.project || {};
  const items = Array.isArray(data.interactions) ? data.interactions : [];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-root)' }}>
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-4">
        {/* Header with theme toggle */}
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-start justify-between">
          <div className="flex-1">
            <div className="text-[13px] font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
              {proj.displayName || 'Shared chat'}
            </div>
            {proj.description && (
              <div className="text-[12px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
                {proj.description}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="text-[11px] mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
              Public read‑only · available until {new Date(data.share.expiresAt).toLocaleString()}
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={toggleTheme}
            className="ml-3 rounded-lg p-2"
            style={{ 
              backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)', 
              border: '1px solid var(--overlay-line-90)',
              color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)',
              cursor: 'pointer'
            }}
            title={`Switch to ${theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'} theme`}
          >
            {theme === 'dark' ? (
              <svg className="w-4 h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5" strokeWidth="2"/>
                <path d="M12 1v2M12 21v2M4.22 4.22l1.42 1.42M18.36 18.36l1.42 1.42M1 12h2M21 12h2M4.22 19.78l1.42-1.42M18.36 5.64l1.42-1.42" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round"/>
              </svg>
            ) : (
              <svg className="w-4 h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                <path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"/>
              </svg>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Messages */}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {items.map((it: any) => {
            const isUser = it.kind === 'user';
            const content = (it.contentSanitized || it.content || '').toString();
            const gd = it.graphData;

            // Special rendering for action.bring_in indicator messages
            if (isUser && it.subkind === 'action.bring_in') {
              return (
                <div key={it.id} className="my-1.5 flex justify-end">
                  <div className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[12px] inline-flex items-center gap-2" style={{ 
                    background: 'var(--accent-research-10)', 
                    color: 'var(--accent-research)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--accent-research-20)',
                    maxWidth: '80%'
                  }}>
                    <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 flex-shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                      <path d="M12 7a3 3 0 1 1 0 6a3 3 0 0 1 0-6" strokeWidth="2" />
                      <path d="M5 20c0-3.314 3.134-6 7-6s7 2.686 7 6" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
                      <path d="M18 7v4M16 9h4" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
                    </svg>
                    <span>{content}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            }

            // Determine display name
            let displayName = isUser ? 'you' : 'assistant';
            if (it.author?.displayName) {
              displayName = it.author.displayName;
            } else if (it.subkind === 'agent.bring_in' || it.subkind === 'agent.ask') {
              displayName = 'agent';
            }

            // Agent accent (if agent contribution)
            const isAgent = it.subkind?.startsWith('agent.');

            return (
              <ChatMessage
                key={it.id}
                role={isUser ? 'user' : 'assistant'}
                align={isUser ? 'right' : 'left'}
                headerText={displayName}
                leftAccent={isAgent}
              >
                {gd ? (
                  <ChatGraphMessage
                    chartTitle={gd.chartTitle}
                    chartType={gd.chartType || 'line'}
                    table={gd.table}
                    sources={gd.sources}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <div className="markdown">
                    <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeRaw]}>
                      {content}
                    </ReactMarkdown>
                  </div>
                )}
              </ChatMessage>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';

export default function VerifiedPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [url, setUrl] = useState('');
  const [model, setModel] = useState('gemini_fast'); // default model
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{ code: string; url: string } | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!url.trim()) {
      setError(t('verified.form.urlRequired'));
      return;
    }

    // Basic URL validation
    try {
      new URL(url.trim());
    } catch {
      setError(t('verified.form.invalidUrl'));
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    setResult(null);

    try {
      // Pass model only if user is authenticated
      const selectedModel = user ? model : undefined;
      const res = await api.verifiedCreate(url.trim(), selectedModel);
      setResult({ code: res.code, url: res.url });
      // Auto-navigate after 2 seconds
      setTimeout(() => {
        navigate(`/verified/${res.code}`);
      }, 2000);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e?.response?.data?.message || t('verified.form.error'));
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyUrl = async () => {
    if (!result) return;
    const fullUrl = `${window.location.origin}/verified/${result.code}`;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullUrl);
      // Show feedback (could use toast library if available)
    } catch (err) {
      // Fallback
      const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
      textArea.value = fullUrl;
      document.body.appendChild(textArea);
      textArea.select();
      document.execCommand('copy');
      document.body.removeChild(textArea);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="content-area" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 88px)' }}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-2xl px-4">
        <div className="mb-6">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
            {t('verified.title')}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            {t('verified.description')}
          </p>
        </div>

        {!result ? (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="url-input" className="block text-13 mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                {t('verified.form.urlLabel')}
              </label>
              <input
                id="url-input"
                type="url"
                value={url}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setUrl(e.target.value);
                  setError(null);
                }}
                placeholder={t('verified.form.urlPlaceholder')}
                disabled={loading}
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-13"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)',
                  border: error ? '1px solid var(--accent-danger)' : '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                  color: 'var(--text-primary)',
                  outline: 'none',
                }}
                onFocus={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = 'var(--accent-primary)';
                }}
                onBlur={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = 'var(--border-subtle)';
                }}
              />
              {error && (
                <p className="text-12 mt-2" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-danger)' }}>
                  {error}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            {user && (
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="model-select" className="block text-13 mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                  {t('verified.form.modelLabel', 'AI Model')}
                </label>
                <select
                  id="model-select"
                  value={model}
                  onChange={(e) => setModel(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={loading}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-13"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                    color: 'var(--text-primary)',
                    outline: 'none',
                    cursor: loading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="gemini_fast">Gemini Fast</option>
                  <option value="gemini_quality">Gemini Quality</option>
                  <option value="grok_fast">Grok Fast</option>
                  <option value="grok_quality">Grok Quality</option>
                  <option value="gpt_fast">GPT Fast</option>
                  <option value="gpt_quality">GPT Quality</option>
                  <option value="claude_fast">Claude Fast</option>
                  <option value="claude_balanced">Claude Balanced</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading || !url.trim()}
              className="w-full py-3 rounded-lg text-13 font-medium transition-colors"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: loading || !url.trim() ? 'var(--bg-disabled)' : 'var(--accent-primary)',
                color: loading || !url.trim() ? 'var(--text-disabled)' : 'var(--text-on-accent)',
                cursor: loading || !url.trim() ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              {loading ? t('verified.form.processing') : t('verified.form.submit')}
            </button>
          </form>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-success-10)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-success-20)' }}>
              <div className="text-13 font-semibold mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-success)' }}>
                {t('verified.success.title')}
              </div>
              <div className="text-12 mb-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                {t('verified.success.description')}
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  readOnly
                  value={`${window.location.origin}/verified/${result.code}`}
                  className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded text-12"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-body)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                    color: 'var(--text-primary)',
                  }}
                />
                <button
                  onClick={handleCopyUrl}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded text-12 font-medium"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-primary)',
                    color: 'var(--text-on-accent)',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  {t('verified.success.copy')}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="text-12 text-center" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
              {t('verified.success.redirecting')}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

Файл: VerifiedViewPage.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm';
import rehypeRaw from 'rehype-raw';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useDiscoveryStore } from '../stores/discoveryStore';

export default function VerifiedViewPage() {
  const { code } = useParams<{ code: string }>();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const connectWs = useDiscoveryStore((state) => state.connectWs);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [data, setData] = React.useState<any | null>(null);
  const pollIntervalRef = React.useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const wsListenerRef = React.useRef<((msg: any) => void) | null>(null);

  // WebSocket listener for verified.stream events
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!code || !user) return;

    const subscribeToCode = () => {
      const ws = (window as any).__wsRef;
      if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
        try {
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'subscribe', verifiedCode: code }));
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('Failed to subscribe to verified code:', e);
        }
      }
    };

    // Create listener function
    const listener = (evt: MessageEvent) => {
      try {
        const msg = JSON.parse(evt.data);
        // Only process verified.stream events for this code
        if (msg?.type?.startsWith('verified.stream.') && msg?.data?.code === code) {
          const eventType = msg.type;
          
          if (eventType === 'verified.stream.fetch_start') {
            setData((prev: any) => ({ ...prev, status: 'processing' }));
          } else if (eventType === 'verified.stream.fetch_success') {
            // Fetch updated data when fetch succeeds
            api.verifiedGetPublic(code).then((res) => {
              setData(res);
            }).catch(() => {});
          } else if (eventType === 'verified.stream.fetch_failed') {
            setData((prev: any) => ({
              ...prev,
              status: 'failed',
              error: msg.data?.error,
            }));
            if (pollIntervalRef.current) {
              clearInterval(pollIntervalRef.current);
              pollIntervalRef.current = null;
            }
          } else if (eventType === 'verified.stream.analysis_start') {
            setData((prev: any) => ({ ...prev, status: 'processing' }));
          } else if (eventType === 'verified.stream.analysis_complete') {
            // Fetch final data when analysis completes
            api.verifiedGetPublic(code).then((res) => {
              setData(res);
              if (pollIntervalRef.current) {
                clearInterval(pollIntervalRef.current);
                pollIntervalRef.current = null;
              }
            }).catch(() => {});
          } else if (eventType === 'verified.stream.analysis_failed') {
            setData((prev: any) => ({
              ...prev,
              status: 'failed',
              error: msg.data?.error,
            }));
            if (pollIntervalRef.current) {
              clearInterval(pollIntervalRef.current);
              pollIntervalRef.current = null;
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Ignore parse errors
      }
    };

    // Access WebSocket from discoveryStore's module scope
    // We'll attach listener via window event delegation
    const wsMessageHandler = (evt: MessageEvent) => {
      listener(evt);
    };

    // Store reference for cleanup
    wsListenerRef.current = wsMessageHandler;

    // Attach listener to window (works because discoveryStore's wsRef dispatches events)
    // Actually, we need to hook into the existing wsRef.onmessage
    // Since we can't directly access wsRef, we'll use a custom event emitter pattern
    // or check the existing wsStore for messages
    
    // For now, let's use polling as fallback and WS will update when connected
    // The WebSocket handler in discoveryStore already processes all messages
    // We need to intercept them - but that's complex. Let's use a simpler approach:
    // Check wsStore for recent messages of type verified.stream.*
    
    // Actually, the simplest is to extend the wsStore or create a custom event system
    // But for MVP, polling + WS updates is fine. The WS will update the store,
    // and we can check it periodically or use a custom event
    
    // Since discoveryStore already handles all WS messages globally,
    // we'll use a custom event emitter on window
    (window as any).__verifiedWsListeners = (window as any).__verifiedWsListeners || [];
    (window as any).__verifiedWsListeners.push(listener);

    // Try to subscribe immediately if WS is already open
    subscribeToCode();

    // Ensure WebSocket is connected and subscribe when it opens
    if (user?.tenantId) {
      connectWs(user.tenantId).then(() => {
        subscribeToCode();
      }).catch(() => {});
    }

    // Track WS open listener to prevent accumulation
    let wsOpenListener: (() => void) | null = null;

    // Also listen for WS open events (in case WS reconnects)
    const checkAndSubscribe = () => {
      const ws = (window as any).__wsRef;
      if (ws) {
        if (ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
          subscribeToCode();
        } else {
          // Remove previous listener if exists to prevent accumulation
          if (wsOpenListener) {
            try {
              ws.removeEventListener('open', wsOpenListener);
            } catch {}
          }
          // Wait for open
          const onOpen = () => {
            subscribeToCode();
            if (wsOpenListener) {
              try {
                ws.removeEventListener('open', wsOpenListener);
              } catch {}
              wsOpenListener = null;
            }
          };
          ws.addEventListener('open', onOpen);
          wsOpenListener = onOpen;
        }
      }
    };

    // Check periodically if WS opened (for reconnect scenarios)
    const checkInterval = setInterval(() => {
      checkAndSubscribe();
    }, 1000);

    return () => {
      clearInterval(checkInterval);
      // Clean up WS open listener
      if (wsOpenListener) {
        try {
          const ws = (window as any).__wsRef;
          if (ws) {
            ws.removeEventListener('open', wsOpenListener);
          }
        } catch {}
        wsOpenListener = null;
      }
      if ((window as any).__verifiedWsListeners) {
        (window as any).__verifiedWsListeners = (window as any).__verifiedWsListeners.filter(
          (l: any) => l !== listener
        );
      }
      wsListenerRef.current = null;
    };
  }, [code, user, connectWs]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;

    const fetchData = async () => {
      try {
        if (!code) {
          setError(t('verified.view.missingCode'));
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        const res = await api.verifiedGetPublic(code);
        if (mounted) {
          setData(res);
          setLoading(false);

          // If analysis is still processing, poll for updates (as fallback)
          if (res.status === 'pending' || res.status === 'processing') {
            // Clear existing interval
            if (pollIntervalRef.current) {
              clearInterval(pollIntervalRef.current);
            }
            // Poll every 5 seconds (less frequent since WS handles updates)
            pollIntervalRef.current = setInterval(async () => {
              if (!mounted) return;
              try {
                const updated = await api.verifiedGetPublic(code!);
                if (mounted) {
                  setData(updated);
                  // Stop polling when completed or failed
                  if (updated.status === 'completed' || updated.status === 'failed') {
                    if (pollIntervalRef.current) {
                      clearInterval(pollIntervalRef.current);
                      pollIntervalRef.current = null;
                    }
                  }
                }
              } catch (e) {
                // Silent fail on polling errors
                console.error('Polling error:', e);
              }
            }, 5000);
          }
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        if (mounted) {
          setError(e?.response?.data?.message || t('verified.view.error'));
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };

    fetchData();

    return () => {
      mounted = false;
      if (pollIntervalRef.current) {
        clearInterval(pollIntervalRef.current);
        pollIntervalRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [code, t]);

  const handleCopyUrl = async () => {
    const fullUrl = `${window.location.origin}/verified/${code}`;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullUrl);
      // Could show toast notification here
    } catch (err) {
      // Fallback
      const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
      textArea.value = fullUrl;
      document.body.appendChild(textArea);
      textArea.select();
      document.execCommand('copy');
      document.body.removeChild(textArea);
    }
  };

  const handleShare = () => {
    if (navigator.share && code) {
      navigator.share({
        title: t('verified.view.shareTitle'),
        text: t('verified.view.shareText'),
        url: `${window.location.origin}/verified/${code}`,
      }).catch(() => {
        // User cancelled or error
      });
    } else {
      handleCopyUrl();
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="content-area flex items-center justify-center" style={{ minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 88px)' }}>
        <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
          {t('verified.view.loading')}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !data) {
    return (
      <div className="content-area flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6" style={{ minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 88px)' }}>
        <div className="w-full max-w-lg text-center">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold mb-3" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
            {t('verified.view.errorTitle')}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-base mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary-strong)' }}>
            {error || t('verified.view.errorDescription')}
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate('/verified')}
            className="mt-4 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-13 font-medium"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-primary)',
              color: 'var(--text-on-accent)',
              border: 'none',
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            {t('verified.view.backToForm')}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="content-area">
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-4">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-start justify-between">
          <div className="flex-1">
            <div className="text-[13px] font-semibold mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-heading)' }}>
              {t('verified.view.title')}
            </div>
            {data.url && (
              <a
                href={data.url}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="text-12 inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:underline"
                style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }}
              >
                {data.url}
                <svg className="w-3 h-3" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                  <path d="M18 13v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6M15 3h6v6M10 14L21 3" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"/>
                </svg>
              </a>
            )}
            {data.createdAt && (
              <div className="text-11 mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
                {t('verified.view.createdAt')} {new Date(data.createdAt).toLocaleString()}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 ml-4">
            <button
              onClick={handleCopyUrl}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-12 font-medium"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)',
                border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                color: 'var(--text-primary)',
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
              title={t('verified.view.copyUrl')}
            >
              {t('verified.view.copy')}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleShare}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-12 font-medium"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)',
                border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                color: 'var(--text-primary)',
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
              title={t('verified.view.share')}
            >
              {t('verified.view.share')}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Status indicator */}
        {data.status && (
          <div className="mt-4 mb-4">
            {data.status === 'pending' || data.status === 'processing' ? (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-3" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-research-10)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-research-20)' }}>
                <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-4 w-4 border-2 border-current border-t-transparent" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-research)' }}></div>
                <div className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-research)' }}>
                  {data.status === 'pending' ? t('verified.view.status.pending') : t('verified.view.status.processing')}
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : data.status === 'failed' ? (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-danger-10)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-danger-20)' }}>
                <div className="text-12 font-semibold mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-danger)' }}>
                  {t('verified.view.status.failed')}
                </div>
                {data.error && (
                  <div className="text-11" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                    {data.error}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Analysis Content */}
        {data.analysis && data.status === 'completed' && (
          <div className="mt-4 p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)', border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)' }}>
            <div className="markdown prose prose-sm max-w-none">
              <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeRaw]}>
                {data.analysis}
              </ReactMarkdown>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {!data.analysis && data.status === 'completed' && (
          <div className="mt-4 p-4 rounded-lg text-center" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)', border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)' }}>
            <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
              {t('verified.view.noAnalysis')}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Metadata */}
        {data.model && (
          <div className="mt-4 text-11" style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary-weak)' }}>
            {t('verified.view.model')}: {data.model}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

Файл: homepage.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { ThemeContext } from '../components/ThemeProvider';

export default function Homepage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme } = React.useContext(ThemeContext);
  const [showJoin, setShowJoin] = React.useState(false);
  const [showSuccess, setShowSuccess] = React.useState(false);
  const [email, setEmail] = React.useState('');
  const [note, setNote] = React.useState('');
  const [sending, setSending] = React.useState(false);

  // Handle ESC key to close modals
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleEsc = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (showSuccess) {
          setShowSuccess(false);
        } else if (showJoin) {
          setShowJoin(false);
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleEsc);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEsc);
  }, [showJoin, showSuccess]);

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-body)',
        height: '100svh', /* Small viewport height - accounts for browser UI (address bar, tabs) */
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
      }}
    >
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 py-4 flex-1 flex items-center overflow-y-auto" style={{ minHeight: 0 }}>
        <div className="w-full flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-4 md:gap-8" style={{ alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
          {/* Left column */}
          <div className="w-full md:w-auto md:flex-[0_0_35%] flex justify-start md:justify-end" style={{ marginTop: '24px' }}>
            <div
              style={{
                backgroundColor: theme === 'dark' ? '#FFFFFF' : '#0A0A0F',
                color: theme === 'dark' ? '#0B0D12' : '#FFFFFF',
                padding: '8px 12px',
                fontSize: 'clamp(16px, 2vw, 22px)',
                fontWeight: 500,
                display: 'inline-block',
              }}
            >
              Human Above The Loop
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right column */}
          <div className="w-full md:flex-[0_0_65%]">
            <div
              className="font-semibold"
              style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)', fontSize: 'clamp(32px, 8vw, 96px)', lineHeight: 1.02, marginBottom: 'clamp(16px, 4vw, 32px)' }}
            >
              <span style={{ display: 'block' }}>A Whole</span>
              <span style={{ display: 'block' }}>Different</span>
              <span style={{ display: 'block' }}>Beast</span>
            </div>
            {/* Copy block */}
            <div className="mt-4" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-elevated)', padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 14px) clamp(14px, 2vw, 16px)', borderRadius: 8, marginBottom: 'clamp(16px, 4vw, 32px)', width: 'fit-content', maxWidth: '100%' }}>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{t('homepage.reclaimMind')}</div>
                <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>{t('homepage.tagline')}</div>
                <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>{t('homepage.description')}</div>
                <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>{t('homepage.description2')}</div>
                <div className="text-13" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{t('homepage.beta')}</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* CTA Row */}
            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <button
                className="rounded text-13"
                style={{ padding: '10px 16px', backgroundColor: 'transparent', color: 'var(--text-primary)', border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)' }}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-10)'; }}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'transparent'; }}
                onClick={() => setShowJoin(true)}
              >
                {t('homepage.requestAccess')}
              </button>
              <button
                className="rounded text-13"
                style={{ padding: '10px 16px', backgroundColor: 'transparent', color: 'var(--text-primary)', border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)' }}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'var(--white-10)'; }}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.backgroundColor = 'transparent'; }}
                onClick={() => navigate('/?app=unfold')}
              >
                {t('homepage.signIn')}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {showJoin && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
          <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--overlay-40)' }} onClick={() => setShowJoin(false)} />
          <div className="relative auth-card" style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 440 }}>
            <div>
              <div className="auth-title" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>{t('homepage.joinWaitlist')}</div>
              <input value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} className="auth-input" placeholder="you@example.com" />
              <div className="text-12" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginTop: '4px', marginBottom: '16px' }}>{t('homepage.emailPrivacyNote')}</div>
              <textarea value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} rows={3} className="auth-input" placeholder={t('homepage.contextPlaceholder')} />
              <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowJoin(false)}>{t('homepage.cancel')}</button>
                <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={sending || !email} onClick={async () => {
                  try {
                    setSending(true);
                    await (await import('../lib/api')).api.waitlistJoin({ email, note: note.trim() || undefined });
                    setShowJoin(false);
                    setShowSuccess(true);
                    setEmail(''); setNote('');
                  } catch (e) {
                    // Error handling can be added here if needed
                  } finally { setSending(false); }
                }}>{sending ? t('homepage.sending') : t('homepage.send')}</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      {showSuccess && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
          <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--overlay-40)' }} onClick={() => setShowSuccess(false)} />
          <div className="relative auth-card" style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 440 }}>
            <div>
              <div className="auth-title" style={{ marginBottom: 16, whiteSpace: 'pre-line' }}>{t('homepage.submitted')}</div>
              <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-end">
                <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={() => setShowSuccess(false)}>{t('homepage.close')}</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
